guidance.statement: Targeting Rs.80,000 Crores EBITDA for O2C segment in FY27

guidance.statement: New energy revenues expected from FY2028

capex.statement: Investing in dark stores, digital platforms, and supply chain for online business scale-up

other.statement: NBR expansion targeting commissioning by April 2027; SBR latex plant expected in Q2 FY28; utilization to ramp over 2-3 years.
other.quote: As I mentioned earlier, our goal is about April ' 27. So, we are on track right now on April ' 27. And the utilization will slowly ramp up over maybe two to three years, obviously, till we get to full capacity utilization. We hope earlier, but our thinking is two to three years.

other.statement: Buying butadiene from IOCL regularly; styrene monomer project at IOCL still far away and not yet in commercial discussions.
other.quote: We are buying butadiene from IOCL, so we are very much in touch with them regularly. I think the styrene project is still a while away, and I do not think it is going to be enough for the entire country. guidance.statement: EBITDA margin expected around 70% for FY27
guidance.quote: We are expecting this to be substantially better this year, largely due to commodity prices being good, but also because we have maintained fiscal discipline. So, hopefully, Raajeev will say it, but I think it should be around 70% mark, if I am not wrong, the EBITDA margin.

guidance.statement: Exit production target of 2,500 boepd for FY27 and 5,000 boepd by FY29
guidance.quote: We are hoping that this year we will exit at around 2,500 that is the guidance we are reasonably sure that we should be able to deliver on our promise to you of ramping up to 2,500 barrels of oil gas equivalent production from our portfolio.

demand.statement: Oil price realized at $88.2/bbl in Q2 vs $95.3/bbl in Q1; gas at $8.84/MMBtu vs $10.33/MMBtu
demand.quote: Our realized oil price averaged $88.2 per barrel in Q2 against $95.3 per barrel in Q1. It moved sharply within this quarter. About $76 is what we realized in July. $84 is what we realized in August and around $100 plus is what we realized in September. Gas realizations which move in line with the oil prices also fell from $10.33 per MMBtu which was our average realization in Q1 to $8.84 per MMBtu

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 71% (69% ex-one-off)
margin.quote: EBITDA was Rs.90 crores, almost 3x to what we reported in Q2 last year with a margin at about 71%.

capex.statement: Capex guidance of Rs.250 crores for FY27
capex.quote: we went to Rs.87 crores, then Rs.220 crores, hopefully Rs.250 crores this year

product_mix.statement: Karjisan has concessional royalty/cess (<5% vs ~30% in Bakrol), giving 2x P&L impact per barrel
product_mix.quote: Karjisan is an interesting field for us because Karjisan has the best fiscals in our portfolio as of today, because it has concessional Cess and royalty rates to it, because it is still in its primary term as a production-sharing contract. So, Karjisan will end up having a lopsided positive impact on our P&L. Actually, every barrel of Karjisan adds 2x the barrel of Bakrol.

fund_raise.statement: KG/offshore funding undecided; may consider debt or capital raise depending on ramp-up appetite
fund_raise.quote: Too early to say. I think it will depend upon our appetite of ramp-up. I mean, you can always fund any sort of a growth through internal accruals. That takes long. other.statement: Exit production trajectory: FY24 exit 982 boepd, FY25 exit 1,200 boepd, FY26 exit 1,758 boepd, FY27 target 2,500 boepd, FY28 target 3,500 boepd, FY29 target 5,000 boepd
other.quote: In Fiscal Year '2024, we exited there at around 982 barrels. The next year, we exited around 1,200 barrels. That went up to 1,758 barrels. We are hoping that will go to 2,500 barrels this year. Next year, that should be around 3,500 barrels. Thereafter, that should be 5,000 barrels.

other.statement: Private buyer sales used to manage working capital at slightly higher discount to dated Brent
other.value: working capital management via private sales
other.quote: Of late, what we have seen is that their ability to purchase crude oil at higher prices is limited. And that we have witnessed over the last couple of quarters when crude oil started inching towards $100 a barrel. guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth guided at 15-20% YoY; operating margin target to reach FY25 levels by Q4 FY27 and ~8% by Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: Like guided earlier, our growth will be between 15% to 20% from the previous year sales. We are confident of achieving that.

guidance.statement: 5-year vision to reach INR 5,000 cr revenue by FY31 through Narmadapuram expansion, domestic penetration and export presence
guidance.quote: We remain firmly focused on our 5-year vision of reaching revenues of INR 5,000 crores by FY31 through capacity expansion at Narmadapuram, deeper domestic penetration and broader export presence.

guidance.statement: U.S. exports expected at 25-30% of FY27 revenue; Narmadapuram partial commissioning in Q1 FY28 with ~INR 500 cr revenue in FY28 scaling to ~INR 1,200 cr in FY29
guidance.quote: We expect U.S. exports to constitute 25% to 30% of our revenues for the full FY27, and we will continue to grow U.S. revenues in a measured way rather than pressing the accelerator too hard.

demand.statement: Structural drivers strong: grid strengthening, renewables, railways/metro, data centers; multiyear programs reflected in inquiries and order flow
demand.quote: Transmission and distribution investments, renewable capacity addition, railways and metro electrification, and the buildout of large data centers all remain supportive throughout the quarter.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 operating margin 7.3% vs 6.6% Q1 FY27 and 1.3% Q2 FY26; target to exceed FY25 operating margins by Q4 FY27 and reach ~8% operating margin by Q4 FY27
margin.quote: Operating profit for the quarter was INR 40.9 crores with an operating margin of 7.3% as against 6.6% in Q1 FY27 and 1.3% in Q2 FY26.

margin.statement: HTLS product carries double-digit margins; INR 200 cr+ HTLS order book to aid margin improvement; HTLS to help exceed FY25 margins more comfortably
margin.quote: HTLS by itself could give us double-digit margins. But then HTLS order book is roughly INR200 crores as of now.

order_book.statement: Order book INR 731 cr as of 30 Sep 2026 (INR 632 cr domestic, INR 99 cr export); Power Cable & specialized conductors INR 575 cr; HTLS order book INR 200 cr+ as of date
order_book.quote: Our order book as of 30th September '26 stood at INR 731 crores, comprising INR 632 crores of domestic orders and INR 99 crores of export orders.

pricing_cost.statement: Metal booking discipline: firm-price orders booked next working day; no firm-price orders beyond 3-4 months delivery; aluminum >75% of metal value consumption; aluminum softened in quarter
pricing_cost.quote: The day we receive a firm-price order, the next working day we book the metal, and mostly, we do not accept firm-price orders beyond 3 to 4 months delivery.

product_mix.statement: HTLS (carbon-core and gap-type up to 765 kV), EHV cables up to 220 kV, e-beam cables, rubber cables identified as margin-accretive growth segments; Narmadapuram to house these
product_mix.quote: Narmadapuram is what allows us to move up the value chain with EHV cables up to 220 kV, specialized conductors, including HTLS and e-beam cables.

risk.statement: Metal price volatility and global trade environment remain key challenges; HTLS execution involves EPC/installation with potentially longer deliveries; 220 kV approvals take 1-1.5 years
risk.quote: The wires and cable industry continued to navigate two familiar challenges this quarter- metal price volatility and the global trade environment that is still settling down.

other.statement: National Electricity Plan projects INR 5 lakh cr investment in EHV transmission lines 2027-2032; management estimates HTLS reconductoring market ~INR 50,000 cr over next 5 years
other.quote: As per our internal assessment of the tenders announced by multiple utilities, state governments and central government authorities, the management projects the market size for reconductoring projects of HTLS to be approximately INR 50,000 crores in the next 5 years.

other.statement: Data center approvals established with leading developers representing substantial share of hyperscale/colocation capex; approvals with others progressing
other.quote: We have established approvals with leading data center developers and the customers where we are approved, represent a substantial share of the hyperscale and colocation capex being planned in the country.

guidance.statement: Consolidated FY27 capex increased to about INR150 crores across fasteners, DC contactors and MCUs
guidance.quote: We are also increasing our overall FY27 capex to about INR150 crores across all our businesses of fasteners, DC contactors and MCUs.

demand.statement: CV segment strong traction, particularly high volumes from a marquee customer driving outperformance
demand.quote: A key driver has been strong traction in the CV segment, particularly high volumes from a marquee customer.

demand.statement: Stand-alone revenue grew 32% YoY in Q2 FY27 vs industry 18%; H1 grew 28% vs industry 20%
demand.quote: While industry sales grew by approximately 18% in Q2 FY27, our stand-alone revenue increased by around 32% year-on-year basis.

margin.statement: H1 EBITDA up 17% YoY to INR58.7 crores; Q2 EBITDA up 8% YoY to INR27.7 crores; PAT lower due to exceptional gain in prior year
margin.quote: Our H1 EBITDA increased by 17% year-on-year to INR58.7 crores, whereas for Q2 FY27, EBITDA increased to INR27.7 crores, reflecting a growth of around 8% Y-o-Y.

margin.statement: Fastener EBITDA margin historically 15-16%; hope to maintain but exceptional inflation may cause marginal pressure this year
margin.quote: On the fasteners business, we've been hovering between 15% and 16% EBITDA. Like I said a little while ago, we hope to maintain that. But this year is an exceptional year.

margin.statement: Near-term margin pressure from input cost inflation; low-cost inventory exhausted in Q1; pass-through with time lag
margin.quote: As discussed on our previous earnings calls, we exhausted most of our earlier low-cost inventory in Q1. At the same time, commodity and non-commodity input costs have increased significantly amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.

order_book.statement: SEM targeting INR150 crores annual revenue for breakeven; expect to outperform in FY28
order_book.quote: Once we reach a revenue of INR150 crores plus, we'll probably achieve breakeven point at that time.

order_book.statement: SEM production lines for onboard chargers and multifunction units commissioned in Q2; revenue ramp from Q3/Q4 as customer SOPs start
order_book.quote: The production lines for onboard chargers and multifunction units scheduled for commissioning in Q2 has been commissioned as planned.

order_book.statement: STML commercial supplies of high-voltage DC contactors and relays commenced in Q2 FY27 as scheduled
order_book.quote: Commercial supplies, which were scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27, have now commenced.

capex.statement: Fastener capex plan raised from INR80 crores to about INR110 crores; INR25 crores already incurred
capex.quote: Against our earlier capex plan of INR80 crores for fasteners business, we have already incurred about INR25 crores and our total fastener capex plans within the range of about INR110 crores now.

capex.statement: SEM capex INR20 crores and STML capex INR10 crores included in consolidated INR150 crores
capex.value: INR20 crores SEM, INR10 crores STML
capex.quote: So our overall capex at a consolidated level will be about INR150 crores. INR20 crores is going to happen at SEM and about INR10-odd crores at STML.

capex.statement: Stand-alone fastener capex ramped up to INR120 crores for FY27; expected to add roughly INR150 crores revenue capacity
capex.quote: Our -- on our stand-alone fasteners business, the initial capex plan was INR80 crores, which has been ramped up to maybe close to more like INR130 crores this year -- sorry, INR120 crores this year.

pricing_cost.statement: Price pass-through negotiations ongoing with OEMs; some agreed, some under negotiation, some retrospective; expect substantial compensation in H2
pricing_cost.quote: We are negotiating with our customers for price increases, not only on account of steel, which is a normal practice running for years, but this year exceptional item is inflation and cost increases.

pricing_cost.statement: Price recovery expected in Q3 and Q4 with retrospective effect
pricing_cost.quote: Correct. And some of those price increases will have a retrospective effect as well.

risk.statement: Inflation, potential interest rate increases, geopolitical uncertainties remain key factors to watch for industry
risk.quote: However, inflation, potential interest rate increases and geopolitical uncertainties remain important factors to watch.

risk.statement: AEM advanced motor PoC delayed; one PoC expected by end-November, second put on hold by customer due to inflationary pressure
risk.quote: One PoC is delayed, but expected to be completed by the end of November. The second PoC has been put on hold by the customer because of the inflationary pressure that they were facing.

other.statement: Industry Q2 FY27 domestic sales grew ~18% YoY to 83.88 lakh units; H2 expected positive momentum from festive demand, new launches, infra spending, fleet replacement
other.quote: The Indian automobile industry recorded its highest ever second quarter sales across major vehicle segments in Q2 FY27. Domestic sales grew approximately 18% year-on-year to 83.88 lakh units.

other.statement: Fastener business has all major OEMs onboarded; focus on increasing share of wallet and new product development
other.quote: We are already working with pretty much all the customers. There are no major customers to be acquired in that fasteners space.

guidance.statement: NIM guidance 3.85-3.95% for Q3 and Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: Hence, we project NIM in the range of 3.85% to 3.95% for Q3 and Q4.

guidance.statement: ROA expected above 1.6% for FY27
guidance.quote: ROA is expected to move above 1.6% plus range.

guidance.statement: Cost-to-income ratio guidance 45-47% for FY27
guidance.quote: Our cost-to-income will largely be in the range of 45% to 47% for FY27.

guidance.statement: Credit growth target 2-3% above industry level
guidance.quote: We are very conscious with improving our credit growth through secured lending while venturing into other avenues to achieve the credit growth of 2%, 3% above the industry.

margin.statement: NIM increased to 3.87% in 2QFY27 from 3.78% in 1QFY27
margin.quote: Thus, our NIM has increased from 3.78% in 1QFY27 to 3.87% in 2QFY27.

margin.statement: Yield on advances improved to 9.85% in 2QFY27 from 9.79% in 1QFY27
margin.quote: Our yield on advances improved to 9.85% in 2QFY27 from 9.79% in 1QFY27.

margin.statement: Cost of deposits remained stagnant at 5.56% in 2QFY27
margin.quote: At the same time, the cost of deposits remained stagnant at 5.56% for 2QFY27 when compared to 1QFY27.

order_book.statement: Advances grew 26% YoY to INR 72,442 crores in 2QFY27
order_book.quote: We had registered 26% advance growth in 2QFY27 year-on-year, and our advance have increased to INR 72,442 crores from INR 57,561 crores in 2QFY26.

order_book.quote: Our core strength, MSME, has increased by INR 2,600 crores, that is, from INR 40,262 crores to INR 42,862 crores.

order_book.statement: Secured retail loans grew by INR 1,134 crores to INR 7,802 crores
order_book.quote: And the new segment, secured retail loans, increased by INR 1,134 crores, that is, from INR 6,668 crores to INR 7,802 crores.

capex.statement: Branch network expanded to 1,000+ branches from 800, new branches delivering consistently
capex.quote: We were at 800 branches. Now, as of today, we are at 1,000-plus branches. The newly opened branches have started delivering quite consistently.

pricing_cost.statement: Deposit cost expected to increase by 10 bps next quarter
pricing_cost.quote: We foresee 10 bps increase there, sir.

risk.statement: Contingent provision of INR 50 crores made for unseen economic uncertainties
risk.quote: The bank has made a contingent provision of INR 50 crores during this quarter, specifically designed for unseen economic uncertainties in future.

other.statement: Gross NPA reduced to 1.44% in 2QFY27 from 1.73% in 1QFY27
other.quote: Our Gross NPA percentage has reduced to 1.44% in 2QFY27 from 1.73% in 1QFY27 which is 29 bps reduction.

other.statement: Slippages INR 175 crores vs recoveries INR 317 crores in 2QFY27
other.quote: For Q2 FY27, the total slippages are INR 175 crores, while the total recoveries for Q2 stood at INR 317 crores, consisting of INR 180 crores from live NPA accounts and INR 137 crores from technically written-off accounts, resulting in negative credit cost.

guidance.statement: No forward-looking statements given for DIFC and Barjeel AMC AUM expectations for H2 FY27
guidance.quote: We do not give any forward-looking statement. DIFC is still in a very nascent stage, so it may take time. Nonetheless, we don't give any forward-looking statement, sir.

guidance.statement: Plan to significantly increase recurring revenue income over next 3-5 years to reduce cyclicality risk; long-term strategy not dependent on geopolitical trends
guidance.quote: No, our plan is to significantly increase the recurring revenue income. This will eventually take care of the cyclicality risk as far as our cash flows are concerned. So, this is part of a long-term strategy that we have built in.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 priorities: increase productivity of existing people, expand cross-selling opportunities aggressively; no numerical guidance given
guidance.quote: So second half, we will focus on increase in productivity. As I told in the beginning of the conference, and Mr. Menon had told you, that the cross-selling opportunity that we are taking advantage is only minimum at this stage. We intend to expand aggressively and increase the focus on cross-selling so that the productivity increase can come within the customer base itself if there are challenges.

demand.statement: Customer assets stood at INR 1.12 lakh crores as of September end, broadly stable sequentially despite healthy gross inflows offset by market correction
demand.quote: Customer assets stood at INR1.12 lakhs crores as of September end. Sequentially, reported customer assets were broadly stable. Healthy gross inflows continued during the quarter, but market correction, especially in the month of September, offset some of the underlying inflows.

demand.statement: Transaction-based income outlook: 80% from cash market (90% delivery), 20% from derivatives; focus on long-term wealth creation not day trading/F&O; delivery volumes 50%+ of cash market
demand.quote: When we look at Geojit capital market business, of our cash market volumes, 50% or plus is delivery business. And if you look at the split between equities and derivatives, in terms of income, derivatives constitutes around 20% of the total income, 80% comes from cash, of which 90% comes from delivery business.

demand.statement: GCC business seeing wait-and-watch mode due to geopolitical situation and currency depreciation; no major redemptions observed
demand.quote: We have observed that attractive FCNR deposit offering and market conditions were influencing the allocation of investment across prod ucts. Rupee movement and global investment opportunities have also shaped client preferences, including interest rates in the US. We have not noticed any major redemptions in our overseas

margin.statement: Q2 revenue INR 165.82 crores up 2.5% Y-o-Y and 3.38% sequentially; EBITDA INR 36.7 crores; H1 revenue up 6.72%, EBITDA INR 78.23 crores; margins pressured by higher operating costs and lower transaction-linked activity
margin.quote: For H1, revenue from operation increased by 6.72%, and EBITDA stood at INR78.23 crores. The half-year performance reflects top-line resilience alongside higher operating cost and lower transaction-linked activity in the cash market.

order_book.statement: Recurring revenue AUM reached INR 26,737 crores in H1 FY27, up from INR 23,230 crores at end of FY26
order_book.quote: Recurring revenue AUM reached INR 26,737 crores in H1, which is split across mutual fund, overseas AUM, Smartfolio, PMS, and AIF. This is compared to INR 23,230 in the end of FY26.

order_book.statement: Lending book stood at INR 780 crores as of end of Q2 FY27 compared to INR 735 crores year back
order_book.quote: Our lending book stood at INR 780 crores as of end of quarter two compared to INR 735 crores year back.

order_book.statement: Mutual fund SIP book reached INR 156 crores with approximately 1.78 lakh SIP clients
order_book.quote: In the mutual fund distribution business, our SIP book reached INR 156 crores, and the number of SIP clients is approximately INR1.78 lakhs.

capex.statement: Investing in technology platforms, IT capabilities, digital onboarding, analytics and operational efficiency; employee benefit expense increased by INR 8.17 crores Y-o-Y due to higher sales headcount, DIFC recruitment, IT team expansion and
capex.quote: Employee benefit expense increased by INR 8.17 crores Y-o-Y. This increase was mainly attributable to a higher sales personal headcount, recruitment for our DIFC subsidiary, and expansion of the IT team to support the technology transformation program, and of course, higher incentive in line with the growth of distribution business.

capex.statement: Technology investments are imperative for competitive edge; legacy systems being replaced; branch expansion not aggressive in current market; branches predominantly in Tier 2/3 with lower cost
capex.quote: Technology investments are must investments that we are undertaking at this stage. In order to gain market edge in terms of the technology platform as well as the features and products that we have, we need to make investments, and some of the legacy investments are being replaced to gain competitive edge in the market.

product_mix.statement: Cross-selling focus: only 20% clients hold more than one product; less than 5% penetrated for life insurance and less than 3% for health insurance; mutual fund penetration priority
product_mix.quote: We have close to 20% of our clients who have invested through us in more than one product. And primarily that is brokerage and mutual fund, which is the overlapping one. We have right now penetrated less than 5% of our clients for life insurance and less than 3% for health insurance.

other.statement: Recurring income in H1 FY27 is 40% of total income, up from 25% in FY23
other.quote: Recurring income in H1 is 40% of the total income, which has grown consistently over the last few years. Just for comparison, recurring income was 25% of the total income in FY23; now it is 40%.

other.statement: Hiring in technology and field force to be cautious going forward; focus on improving productivity of existing employees rather than aggressive headcount expansion
other.quote: we'll be very cautious in terms of in terms of aggressively increasing the employee count. Our main focus right now is to improve the productivity of the existing employees and having a close look at the cost incurred on these employees

guidance.statement: Capex around INR300 crores for FY27, slightly lower for FY28
guidance.quote: Yes. I mean it should be around the INR300 crores mark. If you look at our spends have reduced from Q1 into Q2, and we expect it to be more closer around the INR300 crores mark by the end of the year.

guidance.statement: Net finance cost expected INR40-45 crores range for H2 FY27
guidance.quote: It will be within a range between that INR40 crores to INR45 crores.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 expected stronger than H1 for US business
guidance.quote: Overall, we expect a better H2 for the US business.

guidance.statement: Cash conversion cycle expected to improve back to historic levels by next quarter
guidance.quote: We believe that the cash cycle engines should be back in the next quarter itself.

demand.statement: Ex-US demand and order books across key markets remain healthy
demand.quote: demand and order books across our key Ex-US markets remain healthy.

demand.statement: US B2B partner business saw strong order book and meaningful new business wins
demand.quote: Our B2B partner business saw a strong order book, and we secured meaningful new business wins during the quarter, from a partnered product, our recent launches and other key molecules in our portfolio.

margin.statement: Gross margin 56% in Q2 FY27, H1 at 58.3%; confident of sustaining H1 gross margins going forward
margin.quote: Our material costs rose to 44% of revenues in Q2 from 42.2% last year, reflecting the increase in raw material costs that Badree described. This moderated our gross margins to 56% for Q2. Importantly, for the first half, gross margins stood at a healthy 58.3%.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin 17.6% in Q2 FY27, compressed by higher material, freight and supply chain costs
margin.quote: Our EBITDA for the quarter was INR251 crores, our highest ever at a margin of 17.6%. Higher material, freight and supply chain costs linked to the geopolitical situation compressed our margins and tempered the flow-through of a very strong revenue growth, but it did not hold back the growth in our absolute profitability.

margin.statement: Ex-US margins slightly higher than company average EBITDA
margin.quote: It should be slightly higher than the company average in terms of the EBITDA because it depends on the B2B as well as the B2C markets. Overall, I think the gross margins and the EBITDA are good in these markets.

order_book.statement: Ex-US revenue reached INR6,963M in Q2 FY27, up 31% YoY; H1 up 24% YoY to INR12,838M
order_book.quote: Ex -US revenue for Q2 reached ₹6,963 million, an outstanding 31% growth year -on-year. For H1, revenue was ₹12,838 million, up 24% year -on-year.

order_book.statement: US revenue INR6,855M ($73M) in Q2 FY27, up 9% YoY and QoQ; H1 up 7% YoY to INR13,137M
order_book.quote: Revenue for Q2 stood at ₹6,855 million, or $73 million, growing 9% year -on-year and 9% quarter -on-quarter. For H1, US revenue was ₹13,137 million, up 7% year-on-year.

capex.statement: Capex and intangibles INR208 crores deployed in H1 FY27 for differentiated pipeline including nasal spray, transdermal patch, controlled substances
capex.quote: At the same time, we continue to invest in our future, deploying INR208 crores in capex and intangibles to support our growth platforms. Including our nasal spray and transdermal patch programs, these investments are directed at the differentiated pipeline Badree outlined, including our controlled substances opportunity, which will broaden our addressable market and support margin accretive growth

pricing_cost.statement: Material costs rose to 44% of revenue in Q2 from 42.2% last year due to geopolitical situation; alternate sourcing and procurement initiatives underway
pricing_cost.quote: Our material costs rose to 44% of revenues in Q2 from 42.2% last year, reflecting the increase in raw material costs that Badree described.

product_mix.statement: US portfolio shifting to higher-margin differentiated products; 40+ value-accretive products in active pipeline with filings through FY30
product_mix.quote: As I mentioned earlier, our US portfolio is steadily shifting toward higher-margin, differentiated products. We have more than 40 value-accretive products in our active pipeline, with filings and approvals planned in a phased manner and commercialisation through FY30.

product_mix.statement: Controlled substances portfolio: 5 commercialized products (6% of US revenue, $750M market); 10+ pipeline products across nasal sprays, patches, films expanding addressable market to $4.5B
product_mix.quote: Today, our five commercialised CS products, all oral solid tablets, contribute about 6% of our US revenue an d address a market of around $750 million. While this portfolio is constrained by quota allocations, we have more than 10 CS products in our pipeline across multiple domains, including nasal sprays, patches and films, which will expand our addressable mark et to around $4.5 billion, about s

other.statement: Chestnut Ridge facility has capacity and expertise for US-manufactured controlled substance products including nasal sprays, patches and films
other.quote: Regulations require these products to be manufactured in the US, and our Chestnut Ridge facility already has the capacity and expertise to do exactly that.

other.statement: Industry-leading service levels central to winning/retaining business with largest US customers and partners
other.quote: We continue to deliver industry -leading service levels to all our customers. This is a real competitive advantage, and it is central to winning and retaining business with some of the largest customers and partners in the market.

guidance.statement: Ash & Coal Handling revenue growth target 20-25% YoY for FY27 and FY28
guidance.quote: As we have spoken in the earlier call also, we'll have 20% to 25% of the revenue growth in the years to come.

guidance.statement: Wind energy EBITDA margin 4-5% and PAT margin 2.5-3% for FY27 and H1 FY28
guidance.quote: we have EBITDA margin of 4% to 5%, PAT margin of 2.5% to 3% over there. For in the current financial year and the coming financial year till half year.

guidance.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin 15-18% for FY27
guidance.quote: Our EBITDA margin in the stand-alone basis will be between 15% to 18%, which we have spoken during all all the previous call.

margin.statement: RMC segment expected to contribute to profitability from FY28; FY27 focused on plant setup and team building
margin.quote: RMC segment will start contributing to the overall profitability from the coming financial year and it will contribute a good amount to the total profitability. In the current financial year, it will go towards the setting up of the new plant and establishing the team across the location.

order_book.statement: Large wind energy order in final price negotiation, expected closure in 30-45 days
order_book.quote: We are in the final stage of price negotiation. Project execution and ROW issue or land issue, I mean, won't come to us because we are only the equipment supplier. And we are in the final price negotiations closure stage for the large volume of the order. I mean we should close within next 30 days to 45 days time, and we'll announce the sale with it.

capex.statement: RMC business uses capital-light lease-based model with zero capex for plants
capex.quote: Importantly, we are adopting a capital-light lease-based model that enables us to scale without significant investment in fixed assets. We believe this is the right way to build the business.

capex.statement: Wind energy indigenous manufacturing plant operational in 12-14 months, margin impact after 18-24 months
capex.quote: Manufacturing plant should be operational within 12 to 14 months. And there will be a real impact of that will take an other 6 months after that on the profitability. Certainly, that will be a good impact on the profitability, after 1 year, 1.5 years in the books of account.

risk.statement: Monsoon impacts Q2 ash handling volumes (35,000-40,000 MT in Q2 vs 90,000 target); seasonal revenue fluctuation expected
risk.quote: This Q2 was quite less. It was around 35,000 to 40,000. And volume started going up, though there in some part, there was a tsunami or the rain going on for last 1 week, but volume started going up.

other.statement: Pune RMC plant targeting 4,000-4,500 cubic meters per month
other.quote: We should anticipate volumes of almost about 4,000, 4,500 cubic meters per month from this plant alone.

other.statement: India installed wind capacity reached 59.2 GW as of Sep 2026
other.quote: As a result, the country total installed wind capacity reached 59.2 gigawatts as on September 2026.

guidance.statement: Operating cash flow for FY27 expected to be higher than FY26
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining healthy cash flows in the coming quarters and outlook to generate operating cash flow from operations for the entire financial year higher than that of FY26.

guidance.statement: Reiterated FY27 presales guidance of INR9,000 crores; H1 achieved ~INR2,900 crores, targeting ~INR7,000 crores in H2
guidance.quote: For now, we reiterate the INR9,000 crores presales guidance.

guidance.statement: Expects FY27 residential revenue recognition of ~INR5,000 crores with EBITDA margin 22-24%
guidance.quote: It should be INR5,000 crores in rough order of magnitude.

guidance.statement: Office portfolio to grow from 9.5M to 12.5M sq ft operational by FY29; rental income expected ~INR1,700 cr in FY29
guidance.quote: By FY29, we expect that to grow to 12.4 million square feet. So if I add even the retail, there we'll be adding a smaller amount. So I would just say 12.5 million square feet, you can expect from 9.5 million to 12.5 million.

demand.statement: Residential demand remains strong; IT sector job losses not impacting demand as talent shifts to GCCs; premiumization trend continues
demand.quote: We've been maintaining for a long time that despite the net hiring in IT and IT sector and certain companies not being positive, it has not really impacted demand. In fact, demand has actually become more premium while also maintaining growth.

margin.statement: FY27 Real Estate EBITDA margin expected 22-24%
margin.quote: So the margin profile of the entire FY27 would -- in real estate would be in that early 20s, between 22% and 24%, which is what was there in H1 as well.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 38% in Q2 FY27 from 26% in Q2 FY26 (+1,200 bps); Real Estate EBITDA margin 24% vs 12% YoY
margin.quote: Consolidated revenue for the quarter stood at INR1,250 crores with EBITDA of INR478 crores. The EBITDA margin improved to 38% compared with 26% in Q2 of FY26, an improvement of 1,200 basis points.

order_book.statement: H2 launch pipeline of 7 million sq ft with GDV of INR7,600 crores; includes 2 large Bengaluru townships (~INR3,800 crores combined), 1M sq ft each in Chennai and Hyderabad
order_book.quote: We have INR9,800 crores of inventory in addition to another 7 million square feet or INR7,600 crores Gross Developmental Value (GDV) of launches planned for the second half of the financial year.

order_book.statement: H1 business development added ~12.5-13M sq ft (~INR13,000 cr GDV); balance land payable ~INR2,000+ cr over ~1 year (some JDA milestone-dependent)
order_book.quote: We have added about 12.5 million, 13 million square feet totally in this financial year for the first half, of which close to about 10 million square feet has come in Q2. This would approximately translate to about INR13,000 crores of GDV.

capex.statement: Office capex phasing: INR400 cr in H2 FY27, INR1,500 cr in FY28, INR1,500 cr in FY29; post-FY29 projects include WTC Hyderabad, Brigade Industrial Park, Brigade Icon commercial
capex.quote: Balance capex we have to spend for the office in the remaining H2 of '27 is about INR400 crores. In '28, we are expected to spend about INR1,500 crores. And in '29, we're expected to spend another INR1,500 crores.

capex.statement: Land payments INR440 cr in Q2 split ~half Bengaluru, half Hyderabad; West & East Bengaluru focus
capex.quote: It's almost half and half between Bangalore and Hyderabad.

pricing_cost.statement: Average realization up 29% YoY to INR13,841/sq ft driven by disciplined pricing and premium mix shift
pricing_cost.quote: Average realization stood at INR13,841 per square foot, a strong 29% year-on-year improvement, driven by disciplined pricing increases in our existing projects and a sustained shift in contribution of higher-end homes in our overall product mix.

pricing_cost.statement: WTC Bengaluru & Twin Towers re-leasing at ~15% higher rents; annual escalations ~5%
pricing_cost.quote: New leases that we are doing, we are re-leasing the same space at around 15% higher than what it was getting us.

product_mix.statement: H2 launches skewed to INR1-2 cr ticket size (sweet spot); Bengaluru projects largely INR1-1.5 cr (North) and INR2 cr; ~20% at INR3 cr
product_mix.quote: Some of our upcoming launches are in that INR1 crores to INR2 crores range, which is a sweet spot for many customers, especially in Bangalore and Chennai.

fund_raise.statement: Bain Capital invested in SPV Vibrancy Real Estates; entity reclassified from subsidiary to JV, investment accounted via equity method (INR317 cr)
fund_raise.quote: So this is investment which came from Bain Capital's fund in first quarter in a SPV called Vibrancy Real Estates Private Limited.

risk.statement: Chennai launch approvals may slip to next fiscal due to government change; one of two Q4 projects at risk
risk.quote: The other one, we're still working to try and get it within Q4, but that one might get pushed out into the next financial year.

other.statement: Retail: Orion Mall portfolio 94% trading occupancy; retailer sales +16% YoY; footfall steady
other.quote: Our Orion Mall portfolio delivered a steady quarter at 94% trading occupancy. Retailer sales across the portfolio grew 16% year-on-year, led by stronger electronics and restaurant sales, while mall footfall remained steady.

other.statement: Facility Management (Aureya): manages 16M sq ft, revenue INR71 cr, EBITDA 30%
other.quote: Aureya FM Services, our in-house facility management company now manages 16 million square feet with a revenue of INR71 crores and EBITDA of 30% in this quarter.

guidance.statement: Exports expected to sustain at ~7.5 lakh units per quarter
guidance.quote: We expect to sustain this going forward.

demand.statement: Domestic 2W industry grew 18% YoY in Apr-Aug; festive Sep-Dec expected double-digit but lower than 18% due to base effect
demand.quote: 2 -wheeler industry, including electric scooters, demonstrated healthy Y oY growth of 18% in April to August

demand.statement: EV scooter penetration at 25% of scooter category; Chetak retail hit 45,000 in September despite capacity constraints
demand.quote: The industry continued to grow rapidly at 75% plus in Q2 and penetration of electric scooters is now 25% of the scooter category.

order_book.statement: Exports crossed 7.8 lakh units in Q2 FY27, up 41% YoY; second consecutive quarter above 7 lakh
order_book.quote: The BU crossed its highest ever volume of 7.8 lakh units in Q2, a growth of 41% year -on-year. This is the second consecutive quarter above 7,00,000 units.

capex.statement: Overall capacity expanding from 6.25 lakh to 7.75 lakh units per month over next 6-9 months
capex.quote: The overall capacity of 6,25,000 units per month is being expanded to about 7,75,000 units per month over the next 6 to 9 months in a phased manner.

pricing_cost.statement: Input cost inflation impact 3-3.5% of revenue in Q2; cumulative H1 impact exceptionally steep
pricing_cost.quote: Taken together, the impact of commodity and other input cost inflation in quarter 2 was in the whereabouts of between 3% and 3.5% of revenue.

pricing_cost.statement: Calibrated pricing covered 50-60% of H1 inflation impact; balance offset by currency and cost optimization
pricing_cost.quote: We have responded through calibrated pricing actions, which really have covered about between 50% and 60% of the inflationary impact over this first half.

product_mix.statement: Two new brands spanning 125-250cc planned for launch in FY27; Pulsar portfolio refresh targeted by end of festive
product_mix.quote: In addition, we will have 2 new brands in the pipeline, spanning the 125cc to 250cc space getting lined up for launch in FY27.

product_mix.statement: New Pulsar launches (125, 150, 160 upgrades) now 33% of 125cc+ portfolio in early festive, up from 7% in August
product_mix.quote: The share of new launches in our 125cc plus portfolio was 7% in August. It grew to 26% in September. And in the first 16 days of festive, it has further grown to 33%.

risk.statement: Input cost inflation persists into Q3 across metals, proprietary parts, electrical components; magnitude hard to quantify
risk.quote: We've entered the third consecutive quarter of an exceptionally challenging operating environment with input cost inflation, showing no real signs or immediate signs of easing.

risk.statement: Currency headwind if INR stays below 95; will not take pricing to cover currency moves
risk.quote: if the currency were to be a bit of a headwind, we will not take pricing action to cover currency movement because we know it's a very short-term transient measure.

other.statement: Chetak capacity expanding to 80,000 per month by Q4 FY27
other.quote: We are expanding Chetak capacity to 80,000 per month by quarter 4, which will help us get market share and unlock new reach.

other.statement: Realized USD/INR at 95.5 in Q2 vs 94.4 in Q1 and 87.1 YoY; October realizations below 95.5
other.quote: The rupee depreciated through quarter 2 with our realized USD INR rate coming in at INR95.5 versus 94.4 in the previous quarter and 87.1 in the same quarter last year.

guidance.statement: 18% CAGR targeted over next 2-3 years supported by CapEx projects and mining reserves
guidance.quote: The 18% CAGR is definitely in place with the projects and the mining reserves we have started to acquire. Given the unpredictability in the current situation, which will hopefully smooth out in the coming quarters, that should help us regain the CAGR we have anticipated over the next two to three years.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth expected to continue in H2 FY27; no specific FY27 revenue or margin numbers given due to market unpredictability
guidance.quote: No, we are not able to as of now, because of the current situation in the markets. It is quite unpredictable, and costs are also difficult to project. So we cannot put out a specific figure, but it will definitely be better than H1, for sure

capex.statement: Malaysia quarry capacity expansion from 4,000 MT to 8,000 MT expected by FY29; plant commencement by FY30
capex.quote: On the Malaysia project, it is already ongoing. We are working on the quarry part, raising capacity from 4,000 MT to 8,000 MT, which we expect to achieve by FY29, and by FY30 the plant should also commence.

capex.statement: ₹100 crore CapEx programme 30% deployed; further ₹17 crore in Q3 FY27 on solar; funded by internal accruals and selective debt over 24 months
capex.quote: Let me now update you on our ₹100 crore CapEx programme. So far, we have deployed around 30% of the programme. This includes ₹12 crores on captive solar and ₹7 crores on the two mining acquisitions. In the current quarter, we expect to deploy a further ₹17 crores, all of it on solar. That will take us to nearly half of the programme by Q3. The CapEx programme is being funded through internal accru

pricing_cost.statement: Furnace oil cost rose 33% (₹42 to ₹56/kg) impacting ₹1.34 crore; gas cost rose 77% (₹69 to ₹122/kg) impacting ₹0.62 crore; freight/MT rose 11% (₹2,108 to ₹2,346) impacting ₹2.92 crore in Q2 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: In Q1, the furnace oil rate was around ₹42 per kg, and it has risen to ₹56 per kg – a rise of about 33%, an impact of ₹1.34 crores. Gas has risen from ₹69 to ₹122 per kg, around 77%, an impact of ₹0.62 crores. Freight per metric tonne has gone from ₹2,108 to ₹2,346, an 11% rise, an impact of around ₹2.92 crores.

product_mix.statement: Specialty products already contributing to margins; 20 Microns Nano grew double-digit with higher profitability in Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: The specialty products have already started to contribute to margins. You have to look at 20 Microns on a consolidated basis – if you look at 20 Microns Nano as an individual company, it has grown in double digits this quarter and its profitability has also increased.

risk.statement: Q3/Q4 margins hard to predict due to supply-chain disruptions, wars and upcoming midterm elections; wait-and-watch approach
risk.quote: For Q3 and Q4, as I mentioned, it is very hard to predict – not only for us but for all industries – given the ongoing supply-chain disruptions, the wars and the upcoming midterm elections. We don't know what's ahead, so it's a wait-and-watch situation; we hope things don't get worse.

other.statement: 9 MW captive solar plant (5.5 MW Rajasthan, 3.5 MW Gujarat) targeting Q4 FY27 commissioning; to meet ~40% power needs
other.quote: We are building 9 MW of captive solar capacity across two plants – 5.5 MW in Rajasthan and 3.5 MW in Gujarat. The total investment is about ₹29 crores and we are targeting commissioning in the fourth quarter of this financial year. Once running, solar should meet about 40% of our power needs.

other.statement: EBITDA margins consistently between 12-14% for over a decade despite pandemic, supply-chain disruptions and energy/freight cost swings
other.quote: Through a pandemic, supply-chain disruptions and sharp swings in energy and freight costs, our EBITDA margins have stayed between 12% and 14% year after year for over a decade.

guidance.statement: 30 GW target by 2030 underwritten by locked-in pipeline; growth beyond 2030 driven by Salboni thermal, 920 MW Punatsangchhu-III hydro (Bhutan), pumped storage 26.4 GWh, thermal & C&I opportunities.
guidance.quote: Looking further ahead, our locked -in pipeline gives us clear line of sight to our 30 GW target for 2030, and our growth runway extends well beyond it. Multiple drivers support our growth beyond 2030: the Salboni thermal project; the 920 MW Punatsangchhu -III hydro project, our first cross-border generation venture, being developed in partnership with Druk Green Power Corporation, Bhutan's state-o

demand.statement: Power demand grew 11.1% YoY in Q2 FY27, with September up 11.3% and October month-to-date up 21.2%; management sees structural drivers supporting 5-6% long-term CAGR.
demand.quote: Power demand in Q2 FY27 grew about 11.1% year -on-year, building on 8.3% growth in Q1. September alone grew about 11.3%, with peak demand touching 270 GW in Q2FY27. The momentum strengthened further into October, with month-to-date demand growth of 21.2%.

margin.statement: Utkal thermal plant EBITDA more than tripled YoY to ₹368 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by better plant performance and PPA realisations well above DAM prices.
margin.quote: Utkal had an exceptional quarter, now that it operates under long -term PPAs. Plant EBITDA more than tripled year -on-year to ₹368 crore in Q2 FY27, and grew over 60% YoY in H1 FY27. This was driven by significantly better plant performance and by PPA realisations well above the DAM prices at which the plant's power was sold a year ago.

capex.statement: Planned capex for FY27 is around ₹20,000 crore to support the 3 GW commissioning target and 1 GWh of energy storage projects.
capex.quote: The pipeline is substantially de-risked, and we are confident of achieving our 3 GW commissioning target for FY27, supported by planned capex of around ₹20,000 crore. Further, on our energy storage pursuits, we expect to commission about 1 GWh of projects in FY27.

capex.statement: KSK Mahanadi 1.8 GW expansion capex 25-30% below industry benchmark per MW due to ready balance-of-plant infrastructure for 3.6 GW.
capex.quote: See, as we have said that the balance of plant in KSK has been ready. And in the last earnings call also, I have mentioned about this that the capex per MW for the capacity addition of 1.8 GW at Mahanadi plant will be significantly lower than the industry benchmark. So when we say that the investment in Mahanadi expansion, doubling the capacity will be at least 25% to 30% lower cost per MW capex a

pricing_cost.statement: Merchant realisation averaged ₹6.9/kWh in Q2 FY27, ~20% above DAM average of ₹5.7/kWh; Q3 fully booked at similar or better pricing.
pricing_cost.quote: Day-Ahead Market prices averaged ₹5.7 per unit in Q2 FY27. Our merchant realisation, however, stood around ₹6.9 per unit which was around 20% higher than the DAM average, driven by the strategic bilateral contracts we have entered into.

fund_raise.statement: ₹10,150 crore capital unlocked in calendar year via fundraising and JSW Steel share sale; ICRA and India Ratings affirmed AA/Stable rating.
fund_raise.quote: ICRA and India Ratings have affirmed JSW Energy's long-term credit rating at AA with a Stable outlook. This recognises our larger and more diversified operating base, our high share of contracted capacity, and the d eleveraging we delivered through the ₹10,150 crore capital unlocking in this calendar year

risk.statement: Merchant exposure limited to ~4% of capacity (7% of energy); Q3 fully booked at similar or better rates; evening peak opportunity may keep part of Mahanadi capacity merchant.
risk.quote: Yes. Definitely, third quarter is fully booked. And maybe I'll not comment on the pricing, but the pricing discovered may be either same or better than this, not lower than these for quarter 3. And now the discussions are on for quarter 4. Normally, it is 2-2.5 months back before this planning start. There are discussions going on even for quarter 4, but quarter 3 is fully booked.

other.statement: API4 imported coal prices averaged ~US$115/t in Q2 FY27, up 28% YoY; shift to domestic coal and job-work arrangements insulated fuel costs.
other.quote: API4 benchmark coal prices averaged close to US$115 per tonne in Q2 FY27, up around 28% year-on-year from US$90 per tonne. Despite this increase, our transition to domestic coal and the implementation of job -work arrangements at imported -coal plants, which shield us from fuel-price volatility, have enabled us to effectively mitigate the impact and maintain cost competitiveness.

other.statement: Curtailment at 4.8% of generation in H1 (national 5.4%); Q2 curtailed ~225 MUs, revenue impact ₹59 crore; 60% of curtailed capacity on temporary GNA to move to permanent GNA by end Q3 FY27.
other.quote: Curtailment across our portfolio stood at about 4.8% of total generation in H1, below the national level curtailment of about 5.4%. In Q2, our curtailed units stood at ~225 MUs with a Revenue impact of Rupees 59 Crores. Further, about 60% of our curtailed capacity currently on temporary GNA will move to permanent GNA by the end of Q3 FY27, which should reduce our exposure meaningfully.

guidance.statement: EBITDA per ton guidance maintained at INR9,000-12,000 for foreseeable future
guidance.quote: Our guidance remains INR9,000 to INR12,000 as EBITDA per ton.

guidance.statement: Full-year sales volume target revised to ~260,000 tons
guidance.quote: So, we expect sales of about 260,000 tons now for the year. Budget was about 260,000 tons.

demand.statement: Strong demand driven by auto (2W, SUV, PV) and non-auto; tractors showing slight slowdown
demand.quote: Demand was strong. And pa rtly demand has been strong because of the GST cuts, which happened last year on 2-wheelers as well as the smaller vehicles as well as SUV sales have been good

margin.statement: Kocks Block & reheating furnace raised capacity to 300KTPA, improved yields, cut job work, boosted margin
margin.quote: So, with the combination of Kocks Block and reheating furnace, we have been able to increase our capacity to 300,000 tons. And we can actually increase this capacity even beyond this.

capex.statement: New steel plant cost to exceed INR2,000 crore; forging plant capex lower than budgeted INR475 crore
capex.quote: But suffice it to say at this point in time that the project cost will be higher than the INR2,000 crores that we had envisaged.

capex.statement: Existing plant capex ~INR150 crore per year; brownfield expansion to 360KTPA needs ~INR100-115 crore
capex.quote: It will be about INR150 crores for the existing plant. And for the steel plant, as I said, we are still considering the final figures that will be investing.

pricing_cost.statement: Price increase letters of INR3,500-4,000/ton sent for Q3; Q2 settlements ongoing
pricing_cost.quote: The other companies have sent out letters for price increases, which are ranging between INR3,500 to INR4,000 a ton.

product_mix.statement: Seeding non-auto segments (tool & die, oil & gas, railways, bearings) via ingot casting from Nov 2026
product_mix.quote: So, we are starting with ingot casting, which is the route to make specialized stee ls. This is something that we will start in the end of November, it will

risk.statement: Project implementation risk cited as biggest risk; no new competitor capacity expected for 2-3 years
risk.quote: There are several risks. One, there's a project implementation risk. Two, I think that's the biggest risk that we have.

other.statement: Receivables up due to higher sales in Aug-Sep; debtor days increased 4-5 days
other.quote: In number of days, it has increased by 4 to 5 days only because of some sales to customers who are having a high credit period.

other.statement: Solar expansion of 22.5 MW (20 MW for current plant, 2.5 MW for forging NDT line)
other.quote: And we are now expanding the solar plant by another 22.5 megawatts. 20 -megawatt for this will be for the current plant and 2.5 -megawatt will be for the NDT line.

demand.statement: 5G subscriber base grew 36 million in Q1 to exceed 463 million, driving sustained operator investment
demand.quote: According to the recent TRAI data, India's 5G subscriber base grew by 36 million in the first quarter, exceeding 463 million subscribers.

demand.statement: Industry added ~30,000 5G BTS in Q2, total installed base ~593,000; focus shifting to densification
demand.quote: With the industry adding approximately 30,000 5G BTS s during the second quarter, taking the total installed base to around 593,000.

demand.statement: Total data volume up 30% YoY in Q1; 5G usage up 79% YoY, now 44% of total consumption
demand.quote: In Q1, total data volume increased by 30% year -on-year, supported by an 18% rise in average monthly usage per subscriber. Notably, 5G networks are accelerating this trend, with 5G usage alone growing 79% year-on-year, representing 44% of total data consumption, up from 32% in the prior year.

margin.statement: Reported EBITDA grew 2.5% QoQ to INR46.3bn; EBITDA margin improved 80bps QoQ to 54.4%
margin.quote: Reported EBITDA increased by 2.5% quarter-on-quarter and stands at INR46.3 billion for the quarter. Our EBITDA margin also improved by 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter and stands at 54.4% for the quarter.

margin.statement: Energy margin improved to -3.6% in Q2 from -4.6% in Q1 and -4.8% YoY; diesel consumption down 11% YoY
margin.quote: Our energy margin was negative 3.6% in Q2 compared to negative of 4.6% in Q1 and negative 4.8% in the corresponding quarter of last year, reflecting a significant improvement during the reported quarter. Our structured energy efficiency measures are yielding positive results, and diesel consumption is further reduced by 11% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Added ~2,900 macro towers and 7,900 co-locations in Q2; tower base ~270,500, co-location base ~440,200
order_book.quote: We added approximately 2,900 macro towers and robust co-locations of 7,900, marking year -on-year growth of 5.6% in towers and 5.9% in co-locations. Our total macro tower and co-location base reached approximately 270,500 and 440,200, respectively.

order_book.statement: Strong order book visibility from major customers driving tower and tenancy growth
order_book.quote: we do have a visibility of a strong order book. And I think we will keep executing based on that order book. So yo u'll continue to see our delivery in the line with what the orders we have

capex.statement: Growth capex increase reflected in CWIP rising ~INR250 cr QoQ due to healthy order book; capex includes towers, tenancies, 5G upgrades, solar
capex.quote: If you follow our balance sheet, there is an increase of around INR250-odd crores on the CWIP value quarter-on-quarter, which is a reflection of what Prachur was alluding on the very healthy order book what we have.

capex.statement: Africa tower deployments commenced in Zambia and Uganda in Q2; Nigeria deployment starting in Q3; early capex per tower within plan
capex.quote: We have successfully deployed towers in Zambia and Uganda in Q2 and also started generating revenue. In line with our phased rollout plan, we are set to begin deployment in Nigeria during the current quarter and our early capex performance per tower remains within the plan, validating our cost model during the initial phases.

pricing_cost.statement: Annual rental escalation covers majority of inflation impact on opex; capex rates revised per MSA where flexibility exists
pricing_cost.quote: I think first is the escalation that we have that takes care of the inflation impact when it comes to opex. As far as capex is concerned, based on our MSA, whichever rates are to be revised on capex, wherever we have that flexibility, that is accordingly adjusted for the customers.

product_mix.statement: IBS deployments gaining market share for two consecutive years; provided solutions for India Mobile Congress and Vizag Airport
product_mix.quote: Supported by a specialized team focused on design and execution, the company has led incremental market share gains in new IBS deployments for two consecutive years and remains focused on expanding its presence in this segment while enhancing the end user connectivity experience.

risk.statement: Africa expansion at early stage; meaningful metrics to be shared in subsequent quarters as portfolio reaches representative scale
risk.quote: As the portfolio reaches to a more representative scale, we intend to share more detail on operational and financial metrics in subsequent quarters.

other.statement: Tenancy ratio improved from 1.62 to 1.63 driven by sharing of existing towers
other.quote: Our industry -leading tenancy ratio has also improved from 1.62 to 1.63, driven by substantial rollout through sharing of our existing towers.

other.statement: Government support for smart meter deployment on telecom towers; ~140,000 sites deployed over 3 years
other.quote: Government support for smart meter deployment on telecom towers has further reinforced telecom infrastructure as a priority consumer category. Over the last three years, we have deployed smart meters on approximately 140,000 sites.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance revised to early 20s percent for FY27 from prior mid-teens to high teens
guidance.quote: I had said mid-teens to high teens. I think now I think early 20s is a good estimate of where we think we'll end the year.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin long-term guidance anchored at 31-31.5% while funding growth investments
guidance.quote: I would say a long- term guidance of about 31%, 31.5%, where we are funding all these investments for growth is what I would anchor on, right, and not above that.

guidance.statement: Specialty diagnostics target 10-15% of revenue in 3-5 year horizon
guidance.quote: As I said, in a 3 to 5-year horizon, specialty should be at least around 10% to 15% of our revenue, and we'll hold to that.

guidance.statement: API Group ex-Thyrocare profitability target by Q4 FY27 before any corporate action discussion
guidance.quote: I have guided to API Group ex-Thyrocare turning profitable by Q4 FY27. It is only by then that I think even any kind of corporate action would be in the realm of discussion.

demand.statement: Pathology business grew 27% YoY in Q2 FY27; test volumes up 27%, patients up 13%, tests per patient up 12%
demand.quote: Continuing the growth momentum of over 20% achieved in each of the past 2 years, our pathology business grew even faster in Q2 FY27, delivering 27% growth.

order_book.statement: Active franchisee base reached 12,911 with record 1,180 net additions in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: We added about 1,180 franchises in the quarter, our highest quarterly addition in 3 years, taking the active base of franchise to a record of 12,911.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex of INR30 crores for 8 new labs and capacity; similar capex expected in H2
capex.quote: During H1 FY27, a capex of INR30 crores has been invested on account of new lab expansion, 5 in this quarter and 3 in quarter 1 and capacity capex to support 27% volume growth. In balance part of the financial year, we are expecting a similar capex investm ent for the growth of the business

pricing_cost.statement: Pregnancy kit gross margin comparable to diagnostics business; EBITDA margin normalized comparable but not EPS accretive for 3 quarters due to marketing spend
pricing_cost.quote: From an economic standpoint, I would say gross margin of this business is more or less comparable to our diagnostics business. And the EBITDA margin of this business is also at a normalized level comparable to our pathology business.

product_mix.statement: Pregnancy test kit available in 10,000+ pharmacies via Ascent distribution; listed on PharmEasy and quick commerce platforms
product_mix.quote: Today, we are already present in 10,000-plus pharmacies.

product_mix.statement: Specialty diagnostics launched (allergy, genomics) contributing ~4% of pathology revenue; pregnancy test kit launched at INR60 MRP with Beta hCG confirmation at INR399
product_mix.quote: While the specialty segments currently contribute only around 4% of our pathology revenue, the early traction reflects the benefits of our strategic investments.

risk.statement: NHL impairment of INR9 crores (standalone) and INR45 crores (consolidated) taken; non-recurring, non-cash, no operational impact
risk.value: INR9 crores standalone, INR45 crores consolidated

other.statement: Operating cash flow of INR133 crores generated in H1 FY27
other.quote: In cash flow, during H1 FY27, we generated INR133 crores from operating activities.

other.statement: Net cash and equivalents of INR211 crores with zero debt as of 30 September 2026
other.quote: Our balance sheet continues to be strong and resilient, with net cash and equivalents of over INR211 crores and zero debt as on 30 September 2026.

guidance.statement: Loan book growth guidance maintained at 18-20% for FY27
guidance.quote: So, I think, you know, the growth guidance which we given was 18% to 20%, I think, we would be always very happy to grow at what we have delivered now. But currently we are maintaining the guidance.

guidance.statement: ROA guidance maintained at 2.4% for FY27 despite Q2 beat
guidance.quote: No, we are maintaining that. See, this time again, as we said, there is some one-offs in the overall interest income. Which has led to higher ROA. The normalized ROA is 2.4, which is in line with Q1.

demand.statement: No demand impact seen from 25 bps repo hike; momentum continues
demand.quote: So honestly, I think, you know, this 25 bps repo increase, we have not seen any change in terms of momentum in the market because market has easily absorbed that, which reflect in overall industry.

margin.statement: Spread improved 31 bps QoQ to 2.43%; NIM improved 17 bps QoQ to 3.67%
margin.quote: Coming to margins, our spread increased by 31 bps sequentially to 2.43%. Excluding one-off spread would be 12 bps higher, that is 2.24%. NIM improved by 17 bps sequentially to 3.67%.

margin.statement: Expect spread and NIM to improve further from current levels
margin.quote: With higher incremental yield vs book yield and rising interest rate scenario, we feel that spread and NIM should further improve from hereon.

order_book.statement: Overall disbursements grew 60% YoY to INR 9,609 crores in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Overall disbursement grew 60% YoY to INR 9,609 crores. This includes pool buyout of INR 838 crores.

order_book.statement: Retail disbursements reached all-time high of INR 9,250 crores, up 54% YoY
order_book.quote: Retail disbursements reached an all-time high of INR 9,250 crores, registering a growth of 54% YoY.

order_book.statement: Loan book grew 19% YoY to INR 95,079 crores as of Sep 30, 2026
order_book.quote: This translated to an overall loan book of INR 95,079 crores as on 30th September '26, representing growth of 19% YoY.

capex.statement: Opex increased 20% YoY to INR 260 crores driven by manpower additions in affordable vertical
capex.quote: Operating expenses increased by 20% YoY to INR 260 crores in Q2 FY27 from INR 217 crores in Q2 of FY26, largely in line with the growth in business volumes and driven primarily by investments in manpower addition with the affordable vertical.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost of borrowing improved 5 bps QoQ to 7.31%; incremental cost improved 15 bps to 7.26%
pricing_cost.quote: Cost of borrowing also improved by 5 bps to 7.31% in Q2 FY27. The incremental cost of borrowing also improved by 15 bps to 7.26%.

pricing_cost.statement: Retail lending rates to increase 10-15 bps and corporate rates 15-20 bps effective Nov 1
pricing_cost.quote: Following the recent 25 bps policy rate hike, we anticipate a modest increase in our borrowing cost. product_mix.quote: Within retail portfolio, the affordable and emerging markets segment continued to be our key growth engines, representing YoY book growth of 45% and 22% respectively, and together contributing 41% of overall retail portfolio. We remained on track to increase this contribution to 45% by the end of FY 26-27.

product_mix.statement: Incremental disbursement mix: ~60% housing, ~40% non-housing (excl. pool buyout)
product_mix.quote: Excluding the pool buyout approximately 60% of incremental disbursements is housing

fund_raise.statement: DA sell-downs to be evaluated from Q3 to improve NIM and ROE
fund_raise.quote: So this is going to be one of our sustainable strategies now that we have hit our stated guidance, you know, on the book growth. So that we will start evaluating now from Q3, and we'll start, y ou know, doing some of the deals which will help in terms of the overall NIM as well as the ROE

That is one. Internal We'll also see improvemen

other.statement: Normalized credit cost expected at 10-12 bps post recovery normalization
other.quote: Yes, that's right. It should be in that range around 10 to 12 basis points.

guidance.statement: FY27 standalone revenue growth 10-15% on FY26 base of INR 234 crores, EBITDA margin 10-15%
guidance.quote: For the standalone business, revenue growth of 10% to 15% on FY26 base of INR 234 crores and an EBITDA margin of 10% to 15% remains consistent in line with what we guided at the start of the year.

guidance.statement: FY27 Innoxel revenue growth 35-45% at 20-25% margin without licensing income of INR 80-90 crores
guidance.quote: For Innoxel, revenue growth of 35% to 45% at a margin of 20% to 25% without-licensing income of roughly INR 80 crores to INR 90 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 Varenyam Healthcare growth 20-25% at 8-13% margin
guidance.quote: For Varenyam Healthcare, growth of 20% to 25% at a margin of 8% to 13% was the guidance.

guidance.statement: Targets 12-15 new out-licensing deals per year; expects 10-12 signed contracts by end of Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: So, there is we target at least 12 to 15 new deals every year. That's our normal target. As of now, in H1, we have signed six deals. We are in advance talks with six to seven other customers for various projects. we are in advance due diligence. So, we can expect that in by end of Q3, we should be sitting at 10 to 12 signed contracts, which would be in FY27.

margin.statement: Standalone Q2 EBITDA margin 9% down from 12.3% in Q1 due to input cost increase of 5 percentage points of revenue
margin.quote: EBITDA was INR 7 crores, three times last year's INR 2.3 crores, but the margin was 9%, down from 12.3% in Q1 FY27. The reason is input material cost. Prices of several of our inputs rose sharply because of the ongoing geopolitical conflicts.

margin.statement: Innoxel moved from EBITDA loss to 33% margin in Q2; US commercial supply started 28 Oct not yet in numbers
margin.quote: To sum up, Q2 is the quarter the group moved from a loss to a profit. And Innoxel moved from an EBITDA loss to a 33% margin. US commercial supply started on 28th October and is not yet in these numbers.

margin.statement: CMO margins well above industry average; future CMO deals to remain in complex space, not vanilla generics
margin.quote: So, as far as margins are concerned, our CMO margins are also well above industry average, and we expect even further future CMO deals to be in the same complex space and not a vanilla generic space.

order_book.quote: Our total order book stood at INR 117 crores at the end of September across domestic tenders, exports and international tenders, which gives us good visibility into the second half.

order_book.statement: Standalone domestic tender book fell from INR 119 crores end of June to INR 65 crores end of September as supplied against it
order_book.quote: Our domestic tender book came down from INR119 crores at the end of June to INR 65 crores at the end of September, largely as supplied against it.

order_book.statement: Corrects standalone order book to INR 117 crores as of September 30, acknowledging slide error showing INR 180 crores
order_book.quote: I think that is an error on our side. I will ask my team to correct that. That was the old number. The correct number is as per what I had just mentioned and the what was presented in the first slide I would say under the standalone business part of the presentation.

capex.statement: Standalone generated INR 65 crores cash from operations in H1, spent INR 15 crores on capex, leaving INR 50 crores free cash
capex.quote: The standalone business generated INR 65 crores of cash from operations in the half and spent about INR 15 crores on capex, leaving roughly INR 50 crores of free cash.

capex.quote: We are targeting completion of the construction by second quarter of calendar year 2028, subject to commissioning and regulatory timelines.

product_mix.statement: Innoxel and Varenyam Healthcare together 45% of revenue before eliminations in Q2, up from 40% a year ago; Innoxel now largest EBITDA contributor at >60% of group EBITDA
product_mix.quote: Innoxel and Varenyam Healthcare, our margin growth platforms, together made up 45% of our revenue before eliminations this quarter, up from about 40% a year ago. Innoxel is now the largest EBITDA contributor in the group, producing more than 60% of the EBITDA across our four companies.

product_mix.statement: Standalone mix improving from 78% tender / 22% branded last year; growth engine shifting to branded exports via new registrations, EU GMP, PIC/S approvals
product_mix.quote: So, if you see last year last quarter that that mix was somewhere close to 78, 22%. So, in fact, we are improving our bet on the branded business more than the tender business. risk.statement: Standalone order book partly priced before input cost increase; margins on that book will stay under pressure until prices ease or book turns over to current cost orders
risk.quote: A good part of our order book was priced before input costs went up. Until those prices ease or the books turn over to orders priced at current costs, margins on that book will stay under some pressure.

risk.statement: Innoxel margins lumpy due to milestone and licensing income timing; lighter milestone quarter will bring margin down; H1 more representative
risk.quote: I would keep the 33% in context. This revenue is still mostly licensing, milestone and development income and that arrives when our partners reach milestones, not evenly every quarter. risk.statement: Varenyam Bio regulatory approval timeline not in control; will be ready for audits and filings but regulator timing speculative
risk.quote: Again, this is something too far out for me to give you a firm answer. This is not something that is completely in our control as well. We can be ready for the regulatory audits. We can file the products. But when the regulators come, is not in something in our control. And it could be closer to the time when we are ready to file the product is something that, I'll be able to give a better answer

other.statement: Standalone general block utilisation 70% in H1 vs 48.5% in FY26; beta-lactam 33% vs 21%; cephalosporins 31.5% vs 24%; meaningful headroom exists
other.quote: In the first half, general block ran at 70% against 48.5% for FY26. Beta-lactam was at 33% and Cephalosporins was at 31.5% against 21% and 24% respectively last year. That leaves meaningful headroom.

other.statement: Standalone trade receivables down to INR 105 crores from INR 120 crores in March and INR 130 crores a year ago
other.quote: Trade receivables are down to INR 105 crores from INR 120 crores in March and INR 130 crores a year ago.

guidance.statement: RO productivity target ~1.5 files/month by end FY27, progressively to 2 files/month

guidance.statement: Opex ratio target below 3% medium term
guidance.quote: With further gains in productivity, efficiency and scale, we expect to generate stronger operating leverage and progressively improve the Opex Ratio to below 3%.

guidance.statement: Cost-to-income ratio target below 40% medium term
guidance.quote: Our immediate objective is to try and start pushing this downwards to less than 40% in the medium term.

guidance.statement: Maintain spreads above 5% on incremental disbursements
guidance.quote: We are confident of maintaining spreads above 5% on our placement disbursements, and that is what we are keenly focused on at every transaction.

demand.statement: No stress seen from weak monsoon; agri-income exposure minimal; lead indicators improving
demand.quote: From what we see on our exposures, and we have a very keen eye and ear to the ground on these, all my lead indicators are actually getting better, as the months are progressing.

margin.statement: Incremental home loan yields up ~8-10 bps recently
margin.quote: Roughly about 8 to 10 bps. Home loans are quite a competitive segment.

margin.quote: Our NIMs remained broadly stable at 7.76%, moderated marginally by 5 bps YoY on account of PLR cut, however supported by 21 bps YoY improvement in cost of borrowings.

pricing_cost.quote: No, not currently. We are examining it, and as and when we feel the need of a PLR change, we will make it happen.

product_mix.statement: Steady-state AUM mix target 65% HL / 35% non-HL; Q2 LAP share up due to top-up loans and construction-stage reclassification
product_mix.quote: Steady state on an AUM level, we will continue to look at tending towards, 65 -35, HL versus NHL.

other.statement: RO productivity improved to 1.2 files/month in Q2FY27 (1.1 in Q1); September 1.3 files/month
other.quote: During Q2FY27, Productivity per RO improved to 1.2 files / month, compared with 1.1 files / month in Q1FY27. The momentum strengthened further in September, when productivity reached 1.3 files / month.

other.statement: Added 21,500+ new customers in H1FY27; top-up loans ~5% of disbursements; focus on existing customer retention
other.quote: In H1FY27, we added 21,500+ new customers to the Aavas Franchise.

guidance.statement: Employee cost guidance maintained at Rs. 95 crores per quarter standalone and Rs. 130 crores per quarter consolidated for full financial year
guidance.value: 95 crores per quarter standalone, 130 crores per quarter consolidated
guidance.quote: As far as our overall guidance number for the employee cost is, that we are maintaining that for the standalone, it is close to around Rs. 95 crores per quarter, and for the consolidated, it is close to around Rs. 130 crores per quarter. guidance.statement: Board policy to distribute 90-95% of profit as dividend; no plans for special dividend or incremental cash distribution
guidance.quote: So as of now, the board-level decision is that most of whatever the profit that we are generating, we will be distributing closer to 90 - 95% of that profit will be distributed as dividend. That dividend aggressive policy that we have continued over the last three to four years, and that should continue.

guidance.statement: Will launch UTI Classif Hybrid Long Short Fund in Q3 FY27 under SIF initiative
guidance.quote: We have received SEBI approval for our Specialised Investment Fund - SIF initiative and will be launching the UTI Classif Hybrid Long Short Fund in quarter three of FY27.

guidance.statement: UTI International to launch two new funds by end of Q3 or Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: We are launching a few products by the end of quarter three and quarter four. Hopefully, that should provide some traction of AUM and revenue growth in UTI International. demand.statement: Equity-oriented schemes attracted Rs. 92,333 crores in Q2 FY27 industry-wide; monthly SIP contribution hit record Rs. 32,490 crores in September 2026

demand.quote: Small and mid -cap funds accounted for 44% of September's equity inflows, while flexi -cap, multi -cap, large and mid -cap, and large -cap funds accounted another 41%.

margin.quote: On a consolidated basis, the core income, i.e. the sale of service amounted to Rs. 398 crores, up by 2% Y-o-Y and 5% Q-o-Q. The core profit after tax for the quarter is Rs. 131 crores, up by 22% Y-o-Y and 2% Q-o-Q.

margin.statement: Consolidated H1 FY27 core revenue Rs. 777 crores, up 1% YoY; core PAT Rs. 263 crores, up 15% YoY

order_book.quote: Our mutual fund quarterly average AUM for quarter two of FY '27 stood at Rs. 4.02 lakh crores, compared with Rs. 3.93 lakh crores in quarter one of FY '27, representing a market share of 4.61%.

order_book.quote: Our total group AUM stood at Rs. 16.28 lakh crores as of September 30th, 2026.

capex.quote: Process optimisation generated approximately Rs. 4.22 crores in savings, while automation is reducing manual intervention.

product_mix.quote: Equity-oriented assets across active and passive strategies accounted for 72% of our average mutual fund AUM, compared with approximately 70% in the previous quarter.

product_mix.quote: During quarter two of FY27, we launched the UTI Balanced Hybrid Fund and four passive products linked to the Nifty 500 and BSE India Sector Leaders indices.

risk.statement: Flexi-Cap fund remains a challenge with large outflows, though performance improved to first quartile in last three months
risk.quote: As we mentioned earlier, Flexi-Cap remains still the challenge for us. While we have seen some inflows in Flexi-Cap, there have been large outflows also in the fund, and that remains a fund which we are focusing on. other.statement: Fintech partners facilitated ~1 lakh transactions in Q2 FY27, contributed 67% of new investor acquisitions
other.quote: Our fintech partners facilitated approximate ly 1 lakh transactions during the quarter two of FY27 and these partners have contributed 67% of the new investor acquisitions.
