other.quote: And even if you look at our closure rate of SIPs in the last quarter, while industry was trending at around 80%, our SIP closure book was around 70%. So, we are better off than industry in terms of SIP closure.

guidance.statement: Specialty chemicals portfolio targeted to grow at 20-25% year-on-year on a multi-year CAGR basis.
guidance.quote: But at an overall level, our aspiration is to continue to grow our specialty chemical portfolio at 20% to 25% year on year on a multi-year CAGR basis.

guidance.statement: Management maintains full-year EBITDA guidance of INR750-800 crore and expects to be closer to the upper end given strong H1 performance.
guidance.quote: I think we are sticking to our guidance. In fact, we think we should given the strong performance in the first half of the year, we should hopefully be closer to the upper end of the guidance we have given for the year.

demand.statement: European competitor plant closures in acetic anhydride expected to strengthen demand and pricing from early next calendar year, viewed as multi-year opportunity.

demand.quote: Acetic anhydride delivered healthy sequential volume growth supported by resilient pharma demand and market share gains in Europe while maintaining a stable domestic market position.

margin.quote: We delivered EBITDA of INR140 crore, translating into a strong EBITDA margin of 25%, driven by improved pricing across our value-added fine chemicals and CDMO portfolio.

capex.statement: Annual capex guidance maintained at INR400-500 crore, with Gajraula multipurpose plant commissioning in next few months.
capex.quote: We will be investing at least INR400 crore to INR500 crore every year as we announced a couple of years back in our investor presentation also.

risk.statement: Large CDMO contract future volumes under discussion with multiple scenarios; visibility expected within few weeks; take-or-pay receivable risk fully protected per agreement.
risk.quote: We are very close to concluding what the way forward would be and as soon as we have the visibility, we will be able to disclose that to all of you, hopefully within next few weeks.

other.statement: Signed agreement to acquire 40% stake in Zettaone Technologies for INR189 crore; shareholders agreement to be concluded soon.
other.quote: I am delighted to share that we have recently signed an agreement to acquire 40% stake in Zettaone with an investment of INR189 crore.

other.statement: Input and utility costs partially offset improved acetyls pricing; chemical intermediates saw higher input costs from elevated crude prices.

guidance.statement: Revenue from stationary engine segment for data centers to reach $100 million peak by FY30, with 30% by FY28 and 50% by FY29
guidance.quote: FY'30, we will reach the run rate at least by Q3 or Q4 for that $100 million. 30% by FY'28 is what we feel, 50% by FY'29.

guidance.statement: Committed to 15% CAGR growth in real terms on a large base

guidance.statement: Net debt to EBITDA target of 1.7-1.8x on consolidated basis for the year
guidance.quote: overall I think we will be at 1.7-1.8 net debt to EBITDA on a consolidated basis for the year.

guidance.statement: Inflection point at Rs 1,850 crores EBITDA next year, after which company will be self-sufficient for capex funding
guidance.quote: the inflection point for us is around Rs. 1,850 crores sort of EBITDA which we wi ll reach next year. After that we will be able to be self - sufficient for funding our CAPEX as well as the maintenance CAPEX

demand.statement: India becoming manufacturing hub for powertrain exports to underdeveloped markets, South America, Africa, Asia; exports of tractors, two-wheelers, construction equipment increasing

margin.quote: It may vary, but anywhere between 6% -7% all the way to 15% -20% will be there depending on the commodity, the product and the time of the order. This is not on the top line, but on the gross margin or the value addition portion.

margin.quote: our top line may reduce, but our absolute margins will improve because some of them are negative on the EBITDA itself in general. There's no point in trying to reset those prices. So, with that, the P&L will be very healthy.

margin.statement: Aluminum margin decline to 6.5% EBIT margin temporary; expects recovery after price correction discussions with customers in next two quarters
margin.quote: Yes, we have seen some corrections of the margins in Aluminum that is not a correction, it is a temporary correction. We had increased our inventory because of the shortage of raw material and also the prices which were increasing dropped suddenly so we had an impact of that. So, with the price increase what we are negotiating with the customer or correction or compensation for the Aluminum price

order_book.statement: Stationary engine order book around $100 million for data centers; inquiries and order push for next level of capacity quite strong
order_book.quote: The revenues will start from FY'29 and go into FY'30 where we will peak at around $100 million and the next level of peak we are expecting in the enquiries and order push is quite strong.

order_book.statement: Aluminum order pipeline long for order wins; new plants ramping up with operating leverage to improve in two quarters
order_book.quote: On the Aluminum, the pipeline is quite long for the whatever order wins we have. There are some headwinds on the new plants where we have to put in the working capital in and we have to start up the plants which is also happening as a suboptimum as of now. So, the operating leverage on those plants will take another two quarters to get into a profitable situation.

capex.statement: Q3 capex expected at Rs 500-600 crores on consolidated level; Q4 capex to be minimal as long-term projects pushed to subsequent years
capex.quote: Q3 on a console level will be between Rs. 500 crores-Rs. 600 crore on the CAPEX.

capex.statement: German subsidiary machine shop investment very small, around Rs 20-30 crores; no major foreign capex or acquisitions planned
capex.quote: maybe 20, 30 crores on a couple of machines there, so that we can support the foundry and reduce the working capital intent.

pricing_cost.statement: Aluminum price spike and drop caused inventory impact; negotiating compensation with customers for past and future corrections
pricing_cost.quote: We had increased our inventory because of the shortage of raw material and also the prices which were increasing dropped suddenly so we had an impact of that. So, with the price increase what we are negotiating with the customer or correction or compensation for the Aluminum price correction also which will play out in the coming two quarters.

product_mix.statement: Broad-basing Aluminum components beyond legacy parts; seeing opportunities in EV and wider OEM product offerings
product_mix.quote: we are also broad basing on the new product on the Aluminum components, not only the legacy parts but I think there are more opportunities coming in not only on the EV but in general, the product offerings of the OEMs have become more wider.

risk.statement: Not a fan of investing outside India in big way due to associated risks; German subsidiary investment strategic and small; averse to foreign acquisitions
risk.quote: I want to make one very clear statement is, we are not a fan of investing outside India in a big way because we understand the risks which are associated. This is a very strategic investment and we will keep it in that way.

risk.statement: Commodity price risk on Aluminum; cannot get margin on increased Aluminum price; some moderation expected
risk.quote: commodity price is a subject where we cannot get the increased Aluminum price, we cannot get a margin for that Aluminum also. So, we have to look at it that way. Some moderation will be there.

other.statement: Alloy wheel business at around 70% utilization in past couple of months
other.quote: Sir, we are at around 70% sort of current utilization level in the past couple of months, I would say.

other.statement: DR Axion Plant-2 started trial production with strong order book; Sunbeam transformation underway with Q3/Q4 expected to be better
other.quote: The DR Axion Plant-2 has started at least trial production I would say and the order book is also strong there. Sunbeam has gone through a very good transformation and we are in close contact with the customers on the way forward. Q3 and Q4 will be looking better for Sunbeam.

guidance.statement: CDMO revenue target of Rs 1,000 crores advanced to FY27 from FY28
guidance.quote: Based on the current orders of existing as well as new CDMO contracts, we now believe we will achieve this target one year ahead of schedule. It means in FY '27, we will be achieving this Rs. 1,000 crores.

guidance.statement: New CDMO revenue target of Rs 2,000 crores set for FY30
guidance.quote: Here, I would like to say that this CDMO business will be double in next 3 financial years. It means from Rs. 1,000 crores, the new target we had set is Rs. 2,000 crore by FY 2030.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance revised from 25% to around 30% for FY27
guidance.quote: Before I conclude, I would also like to revise our revenue growth guidance for current year from 25% to around 30%.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin guidance raised to 38%-40% range for FY27
guidance.quote: We are also raising our EBITDA margin guidance between 38%-40% range for FY '27.

demand.statement: Pharmaceutical Intermediate demand remains robust with successful cost pass-through
demand.quote: Demand environment remains robust and whatever cost pressures we face due to geopolitical issues, we have been able to pass them on successfully.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin expanded 637 bps YoY to 62.1% driven by higher pharma intermediate contribution
margin.quote: The gross margin expanded by 637 basis point Y-o-Y to 62.1%. Gross margin was driven by higher contribution from pharma intermediate business compared to the same period last year.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 40.3%, up 914 bps YoY driven by gross margin expansion and operating leverage
margin.quote: EBITDA margins were at 40.3% up 914 basis point Y-o-Y. EBITDA margin was driven by expansion in gross margin as well as operating leverage.

order_book.statement: New CDMO contracts expected to start contributing revenue from H2 FY27
order_book.quote: We are happy to share that we have received orders for new CDMO contracts which are expected to start contributing revenue from H2 FY '27.

order_book.statement: 8-9 CDMO products getting into revenue stream in next 1 to 1.5 years
order_book.quote: And there are 8-9 products in total you can say that these are getting into revenue stream in next 1 to 1-1/2 year time.

capex.statement: H2 FY27 additional capex of Rs 1,650 million including Rs 1,000 million for electronic-grade chemicals and Rs 450 million for electrolyte additive phase 2
capex.quote: So, in H2 FY '27, we plan to do additional CAPEX of Rs. 1,650 million CAPEX which will have around Rs. 1,000 million for electronic-grade chemicals, Rs. 450 million for second phase of electrolyte additive CAPEX and remaining will be for the maintenance CAPEX.

pricing_cost.statement: Electrolyte additive realization expected in early teens dollar range, not $30-35 spot levels
pricing_cost.quote: So there will be additional, some of the realization because of a price movement, but it will not be kind of $30-$35 kind of pricing. It can be early teens kind of pricing scenario.

pricing_cost.statement: Electrolyte additive pricing based on long-term contracts with raw material and FX pass-through, not spot prices
pricing_cost.quote: We have already signed long-term supply contract all in place. And based on that contract, we get the revised pricing based on some of the key raw material price movement as well as the exchange rate fluctuation.

product_mix.statement: Phasing out old commodity products (Parabens, MS) over 1-1.5 years; MS may continue longer due to good customers
product_mix.quote: We have already started scaling down this old legacy product related to Paraben and MS. It takes some time because right at upfront, we cannot say no to the customer because they also need to develop their alternative vendor and supply line. So that is the reason it may take around 1 to 1-1/2 years to scale down this business. MS business, we may continue for some time because there are some good

risk.statement: Geopolitical, supply chain, logistics, electricity, water constraints cited as ongoing operational concerns
risk.quote: Geopolitical issues are there, supply chain, logistic, operational, electricity, water, there are so many constraints that are always coming. You have to find out the way out of that.

other.statement: Working capital at 115 days in Q2 FY27 vs 99 days in Q1 FY27 driven by higher debtor days
other.quote: Our working capital for the quarter stands at 115 days vis-a-vis 99 days in Q1 FY '27. This was driven by higher debtor days.

other.statement: Advanced Pharma Intermediate segment revenue Rs 4,020 million in Q2 FY27, up 53.1% YoY
other.quote: This segment delivered robust performance with revenue of 4,020 million in Q2 FY '27, reflecting a strong year-on-year growth of 53.1%.

guidance.statement: Planning to close FY27 at ₹580-600 Cr top line and double PAT margin
guidance.quote: And, planning to close the financial year at, around ₹580 Cr to ₹600 Cr as a top line, and, double the PAT margin, EBITDA say ₹12.5 Cr for H1 result.

demand.statement: India air cargo target 10 million tons by 2030, nearly 2.7x current volume
demand.quote: India's Ministry of Civilization has set a policy target of 10 million tons of air cargo by annually by 2030 . So it's almost 2.7 times its current volume.

demand.statement: E-commerce and courier growing multi-fold internationally; retail courier launched this month
demand.quote: E-commerce and Courier is one of the products that is growing rapidly. The growth that you have seen in e-commerce and Courier in the last 10 years domestically, that same growth is happening internationally now.

margin.statement: Margins will increase quarter on quarter as infrastructure can handle double current business
margin.quote: So, margin, bottom line, you will see increasing quarter on quarter and year on year, definitely.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 shipments grew 56% to 674 and tonnage grew 32.84% to 744 tons
order_book.quote: You can see the growth in the number of shipments also from 430 shipments to 674 shipments the H1. And, tonnage also is increased. From 545 tons to 744 tons.

capex.statement: Building technology platform like MakeMyTrip for cargo; expected ready by end of year
capex.quote: We're also look… looking at… our technology platform, wherein we are trying to do something like MakeMyTrip, but for cargo and courier. So, you know the platform is currently being built, but within a few months from now, I think it should be ready, hopefully by the end of the year.

pricing_cost.statement: Maintain margins when freight rates rise; 90% of time margins held regardless of rate doubling/tripling
pricing_cost.quote: Whatever our margins are, even if the Freight is double, tripled, we'll still maintain our margins. That's what we try and do as much as possible. And I can assure you, 90% of the time we do that.

product_mix.statement: Ocean freight is 70-80% of global trade; company plans to grow ocean freight for scale
product_mix.quote: Currently, ocean freight is 70-80% of all global trade volumes, so that is where you know, we would like, like I said earlier, also, we would like to have some market share, or some big… so if we want to grow the company to a great extent, we are going to look at Ocean Freight.

risk.statement: Freight rates volatile due to geopolitical factors (war, airspace restrictions) and fuel prices
risk.quote: Like, there are some places where ocean freight, where the prices increase because of the war and everything or maybe if you can't fly over Pakistan, then those freights are increasing.

other.statement: Current infrastructure can handle double the business volume
other.quote: Our costs remain the same, our infrastructure… current infrastructure can even do double the business that we are currently doing.

other.statement: Top 3 with major airlines (Air India, Emirates, Qatar, Lufthansa); serve large supermarkets Lulu, Nesto via charters
other.quote: We feature amongst the top 10 in India, and we are among the number one, in the top 3 in most airlines out of India, like Air India, Emirates, Qatar, Lufthansa, and most airlines we feature among the top 3.

margin.statement: Revenue from operations grew 11.8% sequentially; operating profit grew 15.4% with operating margin expanding 80 bps to 26.4%.
margin.quote: Given the strong performance across all our businesses, our revenue from operations grew by 11.8% sequentially. Operating profit grew at a much faster pace of 15.4% sequentially on account of operating leverage and operating margin, which has been expanded by 80 basis points to 26.4%.

margin.statement: MF yield remained stable at 88-89 bps; insurance revenue grew 35% sequentially driven by fresh premium growth of 54% in GI and 37% in life.
margin.quote: MF yield otherwise has remained very, very stable between 88 to 89 basis points during the quarter. Our insurance revenue grew by a strong 35% sequentially. This was supported by fresh premium growth of 54% in general insurance and 37% in life insurance.

margin.statement: Other income fell 82% sequentially to INR 3.8 crores due to mark-to-market drag on debt portfolio and reversal of hybrid portfolio gains.
margin.quote: Higher bond yield created a mark-to-market drag on the debt portfolio. The hybrid portfolio also saw a reversal of earlier mark-to-market gain. As a result, other income fell by around 82% sequentially from INR20.8 crores in previous quarter to INR3.8 crores in the current quarter.

order_book.statement: Quarterly average AUM was INR 1.43 lakh crores, up 8% sequentially and 21% year-on-year.
order_book.quote: The sharpest part of market correction has came in last few weeks of October. So after the September quarter has ended. As a result, quarterly AUM of Q2 FY27 remained strong at INR1.43 lakh crores. This was up by 8% sequentially and 21% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Equity AUM grew 16.2% year-on-year to INR 1.37 lakh crores, driven 80% by net sales and strong SIP flows.
order_book.quote: Equity AUM has increased from INR1.17 lakh crores in September 2025 to INR1.37 lakh crores in September 2026. This is a growth of 16.2% or nearly INR19,100 crores. Around 80% of this growth came from net sales, supported by strong SIP flows.

order_book.statement: Quarterly net sales hit a record high of INR 4,137 crores despite negative mark-to-market impact of INR 1,867 crores.
order_book.quote: Despite a negative mark-to-market impact of INR1,867 crores, our Equity AUM grew by 1.7% sequentially. We recorded net sales of INR4,137 crores during the quarter. This is the highest quarterly net sales in our history.

product_mix.statement: Holds OBPP license; awaiting final SEBI framework for Fixed Income Channel Partner (FICP) to launch online bond business via MFD network.
product_mix.quote: We already hold an OBPP license. Here, too, SEBI has issued a consultation paper on the clarity about the fixed income channel partner, which is just like your mutual fund distributors. They call it as FIC P. So I think consultation paper is in the process to define the FICP framework, and we are awaiting the final clarity on that before we launch it full fledged.

risk.statement: Regulatory changes historically cause initial pain but long-term industry growth; distributors adapt by increasing volumes to offset commission cuts.
risk.quote: Distributors have realized that there would be a cut in the commercial, but that is compensated by way of increasing the volume. So, unlike the entry load cut this time -- last 2 years, 3 years, I think whatever last 2 times, 3 times, whenever there was a cut in the commercial, we did not see any impact on our distribution business.

risk.statement: Insurance regulation could significantly impact POSP business viability if 5% vs 10% commission differential persists; volume may not justify revenue.
risk.quote: It is going to be a big, big impact for platform like Prudent or the corporate agent like Prudent in insurance POSP business. But I believe volume might increase -- but of course, that might not justify the revenue. So that is point two.

other.statement: Monthly SIP book reached INR 1,272 crores, up 17.2% year-on-year; SIP market share rose to 3.73% from 3.49%.
other.quote: As of September 2026, our monthly SIP book stood at INR1,272 crores a growth of 17.2% over last one year. Our SIP collections are growing faster than the market. As a result, our share of SIP contribution has increased from 3.49% in September 2025 to 3.73% in September 2026.

other.statement: Market share in equity-oriented AUM (ex-ETF) improved to 2.7% from 2.59% a year ago.
other.quote: Our market share in equity-oriented AUM, excluding ETF, has also improved. It rose from 2.59% to 2.7% over the same period.

guidance.statement: FY27 skid assembly revenue target INR150-200 crores
guidance.quote: The target for this year is to achieve anywhere between INR150 crores to INR200 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue target INR715-725 crores, ~60% growth
guidance.quote: In terms of the overall growth, we expect that this year -- we expect the sales on an overall basis to achieve a grow th of almost 60% for the entire company for the entire year. So that's between -- so we expect this year to close somewhere about INR715 crores to INR725 crores at the least

guidance.statement: FY30 revenue target close to INR1,500 crores with ~25% EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: Based on the expansion that we are doing now, which will be completed by March of '28, we expect that -- and we expect this capacity to be at peak utilization in FY30. We expect the top line to be close to about INR1,500 crores for FY30.

demand.statement: Liquid cooling vertical contributed 24% of H1 FY27 revenue, driven by AI/data center demand
demand.quote: The liquid cooling vertical continues to gain significant traction driven by the growing adoption of advanced cooling technologies in high-performance data centers. This vertical contributed 24% to our revenue in H1 FY27.

margin.statement: Expect ~25% EBITDA margin by FY30 with slight upside
margin.quote: I think we would maintain at about 25%. That's what we believe. Obviously, there will be certain benefits from economies of scale, but also certain pressures in terms of the pricing as we scale up in our verticals. So, considering both, we expect margins to be 25% and slightly upwards.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 24.27%, H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 23.77% vs 21.19% YoY
margin.quote: Our EBITDA margin [inaudible 0:11:29] 24.27% as compared to [inaudible 0:11:33] last year. The profit after tax stood at INR36.56 crores, which is a -- 157% and our PAT margins...

order_book.statement: Confirmed supply pipeline for 3 months, exclusivity with US multinational for India liquid cooling
order_book.quote: So, we -- typically, we see a pipeline of confirmed supply over the next 3 months. So, we have -- we already have a freeze pipeline for this quarter and the start of the next quarter. It will be difficult for me to give you numbers on that, due to confidentiality with the customers.

capex.statement: Total capex INR202 crores: INR124 crores for hose capacity to 30M meters by Mar 2028, INR78 crores for skid capacity to 30K units by Mar 2028
capex.quote: In this month, we have announced a capacity expansion, which involves total capital expenditure of INR202 crores. This is aimed at from a long-term growth outlook and also increase the demand visibility that we are seeing across both our sectors.

pricing_cost.statement: Freight and forwarding costs increased significantly due to international shipping issues
pricing_cost.quote: The only one concern is that the cost of the shipments have increased significantly. If you see in terms of expenses also, one of the major expenses that has increased is the freight and forwarding because of the -- because we are aware of the issues internationally of the increase in the shipping cost.

product_mix.statement: Developing complementary products to SFN for liquid cooling infrastructure; design, sampling, testing ongoing
product_mix.quote: So, we are looking at developing products which are adjacent to SFN and which are used in the liquid cooling space itself. It will be difficult for me to comment on what is the product that we are building until and unless we have developed it and we have got the approvals for it.

risk.statement: International skid designs differ from India designs; require separate qualification, audits, controls
risk.quote: No. So, I would just like to clarify that the design of SFN internationally and the design of SFN in India is different. So -- and so that is the reason why it takes some time because the SFN, which has been designed for India, it has been designed keeping Indian conditions and Indian environment in mind as compared to the design internationally.

other.statement: Hose capacity expanded to 20M meters, further 10M meters by Mar 2028 to reach 30M meters
other.quote: In terms of the stainless steel flexible flow solutions, we have already completed the expansion of our manufacturing capacity to 20 million meters per annum. And we have planned a further expansion of 10 million meters per annum, which will take our total capacity to 30 million meters per annum, and it is estimated to be completed by March 2028.

other.statement: Skid capacity 12K units commissioned, targeting 15K by Dec 2026, then 30K by Mar 2028
other.quote: Our current capacity expansion plan of expansion to 15,000 units per annum is expected to be completed by December 2026. Out of that, we have already commissioned the 12,000 units per annum. And to add on top of that, we have planned the next phase of expansion, thereby raising our capacity from 15,000 units per annum to 30,000 skid assemblies per annum, and the same is expected to be completed by

guidance.statement: Uniware revenue growth expected >15% YoY from Q4 FY27; Shipway revenue growth expected >20% YoY from Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering more than 15% year -on-year revenue growth in Un iware from Quarter 4 FY27 onwards. For Shipway, we continue to expect year-on-year revenue growth to accelerate to more than 20% from Quarter 4 FY27 onwards.

guidance.statement: Shipway adjusted EBITDA break-even expected Q3 FY27; PAT profitability expected Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: For Shipway specifically, we expect the business to achieve adjusted EBITDA profitability starting Quarter 3 FY27, followed by PAT profitability starting Quarter 4 FY27.

guidance.statement: Consolidated profitability and margins expected to improve in H2 FY27 due to moderating investments and operating leverage
guidance.quote: Due to this, at a consolidated level, we expect profitability and margins t o improve during the second half of FY27, supported by continued revenue growth and increasing operating leverage.

demand.statement: International revenue contribution doubled to ~6% of Uniware revenue over two years; growing faster than domestic; profitable
demand.quote: Beyond India, our international business continues to grow. International markets now contribute approximately 6% of Uniware revenues, compared with around 3% at the time of our listing a couple of years ago. Its re venue contribution has doubled over two years, and the business remains profitable while growing faster than our domestic business

demand.statement: International steady-state target early double digits; India to remain dominant; Middle East and Southeast Asia focus
demand.quote: International tod ay is 6%. In steady state, it may get to early double digits. We're not looking at, let's say, a 40%, 50% contribution coming from international markets. India will continue to be a larger contributor to our revenue

margin.statement: Uniware adjusted EBITDA margin at 36% in Q2 FY27; consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin at 17% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Uniware is reporting 36% of adjusted EBITDA margin in Quarter 2 FY27. Even at a consol level, despite of the investments we have made to the business, as we mentioned that we have frontloaded most of the investments towards AI-led product development, talent, sales and marketing, despite of that, our adjusted EBITDA margins are 17%.

margin.statement: Steady-state adjusted EBITDA margin target 20%+ as investments taper and operating leverage improves
margin.quote: The idea is that steady state it should go back to 20% plus levels. As the last few quarters, we stepped up our investments in people, product, and market reach. As these investments translate into results, we anticipate increasing operating leverage, demonstrating increasing operating leverage and increasing profitability in the coming quarters.

order_book.statement: UniReco and UniCapture crossed INR3 crores annualized revenue run rate (~2.5% of Uniware revenue); 150+ clients using these modules
order_book.quote: UniReco and UniCapture have crossed an annualized revenue run rate of over INR3 crores, representing around 2.5% of Uniware revenues. During quarter 2 FY27, more than 150 clients were using these products.

order_book.statement: Uniware added 121 enterprise clients in Q2 FY27, up 17.5% YoY; onboarding 120-150 clients per quarter vs 85-90 at listing
order_book.quote: During Quarter 2 FY27, we added 121 enterprise clients, compared with 103 clients in the same quarter last year, representing a growth of 17.5%. These additions included both traditional enterprises and digital-first brands across multiple categories.

order_book.statement: Shipway crossed INR100 crores annualized revenue run rate; grew >15% YoY in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: With this growth, Shipway has crossed INR100 crores in annualized revenue run rate. Last three quarters, we were focused on building a strong foundation and investments to ensure sustainable growth, which is expected to be visible in the coming quarters.

capex.statement: Investments in AI, product development, talent, sales and marketing frontloaded in H1 FY27; incremental investments to moderate from Q3 FY27
capex.quote: With incremental investments expected to moderate from Quarter 3, continued revenue growth should support improving adjusted EBITDA and operating leverage during H2 FY27.

product_mix.statement: UniReco + UniCapture can lift realization 1.5-1.7x currently; expected to stabilize at 1.2-1.3x as pricing matures
product_mix.quote: As of now, combination of these can actually take the realization to anywhere between 1.5x to 1.7x if both these modules are adopted by the customer which is using Uniware. But we anticipate the pricing and the realization to stabilize anywhere between, let's say, 1.2x to 1.3x.

product_mix.statement: DNA AI companion launched in beta to 10-15 customers; currently free; monetization strategy to be determined after feedback
product_mix.quote: DNA is a beta launch as of now. It's been rolled out to about 10 to 15 customers. We are getting their feedback, and as of now, we are offering this for free. But as we as we make it more comprehensive in ter ms of use cases that different customers share their feedback with, we will figure out a monetization strategy for the same.

risk.statement: No competitive threat from 3PL players; brands mandate Unicommerce OMS/WMS for unified visibility across multiple fulfillment partners
risk.quote: So brands continue to work with multiple providers, or multiple fulfilment partners. What ends up happening is that typically what we've seen, a brand will choose one fulfilment partner for the North region, someone else for West, someone else for South, because different fulfilment partners have strength in particular regions. But they want a single, unified st ack to manage their operations. So

other.statement: M&A a key lever for 5x growth vision; evaluating adjacent product capabilities; criteria: customer fit, good product/team, profitable or path to profitability, reasonable valuation; patient approach, no fixed timeline
other.quote: One of the best utilizations of the cash that we've been adding in the -- on our balance sheet is to do M&A. We continue to look a t opportunities which are adjacent to what we offer today. For us, M&A will be a lot about adding new product capabilities that make sense for our existing customer base. We've talked about the framework that we use to evaluate candidates for M&A, which is that it shou

other.statement: Uniware NRR (net revenue retention) tracked as key metric alongside new client acquisition and profitability; rate per transaction not tracked due to heterogeneous mix
other.quote: The three ways to model our business are, growth of our existing clients, for which we report a metric called NRR , acquisition of new clients, which we report every quarter; and the profits that we're delivering in the business.

guidance.statement: Targeting launch of two projects with combined GDV of approximately Rs. 2,850 crore in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: We are targeting the launch of two projects with a combined GDV of approximately Rs. 2,850 crore in Q3 FY27.

demand.statement: Pre-sales remained moderate at Rs. 151 crore in Q2 FY27 and Rs. 306 crore in H1 FY27 amid evolving market dynamics; existing projects have healthy demand
demand.quote: Pre-sales for the quarter stood at Rs. 151 crore, with first-half pre-sales at Rs. 306 crore. While pre-sales remained moderate amid evolving market dynamics, we continue to prioritize timely project delivery, customer confidence and operational efficiency as key drivers of sustainable business growth.

margin.statement: Gross margin improved to 35% in Q2 FY27 from previous quarter; EBITDA margin at 24% for Q2 and 21.4% for H1 FY27
margin.quote: Gross margin improved to 35% during the quarter compared to the previous quarter, reflecting the strength of our project economics and our continued focus on maintaining healthy project-level profitability.

order_book.statement: Added four redevelopment projects across Malad, Kandivali and Borivali spanning 11 acres with 15 lakh sq ft saleable carpet area and GDV potential of Rs. 5,000 crore
order_book.quote: On the business development front, we further strengthened our presence across western Mumbai with the addition of four redevelopment projects across Malad, Kandivali and Borivali. These projects collectively span approximately 11 acres, with an estimated saleable carpet area of 15 lakh square feet and a combined GDV potential of approximately Rs. 5000 crore.

order_book.statement: Development pipeline provides strong visibility with estimated GDV of approximately Rs. 19,000 crore across 5.7 million sq ft saleable carpet area
order_book.quote: We have a robust pipeline with an estimated GDV of approximate ly Rs. 19,000 crore, across 5.7 million square feet of saleable carpet area

capex.statement: Incurred Rs. 70 crore towards approval costs for upcoming projects (Satya Shripal, Nutan Ayojan/Ascend) lying in inventory
capex.quote: So, for this recently acquired projects means we are planning for the upcoming projects, you know. Like Satya Shripal, then Nutan Ayojan which is Ascend. So, for all these projects till date we have incurred about Rs. 70 crores towards the approval cost.

pricing_cost.statement: Better realization on existing projects drove gross margin improvement; construction cost increases distributed over 2-3 years via percentage completion method; margins recover through realization value
pricing_cost.quote: So, overall, our realization has been better on the higher side on the existing projects and that has driven the EBITDA margin on the higher side or gross profit margin on the higher side.

product_mix.statement: Two new launches in Q3 FY27 (combined GDV Rs. 2,850 crore) plus Arkade Evoke (Bangur Nagar) and Arkade Sapphire (Santacruz) launched Jan-Oct to drive revenue recognition in Q4 FY27/Q1 FY28
product_mix.quote: So, say from this January to October, we have launched two projects, Arkade Evoke in Bangur Nagar and Arkade Sapphire in Santacruz. So, these projects are expected to fall in the revenue recognition bracket over the next Q4 or the Q1 of the next financial year.

fund_raise.statement: Entered MOU for Woollen Mills land parcel in Bhandup; transaction expected to complete in coming months; evaluating two more opportunities materializing in next 12 months
fund_raise.quote: We have entered into an MOU as well in the Bhandup market, Woollen Mills. That transaction is expected to get complete over the next coming few months. And we are also looking at a couple of opportunities which are there in the market, which would materialize in the next 12 months or so.

risk.statement: No major challenges faced in executing multiple redevelopment projects simultaneously; everything going as per plan and estimates
risk.quote: No. So, as of now, there are no major challenges that we have faced. And everything is going as per plan and estimates that we have.

guidance.statement: Gross margin band guided at 41-43% for the second half.
guidance.quote: From a gross margin point of view, obviously it will depend on inflation. This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to.

guidance.statement: Volume growth expected at 8-9% going forward driven by festive and wedding season.
guidance.quote: We feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.

demand.statement: International business grew 30% in Q2 and 28% in H1 across all geographies.
demand.quote: So overall, the growths have been strong. Both, quarter two is at about 30% growth and H1 at about 28% of what you are able to see. Growths are across markets. Whether it is Asia, Africa, Middle East, growths are across markets of what we've been able to get.

demand.statement: Q2 decorative volume grew 6.4% on high base; H1 volume up 8%; rural leading urban, B2B strong in T1/T2 cities.
demand.quote: The 13 | overall volumes despite a very high inflationary environment and the steep price hikes which have been taken, both in quarter one and quarter two, we have been able to grow at a good volume of about 6.4% at the base of the last year, which was almost about an 11% growth in terms of a like-to-like quarter

margin.statement: Consolidated H1 PBDIT margin at 18.2% within band; PAT grew 24%.
margin.quote: On a H1 side again, which is possibly the right perspective of this quarter, the growths are very strong at the top line as well as at the PBDIT margin which is at about 18.2% in the band what we have spoken of and also the PAT growth being very healthy at about 24%.

margin.statement: VAE backward integration expected to yield 300-500 bps benefit on relevant products at full potential.
margin.quote: We believe that when it really works to its full potential, it should really give us some advantage of 300 bps to 500 bps on relevant products.

margin.statement: Standalone Q2 gross margin dipped due to inflation outpacing price hikes; H1 PBDIT margin at 19.6% within guided band.
margin.quote: If you were to look at the overall standalone financials, the net sales growth is 14.8%. The gross margin we have spoken of is down. The PBDIT growth is about 5.9%. If you see from a like-to-like quarter perspective, PBDIT margin is about 17.1% compared to the last year, same quarter which was about 18.5%.

capex.statement: Phase 1 of VAE facility commissioned in September; full capacity of 150 KT expected next year.
capex.quote: Today we have got the phase 1 of it, out of the total CapEx of about Rs. 3,250 crores which is there. The capacity is quite big. What we are confident about is that, as we go forward, within a year's time we should be able to ramp up to full capacity offering this GenNext emulsion which comes in a very different way.

pricing_cost.statement: Price hikes of 7% in Q1, 5% in Q2, and 3.5% announced for November; calibrated to balance demand.
pricing_cost.quote: We have taken now further price increases. We have announced an almost 3.5% price increase for November, which has already been announced, which takes into account the impact of anti-dumping duties as well as what's coming in.

product_mix.statement: New products contribute 18% of revenues; premiumization focus continues across portfolio.
product_mix.quote: Today, I'm happy to announce that we keep on testing this benchmark of the new product contribution to the overall revenues and today the new products contribute to about 18% of the revenues which just shows that the innovation cycle, what we speak is very strong and robust.

risk.statement: Raw material volatility, anti-dumping duty on TiO2, and competitive intensity cited as key near-term risks.
risk.quote: overall outlook continues to be a little bit volatile. Obviously, we see raw material inflation which is really happening. Overall, the volatility continues. The competitive intensity in the market is also very strong and challenging. At the same time, the fact 24 | that there are other challenges which also will come , which is about the Anti-Dumping Duty which we see in TiO

other.statement: Interim dividend of Rs. 5.75 declared; H1 payout ratio maintained at ~21.4%.
other.quote: So going by that, we have announced an interim dividend of Rs. 5.75. We've broadly looked at the same payout ratio of about 21.4% in H1 FY27 as compared to what it was last year.

other.statement: Industrial JV2 (APPPG) revenue up 28% in Q2; margin pressure due to lag in price increases.
other.quote: When we look at JV2, again this is a JV which is largely for General Industrial which includes protective and powder coatings. Here also the revenue has been very strong, about 28% growth in Q2, what we have been able to really get in. And at the same time, on the bottom line there has been a little bit of a setback here, given the fact that the price increases came with a little bit of a delay.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance revised to 14%-15% for FY27
guidance.quote: We are also optimistic of the upcoming festive season and it will give a boost to our performance and we also revise our revenue guidance to 14%-15% for this year.

guidance.statement: Retail revenue guidance of Rs. 160 crores for FY27
guidance.quote: We have given a guidance of approximately Rs. 160 crores by the end of the year, which we are very confident of achieving.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at ~14% excluding 150bps retail impact
guidance.quote: We have always had an EBITDA guidance of about 14%. We believe that it is too early to change that guidance because there is a lot of uncertainty.

demand.statement: Demand broadly stable in H1 FY27 despite uneven monsoon and raw material inflation
demand.quote: Despite uneven monsoon and increasing inflationary pressures in key raw materials, the demand across the textile and apparel sector remained broadly stable during the first half of FY '27.

demand.statement: Recovery seen in Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets over last year
demand.quote: Over the last year and continuing to this year, we have seen recovery in that. So, Tier-2 and Tier-3 are very important for our Fabric business.

margin.statement: EBITDA decline primarily due to raw material cost increase, retail impact within budgeted 150bps
margin.quote: So the largest part of the decline in EBITDA has been the raw material costs that have played a part. Of course, retail has been a part to play, but that is well within our budget that we have indicated earlier.

order_book.statement: Retail business contributed Rs. 65 crores in H1 FY27
order_book.quote: In total, if you look at the first half of the year, then the retail Z ECODE and DEVO business together has contributed to about in the range of Rs. 65 crores to the topline

capex.statement: Capex guidance of Rs. 100 crores for FY27, Rs. 51 crores spent in H1
capex.quote: We had indicated about Rs. 100 crores for the whole year and we believe that we will be in line with that number.

pricing_cost.statement: Cumulative price hikes of 4%-6% over last 6 months to offset raw material inflation
pricing_cost.quote: I think in over the last 6 odd months, we have cumulatively taken a price hike of about, I think between 4%-6% in that kind of range.

product_mix.statement: Fabrics 77%, Garments 16%, Yarn and others 7% of Q2 FY27 revenue
product_mix.quote: During the quarter, Fabrics contributed 77% of the revenue while Garments accounted for 16% and Yarn and others contributed 7%.

fund_raise.statement: Preference share listing expected to take minimum 6 months
fund_raise.quote: As of today, looking into the circumstances, we can say around 6 months minimum it will take.

risk.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty makes raw material outlook unpredictable
risk.quote: It is very difficult to predict how the geopolitical scenario will pan out. Still, the scenario is quite unstable and therefore, it is difficult to give you a certain number.

other.statement: Debt-equity ratio at 0.58 as of September 30, 2026
other.quote: Our debt-equity ratio as of September 30, 2026 stood at 0.58.

other.statement: First interim dividend of Rs. 4 per equity share approved for FY27
other.quote: The Board of Directors has approved first interim dividend of Rs. 4 per equity share of Rs. 2 each in FY '27.

guidance.statement: Target consolidated EBITDA margin of 17-18% for FY27
guidance.quote: We should be up to between 15% to 20%. I think 17%, 18% is our target.

guidance.statement: Expect improvement in domestic business during H2 FY27 supported by project commissioning, O&M commencement and water infrastructure recovery
guidance.quote: While domestic execution has remained subdued in the first half, we expect an improvement during the second half, supported by project commissioning, commencement of O&M activities and a recovery in the water infrastructure business.

guidance.statement: Domestic project execution to accelerate rapidly once West Bengal funds received; weather favorable for construction
guidance.quote: We have plans to accelerate rapidly, and the client is also very keen that we rapidly accelerate. And also the weather is good. I think this is peak construction period. So all things aligned, things should pick up, as I said, from next week, and we'll be able to give a clearer picture next call.

demand.statement: Domestic product demand strong but funding constraints causing postponement; thermal power plant orders expected
demand.quote: The market for domestic product remains very strong. You have to understand that over the last 6 months since this war has started and crude oil prices have gone up, there are fiscal constraints, and these are all public infrastructure expenditure made by either state or central governments. So considering the environment, there is a huge demand for pumps. Huge demand. But the funding resources ar

margin.statement: Gross margins strong; EBITDA margin dip due to revenue fluctuations not margin pressure
margin.quote: I think if you see, our gross margins have actually improved. The revenue is the challenge. There has been a slight dip in the revenue, which is -- but it's not the gross margin. So the gross margins are strong.

margin.statement: International project contracts have cost pass-through clauses protecting margins
margin.quote: All our projects are margin -- cost pass-through. So there are cost variation clauses in every contract.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin at 14.33% in H1 FY27; confident of reaching 17-18% target for full year
margin.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 14.33%, while PAT from continuing operation was at INR93 crores, a marked increase of 20% Y-o-Y.

order_book.statement: Product division order backlog at approximately INR1,000 crores with 52% international
order_book.quote: Our product division order backlog stood at approximately INR1,000 crores at the end of first half, providing visibility for the coming quarters. International orders account for nearly 52% of this backlog.

order_book.statement: Project division order backlog at approximately INR4,079 crores with 53% international
order_book.quote: The project division's order backlog stood at approximately INR4,079 crores at the end of first half, providing substantial visibility for future execution. The international projects accounted for approximately 53% of this backlog.

order_book.statement: International order backlog region split: South Africa ~INR2,400 crores, Italy ~INR350 crores, Australia ~INR80-90 crores
order_book.value: INR2,400 crores SA; INR350 crores Italy; INR80-90 crores Australia
order_book.quote: South Africa is because of the projects there is the largest, approximately INR2,400 crores, I think. And because that's the project long-term orders. And Italy is approximately INR350 crores because those are shorter duration orders. Australia is approximately INR80, INR90 crores

capex.statement: No capacity constraints in international product business; growth dependent on MENA recovery and acquisitions
capex.quote: The international product, you see that's why internationally, our product businesses are stable. And unfortunately, one of the areas has been that our businesses are quite dependent on the MENA region. So we are hoping for traction in the MENA region to pick up.

product_mix.statement: Product division revenue declined due to deferred dispatches from heavy monsoon; expected to even out in H2
product_mix.quote: The product business, I think I don't want to quantify. It will even out. What our basic idea is that a large number of them are now -- should be dispatched. I think seasonally, September was a very heavy monsoon month. And therefore, the project sites did not accept the goods. So I think it will even out in this quarter and surely in the second half.

risk.statement: MENA geopolitical flux affecting new contract finalization and dispatches
risk.quote: Presently this quarter, as I mentioned, geopolitically, the Middle East remains an area of flux, and that is affecting new contract finalization, dispatches to that area to some extent.

other.statement: O&M order book at INR550 crores; contribution not significant in H1 but expected to pick up in H2
other.quote: It's about INR550 crores now. INR525 crores, we got an order of INR550 crores. Some amount is executed, so INR545, INR540 something.

other.statement: International revenue grew 38% YoY in H1 FY27 to INR626 crores
other.quote: International revenue for the first half increased 38% to INR626 crores compared with INR458 crores in first half last year.

guidance.statement: Q3 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin will be very close to 22% if not more
guidance.quote: On a consolidated basis, we'll be very close to 22%, if not more.

guidance.statement: Expect quarterly revenues to cross INR100 crores in Q3 FY27 and target INR500 crores by FY28 organically without further acquisitions
guidance.value: INR100 crores quarterly; INR500 crores by FY28
guidance.quote: The trajectory is clear. We expect quarterly revenues to cross INR100 crores in Q3 of the current year, and we are on track of mission INR500 crores by 2028.

guidance.statement: Committed to over 22% consolidated EBITDA margin for the collective business at INR500 crores scale
guidance.quote: So collectively, we are very confident of over 22% EBITDA margin for the collective business.

demand.statement: Branded prescription growth is in excess of double digits at 11-11.5% but below management expectations; expect upward of 1.5x IPM growth in Q3
demand.quote: Branded pure-play prescription is upward of 10 percentage, contributing around 11%, 11.5%. However, this is also lower than my own expectations. And trust me, those numbers will completely change going forward in quarter 3.

demand.statement: Jagsonpal grew ~15% in Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27 versus IPM growth of ~12% and ~11% respectively, outperforming the market
demand.quote: During the same period, Jagsonpal delivered a growth of close to around 15%. For the first half of FY27, IPM, which is Indian pharma market growth stood at around 11%. In comparison to that, Jagsonpal recorded a growth of around 15%.

margin.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin stable at 22.7% in Q2 FY27 despite planned investments; consolidated EBITDA margin at 19.3%
margin.quote: Standalone EBITDA margins for the quarter remained broadly stable at 22.7%, despite planned advance investments in people, marketing, and medical inputs, as indicated by Manish in his speech, while our consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 19.3%.

margin.statement: Standalone gross margin improved ~70 bps to 64.7% in H1 FY27; expect 50-75 bps annual improvement from product mix and price increases
margin.quote: Standalone gross margin stood at 64.1% for the quarter, whereas it was 64.7% for the half year, indicating an improvement of close to 70 bps over the corresponding previous period.

order_book.statement: Group Pharma Wellness portfolio integrated with cross-training completed; cross-sell through existing field force planned in Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka; adds ~10,000 unique doctors
order_book.quote: The Group Pharma Wellness portfolio, which is acquired this month, has 2 established brands, one in hematinics and second in respiratory, in 6 states in India and around 10,000 additional unique doctors have been added. It is already integrated with one of our largest business, create cross-training of the brands, medical marketing is completed.

order_book.statement: Completed two acquisitions: Aequitas (July 2026) for hospital channel entry and Group Pharma Wellness portfolio (October 2026) adding hematinics and respiratory brands in 6 states
order_book.quote: We completed 2 acquisitions, which provide us now with additional growth levers. We also take pride in the way we have been able to structure the transactions, which derisks us and retains the strength of our balance sheet for further initiatives.

order_book.statement: Aequitas integration: consolidated procurement and distribution, removed duplicate overhead, appointed dedicated business head, rationalizing portfolio; first value-added launch targeted by end of November
order_book.quote: The Aequitas acquired in July '26 gave us an immediate entry to hospital and institution channel. It's a very first quarter with us. We have consolidated procurement and distribution along with Jagsonpal, removed some duplicate overhead, appointed a dedicated business head, and begun rationalizing the portfolio towards the profitable growth.

risk.statement: Hospital business (Aequitas) is rate-driven, contract-driven with price pressures on APIs; corrective supply chain actions to reflect from Q4 FY27
risk.quote: You would also notice that there has been price pressures in the last 12 months, especially on the APIs and all front. These are critical care products you can't do much about. So nothing has been a surprise. The corrective actions that we have taken will start reflecting in the financials only from Q4 onwards.

risk.statement: Pharmarack secondary sales data (12-16.8% growth) runs ahead of primary revenue; expect convergence in a couple of quarters; internal prescription branded growth >10% but not at 16.8%
risk.quote: See, they have been reflecting anywhere between 12% to 16.8%. 16.8% is our highest pivot that they have shown in any given month in last 6 months. Vansh Gupta: No, but I mean last quarter... Amrut Medhekar: Because I just want to also differentiate, largest proportion comes from the prescription branded for us, and that growth is in excess of double digits, so it is more than 10% for sure, interna

other.statement: Building JPL hospital team to cross-sell portfolio into Aequitas network; MR productivity up ~10% with target to exceed productivity threshold
other.quote: We are building the JPL hospital team so that we can cross-sell our portfolio into Aequitas network, which opens institutional tenders and first prescription opportunities for us. Early results are encouraging, with MR productivity already up by around 10%, and our target is to go beyond the threshold of productivity that we aspire for.

other.statement: Generated net operating cash of INR25 crores at consolidated level in H1 FY27; cash and bank balance over INR135 crores maintained despite dividend payout and acquisition investments
other.value: INR25 crores net operating cash; INR135 crores cash balance
other.quote: Despite the enhanced dividend payout and our ongoing investments in acquisitions, the company continues to maintain a strong cash position with cash and bank balance of over INR135 crores, and we continue to generate net operating cash of INR25 crores at a consolidated level during first half of FY27.

demand.statement: Strong demand momentum seen across industrial, power and infrastructure segments
demand.quote: Looking ahead, we continue to see a strong demand momentum across industrial, power and infrastructure segments and expected to maintain a healthy growth and profitability trajectory.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 adjusted operational EBITDA margin 16.6%, down from 17% YoY due to 2.8% raw material cost increase and event expenses
margin.quote: Adjusted operational EBITDA margin is slightly decreased to 16.6% compared to 17% last year. The slight drop in percentage EBITDA is mainly due to increase in raw material costs by 2.8% due to geopolitical issues, as well as we had a couple of good events where we have spent some money, that is, SEMICON India, Transrail, and so many things.

order_book.statement: Order backlog improved 38.9% from March 31, 2026, closing at Rs. 17.4 crores; Q2 end backlog at Rs. 39 crores
order_book.quote: After backlog has improved 38.9% from 31 st March '26, closing at Rs. 17.4 crores, this increase is giving us confidence for our future quarters.

capex.statement: Phase 1B packaging capex to be funded by term loan backed by promoter immovable properties and FDs; 5% interest subsidy from government
capex.quote: So, basically, this loan would be backed by certain immovable properties and some FDs, which would act as collateral and security for the loan and these properties belong to the promoters. Secondly, on the loan approval part, we had a call today morning with the bank authorities, bank officers, and they have informed us that they have obtained all the internal approvals and it is just a matter of

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material costs increased 2.8% due to geopolitical issues, impacting EBITDA margin
pricing_cost.quote: The slight drop in percentage EBITDA is mainly due to increase in raw material costs by 2.8% due to geopolitical issues, as well as we had a couple of good events where we have spent some money, that is, SEMICON India, Transrail, and so many things.

product_mix.statement: Focus on new product development for railways and power sector to sustain growth; SiC epitaxy, packaging and fabrication are three revenue phases
product_mix.quote: Our focus on new product development in the existing business for railways and power sector will continue to sustain the current growth trajectory.

fund_raise.statement: Phase 1A funded entirely by equity; Phase 1B to be funded by debt only, no further equity
fund_raise.quote: Because 1A, we have already done entire equity contribution, no debt, and 1B, we are looking at debt contribution.

risk.statement: Odisha plant commercial production delayed pending government building and fire clearances; no fixed timeline
risk.quote: We are only doing internal testing of our reactors. We are waiting for certain clearances from the government of Odisha. The building clearance and the fire clearance, these things are in process. So, as soon as it comes, then we can start. So, there is no timeline. It all depends on the government's clearances as early as possible.

other.statement: Railways repeat orders driving 70-80% growth; defense prototype testing done, awaiting RFP; export first order 70% executed
other.quote: So, defense, we are yet to start, but railways, we are getting repeat orders. That is why if you see our railway business this year, I am able to see at least 70 % to 80% growth over last year quantity, last year value.

other.statement: Participating in Ministry of Power and MeitY indigenous BSV HVDC development; submitted interest, plan due in a month
other.quote: Yes, we already are participating. We already are participating. And so far, we have submitted our interest. And then in about a month's time, we would submit our plan.

guidance.statement: Revised full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance to 25%+ from earlier 20%+
guidance.quote: Also, on the top line, we are revising our guidance from earlier 20% plus to 25% plus for the full year.

guidance.statement: Maintained full-year FY27 EBITDA margin target at double-digit
guidance.quote: We continue to maintain our full year margin trajectory to the double-digit number.

guidance.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 maintained at INR 200-250 crore
guidance.quote: Our capex guidance for FY 27 remains at INR 200-250 crore.

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 33% y-o-y to INR 1,342 crore, outpacing industry
demand.quote: The Q2 FY 27 revenue stood at INR 1,342 crore, up 33% y-o-y and 10% quarter-on-quarter (q-o-q), outpacing broader industry trends.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 8.2% vs 9% in H1 FY26 due to material cost impact
margin.quote: Consolidated EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 110 crore, up 21% y-o-y with a margin of 8.2% compared with 9% in Q2 FY 26.

margin.statement: Expect H2 FY27 EBITDA margin of 10.5-11% to achieve full-year double-digit target
margin.quote: for H2 specifically, we would be expecting a margin of, let's say, anywhere between 10.5-11% for H2.

order_book.statement: Order book at INR 2,580 crore with 80% LED and 11% EV programs
order_book.quote: Our order book is at INR 2,580 crore, and LED lighting accounts for approximately 80% of the order book, while EV (Electric Vehicle) program accounts for approximately 11%.

order_book.statement: 60% of order book (INR ~1,500 crore) to be delivered in FY28
order_book.quote: almost 60% of the order book gets delivered in FY 28, which is almost close to INR 1,500 crore revenue.

capex.statement: INR 80 crore capex spent in H1 FY27; remaining INR 120-170 crore in H2
capex.quote: Out of that, in H1, we have already done around INR 80 crore of capex, and the remaining will happen for the project which we are progressing in the H2.

product_mix.statement: LED lighting share reached 63% of H1 FY27 revenue, up 200 bps y-o-y
product_mix.quote: LED (Light Emitting Diode) lighting, which has reached 63% of revenue in H1 FY 27, up 200 bps (basis points) y-o-y.

risk.statement: Geopolitical developments and energy prices could further pressure input costs and margins
risk.quote: in the near term, we remain watchful of the geopolitical developments and energy prices, which could further put pressure on input costs and weigh on margins.

risk.statement: Margin guidance assumes no significant further volatility from West Asia crisis
risk.quote: there is a caveat that I'm hoping that there is no significant further volatility based on the ongoing West Asia crisis. If these were to continue, then I would probably have to relook at the guidance.

other.statement: Net long-term debt reduced to INR 188 crore (Sep 2026) from INR 291 crore (Mar 2025); net debt/EBITDA improved to 2.2x from 3.0x
other.quote: Our net long-term debt as on 30th September 2026 stood at INR 188 crore compared with INR 291 crore as on 31st March 2025, and our net debt to EBITDA has improved to 2.2 as on 30th September 2026 versus 3.0 as on 31st March 2025.

other.statement: Company LED penetration at 63-65% (PV 55-60%, 2W/3W 75-80%); industry at 50-55%
other.quote: our estimate is that as we are close to 63-65% of LED penetration collectively, and out of that, our PV is close to 55-60% and 2-Wheeler, 3-Wheeler is in the range of 75-80%. And the market is also close to 50-55%.

guidance.statement: Consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue ₹275 cr vs ₹210 cr, up 31%; EBITDA ₹36 cr vs ₹13 cr; PAT ₹24 cr vs ₹17 cr
guidance.quote: So, as far as consol revenue is concerned for September quarter, it stands at ₹275 crores versus ₹210 crores registering top line growth of 31 %. EBITDA up from ₹13 to ₹36 crores and PAT up from ₹17 to ₹24 crores.

guidance.statement: Consolidated H1 FY27 revenue ₹653 cr up 17%; EBITDA ₹83 cr vs ₹51 cr; PAT ₹64 cr vs ₹59 cr
guidance.quote: As far as first 6 months are concerned, on a consol basis, revenue stands at ₹653 crores up by 17%, EBITDA at ₹83 crores versus ₹51 crores and PAT at ₹64 crores versus ₹59 crores.

guidance.statement: Standalone Q2 FY27 revenue ₹170 cr vs ₹155 cr; EBITDA ₹30 cr vs ₹27 cr; PAT ₹29 cr
guidance.quote: On a standalone basis, the revenue stands at ₹170 crores vis-à-vis ₹155 crores, EBITDA at ₹ 30 crores versus ₹27 crores and PAT at ₹29 crores.

guidance.statement: Standalone H1 FY27 revenue ₹411 cr vs ₹384 cr; PAT ₹57 cr vs ₹65 cr but business PAT higher
guidance.quote: And on a standalone basis, revenue stands at ₹411 crores versus ₹384 crores, while PAT at ₹57 crores versus ₹65 crores, but here if you look at PAT bridge, business PAT during 6 months is higher than previous year.

demand.statement: Demand depends on temperature; clean channel inventory means even normal summer should yield good sales
demand.quote: Demand to a great degree at the consumer level will depend on temperature. If the temperatures are high enough, then product will sell even if it is more expensive. If the temperature is not high enough, products will not sell even if you discount them. Th at is the nature of seasonal categories. As we sit today, because the channel is completely clean from the previous year, even modest demand sh

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 13% vs 6.4% despite gross margin down ~4% due to operating leverage and cost discipline
margin.quote: EBITDA margin expansion as conveyed earlier, despite on a consol basis due to input cost pressure gross margin is lower by about 4%, but EBITDA margin percentage stands at 13% vis-a-vis 6.4%, one on account of operating leverage and secondly, on account of cost discipline and product mix.

margin.statement: Standalone H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 14.4%, up 18% YoY; expect next two quarters somewhat better
margin.quote: in the first half, on a standalone basis, our EBITDA level has actually improved by 18% and EBITDA margin is at 14.4%. In the next two quarters, in fact, it should be somewhat better than this.

margin.statement: Standalone gross margin down ~2.3% but EBITDA margin almost maintained
margin.quote: on a standalone basis, even though gross margin percentage is down by about 2.3%, the EBITDA margin has been almost maintained.

order_book.statement: IMPCO Mexico Q2 revenue ₹40 cr vs ₹17 cr; GSK China ₹23 cr; Australia+USA ₹46 cr vs ₹35 cr
order_book.quote: As far as IMPCO Mexico is concerned, the top line is ₹ 40 crores versus ₹ 17 crores. However, the summer was delayed, so in June quarter, there was a decline in sales, but in this quarter, there has been a decent increase and part of the loss of sales has been made up in the current quarter. As far as GSK China is concerned, it is ₹ 23 crores of sales. As far as Brazil and USA are concerned, of co

capex.statement: New products (RAC, BLDC fans, air purifiers) zero capex for ACs and fans; purifier may need small capex later
capex.quote: Just like our existing business , here also , we will continue following absolutely asset -light operating models. There will be outsourced business model , and as far as air conditioners and BLDC ceiling fans are concerned, there will be zero CAPEX. In air purifier, down the line, there may be a small amount of CAPEX.

pricing_cost.statement: Air cooler margins ~45.9% standalone Q2, down 2.3% YoY; expect similar going forward
pricing_cost.quote: as far as air coolers are concerned, the margins would be more or less what you saw so far, which are, at the moment, on a standalone basis, we ended the quarter at 45.9%, which was 2.3% less than at the same time in the previous year.

pricing_cost.statement: RAC pricing mid-premium segment, not entry-level; specs higher, priced accordingly, similar to Voltas/Samsung for like-to-like features
pricing_cost.quote: Pricing for residential ACs will be in the mid-premium sort of segment. Obviously, we will not compete with the likes of Daikin or Mitsubishi or Hitachi or one of those.

product_mix.statement: BISP (Beyond India Summer Products) 51% of consolidated revenue at ₹625 cr TTM; EBITDA high-single digit, accretive
product_mix.quote: As far as Item #3 , Beyond India Summer Products (BISP) on a consolidated basis, it contributed ₹625 crores of top line. As conveyed earlier and on a consol basis, BISP constitutes of all products and geography sales, which is not dependent on India Summer. So, basically, this is the de-risking from India Summer and that now constitutes 51% of top line on a consol basis

product_mix.statement: Standalone BISP ₹192 cr TTM (24% of revenue), EBITDA ~10%, each category EBITDA positive
product_mix.quote: On a standalone basis, BISP products have contributed in all ₹192 crores of top line in trailing 12 months, that is 24 % and BISP as a whole, EBITDA is around 10 % and each component of the BISP category even on a standalone basis is also EBITDA positive and accretive with minimum capital employment.

risk.statement: International growth uncertain due to Middle East shipping issues, freight costs, tariff uncertainties
risk.quote: International business will grow, but there are uncertainties. For example, current Middle East situation was a big deterrent in growth this year, wherein we had customers who wanted to buy coolers and there are cases where we have got the money in advance, but we are unable to ship. The freight costs have shot up. On the other end, these are these tariff related things.

other.statement: Second interim dividend ₹2/share (face value ₹2), payout ~₹13 cr; total ₹3/share (~₹21 cr) so far in FY27
other.quote: Today, Board of Directors have declared second interim dividend of ₹2 per share on a face value of ₹2. In all, the payout will be about ₹13 crores. This is in addition to interim dividend of ₹1 announced post-June quarter, in all ₹3 and close to ₹21 crores of payout so far.

other.statement: Consolidated ROCE (PBIT/core capital) 143% vs 57% YoY on TTM Sep; standalone negative capital employed, infinite ROCE, RoNW 21%
other.quote: on a consol basis stands at ₹104 crores versus ₹322 crores translating into ROCE percentage i.e. PBIT by capital employed (core capital) 143% versus 57% and return on net worth at 20%. While on a standalone basis, it is a negative capital employed during first 6 months and hence in a way academically it is an infinite ROCE and return on net worth of 21%

guidance.statement: Bharuch plant overall utilization expected 70-75% by year-end FY27
guidance.quote: I would say overall, would be between 70% to 75%.

order_book.statement: Rail tender delayed, committee to be set in 2-3 weeks, interim orders placed on wagon builders
order_book.quote: Tender was delayed and the tender hopefully should get into in terms of -- because committee has not been set yet, committee will be set and all that stuff will happen in the next 2, 3 weeks.

capex.statement: Rail expansion at Jamshedpur and plain bearing at Bharuch on target, trial runs Nov-Dec, PPAPs to follow
capex.quote: The new line would start getting into the trial runs in November and December only, then the PPAPs would start and then we'll qualify those lines.

capex.statement: GGB FRC and metal polymer investments at Bharuch ~INR 70 cr total, asset turn 1.5-2x expected
capex.quote: This Bharuch investments for GGB, what's going on for both FRC and metal polymer put together, I think INR35 crores, INR35 crores, INR70 crores of investments.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost inflation must be passed on, industry cannot absorb; 50% of 130 bps gross margin impact from unfavorable mix, 50% from input cost timing gap
pricing_cost.quote: So probably I would say 50% is because of unfavorable mix and 50% is because of input cost difference between price and cost timing difference.

product_mix.statement: Unfavorable mix in Q2 due to low rail share (16% vs higher historical), rail tender delayed
product_mix.quote: Rail was low in the quarter. That is the unfavorable mix because the global -- the rail tender was delayed.

risk.statement: Geopolitics, trade uncertainties, supply chain realignments, global demand unpredictability
risk.quote: Global industry activity continues to be influenced by geopolitics. So that is a challenge, as we all know, trade-related uncertainties are very much there and supply chain alignments are happening with every passing week.

other.statement: Bharuch SRB lines at 70% utilization, CRB lines below 60%, overall plant ~60% in Q2 FY27
other.quote: SRB lines, we have already reached 70% for the quarter, what we promised in the last quarter. CRB lines are still below 60%, I would say. So on an average, it is at 60%.

other.statement: Bharuch plant revenue INR 75 cr in Q2 FY27, heavily export/intercompany, SRB lines gaining traction
other.quote: From a revenue perspective for this quarter was very close to INR75 crores.

guidance.statement: Targets 60% gross profit and 30% EBIT margin in core coding and marking business
guidance.quote: So we target about 60% gross profit and about 30% EBIT.

demand.statement: Coding and marking segment sees steady growth with new customers added and development in new printer, ink, cartridge technologies
demand.quote: The business outlook for the coding and marking segment for the next half is exciting. With new customer base getting added to our portfolio, we are also in the midst of development in new technologies in printers, inks and

margin.statement: Standalone COGS improved to 41.65% of operating revenue in Q2 FY27 from 42.32% in previous quarter
margin.quote: On a standalone basis, the cost of goods sold is about 41.65% of the operating revenue for the quarter 2. On comparison to the previous quarter, this was 42.32% of the operating revenue.

margin.statement: Standalone employee costs at 17% of operating revenue in Q2 FY27 vs 18% in prior year quarter
margin.quote: Employee costs are 17% of the operating revenue Q2 of FY26-'27. Comparative period in previous year, it was approximately 18% and for the entire FY25-'26, it was 19%.

margin.statement: Consolidated COGS increased to 44% of operating revenue in Q2 FY27 from 40% in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: The cost of goods sold is 44% of the operating revenue. Compared to the Q2 of FY25-'26, it was about 40%.

order_book.statement: Co-packing business in packaging division progressing with regular orders
order_book.quote: The co-packing business is going well. That's not a problem. I think that's definitely progressing and we've got like regular orders for that.

capex.statement: Invested over INR 100 crores in Track & Trace business over last six years
capex.quote: Even in the Track & Trace business, we've invested more than a INR 100 crores already so far over the last six years.

pricing_cost.statement: Price increases already implemented in coding and marking; input cost reduction and overhead optimization expected to improve profitability
pricing_cost.quote: We have already implemented certain price increase. With reduction in input costs and overheads, we feel that our profitability will definitely improve.

risk.statement: V-Shapes development taking longer than expected due to machine reliability, material cost, and team restructuring challenges
risk.quote: But all three acquisitions are fundamentally in Europe with technology acquisitions. MEA, which is our own subsidiary, is fundamentally a geographical expansion. And Sri Lanka has been around for a long time. And yeah, that was the firs t geographical expansion that Control Print did. So that sort of covers, I think, pretty much all the subsidiaries and

other.statement: Coding and marking domestic market is oligopoly; Control Print plus three others dominate ~80% market share
other.quote: And we in the domestic market of coding and marking, we are an Oligopoly. So we along with the other three players, we dominate about 80% of the domestic coding and marking.

other.statement: V-Shapes next-generation machine blueprint targeted for completion by January or February
other.quote: Our target is to finish that in January or February. So we have a blueprint for the next sets of machines that we will make.

demand.statement: Chemicals demand supported by domestic consumption in textiles, alumina, infrastructure; future capacity additions may create near-term supply-demand imbalances
demand.quote: In India, underlying demand remained supported by domestic consumption across textiles, alumina and infrastructure. Capacity additions over last few years have been well absorbed by the markets, however future capacity additions may create near-term supply-demand imbalances and put pressure on prices and margins.

demand.statement: Bioseed Kharif season challenging due to El Niño; Corn, Cotton, Paddy acreage below last year in south and central India; Cotton volumes better than last year
demand.quote: The Kharif season remained very challenging for the Bioseed business due to a broader climatic pressure especially in south and central India. Despite a late recovery in rainfall, acreage under key crops such as Corn, Cotton and Paddy stayed below last year's levels.

demand.statement: Shriram Farm Solutions topline declined 10% YoY due to timing difference in Research wheat seed sales; portion may reverse in Q3 subject to crop conditions
demand.quote: The SFS business witnessed a decline in the topline in Q2 FY 27 compared with Q2 FY 26, largely on account of the difference in timing of sales of Research wheat seed. A portion of the timing-related impact may reverse in Q3, subject to crop conditions and channel demand.

margin.statement: Chemicals PBDIT fell to INR 158 crores from INR 254 crores YoY due to higher input costs and absence of INR 76 crore Gujarat incentive
margin.quote: The PBDIT for this quarter stood at Rs 158 crores against Rs 254 crores last year, as higher input costs more than offset the benefit of better realizations and volumes. Further, last year there was onetime positive impact of Rs. 76 crores towards incentive from the Government of Gujarat.

margin.statement: Vinyl PBDIT rose to INR 51 crores from INR 12 crores YoY on higher PVC and Carbide volumes and realizations
margin.quote: PBDIT was higher at Rs 51 crores as compared to Rs 12 crores last year, led by better volumes and realizations, partially offset by higher input costs.

margin.statement: Sugar & Ethanol PBDIT increased to INR 62 crores from INR 33 crores YoY; prior year had INR 15.5 crore power tariff revision benefit
margin.quote: PBDIT for the segment came in at Rs 62 crores as against Rs 33 crores last year. In Q2 FY26, there was a significant positive impact of Rs 15.5 crores on account of the upward revision of power tariff by UPPCL as mentioned earlier.
