order_book.statement: Fenesta order book healthy; project business at 45% causes volatility but no challenge seen
order_book.quote: it is still a very healthy order book, we do not see any challenge.

capex.statement: Debottlenecking at Bharuch and Kota to improve energy efficiency and increase Caustic capacity at INR 120 crores
capex.quote: we are debottlenecking operations at Bharuch and Kota to improve energy efficiency of our current operations and increase Caustic capacity at a project cost of INR 120 crores

capex.statement: Setting up specialty PVC compounds, medical grades, and HFFR polymer compounds in JV Shriram Teknor at INR 133 crores total, with INR 50 crores equity
capex.quote: we are setting up new lines for manufacture of speciality compounds of PVC, speciality medical grades and diversification into the manufacture of Halogen-Free Flame Retardant (HFFR) grades of polymer compounds in our JV Shriram Teknor Limited at a total cost of INR 133 crores. Our investment will be up-to Rs. 50 crores as Equity into the JV.

capex.statement: Incremental depreciation for Q2 was INR 10 crores from chemical business; not expected to increase significantly for rest of year as most projects capitalized
capex.quote: The incremental depreciation for the quarter, was INR10 crore and it came from the chemical business. Going forward, I do not think it will be very significant, at least in the rest of the year, given the fact that most of the projects have been capitalized.

pricing_cost.statement: Chemicals cost of production up 6-8% across chemistries, selling prices down 4-6%; only Hydrogen Peroxide margins improved due to in-house hydrogen and delinked gas prices
pricing_cost.quote: the cost of production in this quarter has gone up in the range of about 6% to 8% across, the chemistries, and selling price has come off in the range of around 4% to 6%.

pricing_cost.statement: Current PVC prices in range of INR 95,000 to INR 1 lakh per tonne; demand expected to pick up post-monsoon in Q3 and Q4
pricing_cost.quote: the current prices of the PVC are in the range of INR95,000 to INR1 lakh a tonne. So those are kind of prices currently prevailing PVC.

risk.statement: El Niño impact on reservoir storage below previous year and long-term average; will influence agri-inputs, rural consumption, and Rabi cropping conditions
risk.quote: Reservoir storage also remains below the previous year and the long-term average, across the country. This will influence agri-inputs and rural consumption and Rabi cropping conditions over the coming quarters

risk.statement: Sugar cane availability low due to drought in Maharashtra and Karnataka; recent September rains in UP caused lodging of cane, may impact crush volume and recovery
risk.quote: India scenario is that the cane availability will be low given that there has been drought and drought like conditions in Maharashtra and Karnataka, which has impacted the cane. And in UP, there have been recent rains in the month of September, because of which there has been lodging of cane. So that can also impact.

other.statement: Commissioned 100 TPD Aluminium Chloride plant at Bharuch, total capacity now 250 TPD; partially commissioned Calcium Chloride plant at 133 TPD of 266 TPD planned
other.quote: During the quarter, we commissioned the 100 TPD Aluminium Chloride plant at Bharuch, taking the total capacity to 250 TPD along with partial commissioning of Calcium Chloride Plant taking us to 50% of the planned capacity, that is, 133 TPD out of 266 TPD.

other.statement: Commissioned 68 MW hybrid renewable power project at Kota; 58 MW hybrid renewable project at Bharuch progressing as per schedule
other.quote: We also commissioned the 68 MW hybrid renewable power project at Kota, further strengthening our structural cost competitiveness. The 58 MW hybrid renewable power project under group captive SPV at Bharuch, is progressing as per schedule.

guidance.statement: Expects >30% revenue growth in FY27 and FY28, driven by domestic and US exports; Europe pipeline of >INR 35 cr to convert in FY28-29
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

demand.statement: Growth drivers: domestic OEM +50%, exports +75%, aftermarket, merchant exports; new EV parts (54 developed), Europe RFQs, China+1, US warehouse stocking
demand.quote: If you see our numbers, we have increased our domestic OEMs production, export have risen, and also aftermarket. So currently what revenue and merchant exports. So whatever four or five areas we are operating in, we have crossed what do you say, from last quarter we have overtaken domestic performance, export performance, aftermarket performance, and merchant export performance. So these are the f

margin.statement: EBITDA margin target ~23% for next year; current range 20-22%; segment margins: Brakes 30-35%, Alkop 18-19%, Bearing 23%
margin.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%. That is our target and we will try to achieve that.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material cost increases (tin +72%, copper +50%, steel +12%) being passed to customers; aluminium price drop benefits Alkop
pricing_cost.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%. So here we are taking a lot of continuous effort for productivity, how to absorb these costs. So from last year, even from now, we are doing different projects how to increase productivity. So automation is one part of it. So we are getting a lot of robotic cells where volumes are higher. Menon Bearings Limited Q2 & H1

risk.statement: Geopolitical volatility (US tariffs, Ukraine-Russia war, Strait of Hormuz) monitored; Europe seen as more stable long-term export market
risk.quote: US has been a little bit volatile because of Mr. Trump's comments and what he's saying, tariffs, exit policies. But that's why we're looking at Europe also as a long -term part, like long -term area for growth. But what current growth and next financial year growth are coming from our order book and strong order book and what parts we have developed for our A-class customers.

other.statement: Volume growth ~20%+ of the 30%+ revenue growth target; rest from price realization
other.quote: No, no, that is we are just talking about , you see, that is the increased business. That is additional business from which we will be getting the growth of 30%-plus. Maybe some part of it will be due to revision in the rates also, but whatever growth that we are expecting out of 30%, you can say about almost 20% plus will come through volume growth.

other.statement: Headcount grew only 5% vs 30% revenue growth; automation targeting further manpower reduction
other.quote: Like to answer it, like last year we did INR300 crore turnover. You all have the numbers. This year, two quarters, we have done INR190 crore. So what numbers we have given you for this financial year, if it goes at this rate, we'll definitely cross it. And compared to last year, headcount has increased hardly 5%. So we are growing at 30%, but headcount, the man -- what do you say, the manpower is

guidance.statement: MDF segment: full-year volume growth ~20% with core EBITDA margins 15-16%
guidance.quote: we expect to achieve full year volume growth of approximately 20% while maintaining core EBITDA margins in the range of 15% to 16%.

guidance.statement: MDF EBITDA per CBM expected above INR5,000
guidance.quote: we are confident that we can maintain above INR5,000.

guidance.statement: Plywood segment: maintain existing guidance; target double-digit EBITDA margin if quarterly revenue crosses INR600 crores
guidance.quote: we will maintain that if the sales goes up around the INR600 crores -- crosses INR600 crores, we will maintain the double-digit EBITDA margin.

demand.statement: Plywood volume growth 6.1% YoY in Q2 FY27; H1 volume growth 9.2% YoY; confident of >10% annual volume growth
demand.quote: we are very confident that annually we will do more than 10% volume growth still in the Plywood segment.

margin.statement: Plywood core EBITDA margin 10.05% in Q2 FY27 (+180 bps YoY, +160 bps QoQ); H1 9.31% (+120 bps YoY)
margin.quote: On the margin front, our core EBITDA margin stood at 10.05% for Q2 FY27, a growth of 180 basis points Y-o-Y and 160 basis over the last quarter.

capex.statement: Plywood expansion at Sandila, Lucknow: 15 MSM capacity, INR125 crores capex, commercial production Q4 FY28
capex.quote: The proposed new capacity will be 15 million square meters with a budgeted capex of INR125 crores, which will be funded through mix of debt and equity and is expected to commence commercial production in Q4 FY28.

capex.statement: Chipboard entry planned: multi-delight lines alongside MDF, <INR100 crores per line, 250-300 CBM output, first line next year or year after
capex.period: next year or next to next year
capex.quote: We are not looking at per line more than INR100 crores of capex and we are looking at churning out 250 cubic meters, 300 cubic meters out of those INR100 crores of capex.

capex.statement: MDF Vadodara and Odisha greenfield projects on track; MDF commissioning Q2 FY28, Plywood Q4 FY27
capex.quote: Our expansion projects, including the new MDF facility at Vadodara and the new greenfield manufacturing facility at Odisha, are progressing well. And our plans remain on track for commissioning with the committed timelines. MDF is expected to commence in Q2 FY28 and Plywood in Q4 FY27.

pricing_cost.statement: MDF realisations declined to INR31,816/CBM due to rollback of Q1 price hikes; chemical costs up 7-8% permanently
pricing_cost.quote: The realisations declined to INR31,816 per CBM due to rollback of the price hikes taken earlier.

pricing_cost.statement: Plywood realisation INR264/sqm in Q2 and H1 FY27 driven by premium mix
pricing_cost.quote: The realisation stood at INR264 per square meter due to better sales of premium products.

product_mix.statement: MDF pre-lam volume rising, replacing plain boards; HDF flooring started July 2026, ramping in H2 FY27
product_mix.quote: Our HDF flooring line commenced commercial production in July 2026 and it's progressing well. We expected this business to begin contributing to our overall performance in the second half of FY27, as our expansion ramp up.

product_mix.statement: Premium plywood innovations (TermiVax, Greenply Gold 11-year plan) driving value growth and margin expansion
product_mix.quote: In our premium Plywood portfolio, we introduced TermiVax, a patented nanotechnology-based anti-termite solution designed to provide and enhance long-lasting protection against termite attacks, addressing a key concern for consumers across the country.

risk.statement: MDF structural margin improvement expected after 12-18 months when smaller players exit and demand catches up; near-term returns low
risk.quote: I think next 12 months will be further bad. After that, structurally things can change once the smaller people actually die out and the demand catches up.

other.statement: Total plywood capacity from Q4 FY28 will be 81.3 million MSM after Sandila expansion
other.quote: With this expansion, our total plywood capacity starting Q4 FY28 will be 81.3 million MSM.

other.statement: Imports not a major threat due to freight costs and geopolitics; BIS certifications for Vietnam/Thailand/Indonesia noted but gap remains large
other.quote: Honestly, even if imports have slightly increased, the total quantum what it used to be where it is, I think there's a huge gap there. So, I don't think that we are getting worried or challenged because of that.

guidance.statement: Expect to maintain current EBITDA margin levels for new products and overall business
guidance.quote: And also, we will be able to maintain the EBITDA margin where we are right now. So that is the guidance on the EBITDA.

guidance.statement: Reaffirmed 20% annual revenue growth guidance for FY27 and FY28, targeting INR3,750-4,000 crores revenue in FY28
guidance.quote: Yes, we still continue to maintain the 20% guidance. As you are aware, that normally, the first half is lower than the second half for us, and we are confident of showing a 20% growth on an annual basis.

demand.statement: Broad-based demand across domestic and export markets, Africa market growing, aroma chemical usage increasing
demand.quote: These performances were supported by broad -based demand across domestic and export markets, reflecting the resilience of our business model and our continued focus on achieving a higher profitable growth.

demand.statement: Customer first cuts indicate higher offtake for next year, very positive outlook
demand.quote: And we have got first cuts from the customers that they are going to buy more, and we are happy to say that our guidance is a positive outlook.

margin.statement: New products expected to maintain current EBITDA margin range
margin.quote: So, we expect the margins to continue in the range at which we are right now, okay, for the new products coming up.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 27.48% vs 26.12% in FY26, RMC at 52% of sales vs 54% in Q1
margin.quote: EBITDA margins remained a healthy 27.48% in quarter 2 of financial year '27 as against 26.12% for the financial year '26 -'27. Despite volatility in feedstock and freight costs and uncertain market conditions, we have been able to ensure to maintain our ove rall margins during this quarter and for the first half of the year '26-'27.

order_book.statement: New annual contracts starting Q4 FY27 will drive 85-90% utilization of expanded capacity
order_book.quote: You will see part of it coming through in quarter 3, but a significant part would come in quarter 4 because that's when the new contracts really start, which are annual contracts. So we are very positive about those c ontracts. And you will see significant impact of that capacity utilization of almost 85% to 90% during that quarter for the expanded capacity

capex.statement: Total 3-phase capex outline INR1,400 crores with INR1,700-1,800 crores revenue potential, Phase 2 to contribute INR1,000 crores at full capacity
capex.quote: The overall outline for all the 3 phases put together was close to about INR1,400 crores. The Phase 1 is already completed. And some of the Phase 2 also, we have incurred expenses. So broadly, as we speak, we expect INR1,000 crores going forward to be spent on Phase 2 and Phase 3.

capex.statement: Phase 2 and 3 capex of INR1,000 crores remaining, Phase 2 commercial sales from H2 FY28
capex.quote: Phase 2 will happen, and it will be effectively available for commercial sales from second half of next financial year. So we are planning to complete everything by June and from September onwards because there will be trial production and all of that.

pricing_cost.statement: Quarterly freight pricing mechanism in contracts allows pass-through of freight cost variations
pricing_cost.quote: We learned from our mistakes in the past. And now definitely, when we also enter into contracts, we ensure to have a quarterly pricing mechanism for the freight. So, if at all, there is a freight which is exceeding and increasing drastically, definitely, we are in a position to go back to our customers and ask for that increase or decrease whatever it may happen around.

product_mix.statement: Phase 2 includes maltol, ethyl maltol, cyclopentanone, furfural-based derivatives; Phase 3 adds INR450-500 crores revenue potential
product_mix.quote: That's correct. That's furfural -based derivatives, maltol, ethyl maltol, cyclopentanone, and a couple of specialty molecules as well.

fund_raise.statement: State incentives received INR1.62 crores in H1 FY27 vs INR9 crores in H1 FY26, expect INR12-15 crores more in H2
fund_raise.quote: The amount should be in the range of about INR12 crores to INR15 crores.

other.statement: Phase 1 expansion completed: capacity increased from 48,000 to 54,000 MTPA as of Sept 30, 2026
other.quote: Our Phase 1 program is designed to increase install capacity from 48,000 metric tons per annum to 54,000 metric tons per annum, representing an addition of 6,000 metric tons per annum. As of 30th September 2026, this project has been completed.

other.statement: 70% revenue from non-petroleum raw materials, diversified sourcing, no significant impact from West Asia geopolitical situation
other.quote: As we always maintain that 2/3 of our revenue, almost 70% of our revenue comes from non -petroleum source raw materials. So we do not have significant impact of this war and the situation like that.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue target of INR750 crores with healthy orders in hand and delivery scheduled for H2
guidance.quote: As for the current year, we remain on track with our revenue target of FY27 of INR750 crores with a healthy orders in hand and delivery scheduled for the second half of the year.

guidance.statement: Targeting INR1,000 crores sales for FY27-28 and INR1,250-1,500 crores for FY29
guidance.quote: Yes. So like I said, for FY27, '28, our sales target will be INR1,000 crores. And the export mix, I cannot say anything right now because that depends on the situation, but our focus is on export as well as domestic.

guidance.statement: Targeting EBITDA of INR225-250 crores for FY27-28 with higher absolute profit despite potentially lower margin percentage
guidance.quote: But coming year, we are targeting more than INR200 crores of EBITDA. It can be INR225 crores, INR250 crores. So percentage may be lower, but the value terms, it will be higher, and that's what we are targeting.

demand.statement: Power consumption expected to double in 3-4 years driven by AI/data centers, renewables, and transmission expansion, creating sustained demand for transformers
demand.quote: And if you see certain government data, our power consumption will be doubled in next 3 to 4 years. The AI investment and the data center will require a lot of power. The renewable also, government is targeting more and more gigawatts every year. So this all will create a demand for not only transformer, but all the power equipment.

margin.statement: Export EBITDA margins significantly higher than domestic margins, with export margins maintained at previous year levels
margin.quote: No. I think export margins are pretty much same what we did in previous years.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 20.8% from 16.4% in Q1, expected to improve further in Q3 and Q4 with higher export share
margin.quote: On profitability, our EBITDA margin improved to 20.8% in Q2 from 16.4% in Q1. We expect conditions for export to improve further in the near future. This should translate d irectly into higher export share in our revenue mix and in turn, a further improvement in margin over the coming quarters

order_book.statement: Order book of more than INR550 crores as on date with 60-40 domestic-export mix
order_book.quote: So we have an order book of more than INR550 crores going forward. So like I said earlier in my opening remarks that we are on track to achieve more than INR750 crores of sales, which was projected in the beginning of the year. And the export domestic will be in ratio of around 60% to 40%, 60% domestic, 40% export, which is likely to improve in the upcoming quarters.

order_book.statement: Orders in hand executable over next 6 months, with new orders also coming for Q1 FY28
order_book.quote: Yes, yes. Very much. Like I said, we have orders in hand of almost INR550 crores, and we are getting new orders also. And this first half, I think we have done about INR330 crores in sales. So even if we do additional say, INR500 crores, we'll reach to almost more than INR800 crores. I mean we have started getting orders for even the Q1 of next year.

capex.statement: Phase 3 expansion adding 6,500 MVA capacity progressing as per plan with commissioning expected April 2027
capex.quote: On the project front, expansion Phase 3, which will add 6,500 MVA of capacity is progressing as per plan, with commissioning expected in April '27.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices have stabilized at current levels, new orders priced at prevailing market rates with pass-through to customers
pricing_cost.quote: The RM prices have stabilized. Again, it is not as what it used to be. And I don't think that it will completely stabilize till all the Middle East crisis and other things gets concluded. But all the orders what we are getting now is as per the market price, as per the current raw material price.

pricing_cost.statement: Sales prices have increased to partially offset higher raw material costs, but raw material prices unlikely to decrease
pricing_cost.quote: Frankly speaking, I don't think that the raw material price will come down. But you never know. I mean nobody can give that very accurately. But like I said earlier, that with these higher raw material costs, our sales price has also gone up now.

product_mix.statement: Majority production is renewable transformers, minimal distribution transformers, new 220 kV capacity to add 6,500 MVA out of 14,000 MVA total
product_mix.quote: Distribution transformer, we hardly make. We make in very less quantity. So major is all renewable transformers.

risk.statement: Geopolitical situation in Middle East and global political factors create uncertainty for export conditions and freight costs
risk.quote: I mean, of course, we would like to maintain the same higher EBITDA, but the market situation, the world political situation, a lot of things are dependent.

other.statement: Total capacity will reach 14,000 MVA after Phase 3 commissioning, driving growth from FY28 onwards
other.quote: This will take our total capacity to 14,000 MVA and drive the next leg of growth from FY28 onwards.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 export-domestic mix at 40-60, with US contributing 40-60% of export sales, Europe minimal but efforts underway
other.quote: And the export domestic will be in ratio of around 60% to 40%, 60% domestic, 40% export, which is likely to improve in the upcoming quarters.

guidance.statement: FY27 AUM guidance maintained at Rs 50,000 crore; PAT expected around Rs 1,600 crore
guidance.quote: So FY'27 guideline in terms of AUM, we are maintaining guidance at about Rs. 50,000 crores. Since we have already reached about Rs. 44,000 crores AUM, we may slightly do better, but we are maintaining guidance of achieving Rs. 50,000 crores AUM. And as far as the profit after tax is concerned, I think we will be about Rs. 1,600 crores.

guidance.statement: FY28 AUM target Rs 65,000 crore; RoE 19-21%; RoA 4.2-4.7%
guidance.quote: We are on the track to achieve an AUM of Rs. 65,000 crores by FY '28 with return on average equity in the range about 19% to 21% and return on average assets of 4.2% to 4.7%.

margin.statement: Blended yield 17.5%, spread 8.3% in Q2 FY27; NII Rs 812 crore, up 69% YoY
margin.quote: Our blended yields and spreads on net advances increased in the quarter to 17.5% and 8.3% respectively, driven by increasing share of high-yield products and leveraging competitive cost of funds. Our net interest income for Q2 FY '27 stood at Rs. 812 crores, up 69% year-on-year.

margin.statement: Non-interest income Rs 273 crore, up 34% YoY, contributing 25% of net total income
margin.quote: Non-interest income grew 34% year-on-year to Rs. 273 crores, contributing 25% on our net total income for the quarter.

margin.statement: Cost-to-income ratio improved to 41% in Q2 FY27 from 44% in Q1 FY27 and 49% in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: Yet the cost-to-income ratio improved to 41% in Q2 FY '27 from 44% in Q1 FY '27 and 49% in Q2 FY '26, reflecting our continued focus on operating efficiency.

order_book.statement: Consolidated AUM Rs 43,878 crore, up 62% YoY and 9% QoQ
order_book.quote: Our consolidated AUM stood at Rs. 43,878 crores, reflecting a robust 62% year-on-year growth and 9% quarter-on-quarter growth.

order_book.statement: MSME AUM Rs 7,016 crore, up 25% YoY; disbursements Rs 560 crore, up 36% YoY
order_book.quote: Our MSME AUM grew to Rs. 7,016 crores, up 25% year-on-year, and disbursement stood Rs.560 crores for Q2 FY '27, up 36% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Housing AUM Rs 8,325 crore, up 39% YoY
order_book.quote: Our housing AUM stood at Rs. 8,325 crores, delivering a year-on-year growth of 39%.

capex.statement: Added 176 branches in Q2 (154 gold loan, 22 non-gold); total network 1,609 branches; target 500 gold loan branches in FY27
capex.quote: So this year we intend to add about, as per the board, board has given us approval for 600 branches. We are going to add about 500 branches this year in the gold loan alone. Besides that, we will add more branches in the MSME and affordable housing.

product_mix.statement: Self-employed non-professional customers now 76% of housing AUM; focus on smaller ticket, higher yielding loans
product_mix.quote: From a product and customer segment perspective, we will continue to focus on smaller ticket loans and higher yielding business with increased emphasis on self-employed non-professional customers, which now contributes 76% to our AUM.

other.statement: Credit cost 0.8% in Q2; expected sustainable range 0.6-0.9%
other.quote: Our credit costs for the quarter stood at 0.8%, and we expect to maintain credit costs in the range of 0.6% to 0.9% level on a sustainable basis going forward.

other.statement: Raised $300 million via maiden USD senior secured bond under GMTN in H1 FY27; Rs 500 crore CP + Rs 1,271 crore NCD/CP in Q1
other.quote: Yet I am delighted to share that Capri Global raised $300 million through its GMTN program during H1 FY '27 via a maiden U.S. dollar senior secured bond issue. As part of liability diversification journey, we further raised Rs. 500 crores via commercial papers in addition to Rs. 1,271 crores raised in Q1 FY '27 through a combination of NCD and CP.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance for FY27 lowered to 7-9% from earlier 9-11%
guidance.quote: We now expect revenue growth of 7% to 9% in FY27 compared with our earlier guidance of 9% to 11%.

guidance.statement: Confident of returning to 9-11% revenue growth in FY28
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident in our ability to return to 9% to 11% revenue growth in FY28, supported by our new digital-first platforms, enhanced marketing capabilities and greater operational efficiency.

guidance.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin expected broadly in line with FY26 vs earlier 50-100 bps expansion
guidance.quote: We expect FY27 EBITDA margin to be broadly in line with FY26 compared with our earlier expectation of 50 to 100 basis points of expansion.

demand.statement: Retail volumes grew ~2% driven by strong demand for lower price point items
demand.quote: Retail volumes grew approximately 2%, driven by strong demand for our lower price point items.

margin.statement: Gross margin expanded ~197 bps to 65.5% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Gross margin expanded by approximately 197 basis points to 65.5%.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin declined to 8.1% in Q2 FY27 from 10% a year ago
margin.quote: EBITDA was INR76.2 crores, down 13.5%, with a margin of 8.1% compared to 10% in Q2 last year.

order_book.statement: Digital share target of 50% of B2C revenue by Q4 FY27
order_book.quote: With the transition complete, we expect digital to return to its earlier growth trajectory, and we continue to work towards our target of digital share at 50% of B2C revenue by Q4 FY27.

capex.statement: INR36 crores capex for U.K. warehouse migration in Q2 FY27
capex.quote: the main part of this capex related to the U.K. warehouse migration. The commentary, we mentioned the 4 different premises and 2 studios migrate in a single premises to improve the efficiencies and order club bing, which will result in benefit in the coming years, but that was necessary change and easy to operate in a single premises. So that we have invested around INR36 crores over there

pricing_cost.statement: Revenue impact of Shopify migration ~USD2.8 million or 2.8 percentage points of growth
pricing_cost.quote: Based on our internal assessment, the revenue impact in the quarter was approximately USD2.8 million or around 2.8 percentage point of growth.

product_mix.statement: Lab-grown diamond share rose to 12% of total retail revenue from ~10% a year ago
product_mix.quote: In-house brands contributed 57% of B2C revenue and the lab-grown diamond share rose to 12% of total retail revenue from about 10% a year back, strengthening our differentiation and pricing.

product_mix.statement: Lifestyle products ~40% of B2C revenue, medium-term target 50%
product_mix.quote: Lifestyle products contributed approximately 40% of B2C revenue, and we continue to work towards a medium-term objective of 50% share.

risk.statement: U.S. midterm election contentiousness may divert eyeballs from programming, factored into guidance
risk.quote: At this time, we see some possibility of contentiousness there, which might take eyeballs away from our programming. Therefore, we included that as one of the factors influencing our guidance.

risk.statement: U.K. consumer headwinds: inflation 3.5%, consumer confidence sharpest fall since 2020, discretionary spending dispersed
risk.quote: U.K. inflation rose to 3.5% in September, driven by a higher fuel cost, non-food retail sales were almost flat. And in October, consumer confidence recorded its sharpest monthly fall since 2020. As households held back ahead of autumn budget, discretionary category such as our field dispersed.

other.statement: Net cash INR186 crores as of Sep 30, 2026 vs INR279 crores Mar 2026, reduction due to seasonal inventory and U.K. capex
other.quote: As of September 30, 2026, our net cash stood at INR186 crores compared to INR279 crores of March '26. This reduction is mainly related to seasonal inventory buildup and capex related to U.K. warehouse migration of INR36 crores.

other.statement: Second interim dividend of INR1.5 per share declared, Board to consider buyback after building cash for acquisitions
other.quote: The Board has declared a second interim dividend of INR1.5 per equity share, following the first interim dividend of INR1.5 per share in Q1 FY27. Our capital allocation approach continues to balance investment in growth, shareholder returns and balance sheet strength.

guidance.statement: Upgraded Prestige & Above volume growth target to 30% for FY27 and maintained EBITDA margin guidance of around 20% for the year
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we have upgraded our Prestige & Above volume growth to 30% in FY27, and we remain confident of sustaining an EBITDA margin of around 20% for the year.

guidance.statement: Luxury portfolio on track to meet 25% value growth guidance for FY27
guidance.quote: See, we have done a turnover of Rs. 475 crores last year and we are well in course of meeting our guidance of 25% growth in terms of value.

demand.statement: Prestige & Above volume grew 36% YoY in Q2 FY27 to 5.28 million cases, driven by vodka structural shift and Karnataka policy changes
demand.quote: The Prestige & Above category continued its strong upward trajectory, recording highest ever volume of 5.28 million cases at 36% volume growth.

demand.statement: Vodka category share of IMFL reached 6.3% in Q2 FY27, up from 4.5% in 2026 and 3.7% in 2025, driven by Gen Z, women, and flavored vodka
demand.quote: In 2025, it was 3.7 %; in 2026, it became 4.5 %; and this quarter Q2, it is 6.3 %.

demand.statement: After Dark relaunched in 10 states with positive traction; grew ~60% last year; Virasat Indian Single Malt seeing tremendous response across states; Jamun and Aam Panna generating high tertiary interest
demand.quote: Now, after the new pack change, we ha ve entered in 10 states as of now, and we are getting the positive traction of the brand.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 462 bps YoY to 20.4% in Q2 FY27, reflecting premiumization, operating efficiencies, and cost discipline
margin.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 20.4%, expanding by 462 bps on a year-on-year basis.

margin.statement: Gross margin expanded 440 bps YoY to 48.0% in Q2 FY27, driven by premiumization (+510 bps) and price increases (+85 bps), partially offset by packaging cost volatility (~Rs. 27 cr impact)
margin.quote: Gross margin during the quarter is 48 .0%, representing a 440 basis point expansion on year-on-year basis and 109 basis point compression on quarter -on-quarter basis.

capex.statement: Capex directed towards maintenance, operational efficiencies, and essential capacity optimization; disciplined capital allocation approach maintained
capex.quote: We remain disciplined in our approach to capital allocation , with capex directed towards maintenance, operational efficiencies and essential capacity optimization.

pricing_cost.statement: Industry price hike process starts November ahead of February excise policies; inflation absorbed currently, relief expected at next revision
pricing_cost.quote: At this point of time, it will start from November onwards in various excise by the industry representatives.

product_mix.statement: Prestige & Above now 75% flavored vodka; vodka 30% of volume, whisky 40-45%, brandy/rum/gin remainder; non-vodka P&A grew ~20% YoY
product_mix.quote: Vodka is 30% of our volume, whisky is about 40%, 45%, and rest is brandy and rum and gin is still very small because it's only at the extreme top end.

risk.statement: Spirit of Kashmyr matter subjudice in court; no comment at this time
risk.quote: Yes. So, I think the matter is subjudice in the court, and I don't want to comment on that at this point of time.

other.statement: Export shipments to West Asia bounced back after initial disruption; freight rates up significantly, partially absorbed by customers and consumer price increases; present in 70 duty-free locations targeting 100
other.quote: We are currently in around 70 duty -free locations, and our objective is to get to 100.

other.statement: UK FTA provides 8-10% reduction in BIO duty; luxury portfolio priced above BIO, mainstream portfolio well below BIO, so minimal competitive impact
other.quote: We are seeing about close to 8% to 10% reduction in the BIO. And if you see our portfolio, whether it's Rampur or Virasat, it's a single malt, and it is already priced higher than the existing BIO.

guidance.statement: 90-95% of H2 service revenues tied up from signed orders; confident on achieving full year numbers; targeting sustained momentum into FY28
guidance.quote: I think on your first question, I think we would have about 90% to 95% of our revenues tied up for the second half and all efforts are also on for winning more business in Q3 and Q4, that should add. So overall, we are fairly comfortable, confident on achi eving our overall yearly numbers

guidance.statement: Software services expected to deliver single-digit sustained growth above industry average for mid/small tier; product solutions targeting $12-14M/quarter run rate for 10-12% EBITDA margins
guidance.quote: However, going forward, I think we would be moderating that growth to above industry average, particularly for the mid tier or small tier companies. So we should be delivering single digit growth on a sustained basis, at least for the foreseeable future.

demand.statement: Technology spending directed at engineering-led programs connecting silicon, software, and connected devices; customers consolidating vendors for larger integrated scope
demand.quote: Technology spending is increasingly directed at engineering-led programs that connect silicon, software, and connected devices, which is where our capabilities sit. Customers are consolidating vendors and looking for partners who can take on larger, more integrated scope.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin 12.9% (+330 bps QoQ, +700 bps YoY); EBIT margin 8.9% (+250 bps QoQ, +660 bps YoY); PAT margin 8% (+8.8% QoQ, +143.8% YoY)
margin.quote: As we benefit from operating leverage, EBITDA for the quarter was Rs.41 Crores, translating into an EBITDA margin of 12.9%, an improvement of 330 basis points sequentially, and 700 basis points year-on-year. EBIT for the quarter stood at Rs.29 Crores, with an EBIT margin of 8.9%, up 250 basis points sequentially, and 660 basis points year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Total contract value signed in Q2 was $47 million, up 66% YoY; $25 million new bookings, rest renewals; annual contract value $34 million
order_book.quote: Our total contract value signed during the quarter was $47 million of which $25 million Q2 & H1 FY27 Concall Transcript represented new bookings and the rest was renewals. TCV increased by 66% over the same quarter last year. Annual contract value for orders won in the quarter was about $34 million

capex.statement: Focus on financial discipline and prudent capital allocation while remaining flexible to invest in capabilities and opportunities
capex.quote: Emphasis remains on financial discipline and prudent capital allocation while remaining flexible to invest in capabilities and oppor tunities that support the business

product_mix.statement: Software services revenue Rs.252 Cr (+34% YoY, +14.6% QoQ); product solutions Rs.69 Cr (+2.4% YoY, -42% QoQ) due to memory/component pressures
product_mix.quote: Software services revenue was Rs.252 Crores, up 34% year-on-year and 14.6% sequentially. Product solutions revenue moderated to Rs.69 Crores, up 2.4% year-on-year, and reducing by 42% sequentially, as volumes were impacted by ongoing pressures relating to memory availability and component pricing.

product_mix.statement: Launched Juniper Alta device developed end-to-end and shipped within 18 months; demonstrates concept-to-commercialization capability
product_mix.quote: During the quarter, we also launched Juniper Alta, a new device developed end-to-end and brought to shipment within 18 months. The program demonstrates our ability to take products from concept through engineering and commercialization.

risk.statement: Product solutions quarterly volatility due to shipment schedules, product lifecycles, memory/component pricing; better evaluated annually
risk.quote: Product solution, on the other hand, can have a quarter-to-quarter variation depending on program milestones, shipment schedules, and product life cycles. We therefore believe product solution is better evaluated over a longer period rather than through the moment in any single quarter.

other.statement: Headcount grew 7% QoQ; LTM attrition lowered to 9.3%; utilization improved to 86%
other.quote: At the close of Q2, the head count grew by 7%, with LTM attrition lowering to 9.3% and utilization improving to 86%.

other.statement: Cash and investment position of Rs.399 Crores at quarter end; strong balance sheet maintained
other.quote: Our balance sheet remains strong. We close the quarter with a cash and investment position of about Rs.399 Crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 capex guidance of INR 300-330 crores
guidance.quote: In terms of the capex, this year, we will do around INR300 crores to INR320 crores, INR330 crores in that range, overall capex.

guidance.statement: FY28 capex expected above INR 350 crores due to higher screen additions
guidance.quote: And next year will be higher as we mentioned that the screen additions will be more than current year. And therefore, the capex are likely to be more than INR350 crores, plus/minus depending on how the pipeline and fit-outs and the execution gets going on the ground.

guidance.statement: Depreciation to reduce by INR 35-40 crores annually due to useful life extension
guidance.quote: Accordingly, the useful life has been increased and the depreciation, therefore, is now lower between INR35 crores to INR40 crores a year.

guidance.statement: Target net screen additions of 150-175 per year from next fiscal
guidance.quote: 150, 175 is a number that we could achieve from next fiscal every year, could be even more.

demand.statement: PVR INOX footfalls up 4% YoY to 46.3 million in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: We welcomed 46.3 million guests during the quarter, up 4% year-on-year as occupancy rose to 30.4%.

demand.statement: Hindi box office incremental growth muted due to high base; strong Q3-Q4 slate expected
demand.quote: But wait till you have Q3 and Q4, you will see, without making any forward-looking statements for PVR INOX, but at the industry level, we are confident that in Q3 and Q4, you will see a big jump in incremental numbers even for Hindi box office.

demand.statement: Industry box office grew 23% YoY in Q2 FY27 to record INR 4,433 crores
demand.quote: Industry gross box office collections reached INR 4,433 crores, the highest quarterly collections on record and the first time the industry crossed INR4,000 crores in a single quarter.

margin.statement: ATP and F&B SPH each grew 14% YoY to INR 298 and INR 153 respectively
margin.quote: Average ticket price and food and beverage spend per head each grew 14% year-on-year, reaching INR 298 and INR 153, respectively.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 420 bps YoY to 22.3% on Ind AS 116 adjusted basis
margin.quote: EBITDA margin expanded around 420 basis points to 22.3%, driven by strong operating leverage.

margin.statement: F&B gross margins at 77-78% with headroom; 60% of SPH growth from value increase
margin.quote: There is a fairly good headroom to grow because if you look at our F&B, I don't think we've shared that information, but 40% of this growth has happened actually through the volume increase and about 60% of the SPH growth has happened through the value increase.

order_book.statement: SMART Cinema pipeline of ~100 signed locations for next 12-18 months
order_book.quote: And then we have a pipeline of about another 100-odd that we have signed, which should come up in the next 12 to 18 months.

pricing_cost.statement: Value offers: weekday morning shows at INR 99, Friday first shows at INR 149, front row seats from INR 79
pricing_cost.quote: Value offers such as weekday morning shows at INR99, Friday first shows at INR149 and front row seats from INR 79 are bringing in more price-sensitive moviegoers.

pricing_cost.statement: F&B discounted offers (free refills on weekends) driving volume upgrades to larger packs
pricing_cost.quote: So discounted F&B is basically on weekends when we do free refills of large category of Pepsi and popcorn, and that's been a very successful initiative.

product_mix.statement: Regional blockbusters: Jana Nayagan (Tamil) INR 200 crores, Toxic (Kannada) INR 296 crores
product_mix.quote: Regional cinema also witnessed a strong box office growth with star-led spectacles like Jana Nayagan in Tamil and Toxic in Kannada grossing INR 200 crores and INR296 crores, respectively.

product_mix.statement: English films grew 87% YoY to INR 1,024 crores; Spider-Man: Brand New Day highest grossing English film at INR 608 crores
product_mix.quote: English language cinema had a standout quarter with collections growing 87% to INR 1,024 crores, crossing INR1,000 crores in a quarter for the first time. Spider-Man: Bran d New Day became India's highest grossing English movie ever at INR608 crores of box office

risk.statement: No discussions on ticket price caps in Southern states
risk.quote: No conversations at all.

other.statement: 85% of cinema visitors now consume F&B; personalized offers driven by consumption database
other.quote: Today, we have a scenario where close to about 85% of the people who walk in eat something or the other at the cinema, and that's a fairly healthy number.

other.statement: H1 FY27 free cash flow INR 604 crores; debt repaid INR 259 crores
other.quote: During H1, we generated INR604 crores of free cash flow and repaid INR259 crores of debt.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue growth guided at 20-25% y-o-y, targeting around INR 6,000 crore
guidance.quote: And hence, for the full year, we should be anywhere between a 20-25% growth on a full-year basis on the revenue. So, looking at perhaps close to a INR 6,000-odd crore, given that growth number.

guidance.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 maintained at around INR 300 crore including greenfield expansions
guidance.quote: The guidance for the year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, including the new greenfield expansion in the Mechatronics, Advanced Plastics and Alternate Fuels divisions, which is expected to begin the SOP (Start of Production) in the H2 of financial year.

guidance.statement: Long-term 20% revenue CAGR from FY25 to FY31 maintained, targeting INR 11,000 crore by FY31
guidance.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our 20.20.20.20 North Star, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR between FY 25 through FY 31 and inching closer to a 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years. By FY 31, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to around INR 11,000 crore.

order_book.statement: Order book grew to INR 1,879 crore at end of Q2 FY27, up from INR 1,600 crore at end of Q1 FY27
order_book.quote: Coming to the order book, it has grown to INR 1,879 crore at the end of Q2, up from INR 1,600 crore at the end of Q1 FY 27, providing a healthy visibility for the business going forward.

order_book.statement: Order book execution timeline: 14% in FY27, 59% in FY28, 27% in FY29
order_book.quote: Of this order book, approximately 14% is expected to be executed in FY 27 itself, 59% in FY 28 and the remaining 27% in FY 29.

order_book.statement: BCM order book at INR 250 crore backing new Mechatronics plant
order_book.quote: In terms of the won and the acquired program, we are already on a INR 250 crore order book with which confidence we are kicking off the new Mechatronics plant, which has been announced in the results.

capex.statement: Board approved new Mechatronics facility at Manesar with INR 150 crore capex, funded by debt and internal accruals
capex.quote: At its meeting on 24th October, 2026, the Board approved the setting up of a new Mechatronics manufacturing facility at Manesar in Haryana, with a capital outlay of around INR 150 crore to be funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex capitalization at INR 60 crore
capex.quote: Capex on account of capitalization during the first quarter was INR 60 crore. [Note: The capex of INR 60 crore pertains to H1 FY 27.]

product_mix.statement: Order book composition: Advanced Plastics 44%, Mechatronics 27%, Alternate Fuels 20%, Structures & Control Systems 8%
product_mix.quote: Advanced Plastics continues to contribute the largest share at 44%, followed by Mechatronics at 27%, Alternate Fuels at 20% and Structures & Control Systems at 8%.

product_mix.statement: EV and CNG together account for 29% of order book (CNG 20%, pure EV 9%), new future technologies 22%
product_mix.quote: By powertrain, EV (Electric Vehicle) and CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) together accounts for 29% of the order book, with CNG at 20% and pure EVs at about 9%, while new future technologies account for 22% of the total order book.

risk.statement: Geopolitical environment and energy price volatility remain key monitorables
risk.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the geopolitical environment and energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continue to be favourable, giving us confidence for the near term.

other.statement: New Mechatronics plant at Manesar to be commissioned in 2 phases starting Q3 FY28, peak annual turnover ~INR 500 crore
other.quote: The facility will manufacture advanced electronic components such as the Body Control Module (BCM) for leading OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). It is expected to be commissioned in 2 phases, starting Q3 FY 28, with a peak annual turnover of around INR 500 crore post-commissioning.

other.statement: Content per vehicle: INR 70,000-75,000 per PV, INR 20,000-22,000 per 2W; Mechatronics ~20% of PV content
other.quote: So just to give you a sense, let us say the total content per vehicle, which is the playbook for Lumax Auto Technologies, is anywhere around INR 70,000 to INR 75,000 per Passenger Vehicle and about INR 20,000 to INR 22,000 per 2-Wheeler. This is based on the basket of products Lumax Auto Technologies is in currently. I would not be able to give you an exact content per vehicle because there are mu

guidance.statement: Full-year EBITDA margin expected to remain in 24% to 28% range
guidance.quote: Having said all of this, we remain confident of remaining in the 24% to 28% range for the full year.

demand.statement: Clients remain selective with tighter budgets and longer decision cycles as spending shifts towards AI-related investments
demand.quote: Clients remain selective, with tighter budgets and longer decision cycles as spending shift s towards AI -related investments.

margin.statement: PF wage ceiling revision from INR 15,000 to INR 25,000 effective Sept 17, 2026 will impact H2 margin by 20 bps
margin.quote: One is that the government has revised the statutory PF wage ceiling from INR 15,000 per month to INR 25,000 per month effective September 17, 2026. This will have a 20 bps impact on margin.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin improved 90 bps sequentially to 23.9%, driven almost entirely by FX benefit
margin.quote: Yes. So almost entirely the increase in margin is because of FX. So , the 90 bps that you see is almost entirely because of FX.

order_book.statement: Q2 new deal wins USD 31 million vs USD 41 million last quarter; H1 total USD 72 million vs USD 78 million YoY
order_book.quote: New deal wins were USD 31 million compared with USD 41 million last quarter. First half deal wins totaled USD 72 million compared with USD 78 million in the same period last year.

order_book.statement: ACV in H1 FY27 around INR 72 million, down ~10% YoY from INR 78 million; management still targeting FY26 level but acknowledges difficulty
order_book.quote: If you look at our ACV in H1, it's around INR 72 million against H1 of the prior year, which was INR 78 million, so about 10% decline Y-o-Y.

capex.statement: FY28 capex pace expected to slow as seat additions moderate after adding 1,400 seats in H1 and 800-1,000 more in H2
capex.quote: Next year, I think we are still in the budgeting process, but I expect that seat headcount addition will not be as strong because I think we have now added about 1,400, [and] we will add another maybe 800 to 1,000 more in the next couple of quarters.

capex.statement: H2 FY27 capex expected to be similar to H1 at around INR 90 crore each half
capex.quote: INR 90 crores plus INR 90 crores, yes.

product_mix.statement: Analytics and automation grew 5% sequentially and 27% YoY, now at USD 109 million annual run rate (~20% of revenue)
product_mix.quote: Analytics and automation grew 5% sequentially and 27% year-on-year, more than twice the company's growth rate. The business now has an annual revenue run rate of about USD 109 million and accounts for approximately 20% of revenue.

risk.statement: BFSI recovery now expected in Q4 FY27 instead of Q3; volume pressure in few BFSI accounts offsets momentum in emerging business and Hi-tech
risk.quote: Earlier, I had thought that we may be able to do it in Q3. I'm now saying we should be able to recover in Q4.

other.statement: Utilization declined slightly to 74.9% in Q2 from 75.5% in Q1
other.quote: Utilization in Q2 is 74.9% compared with 75.5% in Q1.

other.statement: Easing US financial crime compliance regulation reduced refresh volumes at existing BFSI clients
other.quote: Easing financial crime compliance regulation in the U.S. has reduced refresh volumes at existing clients.

guidance.statement: Revenue target of INR1,300 crores plus for FY27
guidance.quote: So yes, we are heading towards achieving our annual targeted sales value of INR1,300 crores plus, we are going to be achieving that.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin guidance of about 14% for H2 FY27
guidance.quote: I think it should be in the range of about 14 odd %.

guidance.statement: Targeting 18-20% EBITDA margins by next financial year FY28
guidance.quote: And we should be able to reach back to levels of 18%, 20% EBITDA levels by the next financial year.

demand.statement: Q3 demand outlook upbeat with tailwinds for price improvement
demand.quote: Yes, Q3 certainly is looking upbeat. There are tailwinds suggesting that there would be a price improvement.

demand.statement: Industry demand-supply stabilized as imports and exports both declined due to high freight
demand.quote: So whatever was getting exported earlier is finding its way into the domestic market from the Indian players. There is a kind of a stability on the demand and supply situation, as far as paper industry is concerned.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 12.4%, down 84 bps QoQ due to lower realizations and higher input costs
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at INR35 crores with EBITDA margins moderating by 84 basis points to 12.4%.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA flat YoY at INR75 crores, PAT at INR9 crores with 1.5% margin
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at INR75 crores, broadly in line with the previous year. However, higher depreciation and finance costs impacted profitability with profit after tax for the period stood at INR9 crores with PAT margins at 1.5%.

order_book.statement: Operating at 100% capacity utilization with advance orders for production lines

margin.quote: The average cost of borrowing during the quarter was 9.19%, reflecting a reduction of 43 basis points if we compare with the corresponding period last year. And in the last quarter it was 9.25%, which is a reduction of 6 basis points.

margin.statement: Yield compression of ~9 bps QoQ attributed to product mix
margin.quote: I think, currently we are at 16.08, and I think last quarter. So Q1, we were at 16.17. So, there has been approximately a 9 bps decrease as attributed to the product configuration.

order_book.statement: Standalone AUM grew 23.17% YoY to INR 16,011 crores
order_book.quote: On standalone basis, there is a growth of portfolio of 23.17% from INR 12999.44 crores to INR 16011.38 crores.

order_book.statement: Direct assignment executed INR 850 crores in Q2, sanctions on hand INR 850 crores
order_book.quote: During the quarter, we executed direct assignment transactions aggregating to approximately INR 850 crore. In addition, we have sanctions on hand of around INR 850 crores which we expect to utilize during the current quarter.

order_book.statement: Consolidated AUM reached INR 17,042 crores, up 23.31% YoY
order_book.quote: It's INR 17,000 crores, INR 17,042 crores to be precise, this quarter, which translates into almost 23.5% of growth on a half-yearly basis.

capex.statement: Branch expansion target of 300 branches over next 2 years from current 210
capex.quote: So, over a period of next 2-odd years, we see this 210 number touching around 300 going forward. So, the medium-term stand is still there.

product_mix.statement: Wheels portfolio at 8-9% of AUM, targeting 15-20% in 3-5 years
product_mix.quote: If you say right now it is close to 8% to 9%, it should increase 2% to 3% incrementally, ideally every year. So, within next 3 years to 5 years, you should see this hovering around, say, anywhere between 15% to 20%, or around, say, 15%.

product_mix.statement: SME ticket size currently ~INR 29 lakhs, targeting INR 35-45 lakhs over 6-12 quarters
product_mix.quote: But broadly, you will see that within a span of next 6 quarters to 12 quarters, this ticket size is around INR29 lakhs. It may stabilize at anywhere between INR 35 lakhs to INR 45 lakhs.

risk.statement: Drought exposure 10% of portfolio but <1% direct agri; no stress seen in SME borrowers
risk.quote: With all the states that are declared under drought, around 10% of our portfolio is there, but with a very strong caveat that we don't do direct agri. Each and every of our borrower has an allied income. The direct agri is even less than 1%.

other.statement: Housing subsidiary gross Stage 3 at 0.99%, net Stage 3 at 0.70% with INR 3.69 crores overlay
other.quote: Gross Stage 3 asset is 0.99% as compared to 0.98% in June quarter, and Net Stage 3 asset is 0.70% as compared to 0.68% in June quarter. Here also we are carrying INR 3.69 crores as management overlay, which has not been netted off from the Net Stage 3 assets.

other.statement: Centre reach increased by ~1,000 in last 4-5 quarters while branch count grows slowly
other.quote: If you look at the data, we have increased the centres by almost 1,000 in the last four quarters to five quarters. So, we're expanding the ground presence, not showing up on the branch network per se, but the ground presence is increasing.

guidance.statement: Full-year loan growth target of around 14% maintained
guidance.quote: We set a full-year loan growth target of around 14% at the beginning of the year, and we continue to maintain it. We expect to achieve around 14% growth.

guidance.statement: NIM expected to be maintained in 6.1%-6.2% range
guidance.quote: Overall, we remain hopeful of maintaining NIM in the 6.1%–6.2% range envisaged earlier.

guidance.statement: ROA guidance for Q4 exit at 1.2%-1.4% unchanged; medium-term aspiration 1.6%-1.8%
guidance.quote: The Q4 exit ROA guidance of 1.2%–1.4% remains unchanged. We are not providing guidance beyond that at present. Our medium-term aspiration of 1.6%–1.8% remains; the timing is something we need to assess.

guidance.statement: Operating expenses to total assets guidance of 4.2% maintained
guidance.quote: Our guidance of 4.2% operating expenses to total assets remains unchanged.

demand.statement: EEB portfolio stabilized and grew 1.7% YoY after moderation in previous quarters
demand.quote: The EEB portfolio stood at INR 52,616 crores. Importantly, after the moderation witnessed in the previous few quarters, the portfolio remained broadly stable sequentially and grew 1.7% YoY.

demand.statement: Wholesale banking grew 31.6% YoY supported by business momentum and deepening client relationships
demand.quote: Wholesale Banking grew 31.6% YoY, supported by continued business momentum and continuing deepening of our client relationships.

demand.statement: Retail assets grew 41.9% YoY led by commercial vehicles, construction equipment, auto and gold loans
demand.quote: assets grew 41.9% YoY, led by commercial vehicles, construction equipment, auto and gold loans

margin.statement: NIM remained broadly stable at 6.1% despite asset mix shift and savings account moderation
margin.quote: Despite changes in the deposit mix, increase in the secured advances mix and moderation in savings bank account balances, NIMs remained broadly stable at 6.1%.

margin.statement: Repo rate changes implemented for existing loans from first day of following quarter; positive NIM impact possible in Q4
margin.quote: Under our policy, repo-rate changes are implemented for existing loans from the first day of the following quarter. The October change, and any further change in December, will therefore be implemented from January 1. New rates apply to newly sanctioned and disbursed loan s. We could see a positive NIM impact in Q4, subject to how deposit

order_book.statement: Loan book reached INR 1.58 lakh crores with 13% YoY growth; non-EEB grew 20% YoY
order_book.quote: On the asset side, our loan book reached approximately INR1.58 lakh crores, representing a healthy 13% YoY growth. Growth continued to be led by our non-EEB business, which expanded by 20% YoY.

order_book.statement: Total deposits increased to INR 1.73 lakh crores with 4.7% sequential growth; net CD ratio improved to 89.5%
order_book.quote: Total deposits increased to approximately INR 1.73 lakh crores with a strong 4.7% sequential growth, without any support from the FCNR (B) deposits. Importantly, this helped bring our net credit-deposit ratio down to 89.5% from around 92% in the previous quarter.

order_book.statement: Retail term deposits grew 16.8% YoY; retail deposits constitute 72.7% of deposit base
order_book.quote: Retail term deposits remain the principal driver, growing 16.8% YoY. Overall, retail deposits constitute 72.7% of our deposit base, with a focus continuing on strengthening the granular and sustainable components of the liability franchise.

product_mix.statement: Secured portfolio grew 18% YoY to 57.3% of total advances from 54.9% a year ago
product_mix.quote: The secured portfolio grew 18% YoY and now represents 57.3% of the total advances from 54.9% a year ago.

product_mix.statement: Loan mix broadly achieved targeted one-third each: EEB 22%, wholesale 34%, housing 22%, retail and other 11%, SBAL 11%
product_mix.quote: Today, the loan book is significantly more diversified with multiple businesses contributing to growth. EEB group lending now constitutes 22% of advances, SBAL 11%, Wholesale Banking 34%, housing finance 22%, and retail and other loans 11%.

risk.statement: Assam floods affected four districts; INR 406 crore loans under moratorium with 5% additional provision; collection efficiency 99.1%; no material impact expected from Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh climate issues
risk.quote: Four districts were affected. Loans of INR 406 crore were brought under moratorium in line with SLBC guidelines, and we made an additional 5% provision. From asset quality perspective, more than 96% of the moratorium book is standard, with the remaining approximately 4% in SMA-0. Entire 100% is quite a good portfolio. And importantly, Collection efficiency for this portfolio is 99.1%, which was al

other.statement: Gross NPA 3.1%, net NPA 0.9%, provision coverage 87% including technical write-offs; credit cost stable at 1.8%
other.quote: Our overall asset quality position remained healthy, with gross NPA at 3.1% and net NPA at 0.9%. Provision coverage, including technical write-offs, remained strong at approximately 87%. Credit costs also remained broadly stable sequentially at 1.8%.

other.statement: Gross slippages INR 1,125 crores; EEB slippages INR 655 crores; recoveries and upgrades improved to INR 481 crores
other.quote: Gross slippages for the quarter stood at INR 1,125 crores compared to INR 1,079 crores in Q1 with EEB slippages at INR 655 crores. At the same time, resolution momentum strengthened. Recoveries and upgrades improved to INR 481 crores from INR 449 crores in Q1.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin aspiration maintained at 20% plus for H1 FY27
guidance.quote: Still the guidance was 20% plus on an EBITDA, and we stand by to that the commitment of 20% plus, but I cannot give you more than that.

demand.statement: Volume growth of 62% YoY and 7% QoQ in Q2 FY27 driven by higher offtake from existing customers
demand.quote: We recorded volume growth of 62% year-on-year and 7% on quarter-on-quarter supported by higher offtake from existing customers.

demand.statement: Demand growing across key markets; no slowdown seen in short term
demand.quote: Demand is not slowing down. So that's one good sign for us. Demand is growing.

margin.statement: Aspiration to maintain EBITDA margin above 20%; will pass deleveraging benefits to customers to grow market share
margin.quote: We will always try to maintain EBITDA more than 20-plus percent. That is what the company will do. Anything above that could be your guess.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin declined ~300 bps QoQ due to freight (200 bps) and energy costs; gross margin stable
margin.quote: I think 200% was freight and energy cost. Balance 1% may be because of the product mix, the margins fluctuate.

order_book.statement: Supply agreement signed last year to contribute from FY28; INR 120 crores received to date; trial production Q4 FY27, commercialization Q1 FY28
order_book.quote: The supply agreement we signed last year will start contributing to our growth from FY28. Company has received INR120 crores to date under the contract. We are expecting trial production by Q4 FY27 and commercialization in Q1 FY28.

capex.statement: INR 250 crores capex planned for FY27 for two new manufacturing buildings at Pakhajan site
capex.quote: We have committed a capex of INR250 crores this year on building two new manufacturing buildings at our Pakhajan site.

capex.statement: Capex funded through INR 100 crores internal accruals and INR 150 crores sanctioned term loans
capex.value: INR 100 crores internal accruals and INR 150 crores term loans
capex.quote: On capital expenditure, the planned outlay for FY27 stands at INR250 crores. This will be funded through internal accruals of INR100 crores and INR150 crores of term loans, which has been sanctioned.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices increased 10-15% overall from March to September
pricing_cost.quote: Well, it's a mix of some could be 100%, some could be zero. So I'm looking at 10- 15% overall hit on our raw material price.

pricing_cost.statement: Freight cost doubled from INR 10 crores in Q1 to INR 20 crores in Q2; gas price increase added INR 1.8 crores
pricing_cost.value: INR 10 crores to INR 20 crores freight, INR 1.8 crores gas
pricing_cost.quote: During the quarter, the cost of freight increased from INR10 crores in Q1 to INR20 crores in Q2. Increase in gas prices in the quarter also resulted in an additional expenditure of INR1.8 crores.

product_mix.statement: Product mix contributed to pricing improvement; 152 products now vs 140+ previously
product_mix.quote: We have increased certain new products from 140 plus to about 152 products we have now today at least and a couple of products which was sold some low volume in the past, certain of them have sold higher volume.

other.statement: Onboarded couple of marquee large customers in last six months; export share increased to 70% in Q2 FY27 from 65% in Q1 FY27
other.quote: Q1FY27 was about 65%, which has gone to 70%. And for FY26, it was in the range of 63%.

other.statement: Net working capital cycle at 149 days as of H1 FY27
other.quote: Our net working capital cycle stood at 149 days as of H1 FY27.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 expected to be better than H1; growth expected in Q4 FY27 but no numbers given
guidance.quote: So, I think we have mentioned last time that H2 will be better than H1. I think we will maintain that. And we also feel confident that we'll make up for the drop from these clients with the broad-based growth strategy which we have.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin to improve each quarter but reach 20-21% range only early next year
guidance.quote: I can only say right now it will go up to some extent, every quarter, but, it will be early next year when we get there.

demand.statement: Two large OEMs (one in Japan, one in Europe) caused 13% revenue decline; expected to bottom out in next couple of quarters
demand.quote: And it's primarily because of these two clients you see degrowth in the 2 respective geographies. There is growth in Americas as you can see in the US quarter -on-quarter, year -on-year.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 60 bps to 17.8% due to higher product contribution and mix
margin.quote: In terms of profitability, our EBITDA has grown from 17.2% to 17.8%, this is 60 basis point, largely it is because of the business mix as the products contributions are higher as compared to the services part and solutions part.

order_book.statement: Pipeline healthy with 89% wins from target accounts; active pipeline taking time to realize but comfortable with opportunities
order_book.quote: The pipeline is healthy. We have got reasonable wins and now 89% of the wins have come from target accounts. The pipeline is an active pipeline and we see that while it is taking some time for realization, it is an active pipeline and we feel much more comfortable with some of the opportunities on hand.

capex.statement: R&D investments increased by a couple of million dollars during the quarter
capex.quote: And we have continued to make investments in terms of technology. Even during this quarter, our investments into R&D has gone up by a couple of million dollars.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost optimization underway: shifting client engagement mix from high-cost to low-cost centers, leveraging AI and products; technology investments and teams not optimized
pricing_cost.quote: So certainly, our mix may change in terms of our capacity, which has been in certain different centres from high cost to low cost kind of centres, more on the capability side and expectations. We will never optimize our technology investments and the teams which we have. But the client engagement team, the mix may change depending upon what the clients are looking for.

product_mix.statement: Two new adjacencies initiated: Energytech (e.g., Cummins) and Deep tech; early successes in 2-3 quarters, meaningful impact takes time
product_mix.quote: So one thing is we are talking about Energytech, where some of our clients already have like for example Cummins does work into Energytech area, then we can take it to another 15 , 20 clients. And similarly in the deep tech area. So these are the two areas where we are now creating specific offerings.

product_mix.statement: Products revenue grew 5% QoQ and 25% YoY; services revenue flattish; fixed price projects at 70%
product_mix.quote: The Products revenue which we have talked about in the past and we will talk more about this later in the year, maybe early next year, in more detail what we intend to do. But this we have a 5% growth quarter-on-quarter during the quarter and 25% year-on-year. So overall services revenue has been flattish, but Products have grown 5% quarter-on-quarter and 25% year-on-year.

risk.statement: European passenger car OEMs cutting costs dramatically; long-drawn recovery; vendor consolidation expected to conclude by end of Q1 next year
risk.period: end of first quarter next year
risk.quote: So, I believe by the end of first quarter next year, the consolidation process will be meaningfully concluded, is what I think. It has started to some extent and it will get some time to conclude for different players accordingly.

risk.statement: QORIX programs pushed out by 2 years (Gen 4 from 2028 to 2029-30); exploring adjacencies like robotics and partnerships to drive growth
risk.quote: On the QORIX side, I must say that the programs which were supposed to come have , been pushed out by a couple of years. And, so from that perspective, we are looking at what we can do for a few other adjacencies , and also some of the other small products, the we have, and how we can get revenues till that time.

other.statement: Net cash INR 6.2 billion, down due to INR 1.4 billion dividend, INR 1 billion Cymotive acquisition payment, and DSO increase from 51 to 53 days
other.quote: So, our Net cash is about INR 6.2 billion. It has come down a bit, basically for two, three reasons. One is the there was a dividend payment of INR 1.4 billion. There was an acquisition payment of Cymotive in the sense the initial payment of Cymotive about a billion. And the DSO has increased from 51 days to 53 days.

other.statement: Attrition mid-teens in Q2 but predicted to come down substantially next quarter after increments for grades A-E
other.quote: People attrition was a bit higher during this quarter. It was mid-teens, but we as we predict the next quarter, it is coming down substantially. We have done our increments during the quarter for certain grades, initial grade between A to D, A to E grades.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance reconfirmed at mid-to-high single digit; targeting ~12% adjusted EBITDA margin and ~6% EBITDA growth YoY
guidance.quote: So you're correct on revenue, our guidance was mid to high. So we will reconfirm that at the midrange. So that is trending positively as we noted, sequentially, it's -- we see growth there. demand.statement: Q3 seasonality expected to drive volume uplift; OND quarter typically strong for e-commerce and retail campaigns; Masivian recovery post-security breach
demand.quote: On the seasonality, we are fairly confident that business will build up from where we are right now. We will see a lot of marketing campaigns coming away. How will that split happen between RCS and WhatsApp is again something we'll observe during the quarter and then we'll be

margin.statement: Gross margin recovered to 22.4% in Q2 from 20.9% in Q1, up 30 bps YoY driven by new product mix
margin.quote: Gross profit margin for the quarter stood at 22.4% versus 22.1% in the same quarter last year and 20.9% in the previous quarter, an expansion of around 30 basis points compared to the prior year, reflecting the richer mix from our new products.

margin.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin at 10% in Q2, up 50 bps QoQ; one-off costs from Masivian security incident and bonus provision impacted reported EBITDA
margin.quote: Adjusted EBITDA for Q2 was INR1,184 million, which is higher by 8.7% compared to the previous quarter as the strong DM performance more than offsets the nonrecurring costs. capex.statement: No specific capex guidance; cost discipline focus with multiple levers for growth and cost optimization to reach 12% EBITDA margin
capex.quote: We are working on multiple levers, both growth and cost optimization to revert to EBITDA margin of around 12%, which would result in a mid-single-digit EBITDA growth year-on-year.

pricing_cost.quote: See, the earlier rates were in vicinity of the pricing of SMS. product_mix.statement: New products contribution crossed 10% of revenue; recurring revenue 93% of last 12 months revenue, up from 89% in FY26
product_mix.quote: Recurring revenue, which we define as revenue from customers billed in every month of the period, accounted for 93% of revenue over the 12 months from September last year to September this year, up 89% as we reported in FY26.

other.statement: Marko Erkic appointed CEO of Masiv (Colombian subsidiary) to lead LatAm growth and Proximus integration
other.quote: In Latin America, we strengthened our leadership with the appointment of Marko Erkic as CEO for Masivian, our Colombian subsidiary. Marko will support the continued growth of the business across Latin America and its integration within the broader Proximus Global ecosystem.

other.statement: Evaluating M&A targets in Latin America, Southeast Asia, and Saudi Arabia for product and market expansion; free cash ~INR 1,150-1,200 crore available
other.quote: we have around INR.1,150 crores to around INR.1,200 crores, somewhere in that range of free cash. guidance.statement: Yield decline expected around 3% year-on-year and less than 1% quarter-on-quarter
guidance.quote: We have always guided that you will see -- some quarters, you will see a 3% to 3.5% drop in yields. But I think quarter-on-quarter, we've done much better. The drop in yield is less than 1%.

guidance.statement: Expense growth target kept below 10% for the year
guidance.quote: We had guided in the initial part of the year that we will try to keep it less than 10%.

guidance.statement: Non-MF revenue target to reach 20% of total within next couple of years
guidance.quote: We are at the 16%, almost non-mutual fund proportion of sales. And as we said, our target is to get to 20% within the next couple of years.

guidance.statement: No large customer discounts given or expected in near term
guidance.quote: There is no large customer discounts given or no renewal discounts that are given in the numbers that you're seeing.

demand.statement: Equity AUM grew 15.5% year-on-year, ahead of industry 15.2%
demand.quote: Equity AUM grew 15.5%. So ahead of industry, industry was 15.2%.

demand.statement: SIP collections grew 16.5% year-on-year vs industry 12.4%
demand.quote: SIP collections grew 16.5% year-on-year. This is against the industry 12.4% number.

demand.statement: CAMS share of equity net sales upwards of 70% over last year
demand.quote: Our share in equity net sales was upwards of 70%.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 140 bps to 46% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 140 basis points to 46%.

margin.statement: Payments business margin at 20%, KRA very profitable, AIF stable at 20% margin
margin.quote: Payments has been growing at a profitability level, which exceeded our expectations. So to have a card business mix and then still continue to have a margin of 20% is good.

margin.statement: Non-MF steady-state margin target 25%+ in 3 years, aim for 30%
margin.quote: I think a steady-state margin of 25% plus is very much on the cards in the 3-year period that we're talking about. Our aim will be to get closer to 30%.

order_book.statement: SIF AUM at INR20,000 crores with 12 AMCs launched, ~1 lakh investors
order_book.quote: SIF new product class, almost 12 of our AMCs have now launched SIFs. Overall AUM at INR20,000 crores.

order_book.statement: GIFT City retail funds AUM crossed INR1,500 crores with 5 launches, 2-3 more in current quarter
order_book.quote: GIFT City retail funds continue to scale with 5 launches that have happen, 2 more, 2 to 3 more will happen in the current quarter. So the AUM crossed INR1,500 crores.

order_book.statement: InCred AMC appointed CAMS as MF RTA, taking client count to 32 of 64 licensed AMCs
order_book.quote: InCred AMC appointed CAMS as its MF RTA, a fairly significant win for us. So we get with this from a client count perspective to 32 out of 64 licensed AMCs.

capex.statement: Rearchitecture project ~30% done; legacy utility sunset planned by March-April
capex.quote: FUNDSNet is really the face of the RTA utility because this is how the transactions, millions of transactions every day come in. This has all gone live. We are planning to sunset the legacy utility by March, April.

pricing_cost.statement: SIF pricing mirrors regular equity fund rates; no yield difference
pricing_cost.quote: The pricing of the SIF broadly mirrors what we do for the usual funds. So if it is an equity kind of a fund that we have, you will see the same rates that we are charging effectively for equity and regular schemes to be charged for SIF.

pricing_cost.statement: Yield drop <1% QoQ, ~3% YoY due to asset mix shift (debt to passive) and telescopic pricing
pricing_cost.quote: If you see the remaining asset classes, you've seen debt falling down by X percentage, and you've seen the passives going up by the same percentage.
