product_mix.statement: Repository crossed 1.5 crore demat policies; Bima Central broker module driving growth
product_mix.quote: We crossed 15 million, 1.5 crores demat policies. The important thing is that Bima Central now has a module for brokers.

risk.statement: AI/headless architecture not a near-term threat; building core systems via LLMs still distant
risk.quote: Just taking a large LLM or just building a more intelligent SLM on top of it, giving it some instructions and getting the software built is still some distance away.

risk.statement: AMC in-sourcing unlikely; global benchmarks show 90-95% outsourcing intact; scale benefits at INR60 lakh crores AUM
risk.quote: Show me 1 example where anybody is able to condense all their operating costs to 7 or 6 or 5 or 4 bps, there will be no one. There will absolutely be no one.

other.statement: CAMS won all target AMC logos in last 3-4 years; 32 of 64 licensed AMCs now clients
other.quote: In the last 2, 2.5 years, we have flattened that completely. So 32 out of 64 licensed AMCs. And if you reflect on the logos in the last 3 to 4 years, we continue to believe that we have won everything that we wanted to.

other.statement: Cash position INR900 crores after INR160 crores dividend paid; INR3.25 interim dividend declared
other.quote: From a cash position, we ended the quarter with a very comfortable INR900 crores cash position. This is after paying around INR160 crores of dividend during the quarter for the earlier 2 quarters. And we've also declared INR3.25 dividend as an interim dividend.

guidance.statement: Management targets 80-100 new restaurant openings annually in future, up from 50-70 previously
guidance.quote: CapEx as well, helps us expand from building what we were building in the past, 50 to 70 restaurants, to potentially go up to 80 to 100 restaurants in the future.

guidance.statement: Indonesia target: improve ADS from ~19-20M IDR to 25M IDR (+5M IDR/day/restaurant) and restore 15% restaurant EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: The target that that I had set with the with the team over there before I came in, full honest, you know, sharing with you, is is to improve every restaurant on a daily basis by 5 million IDR per day per restaurant.

demand.statement: India SSSG of 14% in Q2 FY27, 14th consecutive quarter of positive dine-in traffic growth
demand.quote: It's the second consecutive quarter with a very strong SSSG growth of 14% for the quarter, with an ADS of 1,31,000, similar to what we achieved in quarter one.

margin.statement: Gross margin dipped slightly by ~0.4% due to chicken cost headwinds; supply chain efficiencies and scale expected to improve it
margin.quote: We have a slight drop in our gross margins of about 0.4%, but not a very significant amount, and most of those efforts have been through a fantastic work our supply chain is doing.

margin.statement: India restaurant EBITDA margin at 13%, company EBITDA margin at 7.8%; target to reach 15% restaurant EBITDA via volume leverage
margin.quote: We had a very strong 13% levels now over last few quarters. But if we look at it from the perspective over last year, a very clear 2.5% improvement in profitability at a restaurant level.

order_book.statement: Indonesia Burger King 'Super Hemat' value program added 35-40 transactions per day per restaurant since late September launch
order_book.quote: We have added about 35 to 40 additional traffic per day per restaurant with just this program. And we're extremely excited about this.

capex.statement: Approved primary capital infusion of ~130 crore rupees for Indonesia asset upgrades, to be deployed in tranches based on milestones
capex.quote: We've set that money aside for for improving the quality of asset. That's that's literally the plan. And, you know, obviously we've taken the approval for the entire money that could go in.

capex.statement: Indonesia asset upgrade program (HVAC, kitchen equipment, lighting, signage, washrooms) to complete over next 6+ months
capex.quote: Asset upgrade is a pillar that's going to be there in Indonesia for the next 6 months, maybe even slightly longer. And what we're doing, what we're doing over there is, again, some of the equipment, energy efficient equipment that's going in there

pricing_cost.statement: Energy costs rising but spending reduced via solar, efficient equipment, lighting; fully offsetting utility inflation
pricing_cost.quote: As energy costs are going up, we're actually bringing down the energy spending, and that's thanks to all the work that he's doing over there.

product_mix.statement: Peri-Peri LTO delivered 30% higher volumes than Korean Season 2, which was 30% higher than Korean Season 1
product_mix.quote: Korean Season 2 that came in quarter one this year was 30% better volumes than Korean Season 1, and Peri-Peri helped us deliver 30% better volumes than Korean Season 2.

product_mix.statement: Launching 'Families' pillar in November with kids program and Avengers co-branded premium products to drive traffic and check
product_mix.quote: The Families program is what we're launching this month, this in November, and you will start to experience over the next several months the efforts around our Family program.

risk.statement: Popeyes Indonesia under active discussion with brand owners to resolve persistent losses and declining ADS
risk.quote: We are in active discussion with the brand owners as well to find a suitable answer as far as Popeyes is concerned.

other.statement: India store count reached 619 as of call date, with 12 openings in October alone
other.quote: We have a very strong pipeline to continue to take this journey forward for growth. As Raj earlier mentioned, we are already at 619. This month, we've already opened 12 stores.

other.statement: App frequency up 7% YoY in Q2; CRM engine live on app driving Dine-In Crazy App Deals
other.quote: App frequency is up about 7% year-over-year in Q2. You will find a lot of the digital elements again shared by Kapil as he speaks about the business there.

543259|2026-11-03.name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd

guidance.statement: Targets 25% AUM growth to reach Rs. 20,000 crore by March 2027
guidance.quote: We are working towards a 25% growth target, which effectively means that we have to hit a Rs. 20,000 crore number by Mar 2027.

guidance.statement: Targets exit ROE of 15% for FY27 and 16% for FY28
guidance.quote: Our target is 15% exit for this year and 16% exit for next year.

guidance.statement: Commits to maintaining 5.0% to 5.2% spread on floating rate book
guidance.quote: We are running a fully floating rate book, and we are committed to maintaining a 5.0% to 5.2% spread, which is what we have always articulated.

guidance.statement: Targets 10 bps annual reduction in opex to assets ratio
guidance.quote: On opex, our commitment is to reduce by 10 basis points every year. So, opex to assets, we would like to push that down by 10 basis points year-on-year.

demand.statement: Demand good across board; H1 strong, expects momentum to continue in H2; tariff issues in Gujarat/Tamil Nadu resolved post Oct 2025
demand.quote: Demand is good across the board. And as you mentioned, we have tale of 2 halves. We have conveyed that, let's say, 3 quarters back, there were some external issues like the tariffs, etc, which impacted some of our markets.

demand.statement: No significant drought impact on portfolio; customers in manufacturing/services in urban areas, not agriculture-dependent
demand.quote: Our business is basically serving customers in the manufacturing and service-related segments. So, our customers don't have too much of an overhang or involvement or any dependence on the agricultural sector.

margin.statement: Spread excluding co-lending at 5.2%, NIM at 6.0%, cost of borrowing at 7.8%, incremental borrowing cost at 7.5%
margin.quote: Consequently, our spread, excluding co-lending, remained healthy at 5.2%, while net interest margin remained at 6.0%.

margin.statement: Insurance distribution fee draft circular impact ~35 bps on ROA; expects ~10 bps concession, net 20-25 bps to offset via LAP mix, assignment income, pricing
margin.quote: The final impact on our ROA is about ~35 basis points. So, we have to basically make up for the 35 bps. We are hopeful that out of that 35bps, about maybe 10 bps will eventually come back as a concession from the insurance authorities.

order_book.statement: AUM Rs. 18,010 crore, up 27% YoY and 6.3% QoQ; disbursements Rs. 1,705 crore, up 32.2% YoY and 4.7% QoQ
order_book.quote: At the end of September 2026, AUM stood at Rs. 18,010 crore, up 27% year-on-year and 6.3% sequentially. Quarterly disbursement reached Rs. 1,705 crore, an increase of 32.2% year-on-year and 4.7% sequentially.

order_book.statement: Co-lending disbursements Rs. 1.8 crore in Q2, portfolio Rs. 593 crore (3.3% of AUM); expects uptick in Q3
order_book.quote: Co-lending disbursements stood at Rs. 1.8 crore during the quarter, taking the co-lending portfolio to Rs. 593 crore or 3.3% of the AUM.

order_book.statement: Direct assignment transactions of Rs. 281 crore executed in Q2
order_book.quote: During this quarter, we executed direct assignment transactions of Rs. 281 crore.

capex.statement: Added 6 branches in Q2, network at 181 branches and 379 touch points; plans 20-25 branches/year, 10-15 more in H2 FY27
capex.quote: Branch additions, we normally do at a run rate of about 20 to 25 branches a year. So, broadly at the same pace. At the moment, we have added about 10 this year. So, about 10 to 15 will get added in the next 2 quarters.

pricing_cost.statement: Origination yield ex co-lending 13%, disbursement yield 13%; book yield fell 10 bps QoQ due to past rate pass-through
pricing_cost.quote: Both portfolio yields, excluding co-lending, and disbursement yields stood at 13%, reflecting consistency in pricing discipline and quality customer acquisition.

product_mix.statement: LAP share can increase by 5% for 6-7 bps spread benefit; holding as headroom for later use
product_mix.quote: We do keep LAP as a kind of headroom that we have, we can increase it by another 5%. So, an increase of 5% in LAP can give us maybe a spread increase of 6 to 7 basis points.

product_mix.statement: Individual housing loans 84% of portfolio; LAP within 20% guardrail, currently ~15%; apartments 30%, self-construction 30%, plots 1-2%, repair/renovation 1%
product_mix.quote: Individual housing loans accounted for 84% of the portfolio, while origination yield, excluding co-lending, was 13%.

risk.statement: AI deployment across lending lifecycle (Cue, ClariFi, BankLens, DocIQ); moving to shared data platform over 18 months
risk.quote: Over the next 18 months, we will move from these point solutions to one shared data and decision platform and exte nd AI into sourcing, collections and servicing in phases

other.statement: Balance transfer outflows reduced to ~4.5% from 5-6% range; expects 4-6% range going forward
other.quote: We used to be at about 5% to 6%. We have brought it down to about 4.5%. We don't want to read too much into it at this point of time. Broadly, we want to convey that balance transfers will be in the 4% to 6% range.

other.statement: ECL assumptions recalibrated every quarter
other.quote: We are now recalibrating the ECL assumptions every quarter.

guidance.statement: Insurance segment aims to achieve budgeted numbers if no adverse regulatory changes
guidance.quote: So, we are hopeful if nothing changes or if some impacts are done, we shall be able to achieve our budgeted numbers.

guidance.statement: Expect NBFC AUM of ₹1,125-1,150 crore by end FY27, below earlier ₹1,300 crore target
guidance.quote: So, AUM by the end of the year, we expect to be around Rs. 1125 to Rs. 1150 crores. But the rundown for the discontinued products, you need to understand that could have been higher in the next year, which has been shifted to this year.

guidance.statement: StoxKart targets >₹100 crore revenue in FY27; no break-even this year; plans ₹50 crore additional investment
guidance.quote: We at least aim for more than Rs. 100 crores revenue this year and good increase next year also. So, to fund this high growth, we need to keep investing in the technology and marketing. Hence, I do not see break even coming this year, but we will maintain the same level of bottom line.

demand.statement: Q2 brokerage revenue fell sequentially due to SEBI CAS changes from Aug 3 reducing turnover; treasury income hit by lack of arbitrage
demand.quote: But since some changes in regulatory changes by SEBI, CAS, that has been introduced in August 3rd. And this was a bigger change for options and happened to closing May. So, people suffered the losses. And in due course, people sta

margin.statement: H1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 19.9%, PAT margin 6.2% up 30 bps YoY
margin.quote: For the first half, consolidated operational income stood at Rs. 1047.5 crores up 21.1% YOY. EBITDA was Rs. 208.4 crores up 13.0% with a margin of 19.9% and profit after tax was Rs. 65 crores up 27.6% YOY. The PAT margin improved by 30 basis points to 6.2%.

margin.statement: NBFC segment EBIT rose 43% YoY to ₹37.6 crore in Q2 FY27 on higher yields and lower cost of funds
margin.quote: The Financing or NBFC segment recorded strong growth with revenue increasing by 33.6% YOY to Rs. 62 crores and segment EBIT rising by 43% to Rs. 37.6 crores supported by higher portfolio yields and a lower cost of funds.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 19.1% in Q2 FY27, stable vs 19.2% YoY; PAT margin 5.3% up 50 bps
margin.quote: For the quarter ended September 2026, consolidated operational income stood at Rs. 532.5 crores, a growth of 20.9% YOY and 3.4% quarter-on-quarter. EBITDA was Rs. 101.6 crores up 20.4% YOY with an EBITDA margin of 19.1%, broadly stable as compared with 19.2% in Q2 FY26.

order_book.statement: Broking DP AUA rose to ₹1,66,737 crore, up ~17% from March 2026
order_book.quote: Our broking client base, including StoxKart, grew to 14.2 lakh as of September 2026, and broking DP AUA rose to ₹1,66,737 crore, up about 17% from March 2026.

order_book.statement: Mutual fund AUM at ₹4,711 crore with 91,145 running SIPs; wealth AUM/AUA grew ~25% in H1 to ₹1,464 crore
order_book.quote: Mutual fund AUM stood at ₹4,711 crore with 91,145 running SIPs, and our wealth AUM/AUA grew about 25% in the half year to ₹1,464 crore.

order_book.statement: NBFC AUM at ₹1,031 crore as of Sep 2026; disbursements ₹323 crore in H1 FY27
order_book.quote: Our AUM stood at ₹1,031 crore as of September 2026, with disbursements of ₹323 crore in the first half, through 41 branches across 7 states.

capex.statement: Plan to invest ₹50 crore more in StoxKart, primarily to grow MTF book
capex.quote: So, we expect to invest Rs. 50 crores more in StoxKart, which will primarily be used for our increase in MTF business. We want to increase our book size in MTF.

pricing_cost.statement: Expect ~20 bps increase in borrowing cost from RBI repo hike; >90% borrowings floating rate; negligible NIM impact due to yield improvement
pricing_cost.quote: So, we expect 20 basis point increase in our cost gradually as and when the reset gets due. Our more than 90% of the borrowing is at floating rate. So, definitely, the borrowing cost will go up by around 20 basis points. product_mix.statement: Plan to reduce unsecured loan book below 15% in ~1 year, maintain at 10-15% long term
product_mix.quote: So, we plan to reduce the unsecured loan book further from current level. So, we expect it to be, you know, below 15% in about a year or so. And we want to maintain it, you know, at 10 to 15% level.

fund_raise.statement: Raised ₹150 crore via NCD public issue in Oct 2026, oversubscribed at ₹166.49 crore
fund_raise.quote: On 28th September 2026, we filed our Prospectus for a public issue of secured, rated, listed, redeemable, non-convertible debentures of ₹1,000 face value each, with a base size of ₹75 crore and a green shoe option of up to another ₹75 crore, for a total of ₹150 crore.

risk.statement: RBI repo rate hike 25 bps in Oct may pressure borrowing costs; pace of transmission and lender repricing uncertain
risk.quote: Looking ahead, we are mindful that the RBI's 25 basis point repo rate hike in October may put some upward pressure on our borrowing costs, depending on the pace of transmission and lender repricing.

other.statement: NBFC NIM improved to 7.8% in H1 FY27 from 7.3% in FY26
other.quote: NIM improved to 7.8% in H1 FY27 from 7.3% in FY26, and the NBFC earned a profit after tax of ₹23.3 crore in the first half, close to the ₹24.6 crore it earned in the whole of FY26.

other.statement: NBFC capital adequacy ratio strengthened to 46.1%
other.quote: Our capital adequacy ratio strengthened further to 46.1%, giving us ample headroom to grow.

guidance.statement: Medium-term book mix target of 45-55% between inclusive finance and retail assets maintained
guidance.quote: We may not be reaching 45-55 by the end of the year, but as we had stated in our earlier calls, 45-55 is the kind of a mix that we would like to maintain in the medium term.

guidance.statement: Full-year advances growth guidance of 30% to 35% and exit ROA of approximately 1.4% to 1.5% maintained
guidance.value: 30% to 35% advances growth; 1.4% to 1.5% exit ROA
guidance.quote: We remain focused on the full -year objective of 30% to 35% advances growth and an exit RO A of approximately 1.4% to 1.5%, while continuing to assess developments in the operating environment

margin.statement: NIM improved 28 bps year-on-year to 7.2% in Q2 FY27 aided by growth in paying book share
margin.quote: Our net interest income for the quarter stood at INR368.8 crores, a growth of 42.8% year-on-year, and NIM improved 28 basis points year-on-year to 7.2%, aided by growth in the share of our paying book.

margin.statement: PSLC income dropped to INR8 crores in Q2 from INR45 crores in Q1; CLOU convenience fees increased by INR14 crores offsetting the decline
margin.quote: We made around INR8-odd crores of PSLC income in Q2. My sense is that we would be making around INR5-odd crores of PSLC income in Q3, because typically the market is very modest in Q3. And I think in so far as the convenience fee from the CLOU business is concerned, we will continue to see some amount of growth in that.

order_book.statement: Gross advances including IBPC at INR14,972 crores, up 34.6% year-on-year; disbursements at INR3,096 crores, up 27.4% year-on-year
order_book.value: INR14,972 crores gross advances; INR3,096 crores disbursements
order_book.quote: Gross advances including IBPC stood at INR14,972 crores, representing a year-on-year growth of 34.6%. Disbursements during the quarter were INR3,096 crores, an increase of 27.4% over the corresponding period last year.

capex.statement: Adding 50 branches in next 4-5 months; 10 already opened; expected to add INR30 crores monthly disbursements by February
capex.quote: We are adding a few branches, we'll be adding around closer to 50 branches in the next 4 months or 5 months. We already opened around 10 at this point of time, so there will be an increase contribution approximately of at least around INR50 lakhs to INR60 lakhs per branch. Around INR30 crores is likely to come from branches once their operations say probably by February.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost-to-income adjusted for digital expenses at 68.7% in H1 FY27 versus 72.9% in H1 FY26; CGFMU expenses expected to remain stable as MFI share stable
pricing_cost.quote: Our pre-POP has grown significantly on year-on-year basis to INR145.5 crores, with our CTI adjusted for digital expenses at 68.7% in H1 FY27 versus 72.9% in H1 FY26.

product_mix.statement: Inclusive finance at 41% and retail assets at 59% of advances; mortgage and CV growing at 36% YoY; CLOU digital credit scaling exponentially
product_mix.quote: We are encouraged by the quality and composition of this growth, with both inclusive finance at 41% and retail assets at 59% contributing to the expansion of our franchise.

risk.statement: Drought in Karnataka and Maharashtra may have lagged impact on collections; cautious onboarding new customers in affected districts; no material adverse impact seen yet
risk.quote: While the drought conditions across Karnataka and Maharashtra have not thus far resulted in any material adverse impact on the portfolio performance or asset quality. Our bank continues to maintain a prudent approach and closely monitor the evolving situation.

other.statement: Current bucket collection efficiency for inclusive finance at 99.3% in Q2 FY27 versus 99.2% in Q1 FY27
other.quote: Current bucket efficiency for IF in Q2 FY27 stood at 99.3% versus 99.2% in Q1 FY27.

other.statement: INR1,000-1,100 crores exposure in drought-affected districts of Karnataka and Maharashtra; no significant collection change in September-October
other.quote: We have around INR1,000-odd crores to INR1,100-odd crores of exposure in these affected areas. And we've not seen any significant change. Well, there's been a change over a period of last couple of quarters. September and October have not shown any significant change as of now.

guidance.statement: Medium-term loan book target INR 8,000-10,000 crores over 3-4 years post SFB launch
guidance.quote: We are looking at around INR 8,000 crores to INR 10,000 crores book over a period of 3 to 4 years.

guidance.statement: First year SFB disbursal target around INR 2,000 crores in first 12 months of operations
guidance.quote: We are looking at anywhere around INR 2,000 crores odd, kind of, disbursal, which will be happening across the portfolios and the secured product, which we are looking at.

demand.statement: Regaining B2B alliance volumes after Q1 dip; CMS and alliance numbers show recovery
demand.quote: In Q1 FY27, our B2B and Alliance business had reduced due to skepticism of an event, which had happened. Now in Q2 and more, we are indeed working towards regaining the market share in this alliance and B2B space as seen in the CMS and alliances numbers, which I ju st stated earlier.

margin.statement: Net revenue margin 38.1% in Q2 FY27, up 100 bps YoY but down 450 bps sequentially; H1 FY27 40.3% vs 35.2% YoY
margin.quote: Our net revenue margin was around 38.1%, which is 100 basis points higher than the last year's net revenue margin. And however, it is lower by 450 basis points sequentially.

order_book.statement: Loan referral disbursals INR 762 crores in Q2 FY27, up 286% YoY; H1 FY27 INR 1,390 crores surpassing full FY26
order_book.quote: Total disbursals in Q2 w ere INR 762 crores, up by 286% on a year -on-year basis. While for H1'27, disbursals stood at INR 1,390 crores, already surpassing full -year levels of FY26, which stood at INR 1,285 crores.

order_book.statement: CMS throughput grew 13% sequentially and 12% YoY to INR 20,511 crores in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Our B2B business, CMS throughput grew 13% sequentially and 12% on a Y-o-Y basis to INR 20,511 crores.

capex.statement: Capex of INR 120-150 crores over 1-1.5 years for SFB transition, mainly technology
capex.quote: We are anticipating anything between INR 120 crores to INR 150 crores of capex over a period of 1 year to 15 months from now in terms of transitioning into SFB, the first year of SFB operational.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost of funds 1.4% in Q2 FY27; expect ~4% post SFB conversion, retaining 250-300 bps advantage over traditional SFBs
pricing_cost.quote: Our cost of funds for Q2'27 was 1.4%, giving Fino a structural cost advantage. Further, we expect our cost of funds to be around 4% even after SFB conversion, retaining an advantage of roughly around 250 to 300 basis points over the traditional SFBs.

product_mix.statement: CASA contributes 52% of revenue; renewal income record INR 74.6 crores in Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: CASA segment contributed INR 174 crores or 52% of our revenue, including a record renewal income of INR 74.6 crores, which we see as one of the biggest indicators of sustainable retail income.

product_mix.statement: Relaunch of UPI B2B P2M segment on track for Q4 FY27
product_mix.quote: On digital business front, we had indicated the relaunch of our UPI B2B P2M segment during the year, and I'm happy to share that we are on track and shall be resuming these services of this product by Q4 FY27.

risk.statement: No medium-term guidance for revenue growth, EBITDA margins, ROA; FY27 treated as transition year
risk.quote: We are not providing any guidance right now. We are focusing on building a strong liability franchise. So, our growth in CASA, which will be the cornerstone for our SFB launch and our loan referral business, which is a testimony to say that there is a demand for credit in our target segment, which we are dealing with.

other.statement: Plan to open ~40 liability branches and 25-30 asset centers in first year of SFB operations
other.quote: We are also planning to open approximately 40-odd branches, liability branches and around 25 to 30 asset centers in the first year of operations.

other.statement: CASA base 1.91 crore accounts as of Sep 2026; 8.2 lakh new accounts opened in Q2 FY27
other.quote: Our CASA base is inching towards a 2-crore mark, having reached 1.91 crore as at September 2026. This quarter saw 8.2 lakh new accounts open, averaging roughly 1 new account being opened every 10 seconds.

guidance.statement: Food and FMCG EBITDA margin guided at 3-4% for FY27; medium-term aspiration to reach high single-digit margins from FY28 onwards
guidance.quote: In food and FMCG, quarterly revenue grew 32% year-on-year to INR2,216 crores with an EBITDA margin of 3.2% in line with our FY27 guidance range of 3% to 4%.

guidance.statement: Edible oil EBITDA per MT guided at INR 4,000-4,500 for FY27 with mid-single-digit volume growth and gradual market share uptick
guidance.quote: In edible oil, we continue to guide on mid-single-digit volume growth, gradual uptick in market share and maintaining EBITDA per ton within our guided range of INR 4,000 to INR4,500 per metric ton.

guidance.statement: Industry Essentials EBITDA guided at INR 3,000-3,500 per MT; Q2 delivered INR 4,300 per MT due to better product mix
guidance.quote: Industry Essentials delivered EBITDA of INR4,300 per metric ton, well ahead of our guidance range of INR3,000 to INR 3,500 per MT.

guidance.statement: Consolidated FY27 revenue run-rate suggests INR 85,000 crores with EBITDA near INR 2,600 crores (~3% margin)
guidance.quote: If this run rate continues the way it is, I think we should be close to INR85,000 crores of revenue. And with the kind of rate which we are looking at as far as the EBITDA is concerned, we are there with the guidance. I think EBITDA margin, right now it is at 2.6% and maybe full year also we can be close to 3% kind of number we can look at.

demand.statement: Expect mid-to-high single-digit volume growth in H2 FY27 supported by festive demand despite rural sluggishness
demand.quote: I feel while we have delivered H1 11%, I think full year we should be there at 8%, 9% kind of number.

demand.statement: Urban demand grew faster than rural in Q2/H1; rural demand under pressure from rainfall deficit and high food inflation (~7.5%)
demand.quote: See, for us, the urban grew better than rural, fact number one. But the difference between both is not that staggering. I mean, rural grew little less than urban for us. So, yes, there is some kind of pressure which we saw on the rural number one.

margin.statement: Edible oil Q2 EBITDA ~INR 4,100/MT within guided INR 4,000-4,500 range
margin.quote: In edible oils, EBITDA stood at approx INR4,100 per MT during the quarter, again in line with our guided range of INR 4,000 to INR4,500 per MT.

order_book.statement: Branded exports grew 72% YoY in Q2; LTM branded export revenue crossed INR 800 crores
order_book.quote: Our HoReCa business grew 22% with LTM revenue crossing INR800 crores, while branded export delivered strong growth of 72% year-on-year.

capex.statement: Investing heavily in modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce channels for food and FMCG distribution expansion
capex.quote: We are investing quite heavily on this channels. We are also investing on urban towns where these products are been bought more.

pricing_cost.statement: Finance cost increase from inventory funding recovered through pricing; profitability not impacted
pricing_cost.quote: Most of the finance cost which increase, we recover it in our pricing part. And therefore, in spite of increase in finance cost, you will see that profitability has not been impacted as such.

pricing_cost.statement: Standardized pack sizes mandated from September favorable for branded players; eliminates grammage wars and boosts volumes
pricing_cost.quote: Yes, the standardized pack is always favorable for branded companies like us because then you have a value level playing field across. And standardized pack will also to some extent increase the volumes for us.

product_mix.statement: Industry Essentials: Oleochemicals and specialty chemicals now 45% of segment revenue, driving margin upside
product_mix.quote: Oleochemicals and specialty chemicals now contribute around 45% of segment revenue, reflecting the increased importance of this business.

risk.statement: Rainfall deficit 12-13% nationally, >30% in key wheat states may impact Kharif harvest and Rabi sowing; rural demand already weaker than urban
risk.quote: Number two, with this deficit in rainfall of 12%, 13% across overall India and then couple of territories experiencing deficit more than 30%, 35%, 40% also and with the wheat growing areas of like Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab where deficit I understand is more than 30%. So, therefore, this may have some impact on the Kharif harvest and the Rabi sowing.

risk.statement: Food inflation at 7-7.5% and headline CPI near 6% may dampen demand; festive season expected to offset some pressure
risk.quote: The inflation is again another spoil factor which is going on right now, which is sitting at a very high with headline CPI touching close to 6% as we speak today. And within that CPI, 6% food inflation is already at 7%, 7.5% kind of level.

other.statement: Direct retail reach at 9.7 lakh outlets; total retail reach ~26 lakh outlets; focus on improving throughput and outlet productivity
other.quote: Our direct retail reach now stands at 9.7 lakh s outlets, while our total retail reach remains at around 26 lakhs outlet.

other.statement: Inventory increased INR 6,000 crores in H1 due to sluggish September and sunflower supply chain disruption; funded via working capital lines; expected to normalize in Q3 (OND)
other.quote: So, because of that the inventory buildup, actually inventories have gone up by INR6,000 crores, not INR600 crores and that is primarily been then funded through our working capital lines. And that's why the lines which funded this INR 6,000 crores is more of a funded lines and therefore gone into cash flow presentation into the financing part of it. And therefore, the cash flow from the operation

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance 18-20%, EBITDA margin 40-45%, PAT margin 25-30%
guidance.value: 18-20% revenue growth, 40-45% EBITDA margin, 25-30% PAT margin
guidance.quote: The growth in revenue will continue to be in the range of 18% to 20% with EBITDA margins in the range of 40% to 45%, and PAT margins in the range of 25% to 30%.

guidance.statement: Confident estimates unchanged despite recent market correction; enough buffers to cushion tactical downturn unless protracted
guidance.quote: And so far, this quarter gives us a lot of heart that strategy had been on the right path. And even as I look at our upcoming forecast for this quarter and the subsequent quarter, despite the headwinds, I am still confident that we do not have to change any of the estimates at this point in time, unless there is a continual protracted downturn from here on as well.

demand.statement: Pensions grew 42% YoY vs industry 12-13%; AIF/wealth revenue and yields grew despite flattish AUM due to mark-to-market
demand.quote: Pensions too, entire of last year, we grew 3x of the pace of the industry. Industry grew at about 12. KFin grew at 36. This year, we have grown faster than that, I think 42% as against similar 12% to 13% growth of the industry.

demand.statement: Issuer solutions targeting 20%+ year-on-year growth for FY27; Jio Platforms IPO completed 12 hours ahead with <40ms latency
demand.quote: On the issuer solutions, I think, we are looking at a 20% total year-on-year growth. And again, with a little bit of luck from the market and depending upon how some of the other larger IPOs are also around the corner, including the Jio one, of course, I believe that we should get to a 20% plus top-end growth.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 40% including Ascent, 45.8% excluding Ascent; target full-year average 40%
margin.quote: EBITDA margins for Q2, excluding Ascent were 45.8%, and including Ascent were 40%. That is the aim that we are targeting that we will end the year including Ascent with a consolidated EBITDA margin of 40%.

margin.statement: Q2 revenue up 13% QoQ, expenses up only 3% QoQ; 18.7% sequential EBITDA growth, 32% YoY; H1 EBITDA up 13.4% YoY
margin.value: 13% QoQ revenue growth, 3% QoQ expense growth
margin.quote: Sequentially, expenses have gone up only by 3% quarter-on-quarter, while the revenue quarter-on-quarter went up by about 13%. And we believe that this will continue to play out in Q3 and Q4 as well.

margin.statement: Ascent EBITDA margin improved from -12% YoY to ~8% in Q2; targeting double-digit EBITDA in next couple of quarters, ~20%+ next fiscal year
margin.quote: But again, thanks to some really wonderful work by the business development teams. In each of the operating geographies, we continue to grow 30% plus on Ascent. And again, with a committed focus on cost optimization, the margin profile continues to expand. We hope to hit double-digit EBITDA numbers in the next couple of quarters or so.

order_book.statement: International pipeline at ~US$47 million, up from ~US$20 million 12 months ago; six deals over $4-5 million TCV
order_book.quote: The pipeline itself currently stands at roughly US$ 47 million dollars. Now, that used to be roughly around 20 million about 12 months back.

order_book.statement: 18 new international clients in transition, expected to go live in coming 1-2 quarters

product_mix.statement: Issuer solutions, pensions, wealth next-gen AI/cloud platforms going live by January; GFS international replatforming underway

risk.statement: Buffers for market downturn include deferring discretionary spend (transformational IT, automation, geography expansion, product launches) to protect margins

other.statement: Healthy cash and equivalents ~Rs 550 crore after dividend payout; H1 FY27 diluted EPS Rs 10.12
other.quote: We maintain healthy cash and equivalent situation of about Rs. 550 crores after the dividend was paid out. And the diluted EPS at the end of H1 stands at Rs. 10.12.

other.statement: Ascent gap to cash positive ~Rs 3.5-4 crore; expected to turn EPS positive in coming quarters
other.quote: The overall gap from turning cash positive is roughly about Rs. 3.5 crores to Rs. 4 crore, which isn't substantial and something that we should be able to turn EPS positive as well to the coming quarters.

guidance.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target 38-40% as new businesses ramp up
guidance.quote: our sense is that over the next few years, we should be in the range of 38% to 40%, which has been our historical EBITDA margins, once these business units start to contribute in the overall business.

guidance.statement: Effective tax rate guided at 24-25% for rest of FY27 and FY28
guidance.quote: So, the tax rate would be in the range of 24-25%.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected slightly better than historical 18-19%
guidance.quote: we would continue to kind of consider the growth for this financial year slightly better than our historical growth of 18%.

demand.statement: Anti-infectives, antifungal, oncology driving recent growth; Nystatin, Mupirocin, Fusidic acid, Fidaxomicin, Romidepsin, Everolimus seeing traction

margin.statement: Expect full-year margin recovery via revenue growth, cost optimization, inventory management and renewable energy benefits

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin 76.2%, down ~400 bps YoY due to higher raw material prices and product mix

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 33.0% vs 33.2% YoY; ex-new facilities ~37.8%
margin.quote: For H1 FY '27, EBITDA margins remained fairly stable at 33.0% compared to 33.2% in H1 FY '26, despite the contraction in gross margins.

order_book.statement: Injectables TAM ~Rs 5,000 crore; targeting ~Rs 300 crore revenue in 3-4 years from domestic/export markets
order_book.quote: I would say that the TAM for the injectable products that we do is close to around Rs. 5,000 crores, of which we have kind of built in around Rs. 300 crores top line over the next 3 to 4 years from the domestic/export markets.

order_book.statement: Injectables facility: several large customer audits completed, contracts expected to materialize in H2 FY27
order_book.quote: in the last couple of months, we have had several inspections or audits by our potential customers and we continue to engage with them. So, things are progressing quite well on that front, and we are quite optimistic that in, as we have mentioned in the past as well, that in H2 we should see some of these contracts materializing.

capex.statement: Capex guidance Rs 50-60 crore each for FY27 and FY28, total Rs 100-120 crore
capex.quote: for this year and the next year, we expect around Rs. 50-60 crore each every year, the CapEx, which is in the tune of Rs. 100-120 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: No pricing pressure; gaining customers by offering competitive pricing due to fermentation scale and productivity advantages
pricing_cost.quote: we haven't seen any pricing pressure when it comes to Concord, but yes, we have been able to gain customers because of the price reduction compared to their current existing suppliers.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material cost increases (solvents) viewed as temporary; addressing via R&D and productivity improvements rather than pass-through
pricing_cost.quote: When it comes to raw material pricing, it is quite challenging, I would say, to pass on some of the costs that we have incurred to the customers. I think, we would rather try to address these issues through R&D and through productivity improvements rather than passing these.

product_mix.statement: API:Formulation revenue mix steady at ~80:20; gross margins expected to revert to historical levels as input costs normalize
product_mix.quote: for the 6 months, it is around 80-20. So, it has been pretty much in line with what we have, which is the 80/20 split and

risk.statement: Geopolitical uncertainties and supply chain disruptions driving solvent price increases; viewed as temporary

other.statement: Unit-I utilisation 75%, Unit-III 55%, Unit-II (oral solids) 21%, Unit-IV (injectables) 5%

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of around INR170 crores

order_book.quote: And basically, the order book is almost 50% comprises the innovations we did in last 7 months, 8 months, 9 months, and 50% is the normal containers.

order_book.statement: Multiple new biologics project wins: 2 end-to-end projects from US biotech, new program from top global animal health company
order_book.quote: We have onboarded 2 projects for end-to-end development to commercialization projects from a U.S. biotech. We secured additional new program for one of the top global animal health companies and our existing customer.

order_book.statement: Biologics RFP funnel at highest ever with multiple projects in advanced stages, driving growth beyond FY28
order_book.quote: Now same is reflected in our biologics RFP funnel, which is at highest ever with multiple projects in advanced stages. And all this is really going to be driving the growth beyond FY28 for us.

risk.quote: If we look at the war situation, it would have prolonged the upward cycle of commodity, which we are seeing now. other.quote: So seamless, so I will be having our first year of operation in FY29, which I believe approximately 30% capacity utilization at best we can achieve, and then 60%-65% of capacity utilization that we can target for FY30.

guidance.statement: Management targets 35% to 40% revenue growth in FY27 even without PM KUSUM orders

demand.quote: Our Automotive Engines business delivered another strong quarter, growing 37% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand across three-wheeler and four-wheeler applications.

demand.statement: Excel Controlinkage grew 30% YoY in Q2 FY27 driven by new product orders and customer wins
demand.quote: Excel delivered a very strong quarter with a 30% year-on-year growth and this is supported by new product orders and new customer wins.

demand.statement: GEML e-two-wheeler volumes 37,000+ units in Q2 FY27, up 114% YoY; L5 three-wheeler volumes ~2,800 units, up 61% YoY
demand.quote: E-two-wheeler businesses recorded volumes of over 37,000 units with a 114% year-on-year growth for quarter 2 '27, while the L5 three-wheeler business recorded nearly 2,800 units at 61% year-on-year growth.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved QoQ from 5.8% in Q1 to 6.2% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: On a quarter-on-quarter basis, we improved EBITDA margin marginally from 5.8% in Q1 to 6.2% in Q2 on a consolidated basis.

margin.statement: Core Business EBITDA margin 11.5% in Q2 FY27 vs 14.8% a year ago due to commodity inflation
margin.quote: Reflecting these pressures, Core Business EBITDA margin was at 11.5% in Q2 compared to 14.8% a year ago.

margin.statement: GEML e-two-wheeler EBITDA loss per unit reduced 70% from ~INR20,000 to <INR6,300; EBITDA loss margin improved from -24% to -7% YoY
margin.quote: Our EBITDA losses per unit in two-wheeler have come down by 70% in Q2 from roughly about 20,000 per unit to less than INR6,300 per unit, indicating a strong and quick path to profitability.

capex.statement: Invested INR331 crores in GEML rights issue and INR112 crores to acquire 20% stake in Excel Controlinkage
capex.quote: Moving on to the capital allocation we invested INR331 crores in GEML's rights issue and we invested INR112 crores to acquire the balance 20% stake in Excel Controlinkage.

pricing_cost.statement: Top commodity pressures: aluminium, iron, copper, PGM (Platinum Group Metals) impacting engines and gensets
pricing_cost.quote: So, aluminium, iron, copper, PGM, Platinum Group of Metals, are the three, four broad buckets which is made for the engines and the gensets - that's where the commodity impact is being faced and impacted to the company.

pricing_cost.statement: Price increases implemented in parts during Q2; full benefit expected by Q4 FY27; B2B/OEM pricing operates with lag
pricing_cost.quote: We began implementing price increases in parts for the business during the quarter and shall continue through rest of the year. However, pricing arrangements in B2B/OEM ecosystem typically operate with a lag.

product_mix.statement: GEML upgraded scooters with IntelliPack connectivity suite: Nexus EX Plus with 5kW motor, Magnus G Max with 30+ connected features
product_mix.quote: We have also upgraded our scooters with new performance and technology features under IntelliPack our connectivity suite. The new upgraded Nexus EX Plus comes with a more powerful 5-kilowatt motor with higher gradeability along with Intellipack. The Magnus G Max with Intellipack offers 30-plus connected features through the Ampere Connect app.

product_mix.statement: Launched 470 cc diesel engine for three-wheelers; unveiled 750 HP Fire Fighting Engine and 160 cc gasoline engine prototype
product_mix.quote: During this quarter, we also launched a new 470 cc diesel engine for three-wheeler applications, further strengthening our product offerings.

risk.statement: Commodity cost inflation continues to offset pricing and cost optimization gains; margin improvement slower than anticipated
risk.quote: However, commodity and other input costs have continued to rise, offsetting some of these gains and therefore the improvement in margins has been slower than we had anticipated.

other.statement: GEML top 2 player in Tamil Nadu and Bihar; #1 in Bihar at ~18% share, #2 in Tamil Nadu at ~15% share; 7%+ share in Southern and Eastern markets
other.quote: We are a top two player in Tamil Nadu and Bihar for quarter 2 '27, and ranking number one in Bihar at about an 18% share and number two in Tamil Nadu at about 15% share, while also having a 7% plus share for Southern and Eastern markets.

other.statement: GEML B2B volumes grew 18% YoY in H1 with multiple new fleet accounts reducing single-customer dependence
other.quote: Our B2B volumes also grew 18% year-on-year in H1 with multiple new fleet accounts, reducing our dependence on any single customer.

guidance.statement: Expect similar percentage rise in turnover as 60% capacity expansion with additional 2-3% operating leverage on EBITDA margins
guidance.quote: So, we are expanding by 60%. So, similar percentage rise we can expect in the turnover. In terms of the EBITDA margins, I think we should be happy to have additional 2 %, 3% operating leverage out of the new facility because of the distribution of overheads over a larger production.

guidance.statement: Expect margins to move back to higher levels by end of Q3 FY27 as production and selling prices normalize
guidance.quote: As production and selling prices have normalized in the current quarter, we expect the margins to move back to higher levels at the end of this quarter.

demand.statement: Rooftop solar business seeing extremely good response with many projects signed up for current quarter under PM Surya Ghar Yojana and C&I demand
demand.quote: We have a lot of projects already signed up for the current quarter and the response is quite encouraging.

margin.statement: October production exceptionally good; expect to make good Q2 shortfall in rest of year and return to previous margin levels
margin.quote: During the month of October, we have had exceptionally good production, which we hope is going to continue for the rest of the quarter. With more positive results in the current quarter, we feel it could be possible to make good the shortfall in the rest of the year.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 30.4% on solar glass vs 33% in Q2 FY26 and 33.8% in Q1 FY27 due to lower production and 2.8% price decline from fuel surcharge reduction
margin.quote: EBITDA INR116.34 crores stood at 30.4% based on sales of solar glass versus INR125.5 crores in Q2 FY26 at 33% and INR142.0 crores in Q1 FY27 at 33.8%.

order_book.statement: No challenge in selling additional production from new capacity due to supply gap and strong customer relationships; already in discussions to onboard new customers
order_book.quote: In view of supply gap and its customer relationships, the company does not foresee any challenges in selling the additional production.

capex.statement: Project cost increased by INR150 crores to INR1,100 crores for 600 TPD expansion due to fuel cost saving equipment, power redundancy and rupee devaluation
capex.quote: So all this put together, Board has decided to increase the project cost by INR150 crores, which will of course be funded internally and without any increase in the loan amounts from the banks.

pricing_cost.statement: Average ex-factory selling price INR155.9/mm in Q2 FY27 vs INR160.3/mm in Q1 FY27; fuel surcharge partially rolled back in July but now restored to original levels
pricing_cost.quote: The average ex-factory selling price during Q2 FY27 was INR155.9 per millimeter as compared to INR147.5 per millimeter in Q2 FY26 and against INR160.3 per millimeter in Q1 FY27.

product_mix.statement: Solar kits revenue INR14.1 crore in Q2 FY27 (INR15.4 crore H1); negligible EBITDA; strengthens supply chain position and direct customer access
product_mix.quote: total sales during the quarter stood at INR3 96.2 crores including solar kits which accounted for INR14.1 crores.

fund_raise.statement: Preferential issue of warrants and equity fully realized; no outstanding warrants or further dilution anticipated in foreseeable future
fund_raise.quote: Everything has been realized. Everything, it's all paid up. Some people who had been issued warrants were not able to pay the remaining amount for conversion. And according to the SEBI law, we were obliged to forfeit the initial deposit which we have reported.

risk.statement: Gas price volatility remains key risk; fuel surcharge mechanism is one-off force majeure arrangement not a permanent pass-through for other raw material cost increases
risk.quote: In fact, there is no such arrangement of fuel cost surcharge also because the prices were being charged by us in par with the landed cost of imports. But this was like one -off situation, force majeure situation where the war was thrown on the entire world.

other.statement: Furnace 1 and 2 may need temporary 75-day shutdown each for rebuild in first half of FY28 but new production will maintain supply seamlessly
other.quote: While the existing furnaces are operating at full capacity, we may have to take Furnace 1 and 2 for a temporary shutdown of 75 days each for rebuild, which may happen in first half of the next financial year 27-28.

other.statement: INR1,100 crore capex funded by INR800 crore internal accruals (preferential equity/warrants) and INR300 crore debt already tied up but not drawn
other.quote: INR1100 crores will be funded internally by INR800 crores and INR300 crores is the debt which we had signed much earlier. So, we have not yet drawn the debt as such.

guidance.statement: Rental income growth guidance of 14%-15% for FY27 and FY28 maintained; optimistic about exceeding FY27 guidance
guidance.quote: I think, Pritesh, we had come out in Q4 and actually given a straight guidance for two years to expect a 14%-15% kind of rental growth. I do not think that changes for FY27 and FY28.

guidance.statement: Normalized October consumption growth expected at 20%-25% year-on-year
guidance.quote: I would say that, I would compare maybe October this year to November last year. Because last year there was no Diwali in the month of November. Diwali was in October last year. So we are comparing two different time periods and maybe, a 20% to the higher end of 25% range is what we can say is the outlook for October 2026.

demand.statement: Excluding jewelry and electronics, consumption grew 22% in Q2 FY27, broadly in line with Q1
demand.quote: Excluding jewelry and electronics, consumption grew by 22%, broadly in line with 24%, which was recorded in Q1.

demand.statement: Retail consumption grew 25% YoY in Q2 FY27 to Rs 4,685 crore; every mall delivered double-digit growth
demand.quote: Consumption for the quarter stood at INR 4,685 crores, representing growth of 25% year- on-year. For the first half, consumption increased by 28% to INR 9,415 crore s. What is particularly encouraging is that every mall in our portfolio delivered double -digit consumption growth during the quarter

margin.statement: St. Regis Mumbai EBITDA margin remained healthy at 44% with 13% income and EBITDA growth
margin.quote: The St. Regis, Mumbai continued to lead the performance with both income and EBITDA increasing by 13% during the second quarter and has continued to maintain its lead as far as average room rates are concerned. We saw a 20% increase in average room rates for The St. Regis, Mumbai while the EBITDA margins remained healthy at 44%.

order_book.statement: Office portfolio occupancy increased to ~79% in September 2026 from 70% in March 2026; billing occupancy also increased driving 64% office income growth
order_book.quote: In offices, our portfolio occupancy has increased to approximately 79% in September (2026) from 70% in March 2026 and 72% in June (2026). Our billing occupancy has also increased, and that is why we see office income growing by 64% year-on-year to INR 89 crores in the second quarter.

order_book.statement: Phoenix Mall of Asia trading occupancy reached 96% from 84% a year ago; consumption up 68%, rental income up 44%
order_book.quote: Phoenix Mall of Asia has established itself as one of Bengaluru's leading premium retail destinations. During Q2, it continued to scale with consumption increasing by 68%, rental income by 44%, and trading occupancy reaching 96%, up from 84% a year ago.

order_book.statement: Leasing progress: Rise 1 retail 60% leased at Rs 500+ pspm; Kolkata 90% leased, Surat 50% leased, Bangalore expansion 70% leased, Palladium expansion 60% leased
order_book.quote: With this next phase of expansion of retail, Rise 1, we are going to be adding about 150 stores. It is going to be a combination of relocations and new brands. About 50% of the brands in Rise 1 are going to be new brands that we are adding there. We have completed about 60% of the leasing, and the rentals are expected to be upwards of INR 500 pspm for that block, which is higher than the existing

capex.statement: Advance given for acquisition under discussion; Chandigarh land payment ~Rs 700 crore completed in Q1; incremental land in Coimbatore and Kolkata
capex.quote: Now the main large expense towards land this time was the payment for the completion of land payment for Chandigarh, which we completed in quarter one. That was almost a INR 700 crore payout. And we are adding some incremental land around our existing sites in Coimbatore and Kolkata.

capex.statement: Q2 capex outflow Rs 389 crore (Rs 349 crore construction, rest FSI/land); H1 land/FSI spend ~Rs 800 crore, construction ~Rs 700 crore
capex.quote: Total capex outflow during Q2 was INR 389 crore, out of which INR 349 crore was towards the construction cost and the remaining toward the FSI and land cost.

pricing_cost.statement: F&B revenue share typically 15%-20%+ depending on format; new gourmet formats driving hypermarket category improvement
pricing_cost.quote: I think in F&B, I would say that our revenue percentages would typically be 15% and higher, depending on the kind of format that is there. It can be 15%, 18%, 20%, or more.

product_mix.statement: One-third of consumption increase from new stores; new stores bring affluent customers lifting overall sales
product_mix.quote: Another important aspect to highlight is that we are seeing about one-third of the increase in consumption coming from the new stores. The interesting part of new stores is that they bring a wider impact beyond direct sales contribution to those stores, because they bring in a new set of affluent customers, which lifts up the overall sales of all the existing brands in the stores.

product_mix.statement: Fashion & accessories (60% trading area) grew 22%, F&B grew 21%, entertainment grew 16%; new brands contributing ~1/3 of incremental consumption
product_mix.quote: Fashion and accessories, which account for approximately 60% of our trading area, grew by 22%. Food and beverages grew by 21%, while entertainment grew by 16%.

fund_raise.statement: ISMDPL acquisition: NCLT approved selective capital reduction in Oct 2026; completion expected Nov 2026; PML stake to increase from 58.33% to 68.1% for Rs 1,350 crore consideration
fund_raise.quote: In October 2026, the NCLT approved the Selective Capital Reduction scheme, forming part of Tranche 2. We expect the capital reduction to be completed in November 2026, following which PML stake in ISMDPL will increase from 58.33% to 68.1%. The capital reduction consideration is INR 1,350 crore.

risk.statement: 5% of leasable area under active fit-outs impacting consumption by 2-3 percentage points in Q2; strategic churn ongoing at multiple assets
risk.quote: In fact, right now at this time, across our portfolio, 5% of the leasable area is under active fit-outs at this time. This includes the renovations and other optimizations that we are strategically carrying out.

risk.statement: Kolkata residential delayed due to plan change and approval delays from elections; launch expected in 2 quarters
risk.quote: Second is, the approval has taken longer time than what we were expecting to start this premise because of the election and other reasons. But we are expecting that to start maybe in two quarters' time, and you will see in couple of our investor calls subsequently.

other.statement: Typically 20% increase on previous minimum guarantee rentals when repricing expiries; expect same trend to continue
other.quote: You would have seen that typically we have a 20% increase on our previous minimum guarantee rentals, when we reprice the expiries, we expect the same trend to continue as well. That will also have a positive impact on the rental growth.

other.statement: Net cash from operations increased 20% to Rs 711 crore in Q2; operating free cash flow after tax and net interest grew 22% to Rs 631 crore
other.quote: Cash generation remained robust in Q2. Net cash from operations increased by 20% to INR 711 crore. Operating free cash flow after tax and net interest grew by 22% to INR 631 crore.

order_book.statement: Strong pipeline of new business wins across Automotive Technologies, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions, and Bearings & Industrial Solutions securing future revenue growth
order_book.quote: What has kept us going and the revenue growth that you see is because of a strong pipeline of new business wins. We continue to keep the focus on winning new businesses with our existing customers as well as with new customer acquisitions that we do.

capex.statement: Q3 CY26 capex was INR 182 crores, highest quarterly spend; nine-month capex INR 357 crores
capex.quote: On the capex, as you can see, clearly, in the third quarter, we have invested INR 182 crores in the third quarter alone, and this has complemented the overall performance, which were a little muted in the first two quarters and our commitment to invest for the future growth of Schaeffler in India stays the course.

product_mix.statement: Revenue mix: Automotive Technologies 37%, Bearings & Industrial Solutions 35%, Exports 17%, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions 11%
product_mix.quote: our Automotive Technologies still continue to be at about 37% of the revenue, Bearings and Industrial Solutions coming in close second with 35%, follow ed by our export, which has cropped up from 15% in the last quarter to 17% and our Vehicle Lifetime Solutions, which is at about 11% of the total revenue kick

other.statement: New business wins across engine applications (lash adjusters, roller tappets), clutch portfolio, rocker arms, aftermarket timing kits, lubricants, railway TAROL/TRB, industrial automation actuators
other.quote: We did have a lot of business in the engine application portfolio such as our lash adjusters, HLA-RFF, the roller tappets and so on. We also had some strong business win in the clutch portfolio for the automotive application, passenger vehicles in particular, and some of the rocker arm assemblies that go into the engine.

other.statement: Working capital increased to ~19% of sales due to planned localization inventory and unplanned e-mobility inventory buildup; free cash flow only INR 41 crores; focus on recovery in Q4
other.quote: What you would see is the increase in working capital, which has gone up and as a percentage of sales has crept to almost 19% levels. The reason for this is we did have some planned increases - due to our localization projects, we have to continue to service the customers.

guidance.statement: Management guides for low single-digit revenue growth for FY27, down from earlier high single-digit guidance
guidance.quote: I think so the position is that we'll be growing by a single low digit, and that is where we are.

guidance.statement: Management expects about 100 bps decline in gross margin and similar or slightly more decline in EBITDA margin for the year
guidance.quote: Going forward also, our imagination is that we will deliver low single-digit revenue growth with some, say, about 100 bps loss in gross margin and a similar or slightly more decrease in EBITDA.

demand.statement: Q2 demand driven by insecticides due to El Nino; herbicides and fungicides weak; Rabi season outlook depends on South and East zones
demand.quote: Due to the dry weather, performance of our herbicides was significantly impacted while insecticide segment has good growth.

demand.statement: Management more confident on Southern and Eastern regions for Q3-Q4 due to returning monsoon opportunity
demand.quote: Compared to Central and Western, we are more confident of the Southern and Eastern region.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin improved due to tight control on other expenses; gross margin slightly lower YoY due to GST refund impact
margin.quote: EBITDA margin improvement is mainly because of the -- you see very tight control on the other expenses. So there is a decline in other expenses because of which the EBITDA margin increased.

order_book.statement: European and Brazilian subsidiaries hold registrations only; 14 countries with customer appointments, purchase orders from 5 countries
order_book.quote: We have appointed customers in about 14 countries, and we have purchase orders in hand from five countries, five of the customers.

capex.statement: Dahej plant capacity expansion planned for FY28: adding 2 new fungicide products, increasing from 2 to 4 products; capex amount to be disclosed later
capex.quote: We have recently aligned to do some capacity expansion in the current plant, wherein we will be increasing capacity of existing products as well as we'll be adding new products, 2 new products in the existing plant itself. So next year, FY 28, we will be having 4 products in our portfolio, up from 2, which we are currently selling.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices mixed in Q2; some down from Q1, some up; selectively passed on cost increases
pricing_cost.quote: Some of the raw material prices have come down from quarter 1 further in quarter 2. Many other raw material pric es have gone up in quarter 2, wherever possible and very selectively and very calculatively, we have passed on the increased cost to the market

product_mix.statement: Q2 product mix: insecticides 47%, fungicides 25%, herbicides 8%, others 20%; insecticides drove growth
product_mix.quote: From a product category perspective, insecticides contributed 47 %. You will notice, as -- I spoken earlier, insecticide segment has done very well and 47% share came from insecticide segment, 25% contribution from fungicide segment and only 8% herbicide contribution was there and 20% others contribution.

risk.statement: Generic crop protection facing pricing pressure due to tepid demand; unable to pass full cost increases despite rising raw material and freight costs
risk.quote: One thing is on the demand side because we have seen a year of tepid demand. So we are able to pass on the increased cost only in a selective and a calculated way, which we are doing. Yet because of the tepid demand, we cannot pass on the entire cost incre ase to the consumer

risk.statement: Industry carrying high-cost inventory; Dhanuka avoided via conservative buying since July 2026; advantage temporary as competitors will catch up
risk.quote: Unlike the high-cost inventory issues lagging the sector, our proactive raw material sourcing and lean distributor inventory levels ensured zero channel stuffing and healthy cash generation

other.statement: Biostimulant revenue Q2 FY27 INR11.7 crores vs INR8.4 crores Q2 FY26 (4 molecules); only 2 molecules billing in Q2, third launching December
other.quote: Biostimulant Q2, in quarter 2, there is -- as compared to previous year increase of around INR3.3 crores as against INR8.4 crores, INR11.7 crores this year.

other.statement: Royalty income from Bayer products Q2 FY27 INR6.5 crores vs INR4.3 crores Q2 FY26
other.quote: This was around INR6.5 crores as against previous year in quarter 2 is around INR4.3 crores.

511243|2026-11-04.name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd

guidance.statement: Full-year AUM growth guidance maintained at around 25% with net credit costs at approximately 1.4%
guidance.quote: At the beginning of the year, our objective was to deliver around 25% growth while maintaining net credit costs at approximately 1.4% for the full year.

guidance.statement: Steady-state AUM growth guidance of 20% to 23% over the medium term
guidance.quote: We still hold to that 20% to 23% on a steady-state basis, because there are volatilities that is possible.

guidance.statement: Opex ratio expected to remain broadly in 3.0% to 3.1% range near term, targeting around 2.8% over next 2-3 years
guidance.quote: As mentioned earlier, we expect the Opex ratio to remain broadly in the 3.0% to 3.1% range in the near term. However, over the next two to three years, our objective is to drive further operating efficiencies and gradually bring the Opex ratio down to around 2.8%.

guidance.statement: CSEL and Consumer Durables combined pre-tax ROA expected to sustainably exceed 4% over medium term
guidance.quote: They are already delivering a pre-tax ROA of around 3.6%, and we Cholamandalam Investment and believe that, on a combined basis, they have the potential to sustainably deliver over 4% pre-tax ROA

demand.statement: HCV industry grew 40% in Q2 and 20% in H1; industry expected to deliver 15-20% growth in H2 under conservative scenario
demand.quote: Taking all segments together, it appears that the industry should be able to deliver 15% to 20% growth in the second half even under a conservative scenario, supported by healthy demand trends across most vehicle categories.

demand.statement: October vehicle finance disbursements trending at 18-20% YoY growth; Q3 expected at 20-22% YoY growth
demand.quote: Based on the current trends, October growth is trending at approximately 18% to 20% year-on-year compared to October of last year.

margin.statement: NIM pressure expected from modest yield decline of ~10 bps, offset by credit cost improvement; ROTA to remain better than last year
margin.quote: While we will make every effort to manage the spread effectively, it would be prudent to factor in the possibility of a modest decline in yields of around 10 basis points. However, in our view, this impact should be more than offset by improvements in credit costs, which are expected to remain favorable.

margin.statement: Full-year cost of funds expected to increase by 15-20 bps YoY assuming 50 bps repo hike (25 bps done, 25 bps expected)
margin.quote: With respect to interest costs, even if there is an increase of up to 50 basis points during the second half of the year, we believe the overall cost of funds for the full year may increase by only around 15 to 20 basis points on a year-on-year basis.

order_book.statement: Aggregate disbursements grew 47% YoY to INR35,872 crores; AUM grew 25% YoY to INR2,68,009 crores
order_book.quote: Aggregate disbursements grew by 47% year-on-year to INR35,872 crores, reflecting healthy demand conditions, execution strength and continued expansion of our distribution franchise. This translated into an AUM of INR2,68,009 crores, registering a growth of 25% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Vehicle finance disbursements grew 31% YoY to INR17,801 crores; AUM grew 21% YoY to INR1,29,787 crores
order_book.quote: Vehicle finance disbursements grew by 31% year-on-year to INR17,801 crores, resulting in an AUM of INR1,29,787 crores, a growth of 21% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Consumer loan disbursements grew 103% YoY to INR8,726 crores; AUM grew 32% YoY to INR45,902 crores
order_book.quote: Consumer loan disbursements grew by 103% year-on-year to INR8,726 crores, resulting in an AUM of INR45,902 crores, up 32% year-on-year.

pricing_cost.statement: Repricing of floating-rate portfolios in Affordable Housing and LAP to be implemented over next 1-2 months to offset cost of funds increase
pricing_cost.quote: In addition, wherever there is scope to reprice floating-rate portfolios, we will take appropriate pricing actions. As of now, businesses such as Affordable Housing and Loan Against Property are evaluating these actions and may implement them over the next one to two months.

pricing_cost.statement: PLR hike in home loans and LAP planned for Q3 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: We have not done. We will do it in this quarter, coming quarter, quarter 3.

product_mix.statement: Vehicle finance share at 52% of AUM; mortgage (HL+LAP) at 36-37% likely to rise slightly over 3-4 years; CSEL/CD/Gold to stay within 15% max near term
product_mix.quote: Vehicle finance, which is financing for 5 to 6 years, obviously, they will come down from 52% to below 50%. That only the change will happen. As far as the small ticket size and consumer business is concerned, where CSEL, CD and gold is concerned, they are going to be within 15% max in the near term.

fund_raise.statement: Board approved proposal to raise up to INR5,000 crores capital, subject to approvals, to strengthen capital base and support growth
fund_raise.quote: Given the strong growth momentum across our businesses, the Board has approved a proposal to raise up to INR5,000 crores of capital, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

risk.statement: Insurance commission reform impact: evaluated scenarios and have alternative revenue levers; awaiting final clarity on extent of reduction before implementing measures
risk.quote: On insurance income, as mentioned earlier, we have already evaluated various scenarios and do not believe this will create a significant issue for us. We have alternative plans and revenue levers available. At this stage, we are waiting for greater clarity on the actual extent of any reduction in insurance income.

risk.statement: Drought impact assessment: rainfall deficit concentrated in historically drought-prone regions (Vidarbha, Malwa, parts of MP, Karnataka); tractor exposure only 3% of vehicle finance; Rabi season reservoir levels key monitor by Dec
risk.quote: The deficit is largely concentrated in regions such as Vidarbha, Malwa, parts of Madhya Pradesh, and certain districts of Karnataka, which have historically been drought-prone areas. Cholamandalam Investment and Therefore, we do not believe this is likely to affect the overall growth momentum

other.statement: Gross Stage 3 improved to 3.25% in Sep'26 from 3.29% in Jun'26; GNPA per RBI norms improved to 4.44% from 4.50%
other.quote: Gross Stage 3 improved to 3.25% in September '26 from 3.29% in June '26. GNPA as per RBI norms improved to 4.44% in September '26 from 4.50% in June '26.

other.statement: Credit cost reduced by 37 bps YoY; PBT ROA expanded by 40 bps YoY; ROE improved to 19.4% from 18.1%
other.quote: Our strong portfolio performance led to a reduction in credit cost by 37 bps. Consequently, our profitability improved with margins, our PBT ROA expanding by 40 bps year-on-year. This translated into a stronger return profile with ROE improving to 19.4% compared to 18.1% a year ago.

guidance.statement: Capex budget for FY27 is approximately INR 80 crore, including INR 45-50 crore maintenance capex; remaining focused on analytical capabilities and self-service offerings.
guidance.quote: As stated in our last conference call, we have budgeted approximately INR80 crores for capex for FY '27, which includes a maintenance capex of around INR45 crores to INR50 crores.

guidance.statement: Management reiterated medium-term guidance of INR 700 crore revenue by FY28 with 35-36% EBITDA margin, implying ~20-25% CAGR top-line growth.
guidance.quote: Yes, medium term, I think we are quite confident. If I may give an analogy for Vimta, it's like a coiled spring now. So there's a lot of potential in this spring. We need the right opportunities for this spring to really jump up because the base is very strong.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin 35.5% in Q2, 36% in H1; medium-term risk of 100-200 bps correction due to service mix shift toward biologics, though scale economies may offset manpower/material costs.
margin.quote: In the coming quarters, we may not see a shift in any significant manner. But medium term, there is a possibility of correction of around 100 to 200 basis points. This is more to do with the service mix rather than input cost.

order_book.statement: Biologics CRADS: initial order booked, active discussions with multiple clients, targeting onboarding a couple more in Q3; revenue contribution modest now, expected to become significant in 2-3 years.
order_book.quote: We are already working on the initial order that has been booked. And right now, we are talking with multiple clients, and we hope to onboard at least a couple of them more in this quarter.

capex.statement: Capex utilization in H1 FY27 was lower than planned (INR 112-115 crore spent); H2 utilization expected to align with plan.

capex.statement: Investing in tech infrastructure and office refurbishment, increasing depreciation

pricing_cost.statement: Wage hike effective July 2026 impacted margin by ~170 bps QoQ
pricing_cost.quote: Increment ate up about 170 basis points of margin on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

risk.statement: Furloughs in Q3 expected at same levels as last year; no extra furloughs seen as of now

risk.statement: No guidance provided for Q3 due to seasonality; H2 confidence based on pipeline and renewals

other.statement: Collections $164M in Q2; DSO improved to 51 days, a 2-year best
other.quote: Collection s during the quarter were $164 million, resulting in our DSO touching our 2-year best of 51 days.

other.statement: Cash and cash equivalents at $300.4M as of Sept 30, 2026
other.quote: Our cash and cash equivalent as of 30th September 2026 stood at $300.4 million.

guidance.statement: Holds FY27 guidance: high single-digit underlying volume growth in stand-alone and double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth at consolidated level
guidance.quote: We continue to hold our FY27 guidance, high single -digit underlying volume growth in stand -alone and double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth at a consol level.

demand.statement: Delivered strong broad-based underlying volume growth across India, Indonesia and Africa despite subdued monsoon in India
demand.quote: We delivered strong broad-based underlying volume growth across India, Indonesia and Africa despite subdued monsoon conditions in India, while being supported by tailwinds in Indonesia.

margin.statement: Input cost inflation intensified across crude-linked derivatives, palm oil and commodity inputs, one of the highest inflationary impacts in many years
margin.quote: The input cost environment remained significantly challenging through the quarter. Inflation intensified across crude-linked derivatives, palm oil and commodity inputs.

order_book.statement: GUAM delivered 7 consecutive quarters of double-digit top line growth and 11 consecutive quarters of double-digit bottom line growth
order_book.quote: More importantly, GUAM has now delivered 7 consecutive quarters of double -digit top line growth and 11 consecutive quarters of double -digit bottom line growth.

capex.statement: Capacity expansions in GUAM happening in next few months as existing businesses operating at very high capacity utilization constraining growth
capex.quote: We are operating with actually, frankly, very, very high capacity utilization on some of our existing businesses. These are businesses, which have been there with us for many years. And we've reached capacity utilizations, which are now kind of constraining our growth. There are expansions in capacity which are happening in the next few months.

pricing_cost.statement: Taking calibrated pricing actions significantly in soaps and liquid detergents where cost impact is large and margins below normative levels
pricing_cost.quote: We will continue to take calibrated pricing actions significantly in soaps and liquid detergents, where the cost impact is large and the margins even today are below normative levels.

product_mix.statement: Launched Godrej Rizz in selected markets across West and South India and Godrej Zap entry into stain removers online, both received well
product_mix.quote: During this quarter, we launched Godrej Rizz in selected markets across West and South India. We also launched Godrej Zap, our entry into stain removers online. Both these new launches have been received well.

other.statement: Trade inventory correction of estimated 150 bps impact in stand-alone business to maintain healthy channel levels and focus sales team on offtake
other.quote: This is despite an estimated 150 bps impact from trade inventory correction in the quarter. While this has been a modest near-term impact in terms of the correction we've done, we believe that maintaining healthy channel levels is important for operational excellence and sales team to remain focused purely on offtake.

other.statement: Consolidated revenues grew 19% year-on-year, 15% in constant currency with underlying volume growth of 8%, EBITDA grew 12%, net profit grew 14% to INR523 crores
other.quote: At a consolidated level, revenues grew 19% year-on-year, 15% in constant currency terms with underlying volume growth of 8%. EBITDA grew 12%. Net profit grew 14% to INR523 crores.

guidance.statement: NIM target 3% to 3.4% and ROA target 1.1% to 1.35% for H2 FY27
guidance.quote: NIM and ROA, as I mentioned, 3% plus and 1% plus continuous improvement every time. That much only I can tell you. Continuously, we are maintaining, as I told you earlier also, it is 3% to 3.4%. So also, ROA will be 1.1% plus or it will be between 1.1% to 1.3%, 1.35%.

guidance.statement: Retail share target 60%, mid-corporate 22%, large corporate 18%

guidance.statement: Cost-to-income ratio target 51% to 52%
guidance.quote: We are as per the guidance. It is 52% or 51%. We will focus on that.

margin.statement: NII INR982.44 crore, up 5% Q-o-Q and 35% Y-o-Y; NIM 3.17% vs 3.20% Q1 FY27 and 2.72% Q2 FY26

risk.quote: Scanty rainfall this year, no doubt about it. This rainfall in the previous quarter, some of our investors has asked the same question. I told them also, it is not new to us. other.quote: Had it happened, it would have been much, much better. But if it has not happened in Q2, it will definitely happen in Q3. Definitely, numbers will further improve. Some major 1 or 2 accounts are also there. With that, GNPA as well as NNPA are also going to improve further.

other.statement: Attrition rate very low; ESOP and incentivization discussed at Board level
other.quote: Pranay, good evening. You have raised the right point, but attrition rate in Karnataka Bank is very low.
