other.statement: Total carbon black capacity ~8 lakh tonnes including Andhra; significant export growth expected over next few years
other.quote: We should see significant growth in exports over the next few years. We have a fairly small market share today with some of the largest customers globally. And we are entering into conversations with them on long-term tie-ups, which should easily see our volumes multiplying as we progress over the next year.

other.statement: Aquapharm expanded critical raw material inventory coverage to protect supply chain against volatility
other.quote: On the raw material front, we have expanded our critical raw material inventory coverage to protect our supply chain against ongoing market volatility.

guidance.statement: Maintain FY27 volume growth guidance of high single-digit to low double-digit for combined business; beyond FY27, mid-teens volume and mid-to-high teens revenue growth over next couple of years.
guidance.quote: We maintain our guidance for FY27 of achieving a high single-digit to low double-digit volume growth for the combined business. And beyond FY27, including new launches planned for FY28 onwards, we maintain our volume growth guidance of mid-teens and revenue guidance of mid-to-high teens over the next couple of years.

demand.statement: Imperial Blue and Mansion House registered secondary volume growth of 8.5% and 7.1% QoQ in Q2 FY27, driving market share gains.
demand.quote: Firstly, both our flagship brands, Imperial Blue Whisky and Mansion House Brandy have registered a robust secondary volume growth of 8.5% and 7.1%, respectively, in Q2 FY27 versus Q1 FY27.

demand.statement: Overall volumes increased 160% YoY and 2% QoQ in Q2 FY27; growth was flattish QoQ due to higher primary in Q1 from TSMA exit states.
demand.quote: In Q2, our overall volumes increased by 160% on a year-on-year basis and 2% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

margin.statement: Adjusted gross margin 41.8% in Q2 FY27 vs 42.1% in Q1 FY27; excluding inflationary pressures, margin would be closer to 44%.
margin.quote: Adjusted for subsidy, we have achieved a gross profit of Rs. 432 crore in Q2 FY27 and a margin of 41.8% compared to 42.1% in Q1 FY27. Excluding the impact of inflationary pressures, the margin would have been higher, closer to 44%.

margin.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin 14.1% in Q2 FY27; excluding inflationary pressures, margin would be approximately 16.5%.
margin.quote: Adjusted for subsidy, the EBITDA grew by 143% to Rs. 146 crore and a 14.1% margin on the combined business. Excluding the impact of inflationary pressures, the margin would have been approximately 16.5%.

margin.statement: NSR moderated 0.75% QoQ to Rs 1,174/case in Q2 FY27 due to state and brand mix change; grew 4.2% YoY on H1 basis.
margin.quote: The overall NSR moderated by 0.75% to Rs. 1,174 per case for Q2 FY27 from Rs. 1,183 per case in Q1 FY27 and increased by 3.2% from Rs. 1,138 per case in Q2 FY26.

order_book.statement: Mansion House Reserve Brandy grew 25% QoQ and 50% YoY in September 2026 in Tamil Nadu; highest volume month ever.
order_book.quote: Mansion House Reserve Brandy has seen 25%+ quarter-on-quarter volume growth with 50% year-on-year volume growth in September 2026, emerging as the highest volume month ever.

order_book.statement: Imperial Blue recorded highest ever quarterly volumes in Karnataka with market share crossing 40%, up 900 bps QoQ.
order_book.quote: During Q2, Imperial Blue Whisky recorded its highest ever quarterly volumes in the state with market shares crossing 40%, a massive 900 bps increase on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

capex.statement: Strategic investment of Rs 22 crore for 30% stake in Black Tiger Distilleries (Bodega Suprema Tequila) over two tranches: Rs 6 crore invested, Rs 16 crore over next 12 months.
capex.quote: We have agreed to invest Rs. 22 crore for a 30% stake in the company, over 2 tranches - Rs. 6 crore, which has already been invested and, another Rs. 16 crore will be invested in the next 12 months.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material inflation impact estimated at ~2.5% or Rs 25 crore per quarter on gross margins compared to pre-West Asia crisis levels.
pricing_cost.quote: See, it has been around 2.5%. The way we are looking at this is pre-West Asia crisis. So, compared to Q4, the kind of impact that you are looking at is more like 2.5%. On a net basis, you can consider around Rs. 25 crore on a quarterly basis in Q1 as well as Q2.

pricing_cost.statement: Packaging costs (glass) rose meaningfully over last two quarters due to geopolitical tensions; ENA prices started showing inflationary trend at Q2 exit with rising fuel and grain costs.
pricing_cost.quote: The ongoing geopolitical tensions have resulted in continued inflationary pressures across packaging inputs particularly glass, resulting in a meaningful increase in packaging costs during the last 2 quarters. While exiting Q2 FY27, ENA prices have also started to show an inflationary trend with rising fuel and grain costs.

product_mix.statement: A&P reinvestment rates increased 61 bps QoQ in Q2 FY27 due to strong ATL/BTL execution ahead of festive season.
product_mix.quote: A&P reinvestment rates increased by 61 bps in Q2 FY27 versus Q1 FY27 on the back of strong ATL and BTL execution drives ahead of the festive season.

product_mix.statement: Samsara Gin grew 50% in H1 FY27 vs H1 FY26; business skewed to H2 (65% of annual volumes).
product_mix.quote: Samsara has grown by 50% in the first half compared to last year. It is important to note that SSL's business is largely skewed towards H2 compared to H1, with H1 contributing approximately 35% of the overall yearly business, compared to 65% in H2.

risk.statement: Exceptional integration costs of Rs 10-11 crore per quarter expected in Q3 and Q4 FY27; no TSMA fees in FY28.
risk.quote: No, we will not be seeing any TSMA fees in FY28. And you should be expecting over the next 2 quarters around Rs. 10 crore - Rs. 11 crore on a quarterly basis. So similar levels what you have seen in Q2, in Q3 and Q4 as well.

risk.statement: ENA prices expected to remain elevated in near term due to hardened grain prices; difficult to predict long-term trend.
risk.quote: We expect that ENA would be on elevated side in the near term.

other.statement: Gross debt Rs 2,202 crore, net debt Rs 2,074 crore as of Sep 30, 2026; slight reduction vs June 2026; target net debt in March 2027 below March 2026 levels.
other.quote: As on 30th September 2026, our gross debt stood at Rs. 2,202 crore and net debt stood at Rs. 2,074 crore. There is a slight reduction in net debt levels as compared to June 2026. I want to reassure you that our target is to take the net debt in March 2027 to below March 2026 levels.

other.statement: Annualized net working capital days at ~65 days on gross basis including Telangana overdues of Rs 550 crore; days increased ~5 days vs March 2026; expect similar levels going forward excluding overdue recovery over 12-24 months.
other.quote: As it stands today, you are looking at an annualized net working capital days on gross basis at around 65 days. This obviously is taking into account the overdues of Telangana of around Rs. 550 crore as well. In terms of going forward, excluding the benefit of potentially getting the overdues over the next 12-24 months, you should be looking at similar levels from a net working capital days perspe

guidance.statement: Management guided EBITDA margin to be close to 15-17% band in Q3 and Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: We are quite confident that we will be quite close to that 15% to 17% band that we have indicated. In the third quarter, and possibly also in the fourth quarter as well.

demand.statement: October saw highest sales growth in 25-30 months; festive demand shifted to Q3 due to later Diwali
demand.quote: October was the month when we had the highest, you know, sales growth in the last possibly 25, 30 months. So, therefore, you know, festive season looks good.

demand.statement: Industrial business delivered robust high double-digit volume and value growth across segments
demand.quote: In industrial performance, we delivered robust high double-digit volume and value growth.

demand.statement: Decorative volume growth 3% in Q2 FY27, 5.6% in H1 FY27; value growth 11.9% Q2, 12.3% H1
demand.value: 3% vol Q2, 5.6% vol H1, 11.9% val Q2, 12.3% val H1
demand.quote: Volume growth, 3%, and on the half-yearly basis, if you look at it, it is 5.6%. This is stand alone. Value growth, 11.9%, and half-yearly basis, 12.3%.

margin.statement: Consolidated gross margin was 39.3% in Q2 FY27 and 40.1% in H1 FY27
margin.quote: Consolidated, you know, if you look at the figures, we are at the range which we normally operate in. Even in this quarter, we were at 39.3, you know, against 40.1 on a half-yearly basis.

margin.statement: Standalone gross margin was 36.6% in Q2 FY27 and 38.1% in H1 FY27, within normal 38-41% range
margin.quote: On a standalone basis, quarter two was 36.6, but on a half-yearly basis, it stands at 38.1. We normally operate in the range of 38 to 41, as far as gross margin is concerned, so it is well within that range.

margin.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin dropped to 10.8% in Q2 FY27 vs 14.4% in H1 FY27 due to Rang bana rahe campaign spend
margin.quote: In quarter two, the EBITDA dropped to 10.8% versus 14.4% for the half-yearly position. Our guided range is 15 to 17, so at the end of half-year, we are at 14.4, which is close to that.

capex.statement: Completed Hindukur plant expansion; evaluating new West Bengal incentive policy for Panagar investment; planning Orissa factory
capex.quote: We just, completed the expansion in our Hindukur plant. Today, the West Bengal government has announced a new industrial incentive policy. We will take a look at it and then decide to the scale of investment that we want to make in Anagar. Which is in

pricing_cost.statement: Industrial price hikes recovered ~90% of targeted increase by end-November, balance 10% by December
pricing_cost.quote: We have been able to pass on, partially the price increase, you know, and some more price increases we have got in the month of October. Some we are planning to get in November as well, hoping that, you know, we will be recovering almost 90% of the increase that we want at the end of November.

product_mix.statement: Launched waterproof tile adhesive (first in India), decorative panels (tech from Bolix), Long Life Parapet Coat, Dam Shield with 3-year warranty
product_mix.quote: Some interesting new products which we introduced in this period. One is the waterproof tile adhesive. It's a unique tile adhesive introduced by us for the first time in India, which is waterproof by nature. The second is, you know, decorative panel, which we sell in good quantities in, Poland, France, UK.

product_mix.statement: Home seal segment outperformed with roof coolant seal and dam shield as key drivers; wood coatings strong double-digit growth; differentiated products outperformed
product_mix.quote: The home seal segment continued to outperform, with roof coolant seal and dam shield emerging as key growth drivers. Wood coatings registered strong double-digit value growth

risk.statement: Raw material price volatility makes gross margin recovery timing uncertain; competitive intensity remains with new entrant rebating
risk.quote: prices are so volatile, it's difficult to say that, I mean, how they will fluctuate month on month. Of course, we have a lag between the consumption and it converting into the COGS, cost of goods sold.

other.statement: Market share stable at ~20.2% in H1 FY27 vs 20.3% earlier; new entrant raised prices to industry level but increased rebating
other.quote: We are at the end of half one. We are more or less at the same level at which we were earlier. At that, we were earlier at 20.3, we're still at about 20.2 at the end of half year.

other.statement: Retail store network at 2,000+ as of H1 FY27; added 4,800 tinting machines in H1, 2,700 in Q2
other.quote: Retail store network is at 2,000 plus, as on half-year financial year 2027. In tinting machines, we added 4,800 machines as of first 6 months, and during the quarter, we added 2,700 machines.

guidance.statement: Consolidated sales growth guidance for FY27 revised to 15% excluding Foskor and AWUKO
guidance.quote: In the last earnings call, we revised this earning the sales increase to 15%, and we maintain the revised guideline.

guidance.statement: Consolidated Ceramics sales growth guidance revised upward to 25-28% for FY27
guidance.quote: Consolidated Ceramics, we initially communicated a growth of 15% to 15.5%. In the last earnings call, we revised this to 23% to 25%. We further now revise upward to 25% to 28%.

guidance.statement: Consolidated Abrasives margin guidance for FY27 lowered to 8-8.5% excluding AWUKO
guidance.quote: Considering the standalone margin drop in H1, the cost pressures, we expect the full year margin to be 8% to 8.5%, excluding AWUKO.

guidance.statement: Consolidated Ceramics margin guidance for FY27 raised to 22.5-23.5%
guidance.quote: Consolidated Ceramics margins were expected to be 20.5% to 21% as per the last guidance. We expect this to go up to 22.5% to 23.5%.

demand.statement: Strong demand across industrial activities, construction, and infrastructure-led demand driving Abrasives growth
demand.quote: The growth is aided by growth in industrial activities, construction, and infrastructure -led demand, new geographical coverages, new product introductions, and better go-to-market initiatives from our team.

demand.statement: Ceramics demand strong across all three regions: India, Americas, and Australia
demand.quote: Ceramic growth was driven in all the 3 regions, that is India, Americas, as well as in Australia.

demand.statement: Electrominerals demand strong from refractory and abrasive customers both domestic and exports
demand.quote: Strong demand from refractory and Abrasive customers both in India and abroad helped achieve this growth.

margin.statement: Standalone Ceramics PBIT grew 48.2% YoY to INR 67 crores
margin.quote: Ceramics PBIT was INR 67 crores compared to INR 45 crore, marking a growth of 48.2%.

margin.statement: Standalone Electrominerals PBIT grew 49.1% YoY to INR 29 crores
margin.quote: Electrominerals, PBIT was INR 29 crores compared to INR 20 crore, marking a growth of 49.1%.

margin.statement: Consolidated Ceramics PBIT grew 62.1% YoY to INR 101 crores
margin.quote: Ceramics PBIT, in Q2 FY '27, consolidated Ceramics PBIT was INR 101 crores compared to INR 62 crores in Q2 FY '26, a growth of 62.1%.

order_book.statement: Strong project orders in Refractories business driving Ceramics growth
order_book.quote: The project orders are also pretty strong, and that is how we are seeing at this point in time.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex spend INR 127 crores vs INR 162 crores last year
capex.quote: Capex for H1 FY '27, we spent a capex of INR 127 crores compared to last year INR 162 crore.

capex.statement: INR 66 crores already invested in semiconductor equipment components for anchor customer
capex.quote: I think you had mentioned a capex of about INR 66 crores that we have already incurred for our anchor customer.

capex.statement: Total semiconductor investment could scale 3-4x current investment
capex.quote: You had also flagged that the total investment would scale up to about 3x to 4x of whatever we have already invested.

pricing_cost.statement: Export duty withdrawal on Chinese imports helping Indian abrasives competitiveness
pricing_cost.quote: It's a welcome thing as far as the Indian manufacturers are concerned. So we see that it's a good step from our point of view, and that could also play a role in the growth.

pricing_cost.statement: Chinese competition continues but improving due to export duty withdrawal and strong dollar
pricing_cost.quote: As far as Chinese competition is concerned, continues to be definitely be affected by the Chinese competition. It is getting better because of this export duty benefit withdrawal, plus the strong dollar and weak rupee.

risk.statement: VAW Russia status quo remains with no volume improvement expected
risk.quote: The status quo predominantly remains the same. No specific update. We continue to operate at the same level of constraints, and that is what currently is continuing.

risk.statement: No specific tax incentives available for new age businesses under new tax codes
risk.quote: No. there is no specific program tax benefit currently being made available. If you see the new tax codes, they have dispensed with many of these incentives. We are all at the normal tax rates. So there is no specific benefit that we are enjoying.

other.statement: Consolidated debt INR 362 crores, cash INR 251 crores, net debt INR 111 crores, debt-to-equity 0.09
other.quote: Cash and debt position, consolidated debt was at INR 362 crores and cash was INR 251 crore. This is excluding cash at VAW, leaving a net debt of INR 111 crore. Consolidated debt-to-equity ratio is at 0.09.

other.statement: AWUKO closure proceeding with asset sale for INR 5.34 crores and employee settlement completed
other.quote: As part of the closure process, AWUKO Abrasives entered into agreements in October '26 for the sale of all its property, plant, equipment, and inventory for an aggregate consideration of INR 5.34 crores. AWUKO has also entered into a reconciliation of interests and social plan with all its employees in accordance with applicable German labor law requirements.

guidance.statement: Management expects FY28 EBITDA of INR 1,800-2,200 crore driven by cost levers, operating leverage, and Zone IV ramp-up
guidance.quote: So we have talked about the three focus areas that are important for us to achieve that trajectory in our previous calls and we remain on track on execution of all of those initiatives under these three areas.

demand.statement: Energy segment demand robust; gasoline-naphtha cracks at $20+ per barrel in Q2; domestic demand picking up for Fuel Additives
demand.quote: The gasoline-naphtha crack, it was very robust. It was $20-plus per barrel, if I look at last quarter. So overall, demand remained quite robust.

demand.statement: Non-Energy demand tailwind steady and strong across domestic and global markets; NCB demand very strong, DCB second half strong, NT chain developing downstream markets
demand.quote: I think the demand tailwind both in domestic as we ll as in the global market in Non-Energy application remains very steady and strong, and we can go value chain by value chain

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA reached record Rs 418 crore, up 44% YoY; H1 FY27 EBITDA up 58% to Rs 802 crore
margin.quote: Q2 FY27 EBITDA increased by 44% year-on-year reaching Rs. 418 crore. Our H1FY27 EBITDA increased by over 58% to close at over Rs 802 crs, as against Rs 507 in H1FY26.

margin.statement: Zone IV target is INR 250-350 crore bottom line in first 18 months; aspiration to be EBITDA additive in FY28
margin.quote: From a margin standpoint, in the first 18 months, our target is to achieve INR250 crore to INR350-odd crore of bottom line from Zone IV, and I think we continue to push for that aspiration.

margin.statement: Pass-through mostly on absolute basis; percentage margins compress in high RM price environment but absolute contribution protected
margin.quote: I think typically, our pass-throughs are on an absolute basis, not on a percentage basis and that is where in an inflationary scenar io of significantly higher RM prices, sometimes the percentage might get impacted, while the absolute EBITDA or absolute contribution on the product remains relatively concrete

order_book.statement: Signed 10+ year manufacturing and supply agreement with global specialty chemical major with ~Rs 1,500 crore revenue potential; commercial operations targeted FY29
order_book.quote: On October 13, 2026, we also entered into a dedicated 10+ year manufacturing and supply agreement with a global specialty chemical major, representing a revenue potential of ~Rs. 1,500 crore.

order_book.statement: Augene Chemicals JV trial production underway; order book gaining traction; steady-state revenue projected at Rs 300-400 crore
order_book.quote: On the Augene Chemicals JV (Partnership with Superform), the facility is ready with the trial production which is underway, while the orde r book is gaining traction. Commercial production is expected to commence soon, with steady-state revenue projected at Rs. 300-400 crore

capex.statement: Zone IV to introduce 5-10 products in FY27, expanding to 20-25 products across 5 chemistry blocks by FY28; remaining 4 chemistry blocks online within FY27
capex.quote: In Zone-IV, we plan to introduce 5 to 10 products in FY27, expanding to 20 to 25 products across 5 different chemistry blocks by FY28. The remaining 4 chemistry blocks are expected to come online within this financial year.

capex.statement: FY27 planned capex of Rs 700-800 crore; Zone IV Phase I commissioned Sept 7, 2026; CWIP of Rs 1,800-1,900 crore mostly Zone IV to be capitalized by March 31, 2027
capex.quote: Our product portfolio continues to expand across energy, agrochemical intermediates, advanced polymer formulations, and pharma building blocks, supported by our planned FY27 CAPEX of Rs. 700 crore to Rs. 800 crore.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices surged: Sulphur up 5-6x, elevated freight costs; pass-through with lags in some segments (AgChem quarterly contracts); acid value chain unable to fully pass through sulphur inflation
pricing_cost.quote: Almost all of our raw materials saw significant price increase, while RMs such as Sulphur saw prices surge by over 5-6x, combined with sharply elevated freight costs, strained global supply chain economics.

pricing_cost.statement: In Agrochemicals, quarterly contracts create one-quarter lag in price pass-through; other long-term arrangements also have delayed impact
pricing_cost.quote: In many of the segments, for example, in Agrochemicals, we have quarterly contracts, right. So there is a lag of quarter when it comes to pass-through of the pricing.

product_mix.statement: Long-term contracts currently 25-30% of business; aspiration to increase share; fixed costs well covered including inflation in most contracts
product_mix.quote: Usually, it is around 25% to 30% of our business that comes through some of these long-term partnerships. We hope the share of that will go up going forward as we do more and more such partnerships.

product_mix.statement: Energy segment ~50% of revenue in Q2; medium-term expectation to settle at 30-40% as Zone IV ramps up and pricing corrects
product_mix.quote: We expect the energy to settle somewhere between 30% to 40% kind of a range of our overall portfolio and especially as the Zone IV ramps up pans out, many of the products coming out of that site as well as revenue getting contributed will balance the overall portfolio.

risk.statement: Inventory loss risk remains top priority; forward booking product contracts to match RM pricing; risk cannot be fully eliminated due to import/export heavy business
risk.quote: We are trying to ensure that to whatever extent possible, forward book some of the product contracts to ensure that wherever we have booked the raw material that pricing is passed on to our customer.

other.statement: Fuel Additives capacity expanded from 290 to 360 KTPA in Q1 2026; running at near full capacity in Q2
other.quote: In Fuel Additives, the capacity utilization remained strong in Q2 following our expansion from 290 KTPA to 360 KTPA in the first quarter of 2026.

other.statement: China's anti-involution strategy and VAT rebate removal (up to 13% of product price) dramatically improved NCB chain; similar policy change in PDA could drive turnaround
other.quote: The biggest lever for there was China's anti-involution strategy, which impacted NCB chain, right, where we removed the VAT subsidy rebates that Chinese players used to get, which was as high as 13% of the product price.

guidance.statement: Medium-term consolidated EBITDA margin improvement of 1-1.25% per year and standalone EBITDA improvement of 1.5% per year
guidance.quote: Every year, we should be improving by almost around 1% to 1.25% of EBITDA on a consolidated basis. And Ipca EBITDA will grow by almost around 1.5% stand-alone EBITDA.

guidance.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue growth guidance maintained at 14-16% and EBITDA margin guidance at 22-23%
guidance.quote: In earlier quarters, we have given that -- earlier quarter, we have given guidance that overall growth guidelines was almost around 12% to 13%, which was revised to 14% to 16%. So tha t would remain. And consolidated EBITDA margin guidelines was from 22% to 23%, that will also stand there

demand.statement: Export formulation business grew 32% YoY to INR653 crores in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: On export formulation business, on a stand-alone basis, Ipca has grown by 32% in Q2 FY '27 to around INR653 crores as against INR493 crores in Q2 FY '26.

demand.statement: Pain segment volume growth 8-9% and price growth 4-4.5%
demand.quote: Volume-led growth may be almost around 8% to 9% and price growth may be around 4% to 4.5%, yes.

demand.statement: Branded business in ROW markets grew 19% YoY to INR172 crores in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: Our promotional branded business in ROW markets has delivered growth of 19% for Q2 FY '27 to around INR172 crores against INR145 crores in Q2 FY '26.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 22.97% in Q2 FY27 from 21.68% in Q2 FY26 despite input cost increases
margin.quote: In spite of all these factors, overall consolidated EBITDA margins have improved to around 22.97% in Q2 FY '27 as against 21.68% in Q2 FY '26.

margin.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin improved to 26.6% in Q2 FY27 from 25.46% in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: Stand-alone EBITDA margin of Ipca has improved to 26.6% in Q2 FY '27 as against 25.46% in Q2 FY '26.

margin.statement: Unichem EBITDA margin at 11.3% in Q2 FY27 impacted by INR30 crores extra freight costs
margin.quote: Let's say, Unichem has delivered almost around 11.3 % kind of EBITDA margin in current quarter. I think overall because of freight increase, the freight was significantly increased in this particular quarter. And freight numbers almost arou nd INR30 crores extra has gone in this quarter

capex.statement: Pisgah subsidiary will take more time to improve; API order positions good, expected to improve by next financial year
capex.quote: Let's say, except one subsidiary, which is Pisgah, all subsidiaries have done well. And they are all in profit, yes. Pisgah will take some little mo re time because there are good order positions on their API side. And so maybe I think by next financial year, things will start improving

pricing_cost.statement: Significant price increases on inputs, logistics, shipping, fuel and energy costs in Q2 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: For Q2 FY '27, we continue to see significant price increase on inputs, logistic cost, shipping cost and even fuel and your -- energy cost.

risk.statement: Freight costs significantly increased with air shipment percentage rising from 5-6% to 25% in Q2 FY27
risk.quote: Air percentage of overall has gone up almost in this quarter to around -- from 5%, 6% to around 25% -- so that has taken almost around INR30 crores out of the freight expenses out of EBITDA that has gone.

risk.statement: Brazil business was loss-making in first two quarters but started delivering profit in Q2 FY27
risk.quote: The Brazil till now, they were incurring losses for first 2 quarters of the current financial year. That has started delivering now the profit.

other.statement: Foreign currency debt fully repaid; only INR155 crores rupee term loan remaining, expected to reduce to INR70-75 crores by year-end
other.value: INR155 crores, reducing to INR70-75 crores
other.quote: So right now, we have only a very small borrowing of around INR155 crores or so on rupee term loan, which probably at the year-end would be -- we will close by around INR70 crores, INR75 crores.

other.statement: Company effectively debt-free with INR700 crores cash against minimal debt; not prepaying low-cost rupee loan
other.quote: So -- and practically, we are debt-free company bec ause we are getting almost around INR700 crores cash in books and debt are hardly any. That debt also, we are not prepaying because that debt is contracted at very low rate compared to the current market rate of what we are realizing on deploying money in mutual funds and all

guidance.statement: Management expects growth in FY27 and FY28 but declines to provide a specific range or number.
guidance.quote: I think 2027 will grow and then 2028 will also grow , but yes, I do not think we are precise enough to go into more clarity there.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin 59.4% vs 60.1% in Q2 FY26; EBITDA margin 22.9% vs 30.4% YoY; input cost increases and geopolitical volatility cited.
margin.quote: Gross margin for the quarter stood at 59.4 % compared to 60.1% in Q2 FY2026.

order_book.statement: RFP activity in current financial year is the strongest to date; steady flow of new proposals; commercial NCEs to drive near-term growth.
order_book.quote: One development that has been particularly encouraging is the level of RFP activity that we have seen in this financial year, and it has been the strongest to date.

capex.statement: Module 1 peptide facility capex ~Rs.250 Crores; Module 2 configuration to be finalized in next 3-6 months.
capex.quote: I think so far we spent maybe around Rs.250 Crores just for Module 1, so you can probably do some approximate math.

capex.statement: Board approved additional land acquisition to expand Unit I footprint; Kakinada investment may be modulated/slowed if commercial business impacted.
capex.quote: Our Board had today approved investment to add some more land , which will expand our Unit I footprint.

capex.statement: Capex outflow in H1 FY27 was Rs.261 Crores; three-year capex guidance indicated at approximately Rs.1,700-1,800 Crores.
capex.quote: Our capex outflow during the first half of FY 2027 was Rs.261 Crores

product_mix.statement: FY26 was first year with CMS revenues exceeding GDS; increasing CMS contribution expected to remain important part of evolution.
product_mix.quote: FY 2026 was the first year where we actually had greater revenues contributing from CMS in comparison with GDS.

product_mix.statement: Specialty segment muted due to customer manufacturing difficulties; expected to normalize by Q4 FY27 with revenue recovery from key products.
product_mix.quote: We expect that the thing will be done probably by Q4 we should be able to start seeing more revenues from the products , which contribute significantly both to the topline as well as the bottomline from those specialty products.

risk.statement: Lumpiness inherent due to few large commercial molecules; shipment timing shifts cause quarterly revenue variability; patent expiries for key molecules not expected before 2030.
risk.quote: Molecules can progress differently from initial expectations, customer timelines can move, and the increasing value of individual commercial shipments can amplify the impact of timing movements between quarters.

risk.statement: AI-driven drug discovery may increase early-stage candidates but not seen as direct threat; Neuland focuses on IND onwards development and GMP manufacturing where AI cannot replace physical process work.
risk.quote: We do not see a direct threat of AI taking away our work because most of our work is actual work that goes into generating material or designing and demonstrating a process that generates material.

other.statement: Filed 2 DMFs (Fezolinetant and Ivacaftor) in H1 FY27, strengthening GDS portfolio.
other.quote: We have filed 2 DMFs during this period one is Fezolinetant and the other is Ivacaftor, strengthening our GDS portfolio.

other.statement: Working capital at 104 days of sales in Q2 FY27 vs 84 days in previous quarter; focus on inventory management, collections, and aligning with business scale.
other.quote: Working capital for the quarter stood at 104 days of sale compared to 84 days in the previous quarter.

guidance.statement: Beryl expected to turn profitable from FY28; Q2 loss narrowed to $25K from $70-75K, targeting breakeven in Q3.
guidance.quote: Q3 Beryl is just little below the breakeven. They had a small loss of about $25,000, which has come down compared to the previous quarter, which was $70,000 to $75,000. So, it's now $25,000 loss in Q2. And, hopefully, in Q3, we look forward to it crossing the breakeven.

guidance.statement: Poles/towers utility services growth visibility for 5-10 years driven by data center power infrastructure; current 70-75 engineers vs 120+ demand.
guidance.quote: Some of the contractors and utility managers are telling me in my trip to US recently that they are expecting growth in the next 5 to 10 years to continue because of the several data centers that are coming up across USA and substations and power lines have to be drawn and they are to be created in the next 5 to 10 years.

demand.statement: US outsourcing demand structural due to core engineering talent shortage; no choice but to outsource civil/mechanical engineering.
demand.quote: Everybody now in USA has no choice but to outsource, especially in core engineering like civil, there's no civil engineers coming out in US in numbers they require. Core engineering of mechanical, core engineering of civil, even AI or anything, there will be increasing demand only.

demand.statement: US power distribution demand surging due to data centers; utility services have fixed committed demand for 110-120 engineers.
demand.quote: The power distribution demand across the country has improved, gone up by several times, demanding more and more engineering work required in that domain. So, from a small team of 30-40 people last year, today, we are around 70-80, and we have demand for beyond 120 people, and that too on a fixed committed basis.

order_book.statement: Work on hand dipped from $4.5 million to $4.2 million QoQ, but October bookings brought it back above end-June levels.
order_book.quote: See, the work at our hand has dipped a bit from about $4.5 million last quarter to around $4.2 million now. But in the month of October, we have record bookings again, and the number is now better than what it was at the end of June.

capex.statement: No major recruitment or infrastructure investment planned; growth to be driven by efficiency, automation, and project-driven hiring only.
capex.quote: So, there is no need for huge recruitments going forward. That will be client driven or project-to-project driven. We don't want to now create a situation like in BIW where we entered three years ago, built up a huge team and could not find the proper work for them for the last two years.

product_mix.statement: New civil/land development domain launched with leading US client via MOU; work expected to start end-November, meaningful contribution from Jan-Feb 2027.
product_mix.quote: That is the area we along with Beryl are tying up. Already tied up an MOU with the client, and the work has to really take off from November end. So, hopefully, when we meet next time in February, March, I'll be able to share more details.

product_mix.statement: Structural steel detailing contributes 80-82% of revenue (~$4.4M of $5.3-5.4M), with the rest from fixed MES teams and minimal BIW (~$100K/quarter).
product_mix.quote: I can tell you roughly 75-80% of the revenue is coming from structural steel detailing and those areas. And in the overall, $5,400,000 -- I think $5,300,000, $4,400,000 has come from civil structural work. That's almost 80% -- 80-82%.

risk.statement: Key risk is US construction demand slowdown; mitigated by expanding from 2% high-rise niche into 10-20x larger residential/civil market via Beryl.
risk.quote: If suddenly US stops growing or they don't go into manufacturing or the civil industry -- construction industry gets into a non-negative trajectory, that could probably be the only thing which can impact our performance. That too marginally, because when such a thing happens also, US will continue to grow at least at 2-3%.

other.statement: Secured 3-year fixed-team MSA with leading plant engineering company for 25 utility engineers; currently staffed 10-15, ramping to full by Dec 2026.
other.quote: It is a fixed team arrangement. And in fact, the team is still under buildup. We have -- again, it's 25 people they wanted. We have only 10 to 15 people currently being offered, and we are in the process of ramping up.

other.statement: Actively evaluating acquisition of a structural design firm to complement civil/land development entry; previous target not yet finalized due to concerns on scalability.
other.quote: We had a good conversation with the prospective seller. We're also studying into their line of business and their ability to ramp up. So, we have a few concerns which we have expressed to them, and we are waiting for their reply. I don't say that we have made any confirmed decision on that. It is still liquid, but we are still looking at other options also.

guidance.statement: Targets 3,000+ keys and ARR ~Rs 8,000 by FY30 under KHIL 3.0 vision
guidance.quote: Our footprint will expand from 10 states to 11 states. Our portfolio will expand from 24 to 31 properties. Inventory will increase from 1900 plus keys to 3000 plus keys. ARR we are targeting at portfolio level, a 33% lift from existing 6000 to around 8000.

guidance.statement: Expects to cross Rs 130-135 cr EBITDA in FY27 and cumulative Rs 750 cr over next five years
guidance.quote: If you look at our cumulative EBITDA for next five years, it will be in the range of Rs. 750 crores. Now, my debt is at zero. By this year end, we will be net zero debt company.

demand.statement: H2 FY27 demand outlook robust; Q2 driven by corporate at business hotels and leisure at resort properties
demand.quote: Outlook looks very promising. The demand is expected to be robust. And as I said earlier, we will show heightened revenue and EBITDA growth in H2 as compared to previous H2.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 26%, up 1300 bps YoY; H1 margin 28%
margin.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 26%, a massive 13% point expansion. This is the operating leverage which is at the best.

capex.statement: Invested in EV fleet (100% electric) and electric kitchens to reduce fuel cost volatility
capex.quote: Electrifying our hotels is one of the main where we have EV cars. We are the first in the industry to adopt EV cars for our hotel fleet. And today we are at 100% all EV cars within our organization.

pricing_cost.statement: ADR flat ~3% YoY in Q2; occupancy rose 50% to 58%; RevPAR up 20%; rate hikes to follow occupancy gains
pricing_cost.quote: Our ADR growth was flat around 3%. But our occupancy has grown from 50% to 58% at portfolio level. So higher the occupancy, higher revenue and excluding the variable cost everything flows into EBITDA.

product_mix.statement: Lease model requires 80-100+ keys for viability; management model flat 6% of revenue, minimum 35-40 keys; GST structure hurts small hotels
product_mix.quote: We need basically properties which are in the range of 80 to 100 for us to take on particularly lease. On particularly lease. Because today, especially because of GST and the way GST is structured, the cost of GST has again gone back to the old VAT days where the cost of VAT was a cost.

risk.statement: GST on sub-18% bracket hotels adds cost burden; small hotels (40-50 keys) unviable under lease model
risk.quote: Because now I have to build in that cost when my expansion. So, when we are taking the input plus 5% or 18% based on whatever the cost is there and on top I am taki ng from the customer only a 5%, the overall sandwiching does not allow a sustainability model of around 40 rooms to 50 rooms at all.

other.statement: Gwalior (lease) and Dwarka, Nashik (management) opening Dec-Jan adding 250-266 keys; Rishikesh, Dehradun in pipeline
other.quote: We have in the month of December, January, Gwalior, which will open up. Apart from that, we also have Dwarka and Nasik. Though they are under management, Gwalior is under lease. But Dwarka under management, we expect that these properties also will add a lot of boost adding more than 250, 266 keys to our portfolio.

other.statement: Net debt Rs 31 cr (0.23x EBITDA) at Sep-26; repaid Rs 30 cr to Axis Finance post quarter; targets net zero debt by FY27 end
other.quote: As of 30th September 2026 our gross debt was Rs. 96 crores. Cash and cash equivalent was Rs. 65 crores and net debt was Rs. 31 crores. Now if you look at net debt to EBITDA it was 0. 23x versus 0.52x as of last quarter, more than halved in just one quarter. And from 0.52 we are at 0.23 and we did not stop there. Subsequent to quarter end we have repaid Rs. 30 crores loan to Axis Finance Limited.

guidance.statement: Expect wholesale segment to continue driving AUM growth for remainder of FY27; expect SME retail disbursements to improve in H2 FY27 as consolidation measures yield results
guidance.quote: to the second half of FY27, we expect the wholesale segment to continue to drive AUM growth for the remainder of the year, supported by our funding opposition, and the opportunity we continue to see in our core markets. pricing_cost.quote: And due to opening of the Lakshadweep, we are having the incremental effect on the ARR because ARR of Lakshadweep is higher than normal ARR of the company.

product_mix.quote: In H1 FY27 revenue from operation stood at INR90.46 crores, a growth of INR16.17 crores over H1 FY26. Hospitality and events contributed INR57.53 crores and advertising contributed INR32.22 crores.

guidance.quote: Where we are going we definitely want to you know -- aspiration is obviously to do, I would say that a high single digit, double digit. I mean, that is where we are headed. Directionally, that's where we want to go.

guidance.quote: For this year itself, for FY27, just to be clear, we are going to be working on the margins that you see for the first half in the same sort of range for the year.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 34.2%, up 367 bps YoY; Q2 EBITDA margin 34.2%
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA grew by 69% to INR765 crores, with margins expanding by 367 basis points to 34.2%.

order_book.statement: HFO contract with Solstice extended 4 years to Dec 2032; adds ~USD180 mn revenue potential
order_book.quote: The tenure of our existing HFO supply contract with Solstice Advanced Materials has been extended by 4 years until December 2032 and will have an additional revenue potential of approximately USD180 million.

order_book.statement: CDMO order book visibility near USD100 mn target; Phase 2 cGMP-4 (INR125 cr) operational by Q4 FY27
order_book.quote: we are at the striking distance of our USD100 million target in terms of order book visibility. And so there will be growth for that business too by the end of this year.

capex.statement: CDMO Phase 2 cGMP-4 capex ~INR125 cr, operational by end Q4 FY27; peak revenue potential 3x capex ~INR900-1,000 cr by FY28-29
capex.quote: Phase 2 of the cGMP-4 facility involving a capex of approximately INR125 crores is progressing as planned and is expected to become operational by the end of Q4 FY27.

pricing_cost.statement: HFC pricing firm, realization improved sequentially; HF merchant sales exceed plan, placed internationally; pricing pass-through in HFO contracts
pricing_cost.quote: The pricing environment for HFC remains firm, with realization improved on a sequential basis.

product_mix.statement: Advanced Materials incubated as new vertical; target 10-15% of expanded revenue by 2030; focus on data centers, electronics, semiconductors, defense
product_mix.quote: if you think of Navin from now to 2030 and look at 20% to 25% growth, Advanced Materials will be roughly about 10% to 15% of the expanded pie by 2030.

product_mix.statement: Specialty Chemicals targeting INR350 cr run rate; 5 new molecules with campaign orders through FY27+; Nectar ramp to 60-65% PAR in FY27, balance FY28
product_mix.quote: I think, probably in the last 2, 3 quarters, where we've consistently said that this business will become more like a INR350 crores business.

other.statement: Interim dividend declared INR8 per equity share (face value INR2)
other.quote: I am also pleased to share that the Board has declared an interim dividend of INR8 per equity share with a face value of INR2 per share.

other.statement: AHF plant utilization improving, not yet at full capacity; MPP debottlenecking commissioned Sep 2026; R32 plant commissioning shortly
other.quote: Our new AHF facility has witnessed an improvement in utilization, contributing to our growth momentum and R32 capex is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning shortly.

guidance.statement: No volume guidance provided for Q3 or full year FY27
guidance.quote: Right now we do not have any numbers for the guidance. We do not see any dramatic change in the situation which is currently there.

demand.statement: Expect power prices to remain firm during peak hours due to renewable penetration and low storage capacity
demand.quote: Looking ahead, we expect power prices to remain firm particularly during peak demand hours, morning and evening as the increasing penetration of renewable energy continues to reshape the power supply mix.

order_book.statement: Signed 1200 MW solar PPA with NTPC Renewable Energy and floated 500 MW/2000 MWh tender for long-term renewable power procurement
order_book.quote: In the last quarter, we have signed 1200 megawatts of solar PPA with NTPC Renewable Energy and have floated 500-megawatt / 2000 megawatt-hour for procurement of long-term power in the renewable energy space.

capex.statement: Mineral exchange capex manageable given cash position; open to partnerships for the platform
capex.quote: Third thing is whether we can put up some money in it. So, given the cash position and our current balances strength, we can definitely support this exchange insofar as CapEx part is concerned.

pricing_cost.statement: Diurnal price variation from <Rs 1/unit to Rs 10/unit ceiling due to <20 GWh storage; storage additions expected in 12-18 months to moderate peaks
pricing_cost.quote: With installed energy storage capacity still below 20 gigawatt-hour, the power market is witnessing significant diurnal price variation ranging from less than Rs. 1 per unit to regulatory ceiling of Rs. 10 per unit.

product_mix.statement: Mineral exchange initiative leverages existing C&I relationships and exchange-setting experience; five minerals including iron ore targeted initially
product_mix.quote: The thought process is twofold. Number one, I mean, all the minerals which are traded, so they are also basically big power consumers also. We already have a portfolio of 500, 600 big C&I, meaning commercial and industrial consumers in our book.

other.statement: Cash and bank balance of Rs 2,431 crore as of 30 September 2026
other.quote: Cash on hand on 30th September is Rs. 2,431 crore.

other.statement: Trading volumes grew 18% YoY to 58.25 BUs in H1 FY27 vs 10.64% energy generation growth
other.quote: During the first half of this Financial Year '26-'27, while total generation of energy grew by 10.64%, our trading volumes actually grew by more than 18% to 58.25 billion units.

guidance.statement: Guidance to reduce total debt by Rs. 500 crores in FY27
guidance.quote: Debt during H1 FY27 is reduced by Rs. 126 crores, and we maintain our guidance of reduction in total debt by Rs. 500 crores for FY27.

demand.statement: FY28 expected to be strong in both domestic and international markets
demand.quote: I think in FY28, we are looking at a strong market. So, both in domestic and both in international market and FY28 is going to be a strong market.

demand.statement: Strong visibility and very strong market for next 6 months
demand.quote: We see strong visibility and a very strong market in next 6 months.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 18.23% in Q2 FY27 from 13.5% in Q2 FY26 and 17.96% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: The EBITDA margin improved to 18.23% for the quarter compared with 13.5% in Q2 FY26 and 17.96% in the previous quarter.

margin.statement: Expect 30-50 bps EBITDA margin expansion per quarter
margin.quote: And you have seen in past couple of quarters, the margin expansion, 30 basis points to 50 basis point margin expansion is there every quarter. And I think we will continue to work on that.

margin.statement: Aspiration to cross previous peak EBITDA margin of 20-21% but not in next 1-2 quarters
margin.quote: And I think margin right now, our aspiration is to cross the previous peak of the margin. I think we are slowly getting there, but I don't think it is going to happen in next quarter or the quarter after that.

order_book.statement: New order wins of Rs. 673 crores in Q2 FY27 with 4-year program life
order_book.quote: During the quarter, the company secured new order wins worth Rs. 673 crores across CV, EV, LV and Farm Equipment segments. These orders have a program life of approximately 4 years and further strengthen our revenue visibility over the coming years.

order_book.statement: Casting orders of Rs. 447 crores including Rs. 272 crores for North America LV exports
order_book.quote: Worth mentioning against the new order wins, Rs. 447 crores comes from the casting side of our business, against which Rs. 272 crores is for the North American export market for light vehicle applications.

capex.statement: Revised FY27 capex guidance to Rs. 550 crores for entire group
capex.quote: And I think we should be ending this year close to around Rs. 550 crores throughout our entire group.

capex.statement: JV investment of Rs. 50-55 crores pending, Rs. 15-20 crores in H2 FY27
capex.quote: JV still about RS. 50 crores, RS. 55 crores investment is pending. This will be done in next one year time. So partly will go in this year, maybe Rs. 15 crores, Rs. 20 crores more in the next half, rest will be the next financial year.

pricing_cost.statement: Domestic steel price hikes fully passed on; export markets only pass on local steel price increases
pricing_cost.quote: Commodity pricing every quarter, we have been able to pass on in the domestic market. In export market, in contract to contract, it differs. And region to region, it differs.

pricing_cost.statement: Expect another steel price hike in India in January, prepared to pass on to customers
pricing_cost.quote: But in terms of our commodity estimates, we believe that in India, there is going to be another steel hike maybe in January. And I think we are well prepared to pass on the increase to our customers.

product_mix.statement: Passenger vehicle segment to contribute 10%+ growth by CY28/FY29
product_mix.quote: We are looking at almost in the next 2 years by CY28 or FY29 basically, we are looking at almost 10% plus growth to come in from passenger vehicles.

risk.statement: Shipping costs settled at peak but may increase further depending on geopolitics
risk.quote: It has largely settled down right now at the peak. But in case there is any further increase, we will have to go back to the customer and speak to them. But right now, there is no incremental increase we are seeing in terms of the shipping cost. But we cannot say. I think it all depends on how the geopolitical issues keep in and out.

risk.quote: Currency movements, rising input costs as well as a sharp rise in shipping costs also rem ain key areas to monitor

other.statement: Gross debt expected at Rs. 1,670-1,700 crores by end of FY27

other.statement: Aim to reduce Rs. 300-400 crores debt in FY28
other.quote: And for next financial year, we aim to reduce Rs. 300 crores to Rs. 400 crores of debt for the next financial year.

margin.quote: consolidated revenue from operation increased by 58% to INR 2,045 crores in H1 FY27, while Operating EBITDA grew by 60% to INR1,818 crores as compared to H1 FY26. EBITDA margin remained at 89%.

margin.quote: PAT for group for H1 FY27 is INR14,247 crores as against previous year INR11,334 crores, an increase by 26%.

order_book.statement: 37 GW capacity under construction: 17 GW coal, 3.6 GW hydro, ~16 GW renewables
order_book.quote: With over 37 gigawatts of capacity under construction, including 17 gigawatts of coal-based capacity, about 3.6 gigawatts of hydro and around 16 gigawatts of renewables, our immediate focus is on timely project execution and maintaining maximum availability of power stations.

capex.statement: Lara Stage 3 (1,600 MW) awarded in Q2 FY27; limited notice to proceed issued pending environmental clearance
capex.quote: NTPC has awarded Lara Stage 3, (1,600 megawatts ) and issued limited notice to proceed pending environmental clearance in Q2 FY27.

product_mix.quote: Our group thermal stations co-fired 0.83 million metric tons of biomass, which is 65% more than biomass co-fired during

other.statement: Board recommended first interim dividend FY27 at INR 3 per share

other.statement: Coal stations fixed cost disincentive reduced to INR 332 cr in H1 FY27 from INR 625 cr in H1 FY26 (half); O&M gains achieved

guidance.quote: we have moved on to planning for next 2 years for fiscal year '28 and '29 and getting back to a growth of at least 25,000, 30,000 tons each year and then potential upside is all the various things that we have discussed come to fruition.

pricing_cost.quote: That also is the reason why if you -- most of you will see that the realization per ton or per kilo on per kg basis has increased about INR178, largely attributable to the increase in the freight, which has been passed on.

product_mix.quote: It's also a function of product mix. So if you see in Q1, there was a higher element of other castings. In Q2, it is slightly lower. So it has a compensatory effect that your freight increased so your product mix has gone a little down.

guidance.statement: Revenue target of INR4,800-5,000 crores by FY29 with existing assets and balancing capex
guidance.quote: So we are expecting that by going in FY29, we aspire that we should reach anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by -- with our existing assets and balancing some of them.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin guidance range of 16% to 20%
guidance.quote: We have not guided for 20%. First of all, Varun ji, I would like to highlight that. We have told that a range is 16% to 20%.

margin.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 17.8% as against 13.1% in Q2 FY26, that is an expansion of 471 basis points and was sustained at the Q1 FY27 level of 17.78%.

margin.statement: Expect to maintain current margin levels with RE power and cost initiatives cushioning input cost increases
margin.quote: So we expect that we should be able to retain the margins at what level we have. As far as the upper level or upper -- it is always the endeavor of the company to reach the top level of margins. But still, I think we are far from there.

margin.quote: So if you remove that part of this, the EBITDA would be around 18.5%.

pricing_cost.quote: Our -- the fabric realization has increased year-on-year by about 6%[Errata: To be read as "Increased Quarter-on-Quarter by about 6%"]. product_mix.statement: Company moving up value chain with higher finished fabric and value-added yarn capacity, 28-30% yarn capacity dedicated to woven fabrics post expansion
product_mix.quote: Actually, as I have indicated many times that normally for the industry like ours, where we have now post this expansion, nearly 28% to 30% of our capacity will be for the -- yarn capacity will be dedicated to woven fabrics.

risk.statement: Near-term risks: inflationary conditions across commodities/services, liquidity strain in downstream channels
risk.quote: In the near term, the inflationary conditions across commodities and services and liquidity strain in the downstream channels are factors which are closely to be watched.

risk.statement: Input cost volatility (dyes, chemicals, coal, freight) and slow fabric price pass-through may pressure margins
risk.quote: Plus, we also need to see that there is a slow pass on of the increases in the fabrics. So that also takes some time. So both of these should also be considered when you extrapolate the margins for us.

other.statement: Spinning capacity utilization over 98% and woven fabric utilization about 90% in Q2 FY27
other.quote: In Q2 FY27, the spinning capacity utilization was over 98% and woven fabric capacity utilization was about 90%.

other.quote: First of all, the peak debt which we are going to have will be about our total term debt will peak in this March at about INR1,440 crores, I think. So total debt could be about INR1,950 crores at the end of March '26.

guidance.statement: No formal guidance given; green shoots seen in Q3 advertising environment
guidance.quote: So generally, we don't give any guidance, but what we are seeing in Q3, there has been some green shoots from the advertising environment, and we believe that should continue.

guidance.quote: Yes, that's been the ambition for us, and we keep focused on that. Having said that, we are riding the wave of the event business, which

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin expected to cross 29% on average for FY27, up from the initial guidance of around 28%.
guidance.quote: We believe that by the year-end, we should be able to cross on an average 29%.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 29.02%; H1 EBITDA margin at 28.45%.
