guidance.statement: Revenue and profitability targets under Vision 2028 retained; EBO store target optimized to 800 by FY28
guidance.quote: While retaining our revenue and profitability targets same, we have optimized our EBO store targets to 800 stores by FY28.

guidance.statement: Committed to double-digit revenue growth for FY27
guidance.quote: We remain confident in pursuing a double-digit growth target for this financial year and are committed to pursuing our revenue and profitability goals through a calibrated, disciplined and sustainable business model.

guidance.statement: Overall revenue double-digit growth expected for full year FY27
guidance.quote: We are focused on our commitment to achieve double-digit growth by the end of the year. That is all I can say.

demand.statement: Floods impacted Q2 sales growth by 3-4%
demand.quote: On the quarter 2 number, I would put it at 3% to 4%.

demand.statement: Retail sales impacted by festival shift; Q2+Q3 merged view shows better result
demand.quote: Actually in retail, because of the festival shifting, you have to look at Q2 and Q3 merged together. When you merge them, you will see a better result.

demand.statement: Positive outlook on winter wear category; expect better fresh sales vs last year
demand.quote: We are positive on the winter wear category this time. Okay. I think winter will be there and it will be cool climate, and fresh sales should be better compared to last year.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA grew 12% YoY to INR80 crores with 21% margin; PAT up 15% to INR54 crores
margin.quote: Consolidated revenue increased to INR373 crores, supported by growth in apparel sales and value. EBITDA grew by 12% year-on-year to INR80 crores with an EBITDA margin of 21% and profit after tax increased by 15% year-on-year to INR54 crores.

margin.statement: Kraus EBITDA margins in line with KKCL overall margins
margin.quote: The EBITDA margins for Kraus are in line with KKCL.

margin.statement: Focus on reducing discounts and increasing fresh sales to improve EBITDA margin
margin.quote: We are seeing that discount in the markets have grown too much. We believe that to improve EBITDA, we have to reduce discounts. We want to work on realistic prices and focus more on rotation, which will improve profitability.

capex.statement: Incremental store size increase requires additional rental investment only
capex.quote: The incremental size has an additional investment only in terms of rental.

pricing_cost.statement: Price hikes taken in first half; inflationary pressure may continue in Q3-Q4; will try to pass on via MRP or discount reduction
pricing_cost.quote: We have already started facing that inflationary pressure. I am not too sure. I feel that it is too early to comment on that. We have taken a price increase in the current two quarters also. If possible, we will try to pass it on to the consumers.

product_mix.statement: Kraus grew over 25% in Q2; expansion into online, exports (Middle East) and MBO channels
product_mix.quote: The brand Kraus delivered a growth of over 25%, representing an encouraging milestone in our strategy to strengthen our presence in the womens wear segment.

product_mix.statement: Lawman re-strategized as retail-focused and online-focused brand
product_mix.quote: Lawman, as we said, we have re-strategized in terms of brand positioning and we have made it a more retail-focused and more online-focused brand.

risk.statement: Floods caused 7-10 days production loss at Vapi/Daman factory
risk.quote: And, the factory was in the water. It was completely in the water, so we were not able to do anything. So around 7, 8 to 10 days went waste.

risk.statement: Winter quarter historically impacts EBITDA mix by 1-2% due to discounting
risk.quote: Winter has always been difficult because it gives you, a sixty days window, in a period of winter, definitely has impact on discounting. It may change your EBITDA mix by a 1% or 2% scenario. Okay, for the particular quarter, which is Q3.

other.statement: Lawman target revised from 175 to 125 stores; focus on larger D2C-led stores
other.quote: The Lawman target has been revised from 175 stores to 125 stores, reflecting a more focused D2C-led strategy centered on establishing larger, higher-quality stores in strategic selected locations that strengthens the brand visibility.

other.statement: Kraus target increased from 50 to 75 stores
other.quote: Conversely, the target for Kraus stores has been increased from 50 to 75 stores, supported by the encouraging brand traction witnessed through this format.

demand.statement: Aroma revenue dropped from INR774 million to INR472 million due to plant changeover and underutilisation; blends revenue stable at ~INR2,970 million; straights revenue recovered from INR927 million to INR1,109 million
demand.quote: Almost our revenue in Aroma reduced from INR774 million to INR472 million, and this is entirely almost ethyl vanillin sale. Blends and the straights, the specialty ingredient business has been always the hallmark, and it has always done well.

margin.statement: Gross margin reduced from INR2,142 million to INR1,958 million; overall EBITDA fell from 3.4% to 2.5% due to liquidity-driven channel financing and overdue payables
margin.quote: on an overall basis, our gross margin has reduced from INR2,142 million to INR1,958 million in this quarter. And this has percolated down and eaten up our EBITDA, which anyway was 3.4% has almost come down to 2.5% in this quarter.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved from 6.35% to 8.04% in specialty ingredients; overall gross margin fell ~2% due to high input costs, dollar strength and channel financing costs
margin.quote: EBITDA obviously improved from 6.35% to 8.04%. This has this -- with adequate liquidity support, this should very first go to the double digit.

order_book.statement: Visibility of 2,500-2,700 tons vanillin demand from US and 1,300-1,500 tons from Europe for next calendar year; expect 1,000 tons/quarter from Q4 FY27
order_book.quote: From the U.S., we have visibility of about 2,500 to 2,700 tons for the next calendar year. And Europe is about 1,500 -- 1,300 to 1,500. So that's why we are saying that probably in Q4, that is the Q1 of next calendar year, we should be at about 1,000 tons.

pricing_cost.statement: Unable to pass on raw material cost increases (phenol more than doubled) to customers due to local competition; channel financing and overdue payables add ~4% to cost (INR190-200 million per quarter)
pricing_cost.quote: the main culprit here is the liquidity issues. However, payables had increased, but to support more and to have more working capital, we had used channel financing, both on the purchase side as well as sales side.

fund_raise.statement: Board approved a rights issue of around INR250 crores backed by promoters; draft letter of offer to be filed tomorrow; proceeds for augmenting working capital
fund_raise.quote: our Board today approved a rights issue of around INR250 crores. So, we'll be filing our draft letter of offer to stock exchanges by tomorrow and wait for their approvals, and very soon, we'll launch the issue.

other.statement: Net debt increased slightly from INR5,260 million to INR5,380 million mainly due to forex revaluation; interest cost stable at ~INR163-169 million; loans repaid despite crisis
other.quote: It was around INR5,260 million, which has gone up to INR5,380 million and a large portion of that is because of the foreign exchange updation. Our interest cost without forex was around INR163 million, which was INR169 million.

other.statement: Working capital cycle normally 200 days; currently appears at 60 days due to INR130 crore of channel financing; rights issue proceeds to unwind channel financing and clear overdue payables
other.quote: my working capital days are looking at 60 days, which is impossible. So our general working capital cycle is 200 days, and that's looking lower because we have INR130-odd crores of credit.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance maintained at over 50%
guidance.quote: I think we should still surpass the 50% guidance that we had for the whole year.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 gross margin target 29-30% and EBITDA margin 13.5-14.5% post-Ind AS
guidance.quote: With gross margin now at 30%, we aim to sustain around 29% to 30% gross margin and 13.5% to 14.5% EBITDA margin for the full year.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin target 7-8%
guidance.quote: I think we would be targeting a pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin of 7% to 8% for the whole year.

guidance.statement: FY28 store addition guidance 120-150 stores, revenue growth 35-40% if only 100 stores opened
guidance.quote: For FY28, our current guidance would be anywhere between 120 to 150 stores.

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 volume growth 31% YoY, H1 FY27 volume growth 43% YoY
demand.quote: In the second quarter, volume growth was 31% year-on-year. In the first half of FY27, volume growth was 43% up year-on-year.

demand.statement: Demand slowdown observed in last 3 months, macro delta +/-5%
demand.quote: In the last 3 months, definitely we saw some sort of a demand slowdown.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 gross margin 29.8%, EBITDA margin 13.6% post-Ind AS
margin.quote: Gross profit grew from INR384.4 crores to INR566.4 crores with a 29.8% margin. EBITDA grew from INR172.7 crores to INR259.7 crores, a growth of 50%.

capex.statement: Opened 106 stores in H1 FY27, highest ever half-year addition
capex.quote: In the first half of FY27, we opened 106 stores and closed 4. This is our highest ever H1 addition.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material cost inflation 3-7%, MRP hikes 5-10% taken to maintain gross margin
pricing_cost.quote: The hike in cost was around 3% to 7%. So to maintain gross margin, we will have to increase the MRPs by 5% to 10%.

pricing_cost.statement: ASP down 3% in H1 FY27 managed via product mix shift to value/economy
pricing_cost.quote: If you see the ASP, the ASP has actually come down 3% in the first half of the year. So how we manage that is by a better product mix.

product_mix.statement: Increasing fashion quotient in assortment from <20% to 30% to attract Gen Z
product_mix.quote: We have introduced a lot more fashion quotient in our assortment. So earlier, it used to be less than 20%. Now we are trying to take it up to 30%.

product_mix.statement: Revenue mix: men's 40%, ladies 29%, kids 22%, lifestyle 9%
product_mix.quote: Revenue mix remained primarily the same, men's wear about 40%; ladies, 29%; kids, 22%; and lifestyle, 9%.

risk.statement: If Q3 SSSG remains muted, FY28 store additions reduced to 100 from 150-200 target
risk.quote: If this trend continues to the third quarter, then next year we'll only open 100 stores, which initially the target was 150 to 200.

other.statement: Backend infrastructure can support 150+ stores per year
other.quote: We have reached a stage where our back end, which is the design, sourcing, warehousing and talent can support 150-plus stores per year.

other.statement: Repeat customer frequency improved from 5.5 to 4.4-4.5 months, mature store repeat sales 55% to 70%
other.quote: The average frequency of our customers, repeat customers, used to be almost 5, 5.5 months, which has reduced to just 4.4 to 4.5 months now. And for our mature stores, the repeat customer sales has increased from 55% to almost 70%.

guidance.statement: Capex for FY27 expected around INR 150 crore
guidance.quote: This year, capex will be in the region of about INR150 crores.

demand.statement: Channel inventory normal; good offtake seen; confident of sustaining growth momentum in upcoming quarters
demand.quote: So channel inventory is normal. So as you can see from our numbers, the velocity underlying growth has been good across all our categories.

demand.statement: Volume growth ex-Wires: 25% volume, 10% price in Q2; H2 volume growth expected mid-teens
demand.quote: H2 growth will be lower than H1, but revenue-wise; sorry, volume-wise, maybe it will be like mid-teens or something like that.

margin.statement: Gross margin 34.3% in Q2 FY27 vs 37.6% YoY and 36.9% QoQ due to higher input costs and mix change
margin.quote: Gross margin stood at 34.3% in Q2, compared to 37.6% in the corresponding quarter last year and 36.9% in Q1 FY27.

margin.statement: Electronics segment sustainable margin 16-17% normal year, 18% in good year
margin.quote: About 16%, 17% is okay. 18% can be in a good year.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin 9.1% in Q2 FY27 vs 8.1% YoY; H1 EBITDA margin near 9.5-10%
margin.quote: EBITDA margin was 9.1% in Q2 this year compared to 8.1% in Q2 last year.

order_book.statement: Electronics segment revenue grew 60% YoY in Q2 led by Solar, Inverter & Battery; Electricals grew 41.2%; Consumer Durables grew 20%
order_book.quote: The Electronics segment—comprising Stabilizers, UPS Systems, Inverters & Batteries and Solar panels—reported particularly strong revenue growth of 60% YoY in Q2.

capex.statement: Innovation centre set up 3-4 years ago to strengthen electronics capability and support new categories like Lighting, Solar, Batteries
capex.quote: We put up the R&D center probably about 3 years back or 4 years back, It is an investment for what is going to come now in the next 3, 4 years.

pricing_cost.statement: 2-3% pricing gap remains to pass through input cost increases; price hikes of 6-12% across categories underway
pricing_cost.quote: As we stand today, we have a 2% to 3% gap in pricing that is yet to be passed through.

product_mix.statement: Solar Power Systems sold mainly in South via system integrators; 75% sales in 3-10 kW residential range; not B2B
product_mix.quote: Our solar products are mainly from 3 kilowatt, so 75% of our sales is 3 kilowatt to 10 kilowatt and it is going to residential households.

product_mix.statement: Lighting launch 3-4 months old; 40-50% SKUs landed; focused on few districts in couple of states; full portfolio expansion targeted by April-May
product_mix.quote: The Lighting launch in the market is not more than 3 to 4 months old. And so we have still been able to land only maybe 40%, 50% of the SKUs that we want to bring to market.

risk.statement: Geopolitical situation monitored; further commodity price movements possible in September-October
risk.quote: We continue to monitor the geo-political situation and will take appropriate actions necessary to protect supplies and margins.

other.statement: A&P spend ~2.3% of revenue, stable; allocation shifts across segments quarter to quarter
other.quote: Or 2.3% of revenue, which is broadly in line with what we have.

other.statement: BLDC fan share upwards of 35-40% driving growth in Ceiling Fans
other.quote: BLDC share is also decent, maybe upwards of maybe 35%, 40%.

guidance.statement: Targets full-year FY27 volume growth of double digits and EBITDA per kg in INR45-46 range
guidance.quote: Yes, we are confident we'll be maintaining now anything around INR45, INR46 range for sure because even this third quarter started on a strong note and we feel that the momentum going forward only can help it.

guidance.statement: Targets INR50 EBITDA per kg in 2-3 years
guidance.quote: So as you said, in 2 to 3 years, it is nothing wrong to hope for a INR50 EBITDA margin in the coming 2, 3 years. So that is what is our internal target is.

guidance.statement: Targets FY27 EBITDA of INR250 crores and capex of INR75-80 crores
guidance.quote: We are aiming at doubling the cash flow from INR107 crores to INR215 crores, as I mentioned in the beginning of the year. So I'm still standing on that. I hope to -- we hope to see an EBITDA of INR250 crores compared to INR173 crores last year.

demand.statement: October demand very strong, best month-on-month growth so far
demand.quote: Yes, the demand is pretty good in October, and the numbers compared to the last October, I'm saying, is very satisfying. Maybe it is too early to talk about it, but definitely, it's much better than what -- on a month-on-month growth-wise, October stands out as the best month so far.

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 sales volumes up 10.1% YoY; pharma volumes up 26.3%, food & FMCG up 23.7%, paints up ~9%, lubricants down 12.3%
demand.quote: I'm very glad to inform you that the sales volumes of the company in the Q2 have gone up by 10.1% compared to last Q2. And profits have jumped by 36%, resulting in a very healthy EBITDA per kg of INR46.5.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA per kg INR46.6 vs INR40.6 in H1 FY26, up ~15%
margin.quote: I think, as I said, our EBITDA has shot up a clean 15%, 18% in the last 2 quarters from INR40.6 last H1 to INR46.6 in the current H1.

order_book.statement: Vibe specialty closures targeting INR50-60 crores top line in 2 years with ~30% EBITDA
order_book.quote: Yes, 2 years down the line, we should be able to see at least $5 million to $6 million, let's say, INR50 crores to INR60 crores top line, with a very strong EBITDA of somewhere around 30%.

order_book.statement: Pharma targeting INR50+ crores turnover in FY27 and INR70-75 crores in FY28
order_book.quote: And going this rate, we'll be able to maintain our projection of INR50 crores plus in the full year this year and probably INR70 crores, INR75 crores for the next financial year.

order_book.statement: Iodex balm packs commercial production starting Dec/Jan; 3 new MNC products launching Dec/Jan
order_book.quote: And another good news is that Iodex project, which has been on hold for more than 3 years, has been cleared with some changes, and the chain molds are also getting ready by December -- November, and probably in December or Jan, we'll be starting commercial production of Iodex balm packs.

capex.statement: Vibe Phase 1 investment INR10-15 crores for molds and machines to reach INR40-50 crores turnover
capex.quote: So based on that, the investment will be in the tune of around INR10 crores to INR15 crores in the Phase 1, which will be sufficient to give us a turnover close to INR40 crores to INR50 crores.

capex.statement: FY27 capex expected INR75-80 crores; INR60 crores spent in first 7 months
capex.quote: And coming to the investments, as I said, investments have been under, I would say, lower levels compared to the last 3, 4 years, and they should be ending up somewhere around INR75 crores for the full year. Already INR60 crores has been spent in the first 7 months.

pricing_cost.statement: Finance cost as % of revenue rose from 4.1% to ~5% due to higher raw material prices; modeling 4.5-4.7% for FY27
pricing_cost.quote: But if you look at it as a percentage, it moved up earlier from 4.1% to almost 5% now. And probably it will come down back to 4%, 4.2% in the future of the total revenue, maybe once the raw material prices come down. But as it looks, unless there is a sudden complete peace in West Asia, the raw material prices are not expected to drop in a hurry. So for the year, we are factoring almost 4.5%, 4.7%

pricing_cost.statement: Successfully passing through raw material price increases; clients accept hikes as packaging is non-fungible
pricing_cost.quote: If the clients are not willing to participate in the price rise and they want to stick on to their old price, you would not see this kind of performance from Mold -Tek. This is the ability of Mold -Tek to get th e price rise actually faster than previously agreed terms.

product_mix.statement: Growth shifting to lighter, higher-value food/FMCG/pharma/Vibe products; volume growth understates value growth
product_mix.quote: So even if the volume growth looks 10%, in my opinion, it's equivalent to 14%, 15% growth of last 3 years, because those days, paints used to be a major contributor to our top line and bottom line. But nowadays, slowly, food and pharma and tomorrow Vibe will start contributing to the growth.

other.statement: Inventory holding ~52 days (25 days RM, 25-27 days SFG+FG); no 4-month inventory
other.quote: Even if you consider the SFG, FG and raw material put together, it will be maximum 1 month, because they're very voluminous. And our carrying time is 52 days. Now currently, it is 52 days because the raw material, maybe half of it, let's say, 25 days is raw material. SFG and FG will be remaining 25, 27 days.

other.statement: Long-term debt expected to start declining by end of FY27 due to cash surplus
other.quote: So this time will be a cash surplus, and there may not be -- you may see the long -term debt or debt as a overall start coming down at least in this year -- end of this year.

guidance.statement: Manufacturing EBITDA target maintained at INR5-7 per litre annually
guidance.quote: these developments support our confidence in maintaining the INR5 to INR7 per litre annual EBITDA targets, whilst recognizing that actual allocations, offtake and input prices will determine the outcome.

guidance.statement: R&O EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 16-18%
guidance.quote: So we've always maintained the sort of guidance on R&O margins of between 16% and 18% at EBITDA levels. So we are very much within that zone.

demand.statement: Expect much higher volumes in next ethanol year starting November
demand.quote: Volumes are going to be great. We are going to have significant volumes.

demand.statement: Expect 900 crore litres grain ethanol demand from OMCs, 100-150 crore litres from chemical industry, 300-400 crore litres from beverage industry
demand.quote: So we are expecting a demand of about 900 crores litres for grain-based ethanol from OMCs for grain-based ethanol. There is about 100 crores to 150 crores litres, which the chemical industry uses. And there's about 300 crores to 400 crore s litres that the beverage industry uses

margin.statement: R&O revenue grew 14% YoY to INR242.8 crores, volumes up 16% to 4.24 million cases, EBITDA up 4% to INR38.6 crores in Q2
margin.quote: Revenue grew 14% year-on-year to INR242.8 crores, while volumes increased 16% to 4.24 million cases. EBITDA grew 4% to INR38.6 crores.

margin.statement: Manufacturing Q2 revenue INR455 crores, volumes 55.26 million litres, EBITDA INR25.4 crores, EBITDA/litre INR4.6
margin.quote: Manufacturing revenue in Q2 was INR455 crores with volumes of 55.26 million litres and EBITDA of INR25.4 crores. EBITDA per litre came at INR4.6 a litre, reflecting higher grain and fuel costs.

margin.statement: H1 manufacturing EBITDA INR5.59/litre; trailing 12-month INR6.6/litre
margin.quote: For H1, EBITDA was INR5.59 per litre, whilst trailing 12-month figures stood at approximately INR6.6 per litre.

capex.statement: QIP proceeds of INR200 crores used for debt repayment and consumer business growth
capex.quote: INR200 crores was the raise, INR150 crores or approximately INR150 crores has been used to pay down debt and the balance amount is currently liquid.

pricing_cost.statement: Packaging material inflation due to petroleum prices impacted margins; Rajasthan price increases offset this almost entirely
pricing_cost.quote: the one thing that's played out this year, which is unique and not prevalent in the last or the preceding years is the packing material inflation due to the whole oil scenario in the world. A lot of our raw materials are dependent on petroleum prices. So that has impacted our margins to some extent. Of course, the price increase in Rajasthan helps that -- help mitigate that almost entirely.

product_mix.statement: Maize ethanol share of total ethanol sales was 60% in H1; may drop to 30% going forward as mix shifts to FCI and broken rice
product_mix.quote: On total sale of manufacturing for H1 on maize is almost 60% on the ethanol part.

fund_raise.statement: Completed INR200 crores QIP during quarter; welcomed new institutional shareholders
fund_raise.quote: We completed our INR200 crores QIP during the quarter. We welcome our new institutional shareholders and particularly value the continued support of existing investors who participated in the fundraise.

risk.statement: Risk in Rajasthan is staying ahead of consumer preferences and new product launches; no meaningful risk seen currently
risk.quote: So the risk really for us is to be on the ball with regard to new products and changing consumer preferences. And up until now, I think we've done an okay job with that. And yes, so I mean, beyond that, I don't really see a meaningful risk in Rajasthan.

risk.statement: Large industry capacity exists but Globus has long-term OMC offtake agreements at all facilities except Bihar
risk.quote: Aside from our Bihar unit, Globus Spirits has long-term offtake agreements at all of its facilities, Bihar and -- pardon me, aside from Bihar, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh, where in any case, where in Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh, there is no ethanol capacit y, all other units have long -term offtake agreements

other.statement: Debt reduced by INR200 crores between March and September; debt-to-EBITDA improved to 2x
other.quote: By September end, INR155 crores had been utilized towards repayment of long-term debt, contributing to an overall INR200 crores reduction in the debt between March and September.

other.statement: Operating cash flow INR139 crores in H1 FY27 vs INR270 crores in H1 FY26 due to higher receivables
other.quote: Cash flow from operating activities for H1 FY27 stood at INR139 crores compared to INR270 crores in H1 FY26. The moderation in operating cash flow is primarily attributable to an increase in trade receivables driven by higher business volumes during the period.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance maintained at 10% to 15%
guidance.quote: We continue to maintain our FY27 revenue growth guidance to 10% to 15%.

demand.statement: Non-agrochemical demand surge due to stock replenishment after international market uncertainties and transportation problems
demand.quote: Sir, this is purely depending upon the demand because of a lot of uncertainties in the international markets and problems of transportation and other things. People were waiting for the things to improve. And all of a sudden, they found that they are running short of their stocks, and they started buying at a faster speed.

demand.statement: NAFTA revenue grew ~30% YoY with significantly better margins; LATAM agrochemical revenue up over 80%
demand.quote: NAFTA was the standout of this quarter Revenue from the region grew about 30% year-on-year with signif icantly better margins. LATAM also did well with agrochemical revenue up by over 80

demand.statement: Europe saw slight moderation due to extended heat and drought; distributors cautious on restocking
demand.quote: Europe, our largest market, saw a slight moderation this quarter coming off an exceptionally strong financial year '26. The weather challenges were highlighted last quarter continued through the September quarter with extended heat and drought conditions in parts of Central a nd Eastern Europe

margin.statement: H1 FY27 gross margin 36.3% up 130 bps, EBITDA margin 16.1% up 140 bps
margin.quote: Gross margin stood at 36.3% in H1 FY27 as against 35% in H1 FY26, an increase of 130 basis points. EBITDA grew by 22% to INR343 crores with EBITDA margin at 16.1% as against 14.7% in H1 FY26, an increase of 140 basis points.

margin.statement: H2 gross margins expected to hold or go up from current levels
margin.quote: Sir, they are expected to hold or go up.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 geographic gross margins: Europe 41%, NAFTA ~40%, LATAM 14%, Rest of World 31%, overall 35.9%
margin.quote: European region, our gross margins have been 41%, NAFTA region also around 40%, LATA M 14% and rest of the world 31%, overall, 35.9

order_book.statement: Total product registrations at 3,044 with 946 applications in pipeline as of 30th September 2026
order_book.quote: Our total product registr ations stood at 3,044 as on 30 th September 2026. Additionally, 946 applications for product registrations are in the pipeline

capex.statement: FY27 planned capex of INR550 crores to INR600 crores for product registrations
capex.quote: FY27, we aim to increase product registrations with a planned capex of INR550 crores to INR600 crores, backed by strong pipeline that reflects our resilience and growth focus

capex.statement: Registration capex unpredictable due to government authority requirements and arbitration processes
capex.quote: Sir, I have said in every conference call that the process of r egistration is absolutely unpredictable. And the things change at the last moment, the go vernment authorities come out with new requirements at the last moment and the approval proce ss also gets delayed because the authorities are not able to meet so frequently and many thi ngs which are totally beyond anybody's guesswork or plannin

pricing_cost.statement: Tariffs not affecting agrochemical business; easy to pass on tariff increases to customers due to registration restrictions
pricing_cost.quote: Tariffs are not affecting agrochemical business at all. Because these products are not freely tradable, not freely available and not freely marketable. Every product needs to be registered and if in case of trading companies like us, we are restricted to source it only from an approved source which is approved by the authorities and a customer has not much choice.

pricing_cost.statement: Pricing environment improving but speed below expectations; still far below pre-COVID levels
pricing_cost.quote: It is improving. The speed of improvement is still not as per our expectation, but it is improving. It is still far down compared to the pre-COVID days, but still, it is not impacting the general business so much.

product_mix.statement: Q2 revenue growth driven by increased prices, positive forex, improved product mix of 18.3% with volume degrowth of 5.1%
product_mix.quote: the 13% revenue growth was on account of increased prices, positive forex impact and improved product mix of 18.3% . With a volume degrowth of minus 5.1%

product_mix.statement: H1 revenue growth driven by increased prices, positive forex, improved product mix of 14.5% with volume degrowth of 3.5%
product_mix.quote: For the half year, the 11% revenue growth was on ac count of an increased prices, positive forex impact and improved product mix of 14.5% (Errata: Actual number to be read as positive 14.5%) with a volume degrowth of minus 3.5

other.statement: Working capital days improved to 70 days as of 30th September 2026, down 28 days from March 2026
other.quote: Working capital days stood at 70 days as at 30th September '26, showing an improvement by 28 days as compared to March '26.

other.statement: Company remains debt-free with cash and liquid investments of INR846 crores as of 30th September 2026
other.quote: The company continues to remain a debt-free company with cash; bank liquid investments stood at INR846 crores as on 30th September 2026.

guidance.statement: Quarterly operating cost expected to remain between ₹680 crore and ₹700 crore over the next few quarters
guidance.quote: What we are saying is that, over the next few quarters, my cost will not increase in proportion to what it was doing earlier. It will remain between ₹680 crore and ₹700 crore.

guidance.statement: Purple Fabric expected to deliver results in 2027-28; MSOCK is a real-fast product to get results sooner
guidance.quote: So, Purple Fabric will deliver results in 2027-28. Definitely, a MSOCK, real-fast product to get the results.

order_book.quote: And also, we are working on a couple of other resourcing, outsourcing projects from Europe and North America markets.

capex.statement: Advantek capex loan of around INR250 crore planned
capex.quote: And I see that total capex loan we will take is around INR250 crores in Advantek.

capex.statement: Maintenance capex at consolidated level around INR25-30 crore annually
capex.quote: Harsha at a consol level, I will say, around INR25 crores to INR30 crores at a console level because we also need some of the operational or maintenance capex at China Romania site.

capex.statement: Total capex of INR220 crore over 12-15 months for Advantek and China expansions
capex.quote: 18 months capex, we have already announced is of around INR220 crores, out of which, as you rightly said, first half is around INR70 crores plus.

pricing_cost.statement: Approximately 4-5% of H1 FY27 25% growth attributed to material pass-through, rest volume growth
pricing_cost.quote: Our approximate estimate is that about 4%, 5% of it would be linked to a material pass-through related thing and rest of it is real volume growth.

risk.statement: Romania downsizing may involve one-off costs, details to be announced next quarter
risk.quote: We are in the process of working all the nitty gritties and details. Please give us one more quarter, and we will come with all the specific answers.

risk.statement: Q3 historically soft due to calendar year-end buying slowdown by international buyers
risk.quote: historically, Q3 tends to be a little soft in terms of demand considering the fact th at almost all large international buyers whose accounting year calendar year ends in calendar year, so it tends to show a little bit slow

risk.statement: Metal price volatility remains ongoing challenge for margin predictability
risk.quote: it is done 100% because it's a very much ongoing thing and different customer has a different time lines. So definitely, we see if the metal price will settle, this margin will either improve or will remain at the same

other.statement: Japan-based customer revenue grew 15% QoQ to INR24 crore, driven by delayed projects coming online
other.quote: While revenue from Japanese customer was around INR24 crores with a growth of 15% against the last quarter.

other.statement: Consolidated working capital at 135 days vs 139 days YoY and 116 days QoQ
other.quote: Overall working capital at our consolidated level is around 135 days against 139 days in the same quarter last year and 116 days in our previous quarter.

guidance.statement: Bromine full-year average yield guidance maintained at INR300 per kg minimum
guidance.quote: we kind of said that we expect the year to be at a INR300 average yield for the full year, and at the minimum every quarter. We will still remain strong of belief that we'll hold that number.

guidance.statement: Bromine volume guidance for FY27 maintained at 18,000-20,000 tons, expected at lower end
guidance.quote: No, as of now, we are expecting to be at the guidance, Sanjesh, albeit at the lower end of the guidance.

demand.statement: PVC demand weakness causing caustic soda volume deferrals, rebound expected this quarter
demand.quote: But we do expect that there will be a rebound in this quarter in PVC pricing, and that should help provide a fillip to the industry, and should actually start helping see some more firmness in our order schedules.

demand.statement: Agriculture demand tepid due to monsoon impact on agrochemicals and brominated derivatives
demand.quote: The agriculture sector, which is another big demand driver for us, continues to be fairly tepid in demand due to the impact of the monsoons.

demand.statement: Specialty chemicals demand strong, especially semiconductor chemicals
demand.quote: Demand for specialty chemicals, especially for semiconductor chemicals, remains strong.

margin.statement: Acume EBITDA loss of INR1 crore in Q2 due to unfavorable mix, one-time costs, inventory revaluation; H1 EBITDA positive
margin.quote: While we had strong volume growth, we did have some unfavourable mix impact because of the lower demand for organic compounds, some one-time period costs, and a one-time inventory revaluation, which had an adverse impact on earnings for the quarter. And for the quarter, we reported an EBITDA loss of around INR1 crores.

margin.statement: Bromine cost inflation mitigated through consumption efficiency and productivity improvements
margin.quote: The inflation in cost of sulfur, hydrated lime, and other elements has largely been mitigated through improvements in consumption efficiency and productivity, and we will continue to focus on those for the remainder of this year to ensure that we are operating at optimum margin levels.

order_book.statement: Industrial salt order book solid but shipments impacted by PVC/caustic soda market deferrals
order_book.quote: Despite a solid order book, shipments were impacted by deferrals of major or multiple orders, largely due to the state of the overall PVC and caustic soda market.

order_book.statement: Bromine export order boards very strong with stable pricing; domestic demand impacted by agro slowdown and pharma muted trends
order_book.quote: Bromine remains kind of a mixed bag. Our export order boards are very strong, and we continue to see a pretty stable pricing environment there. The domestic demand, though, has been impacted by slowdown in agro and muted trends in pharma.

capex.statement: Core business capex within depreciation curve, debt at 0.6-0.7x on 3-year window
capex.quote: I think with the exception of the flame retardant project, I think the rest of it, our capital spend will be remained within our depreciation curve. And we will probably be at 0.6 to 0.7 debt.

pricing_cost.statement: HSD prices rose from INR87/liter in Q2 FY26 to INR136/liter in Q2 FY27; coal and propanol up 40% YoY; sulfur prices more than doubled
pricing_cost.quote: HSD prices were approximately INR87 per liter for industrial HSD in Q2 FY26, continued to rise sharply, and in Q2 FY27, they averaged around INR136. Prices of coal and propanol have increased by around 40% year-on-year.

product_mix.statement: Acume commercialized 4 new products including NPBr for pharma and IPBr; 8 new molecules under development for H2 release
product_mix.quote: During the quarter, we have commercialized 4 new products, including NPBr for pharma, and IPBr, and 8 new molecules are under further development, which should get relea sed through the second half of this year

risk.statement: Key risks: winter impact on bromine recovery, fuel cost increases (WTI/Brent trending up), volume uncertainty from PVC/caustic soda deferrals
risk.quote: Probably the biggest one is just we get into winter, and we do see some impact at times because of that on recovery across our entire system. So that is an operational risk, which is there. I think fuel costs could jump further.

other.statement: Bromine debottlenecking on schedule for 25,000 tons run rate next year
other.quote: Our debottlenecking program on Bromine capacity continue to be as per schedule. We had given earlier guidance on the fact that we expect next year to be at a run rate of around 25,000 tons, and we are on schedule there.

other.statement: Brine field expansion adding 8,000 hectares in two phases, first 4,000 hectares completed and operational by end of quarter
other.quote: Our total brine field, when it is fully expanded, will be 24,000 hectares. We had 16,000 developed, and the expansion is about developing another 8,000 in 2 phases, 4,000 and 4,000.

demand.statement: Strong demand from Southeast Asia, South Africa, GCC; African continent emerging
demand.quote: From the growth perspective, we are getting good growth from the Southeast Asia region. South Africa is one of the countries which is giving us very good response, and also from the GCC sector. Because of GCC, the economy is not performing well, so their dependency on Indian products is increasing. So, these are the two or three continent where we see good growth.

demand.statement: Buffalo meat demand strong in Southeast Asia, MENA, GCC, Africa; Egypt, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia key buyers
demand.quote: So Indian product, you can say, by default is organic. It is economical, and we are having a good demand, good response from our Southeast Asian region, from our MENA region, and GCC countries. Also, there is a new emerging market that's coming these days is from the African continent. Egypt is there. There are many countries.

margin.statement: Logistics costs at peak; margin improvement of 1.5-2% expected when costs normalize
margin.quote: So, what we are feeling, once this all war situation and the tension in the Middle East region has been finishing or diluting, we hope that the charges what we were paying before, at least we will be able to secure the half of it. So, it will definitely increase our margin. And roughly, we can pull it out 1.5-2%. There are the chances to get margins in premium.

margin.statement: Chilled meat segment commands premium margins due to premium positioning
margin.quote: When we're going through the chilled section, the chilled section always get premium because it is a premium product, which is selling in premium places. So, there are good chances to be get good margins with the premium value addition.

capex.statement: No major capex required; only routine small machine capex and working capital needs
capex.quote: As of now, we are not making any huge CAPEX requirements because, as I told in the first question, which was asked in the same call, that we are already using our 70% of the capacity. So, the big CAPEX is right now not required. The only CAPEX or we need the working capital. If the more orders are coming, there will be a need of working capital only. There is no CAPEX requirement for the existing

pricing_cost.statement: Indian buffalo meat priced at roughly half of Australian/New Zealand/Brazil due to rural economy advantage
pricing_cost.quote: The price difference is almost, you can say, double. Because in Australia, they have a farming culture, so they do their cattle rearing and farming. That makes their live cattle prices much higher than India. The main difference is Indian products are much cheaper than the Australian, New Zealand, and Brazil.

pricing_cost.statement: Revenue growth driven by both volume and value; logistics and handling costs passed through to pricing
pricing_cost.quote: The revenue growth here, what you've seen in two quarters, it is both. It is in volume also and it is in value also. As I told you that the price, the product is becoming more value because of the extra cost of logistic and extra cost of handling. So, it is in both in volume and also in value, both realizations.

product_mix.statement: Started vacuum-chilled meat as high-end premium product for hypermarkets and supermarkets
product_mix.quote: And regarding value addition, we have recently started vacuum-chilled meat also, which is a high-end product and which is good for hypermarket, supermarket, and all the kinds of stuff.

product_mix.statement: Expanding into rice, seafood, fruits to complete food basket; early stage but leveraging brand value
product_mix.quote: There are good chances to get growth from these products because we are trying to complete our basket. We are trying to serve our existing customers and new customers a basket of food what they are looking. Rice, meat, seafood are one same generic, and it comes to about a complete meal. So, we are looking at a very strong perspective on these products. And for rice, seafood, it is the initial stag

other.statement: Current capacity utilization at 65-70%; no major capex needed for existing products
other.quote: As of now, the company has its own capacity where we are only utilizing our 65-70%. So, we still have the opportunity if we receive more volumes, more orders, so we are easily able to capable our own infrastructure.

other.statement: Exporting to 49 countries across four continents; all markets where Indian product has access
other.quote: Currently, we have a clientele in almost 49 countries, and we are catering in four major continents. So, there are 49 countries where we are serving to our clients.

guidance.statement: Long-term: expect growth rate of 11-12% to accelerate; at current rate would double in 5-6 years
guidance.quote: Our growth rate of 11%, 12%, which is what we have talked about in the past should accelerate. So if that accelerates, then we will more than double. Even at the current rate, we will approximately double in around 5, 6 years.

guidance.statement: Expect steadiness to return in Global Flight Handling in Q4 FY27; will update after Q3
guidance.quote: We expect steadiness to return in the fourth quarter, but we'll be able to update better when we look at the end of the third quarter.

guidance.statement: No formal forward guidance given; suggested extrapolating H1 EBITDA of INR85 cr and PAT of INR62 cr by multiplying by 2 for full-year estimate
guidance.quote: We don't give forward-looking guidance, formal guidance. But in the last quarterly call also, we had mentioned that you could -- at that time, we had said you could multiply that by 4. We have demonstrated that, that was correct, in fact, slightly better. So, you could multiply this by 2 now to arrive at some kind of estimate, of what the year will look like.

demand.statement: White collar hiring growth moderated to 2% YoY in September; BPO, ITeS, GCC hiring grew 4%; traditional IT subdued
demand.quote: White collar hiring growth moderated to about, 2% year-on-year in September after a strong August. Hiring in BPO, IT-enabled services and GCCs grew by about 4%, while traditional IT and software services remain subdued.

demand.statement: Global Flight Handling impacted by domestic passenger traffic decline in July-August due to airline capacity adjustments and West Asian airspace restrictions
demand.quote: Domestic passenger traffic witnessed a year-on-year decline in July, August, primarily due to airline capacity adjustments, continued disruption arising from the West Asian airspace restrictions.

demand.statement: India office market absorption reached record 66 million sq ft in first 9 months of CY2026, GCCs accounted for 28 million sq ft
demand.quote: India's office market continued to be strong with absorption in the first 9 months of the calendar year 2026, reaching a record 66 million square feet. Global Capability Centers remain a key driver of th is demand, accounting for a record about 28 million square feet of leasing in the same

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 5.3% in Q2 FY27 from 4.3% in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: Consolidated EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at INR43.2 crores compared to INR31.6 crores in Q2 FY26, a growth of 37%. The EBITDA margin improved to 5.3% from 4.3% last year.

margin.statement: IFM EBITDA margin improved to 4.2% in Q2 FY27 from 3.8% in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: IFM EBITDA for the quarter was about INR24 crores with a margin of 4.2% compared to 3.8% in Q2 FY26.

margin.statement: BSS EBITDA margin improved to 7.7% in Q2 FY27 from 5.3% in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: BSS EBITDA margin was at 7.7%, approximately INR21 crores.

order_book.statement: Added 7 new significant logos in IFM in Q2 FY27, taking H1 total to 13
order_book.quote: We added 7 new significant logos in Q2, taking large logo additions for the first half to 13.

order_book.statement: Added 4 new significant logos in BSS during Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: We added 4 new significant logos in BSS during the quarter.

capex.statement: Capital allocation prioritizes investments in technology and capabilities, selective value-accretive acquisitions and shareholder returns
capex.quote: Our capital allocation approach will remain disciplined, prioritizing investments in technology and capabilities, selective value-accretive acquisitions and shareholder returns.

pricing_cost.statement: PF ceiling raised from INR15,000 to INR25,000; full-year impact INR5-6 cr without pass-through, but substantial pass-through limits net impact to INR1-2 cr
pricing_cost.quote: For the full year, the overall impact -- if there is 0 pass-through, would have been about INR5 crores to INR6 crores, but there is substantial pass-through. So we -- at worst, it will be about between INR1 crores to INR2 crores.

product_mix.statement: Denave's Intellibank AI platform scaling across Demand Gen lifecycle; AI agents handle research, qualification, follow-up
product_mix.quote: We also ran several AI pilots with demand and clients and are now scaling this digital workforce model across the Demand Gen lifecycle. In practical terms, what this means is that AI agents take on research, qualification and follow-up tasks while our people focus on high-value conversations that connects the pipelines into revenue.

product_mix.statement: IFM priorities: improve client-level profitability, shift mix to higher-margin technical services (MEP, energy management, technical AMCs), win integrated outcome-linked mandates
product_mix.quote: We aim to improve client-level profitability, shift the mix towards higher-margin technical services such as MEP, energy management and technical AMCs, and continue to win integrated outcome-linked mandates.

risk.statement: Headwinds expected in Denave (global environment) and Global Flight Handling in H2 FY27
risk.quote: We believe these margins are sustainable, as I had mentioned when I briefed and as Sunil also talked about, there are some headwinds that we are seeing in Denave in the global environment and in global, which is our ground handling business.

risk.statement: Effective tax rate expected to remain in current range; benefit from 80JJAA employment incentives but reliance decreasing
risk.quote: The effective tax rate will largely remain in the same range because we have estimated what will be the full-year effective tax rate and accordingly have worked out for respective quarters. So, we don't see a much swing in that rate on a full-year basis.

other.statement: Net cash from operating activities for H1 FY27 was INR46 cr vs INR33 cr in H1 FY26; cash and equivalents INR404 cr as of Sept 2026 with no long-term borrowings
other.quote: Our net cash from - operating activities for H1 was at INR46 crores compared to INR33 crores in H1 FY26. As of September 2026, our cash and cash and cash equivalents, including mutual funds and fixed deposits is at INR404 crores and we have no long-term borrowings.

other.statement: Net debt to equity negative 0.21x as of September 2026; company remains net cash with no long-term borrowings
other.quote: UDS continues to be a net cash company, with net debt to equity is negative 0.21x as of September 2026.

guidance.statement: Guided consolidated sales growth of 18% to 20% for FY27
guidance.quote: As we look ahead, we remain encouraged by the positive demand environment across our key categories and markets, reinforcing our confidence in delivering our guided consolidated sales growth of 18% to 20% for the year.

guidance.statement: Targeted EBITDA margin range of 16% to 17%
guidance.quote: Our targeted EBITDA margin range continues to be 16% to 17%. However, we will evaluate -- we have to be patient for a couple of quarters.

demand.statement: Volume growth contributed over 80% of the 18% revenue growth in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: So, Sneha, volume growth has been close to about -- out of the 18%-odd growth that we've done, more than 80% growth comes from volume-based growth and 20%-odd comes from realization growth.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 12.4%, flat sequentially despite raw material volatility
margin.quote: EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at INR82.8 crores and H1 FY27 EBITDA stood at INR165.3 crores with margins during both the periods at 12.4%.

margin.statement: Uniclan baby hygiene EBITDA margin declined to 6.4% from 8.1% YoY due to raw material inflation
margin.quote: Hence, we've seen the EBITDA margins come down from 8.1% in the previous year quarter to 6.4%. This is primarily on account of increase in the consumption or increase because of the raw material prices.

margin.statement: Long-term target for Uniclan baby hygiene EBITDA margin is 8% to 10%
margin.quote: We'll want to have margins of around 8% to 10% for this business segment in the longer term.

order_book.statement: Reynolds brand revenue contribution expected from Q3 FY27, gaining momentum in Q4 FY27
order_book.quote: But we'll see revenues from Reynolds brand from the goods manufactured by us flowing in from third quarter FY27 and gaining momentum in fourth quarter FY27.

capex.statement: Invested over INR200 crores in H1 FY27; expect further INR100-125 crores in H2 FY27
capex.quote: During H1 FY27, we invested over INR200 crores in capital expenditure and expect to invest a further INR100 crores to INR125 crores during the remainder part of the year.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material inflation at ~15% in Q2 FY27; consumption impact ~9% after price hikes and mix
pricing_cost.quote: So the inflation is around 15%. What we mentioned in Q1, Bhavin bhai, was when you compare it with the consumption, the impact was about 10%. So I'm saying inflation is about 15% with the consumption level of about 60%. So on consumption, the impact is around 9%.

pricing_cost.statement: Taking calibrated price increases at granular product level to protect volume growth
pricing_cost.quote: Wherever we believe that there is any room for increasing the selling prices at the MRP level or at the channel level or reducing the schemes and margins, we are taking those steps.

product_mix.statement: Growth driven by office supplies, adhesives, paper stationery, and back-to-school categories where capacity was added
product_mix.quote: Predominantly would be from office supplies, adhesives, paper stationery, where significant capacity expansion have happened during the last year or so.

risk.statement: Raw material price volatility continues; margin visibility limited for next couple of quarters
risk.quote: Honestly, visibility on the margin guidance continues to be limited, owing to these abrupt fluctuations. Like I said, prices continue to increase in September that have further continued to increase in the month of October.

other.statement: Commissioned first building at 50-acre greenfield facility (~170,000 sq ft) for Reynolds pen manufacturing; revenue from Q3 FY27
other.quote: We are pleased to share that we have successfully commissioned the first building at our new 50-acre manufacturing facility, bringing approximately 170,000 square feet of manufacturing space into operation. This building is dedicated to our office supplies business, primarily for pen manufacturing under the Reynolds brand with revenue contribution expected from Q3 FY27 onwards.

other.statement: Working capital cycle maintained within guided 55-60 days despite volume growth and floods
other.quote: On the working capital front, despite strong volume-led growth and a challenging market environment, we have maintained our working capital cycle within the guided range of 55 to 60 days.

guidance.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin guidance 25% for FY27; confident of achieving it in H2
guidance.quote: Yes, we are very much confident. If you look at that in a domestic front, we are doing extremely good. And with this second half always to be a much better half from the H1. So with this, all the situation, we are very much confident to reach to 25% margin, what we have guided to market, and we are about to maintaining those things.

guidance.statement: Huron H2 FY27 revenue recognition expected to cover the gap; targeting close to INR300 crores (EUR28M) for full year
guidance.quote: So ma'am, I said that we are going to reach close to 300 crores. It means close to EUR28 million there, okay. Today is EUR6.5 million. The difference are going to come in the next 2 quarters then.

guidance.statement: Order intake guidance for FY27 is INR25-30 billion; already exceeded run-rate in H1
guidance.quote: Already, we have been clocked against the guidance is little bit higher. And always our second quarter and third quarter is intake month basically, all the time, okay.

guidance.statement: Huron revenue guidance INR300-325 crores for FY27 with 5-10% EBITDA margin; on track to reach close to INR300 crores
guidance.quote: Correct. we are on the same level. We are looking to be a quarter 3 and quarter 4. And we are very progressed in terms of is all end-user certificates and all. And very positive signals has come from the government authority over there. And I am very happy to share with you, 1 or 2 machines last week, they already given a permissions to us also. So with that, third and fourth quarter, we are seein

demand.statement: Aerospace & defence orders delayed due to government tender timing; pipeline healthy, expecting more orders in coming quarters
demand.quote: In aerospace and defence, many orders we are getting through the government tenders. In a last quarter, there are some of the tenders has not been open as we have been expected. So that will come, and it means we are not lose any orders. It will be in the pipe there.

demand.statement: Strong demand across auto (EV), aerospace & defence, general engineering, electronics; 62% of India's CNC demand still imported
demand.quote: Overall demand continue to remain encouraging across the key sectors, while our capacity expansion will further strengthen our ability to capitalize on opportunities ahead.

margin.statement: Average realization INR32-35 lakhs currently; expects INR35-36 lakhs in next 2-3 years as high-end mix improves
margin.quote: So we will be maintaining, I said that, in between 35 to 36 in the next 2 to 3 years there.

margin.statement: Standalone Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 28% (+320 bps YoY); consolidated 21.8%; entry-level mix high but margins sustained
margin.quote: On the profitability front as well, Q2 FY27 EBITDA stood at INR164 crores compared to the INR111 crores in Q2 FY26, with margin of 28%, an increase of 320 basis points.

order_book.statement: Order book intake of INR800 crores in Q2 FY27; total order book INR5,082 crores as of Sep 30, 2026
order_book.value: INR800 crores intake; INR5,082 crores total
order_book.quote: we recorded a robust order book intake of INR800 crores during the quarter, taking our total order book to INR5,082 crores as of September 30, 2026.

order_book.statement: Order book mix: 36% aerospace/defence, 22% auto/auto components, 21% general engineering, 12% electronics manufacturing, 4% die & mould, balance others
order_book.quote: The industries-wise order book comprises 36% of aerospace and defense, 22% from automotive and auto components. 21% from general engineering, 12% from electronics manufacturing services, and 4% from die and molds, with the balance coming from the other sectors.

capex.statement: Capex for FY27 projected at INR450-500 crores; INR183 crores already spent
capex.quote: So until today, we have done close to 100 and all the advances and paid we have done. So INR183 crores we have done. And now, the only the foundry last miles are there. So what we have been projected, the total outlays of a close to INR450 crores to INR500 crores, we are going to be very near to that after this all completions over there.

capex.statement: ECMS scheme approved capex INR1,020 crores over 5 years with 25% central subsidy; state matching grant expected to take total subsidy to 50%+
capex.quote: Jyoti CNC has received approval for a capital investment of over INR1,020 crores over the next 5 years, which is a capital incentive of 25%. Through this initiative, we aim to develop in-house manufacturing capabilities for key components such as CNC controllers, motors, drives, and operator interfaces.

product_mix.statement: Developing MTX 100 compact 5-axis multitasking turn-mill center for aerospace, defence, auto/EV, oil & gas
product_mix.quote: we recently developed the MTX 100, a compact 5-axis multitasking turn-mill center. The machine combines turning, milling, gear cutting, and grinding operation in a single setup, enabling customers to improve productivity, enhance machining accuracy, and optimize floor space.

product_mix.statement: Building in-house CNC controller, motors, drives, operator interfaces via ECMS scheme; 110+ engineers in controller R&D, adding 40-50 more in 6 months
product_mix.quote: in only this controller division in R&D center today, separately the teams are working since last 1.5 year. Now that number has reached to almost more than 110 people. And we are expecting 40, 50 more engineers are going to add in the coming days, in the next around 6 month there.

risk.statement: CNC controller supply chain risk increasing globally; managed via inventory buffering and advance planning
risk.quote: Yes, there is a CNC controller supply chain is increasing. The concern is becoming increasing due to the worldwide this machine tools order intake is increased dramatically now. In the last 6 months, Japan has clocked the order book intake is more than 60% month-on-month there. The highest order intake is happening in Japan, Germany, Italy, and particularly in U.S., okay. Due to this all AI and th

other.statement: Dispatched ~1,900 machines in Q2 FY27, highest quarterly ever; added 10,000 machines capacity during quarter; foundry operations to commence soon
other.quote: During the quarter, we dispatched approximately 1,900 machines, marking the highest quarterly dispatches in the history of the company's operations. This is on the back of additional 10,000 machines which we put to use during this quarter. Our foundry operations will commence operations in the coming days.

other.statement: Foundry capacity expanding from 1,500 to 5,000 tonnes per month; equipment under transit, completion expected this quarter
other.quote: The existing foundry capacity is close to 1,500 tonne per month. With the new foundry capacity, we will reach to a 5,000 tonne per month.

guidance.statement: Capital allocation framework targets returning ~50% of cumulative adjusted free cash flow to shareholders over rolling 5-year periods via dividends and buybacks
guidance.quote: Starting FY27, our capital allocation framework envisages returning about 50% of cumulative adjusted free cash flow to shareholders over rolling 5-year periods through dividends and buybacks.

guidance.statement: No specific revenue guidance provided; aims to grow at par or faster than market from premium share perspective
guidance.quote: We don't provide specific guidance, and I think on the TPA business we've always mentioned that we will grow at par or faster than the market from a premium share perspective.

demand.statement: Same-store growth on retained group business running at 7-8% vs historical 13-14%
demand.quote: The same-store growth, which used to be about 8% or 9% earlier, we're still seeing about a 7%, 8% same-store growth on the retained business.

margin.statement: Steady-state core business EBITDA margin target remains 22-23%
margin.quote: But we still sort of stand by that our steady-state margins are 22%, 23% in the core business, and that continues to be a focus area to get back there at the earliest.

order_book.statement: Contract liability increased to INR321.7 crores from INR280.2 crores at end of FY26
order_book.quote: The contract liability was INR321.7 crores versus INR280.2 crores at the end of FY26.

fund_raise.statement: Board approved share buyback of INR49.3 crores at INR425 per share funded from internal accruals
fund_raise.quote: In line with this framework, the board has approved a buyback of INR49.3 crores at INR425 per share, funded from internal accruals.

other.statement: EOM consultation paper seen as opportunity; blended TPA fee at 2.7% on group and retail considered exceptional value for insurers
other.quote: We are fairly confident that at our blended 2.7% TPA fee on group and retail is an exceptional value for money from an insurer perspective.

other.statement: Company maintains zero debt balance sheet
other.quote: The company continues to have a strong and zero debt balance sheet.

guidance.statement: Internal target to double revenue every 3 years; confident FY27 revenue will exceed INR1,200 crores vs FY24 ~INR600 crores
guidance.quote: our internal target has always been to double our revenues every 3 years. And if you see our FY24 numbers, our top line was, I think, closer to INR600 crores. And I'm very confident that this fiscal, which is FY27, we will be much higher than INR1,200 crores.

guidance.statement: Target consolidated EBITDA margin of 14-15% in 3 years driven by value-added product share increase

Of this, we spent INR68 crores towards capex and INR110 crores towards the dividend payment and around INR13 crores on the repayment of borrowing, while working capital increased by around INR217 crores. This resulted in a net cash outflow of INR48 crores for the half year.

guidance.statement: Tube volume targeting >100,000 tons in H2 FY27 to achieve full-year growth over last year's 7.5% decline
guidance.quote: we are looking for better than 100,000 metric ton in the second half of this year. So, that we end up achieving some growth over last year and not go down what we are today like almost 7.5% lower.

guidance.statement: Pig iron external sales volume guidance 6.6-6.7 lakh tons for FY27; targeting 8.5-9 lakh tons hot metal output after Hiriyur upgrade, then converting part to steel
guidance.quote: I think we are looking at today maybe 6,60,000, 6,70,000. But we will see more increase in the output coming here with full implementation of oxygen enrichment and PCI, which will come by the year end in both blast furnaces, one and two in Koppal. And subsequently, of course, once we upgrade the Hiriyur plant, we will take all the three mini-blast furnaces, put together an output of 8.5 to 9 lakh

demand.statement: Casting demand strong from tractor, auto, earth-moving and stationary engine sectors in Q2; tractor demand may see small corrections while auto and earth-moving remain strong
demand.quote: Demand for the castings from all sectors was going on very well in quarter one and subsequently in quarter two. The demand for castings was good from tractor, automotive and also the earth moving and stationary engine market.

order_book.statement: Casting order book exceeds 3 lakh tpa committed; targeting 2.5 lakh tpa from existing sites (Solapur 70k, Rajpura 70k, Koppal 90k, Oliver ~25k)
order_book.quote: our commitment to our customer is much higher than 2 lakh metric ton per annum. It goes even beyond 3 lakh metric ton per annum.

capex.statement: Wind power: 35 MW commissioned at Solapur; balance pending commissioning to reduce energy costs
capex.quote: We have not yet commissioned all the windmills. We have just commissioned 35 megawatts of Solapur. We have some work to be done on that.

capex.statement: Koppal alloy steel plant: technology partners ordered, commercial negotiation underway, full execution in 2-3 months, 20-month project timeline
capex.quote: We have already ordered for the technology design partners. We have already tied up with them. Now, we have come to a stage of commercial negotiation and ordering the equipment. We expect that we should next two to three months take up that project full blast and then we should expect around 20 months for project execution and implementation.

capex.statement: Jejuri rolling mill expansion, Baramati expander mill, Ahmednagar piercing mills in execution stage; updates expected in coming quarters
capex.quote: We are ready with going ahead with rolling mill capacity expansion in Jejuri as well as the expander mill project in Baramati and also setting up of small piercing mills in Ahmednagar so that we improve on our product portfolio as well as capacities coming for smaller tubes as well as the large tube which go into oil and gas.

pricing_cost.statement: Pig iron realization up 12.4% YoY to Rs 43,054/t; casting up 6.8% to Rs 1,30,000/t; tube up 1.6% to Rs 1,16,953/t; steel up 7.6% to Rs 77,500/t
pricing_cost.quote: Last year, pig iron price ex-works average realization was Rs. 38,000, which has moved to Rs. 43,054 which is 12.4% improvement in the pig iron prices, whereas casting prices have also moved up almost by 6.8 % compared to last year.

product_mix.statement: Two-part foundry to produce large castings up to 2 tons (engine blocks, non-auto SG iron 480kg parts); expects double EBITDA/ton vs high-pressure lines due to lower volumes but higher value addition
product_mix.quote: Typically, large casting foundries produce volume wise half of the high-pressure moulding lines. So, typically, every two-part foundry manufacturer expects double the margin in large castings. Otherwise, it does not work out because volume outputs are lower. So, per ton value addition is much higher in two-part foundry.

other.statement: Rajpura foundry Phase 2 to be commissioned by March 2027, adding ~24,000 tpa capacity to reach ~4,000 t/month
other.quote: by year end, financial year end, which is March, 31st March, we will bring up the phase two of the Rajpura project so that our capacity can go to close to 4,000 metric ton per month. And accordingly, all steps are being taken to increase the capacity there and clearance is there. And we can look for another 24,000 to come from Rajpura with phase two implementation.

other.statement: Exported 31,000 tons pig iron in Q2 at better realization than domestic; will remain domestic-focused but take opportunistic exports; direct export casting orders booked for earth-moving equipment
other.quote: We also exported one cargo of 31,000 metric tons and as we realized better in export than domestic. We continue to focus on domestic market with better realization and we will be keen to make export as the prices internationally are better than the domestic.

guidance.statement: Targeting FY27 EBITDA margin of 10.5-11%
guidance.quote: The company is targeting 10.5 to 11% of margin for FY27.

guidance.statement: Reconfirmed FY27 guidance; expect stronger H2 supported by healthy order book in garments and fabrics
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we want to reconfirm our FY27 guidance. And we want to assure you all that we remain focused on achieving the stated targets.

demand.statement: Domestic textile sector seeing gradual improvement in production and domestic order activity; broader manufacturing environment encouraging
demand.quote: During quarter 2 FY27, the Indian textile sector witnessed a gradual improvement in production levels and domestic order activity. The broader manufacturing environment also remained encouraging and our capacity utilization improved during the quarter, indicating resilience in the underlying demand environment.

demand.statement: UK and EU FTAs providing boost to export garment business; seeing increasing demand and interest in India as sourcing destination
demand.quote: We are also seeing increasing demand and increasing interest in India as a destination given the free trade agreements. And looking ahead, the U.K. and EU free trade agreements have provided us an additional boost to our export business, and we are looking forward to even stronger demand in the rest of the year.

demand.statement: Structural shift toward man-made fibres and blended fabrics offers significant growth opportunity; India's penetration low vs global share
demand.quote: We believe this structural shift represents a significant growth opportunity for the Indian textile manufacturers and especially Banswara Syntex. Globally, synthetic and blended fabrics account for a substantially higher share of clothing consumption, part icularly in segments such as sportswear, formal wear and fast fashion, whereas India's penetration in these segments is relatively low

margin.statement: Expect to pass on raw material cost increases in H2 FY27 to support margin target
margin.quote: So what you're going to see now in the next half of the year unfolding is hopefully our ability to pass on this. And that is why we're still maintaining our overall prediction that we have made for the year.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 10.2% from 9.1% in Q1; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 9.7% vs 8.5% YoY
margin.quote: Our EBITDA margin increased by 23.9% quarter -on-quarter to INR36.5 crores, (Wrongly said, this should be read as , Our EBITDA increased by 23.9% quarter -on-quarter to INR36.5 crores) with the EBITDA margin improving to 10.2% from 9.1% in quarter 1.

margin.statement: Margin improvement driven by better realisations and higher value-added product contribution; stretch yarn internal consumption up 150 tons/month to 450-500 tons/month
margin.quote: This improvement was driven by better realizations and a higher contribution from value-added products.

order_book.statement: Healthy order book in both garments and fabrics; Q3 FY27 order visibility encouraging
order_book.quote: The second half is typically stronger for our business, and we do expect that the demand and our order book position, which is already a very healthy order book, both in garments and fabrics, will support this performance.

order_book.statement: Garment division has strong order book particularly in jackets; order pipeline from new EU/UK clients like C&A (INR5 cr this year, INR20 cr+ next year) and Reserved
order_book.quote: However, on the product front, our order book remains strong and particularly in jackets, we have a strong order book.

capex.statement: Surat garment facility capex INR30-50 cr additional depending on automation level
capex.quote: The capex for Surat in addition could be depending on how far we go into the automation, between INR30 crores to INR50 crores.

capex.statement: FY27 capex guidance INR130-140 cr; INR36 cr spent in H1; balance to be spent in H2 with max projects completing
capex.quote: So there is no delay as such. But yes, as and when it progresses, we are doing the capex and also keeping in mind the requirement what we need and need -based capex and certain work is in progress. So in H2, maximum projects will get completed.

pricing_cost.statement: Polyester prices increased 25-30% due to West Asia crisis and oil price increases; PTA and MEG prices also up; freight costs increased exorbitantly
pricing_cost.quote: Our polyester prices have increased by 25% to 30%.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material price increases not fully passed on to customers yet across yarn, fabric and garment divisions; lag in pass-through
pricing_cost.quote: The point is, Nirbhay ji, here that the amount of raw material price increase, we have not been able to pass on fully to the customers yet. This is still happening in yarn and in fabric and in garment. There is always a delay between the prices increasing and what we are able to pass on.

product_mix.statement: Focus on value-added products over volume; stretch product sales in fabrics up 30-40% YoY; internal yarn consumption now ~40% of production
product_mix.quote: We have increased the sale of our stretch products significantly in our fabrics. And this has gone up by almost about 30%- 40% as compared to last year. So we are consuming almost now stretch yarns about 450 to 500 tons per month internally, which used to be only at the level of about 300 tons, has increased by about 150 tons per month.

risk.statement: Near-term challenges: raw material price volatility from geopolitical environment, power cost increases, freight cost escalation, vessel availability issues, lag in cost pass-through
risk.quote: At the same time, the industry continues to face some near -term challenges for raw material price volatility due to the geopolitical environment. We have had an increase in the polyester prices because of the West Asia challenges.

other.statement: Yarn capacity utilisation improved to 84% in Q2 FY27 vs 81% YoY and 70% QoQ
other.quote: Our capacity utilization improved to 84% during this quarter compared to 81% in quarter 2 FY26 and 70% in the preceding quarter.

other.statement: Fabric capacity utilisation improved to 82% in Q2 FY27 vs 77% YoY; H1 FY27 at 81% vs 73% YoY
other.quote: Capacity utilization has improved to 82% from 77% in the corresponding last year. And for H1 FY27, our capacity utilization stood at 81% as compared to 73%.

guidance.statement: Design & Build annual revenue growth target of 50-60% for FY27
guidance.quote: we have set a target of 50 to 60%, and that is a target that we all are geared up to achieve. The kind of order book that we already have in place right now really support that claim that we are making that we will certainly be able to achieve our targeted growth of 50 to 60% under the Design & Build vertical.

guidance.statement: All three verticals on track for FY27 annual targets; Design & Build H2 execution expected to accelerate
guidance.quote: all the 3 verticals, which is Leasing vertical, which is Furniture vertical, and Design & Build vertical, are fairly on track in terms of achieving the targets. Let's say, the Leasing vertical has already achieved the numbers that it is targeted to achieve on a proportionate basis. And the same is the case with Furniture vertical as well.

demand.statement: Leasing occupancy maintained at 90%+ across portfolio with committed capacity additions
demand.quote: we generally have more than 90% plus occupancy acros s. And the occupancy has always been stabilized and improving positively and maintain at 90% quarter on quarter and year on year

margin.statement: Leasing vertical target margins: corporate level 25%, center level 30%
margin.quote: on a corporate level, with regards to the Leasing vertical, we'll be able to make at 25%, while at center level, we'll be able to make 30%

margin.statement: Design & Build vertical target margin 18-22%
margin.quote: while on the Design & Build, we'll be able to make between 18% to 22%.

margin.statement: Furniture Manufacturing target margin 24-25% at optimal capacity
margin.quote: And at Furniture Manufacturing at an optimal manufacturing capacity, again, around 24%, 25%.

order_book.statement: Design & Build order book exceeds 300 crores supporting FY27 growth target
order_book.quote: that is primarily because of the kind of order book that we already have, which is more than 300 crores plus. And I think that both the next quarters, that is quarter 3 and quarter 4 would be really promising for this particular vertical, and we will certainly be able to achieve targets.

capex.statement: Asset sale and leaseback transaction with Sanvritti Alpha generated 39-40% return on capital
capex.quote: we generated around 3 9 to 40% on return on capital on these transactions. So this is a very important part of our strategy where we are monetizing an asset and also this would enable us to reduce our debt

pricing_cost.statement: Material and services price increases pressured Q2 margins but annualized margins expected to hold
pricing_cost.quote: also naturally, this quarter, in particular, there has been quite substantial increase in the prices of materials, prices of different services that has been availed. And that obviously has contributed a little bit of pressure. But like I said, on an overall basis, we'll certainly be able to maintain those margin levels

product_mix.statement: Furniture strategy targets institutional, commercial, residential, projects and export segments
product_mix.quote: we have kind of captured across the commercial place, Design & Build and also supplying different types of furniture products, whether it is for residential purposes, commercial purposes, projects, exports and so and so forth.

risk.statement: Quarterly margin variations expected due to project execution timing differences
risk.quote: except for the quarters, which in a quarterly basis, it may kind of go up and down primarily because of there are differences in the project execution cycles, project expenses that has to be incurred and those timing differences may kind of bringing a bit of variations in the margins.

other.statement: Ultrafresh acquisition adds 160+ touch points in Tier 2/3 cities and Nalagarh manufacturing facility
