other.quote: Also, it gave us access to the network that they have created through more than 160 touch points that they have across the Tier 2, Tier 3 cities in India.

other.statement: Proposed demerger separates asset-light leasing and Design & Build into listed EFC (I) Ltd, owned property assets remain in EFC Ltd subsidiary
other.quote: Under the proposed arrangement, the leased premises managed office operation will be housed within EFC (I) Limited, that is a standalone listed company, while the owned property operation will remain within EFC Limited, the wholly owned subsidiary of EFC (I) Limited.

guidance.statement: Monthly disbursement run-rate is 20-22 crores with headroom to double or triple without external capital
guidance.quote: I think, for us, given the traction that we are at right now, about, you know, I think 20- 22-odd crores of lending which is happening roughly every single month in this space, we have a bit of headroom.

demand.statement: 60x scale-up in 6-7 months since Feb 2026 launch with zero paid marketing; strong product-market fit indicated
demand.quote: So, I think just in a matter of 6-7 months, there's been a scale-up of almost 60X.

order_book.statement: Apollo Cash has disbursed over 65 crores and 1.6 lakh loans since launch with 5 lakh+ app downloads
order_book.value: 65 crores disbursed, 1.6 lakh loans, 5 lakh+ downloads
order_book.quote: So I think we've already disbursed almost 65-plus odd crores, almost 1.6 lakh total number of loans disbursed, 5 lakh plus downloads, and, you know, many more happening every single day.

pricing_cost.statement: Loan tenures of 3-6 months currently, exploring 9-12 months; early repayment common but may reduce with larger tickets
pricing_cost.quote: Typically, when we give out loans to our borrowers, right, I think we do 3 months and 6 months, and, you know, potentially we will be exploring 9 months and 12 months as well.

product_mix.statement: Apollo Cash revenue (processing fees, interest) now landing fully on own books vs partnership model, driving P&L uplift
product_mix.quote: So, one of the structural advantages that we have with Apollo Cash versus, you know, the partnership business that we've been doing for a few years now, is that here, the processing fee and the interest and, you know, every line of revenue which is coming from the customer is landing on our book.

risk.statement: Next underwriting model version aims for better approval rates, significantly better risk rates, and smarter loan allocation using Apollo Cash-specific data
risk.quote: Number one, have better approval rates. Number two, to definitely have significantly better risk rates. And finally, smarter loan amount allocation, where we are getting much better at identifying higher quality customers and giving them the loan amount that they deserve.

other.statement: Provisions made to borrow ~100 crores from debt market; leverage near zero with room to scale before tapping lenders in a couple of quarters
other.quote: I think we've already made provisions for, you know, our ability to borrow about 100-odd crores from the debt market, if required, to some degree or the other.

other.statement: Engineering team grew 3X in one quarter; tech team now 43% of total headcount and growing
other.quote: In fact, our engineering team alone, in just one quarter, has grown 3X. Now, we all know our DNA is tech, so this tech mix will show up eventually.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin band 11-13% until polymer plant commissioning; 14-16% thereafter
guidance.quote: So EBITDA margins will always remain between 11% to 13%. Once our polymer gets on stream by December 2027, in the next year we will like to give you a band of 14% to 16%.

demand.statement: Building 1,000 km/month single-core 3.3 kV solar cable plant, commissioning in 18 months
demand.quote: Demand from solar parks is strong enough that we are building a 1,000 kilometre a month single-core 3.3 kV cable plant which will get on stream in the next 18 months.

demand.statement: Data centre cable revenue target INR750 crore in FY27 from existing orders; scanning 66 cities, 230+ developers
demand.quote: In the current year, we are expecting to do INR750 crores out of our top line from data centre customers, for which we already have the orders from there.

margin.statement: EHV cables carry 5-6% margin premium over MV and ~10% over LV cables
margin.quote: So the differential is usually 5% to 6% between a medium voltage and EHV cable and almost 10% between an LV and EHV cable.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 12.9% (up 240 bps YoY); contribution margin fell to 16.9% from 18.7% due to higher LME aluminium inflating revenue base
margin.quote: EBITDA including other income was INR133 crores, up 189%, at a margin of 12.9%.

margin.statement: Data centre cables earn at least 2% extra margin due to stringent pre-qualification entry barriers
margin.quote: So obviously there is a entry barrier there. So this entry barr ier leaves at least 2% extra margin for you

order_book.statement: INR32,000 crore live enquiries for MV and EHV cables to be finalised in next 90 days
order_book.quote: We have presently INR32,000 crores worth of enquiries which are live to be finalized in the next 90 days by various customers across the country.

order_book.statement: Firm order book INR3,735 crore at quoted value (~INR4,300 crore at current prices); H1 inflow INR2,217 crore, book-to-bill 1.29x
order_book.quote: Our firm order book at 30th September stands at INR3,735 crores at quoted value and around INR4,300 crores at current market prices under the price variation clause.

fund_raise.statement: QIP July 2026 raised INR1,614 crore to meet minimum public shareholding requirement
fund_raise.quote: The QIP in July, we completed and raised INR1,614 crores entirely due to the fact that we have to bring down our minimum shareholding.

risk.statement: Key risk: geopolitical/government policy risk in infrastructure sector; but management sees geopolitical risk as positive for new energy demand
risk.quote: every business has a risk, especially when it comes to infrastructure business, which is the power, road, or businesses which at the end of the day are 60%, 70% dominated by government or controlled by government, there is always a geopolitical risk which is associated.

other.statement: Current capacity utilisation ~45% of fully commissioned balancing equipment level
other.quote: So capacity utilization is approximately 45% of what it will be when the entire balancing equipment is operationalized.

other.statement: Conductor volume growth: 6,850 km dispatched in Q2; real volume growth 60-70% YoY excluding metal price impact
other.quote: On actual production, kilometres of cables and tons of conductors made and dispatched, our growth is well above 60% to 70% year-on-year basis. Conductor dispatches were 6,850 kilometres in the quarter.

guidance.statement: Footwear volume growth 5-10% yearly
guidance.quote: That will be nearly 5% to 10% on a yearly basis.

guidance.statement: Export general expected to continue double-digit growth
guidance.quote: And further, we are expecting it will continue to improve in double digit.

guidance.statement: Sustainable gross margin around 55-56%
guidance.quote: You can take it around 55%, 56%.

guidance.statement: Topline growth around 20% expected to continue in coming quarters
guidance.quote: It should remain continued, and we are also expecting better than -- in coming quarters, you will see even better than this.

demand.statement: U.S. automotive market weak for last 2 quarters; customers not buying new cars; OEMs revised projections
demand.quote: Basically, market is not responding well in U.S. for last 2 quarters. And the customers are not going for buying the new cars. Therefore, the automotive companies have revised their projections.

demand.statement: Export OEM volume Y-o-Y not positive due to U.S. market; Q-o-Q 5% growth
demand.quote: And the OEM, 13.5% Y-on-Y and 5% on Q-on-Q basis. And export Y-on-Y. in fact, it is not a positive growth, volume because of certain reasons of U.S. market.

margin.statement: Consolidated margin higher when consolidated revenue exceeds standalone due to warehouse margin addition
margin.quote: Whenever the consol revenue is higher than the stand-alone revenue, definitely, your margin will be higher because percentage will also add in the stand-alone. So that will be improved.

order_book.statement: Good OEM supply orders in hand from U.S.; started contributing to export sales; growth momentum expected to continue next 2-3 years
order_book.quote: And in this context, we have -- as we already informed to you also that we have some good OEM supply orders in our hands from U.S., which we have already started making good contribution to our export sales and revenue and overall business profitability. And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in next 2, 3 years.

order_book.statement: Export OEM orders from Ford and Chrysler increased from 2 to 5 models
order_book.quote: In the U.S. We have received the very good amount of orders or quantity, mainly Ford and Chrysler. And customers are same, but they have increased their requirement on other models also. So suppose, earlier, we were supplying materials for 2 models. Now they have given us orders for 5 models.

order_book.statement: BMW and Mercedes-Benz taking material at near full projections; expected to continue and slightly increase
order_book.quote: BMW and Mercedes -Benz, they are taking material as per their requirement and they have touched almost full projections. So we are expecting that, that will be continued and a little bit increase.

pricing_cost.statement: Not currently discussing price pass-through with customers as freight costs are declining
pricing_cost.quote: That's why we are not -- even in this position, see how much impact will be there to talk with the customers to pass on. That's why when the cost is stable and increase is permanent, then we can talk. But right now, we don't.

pricing_cost.statement: Freight costs peaked at COVID levels but declining 20-25% from peak; will pass on only if increase is stable and permanent
pricing_cost.quote: But now it has gone to a very peak level, which we have seen during COVID. But now it is getting down. And hopefully, in next 2, 3 months, it will be -- I think it has to be a normal level. So this is not stable.

product_mix.statement: Focus on automotive exports; domestic footwear less focus due to price competition; footwear volume and value both increased
product_mix.quote: Since as we already discussed in previous quarters that we are more focusing on automotive and especially on export automotive market. The domestic market because of high price competition all, we are less focusing. And -- but we have also told this thing, footwear will be remained same. But in last quarter, it is -- we are trying to improve footwear market also. And you have seen in this quarter,

product_mix.statement: Furnishing business: 750-800 sub-dealers, 8-10 distributors; retail started but domestic retail weak last 5-6 months
product_mix.quote: Actually, to improve on furnishing business, we already started our retail business, and retail business is also doing well. But in the last 5, 6 months, some domestic market on retail segment is not doing well because of price competition. But definitely, we have a very big scope in furnishing market, and for that purpose, we have appointed around 750 to 800 sub-dealers or dealers and 10 -- 8 to

risk.statement: Market conditions uncertain; cannot project with certainty; margin expected to sustain or improve
risk.quote: Again, nothing can be said because market conditions cannot be projected with certainty. Definitely, uncertain market is there. But with this uncertainty, I can tell you, we're always trying to do better and better. And hopefully, margin will be -- the current margin will be sustained and it should not come down. It should do better.

other.statement: PU capacity utilization at 25%; breakeven at 40%
other.quote: PU, it's not, in fact, generating profit just -- but we are managing because of some tax benefits and all. But still we are operating at 25% capacity utilization. And to get the breakeven, we need to operate at 40%.

other.statement: Bhadla Mini Grid Solar investment payback period maximum 2 years
other.quote: Yes, it's payback period is 2 years only. Maximum 2 years.

guidance.statement: Management expects poultry healthcare to sustain at current base and improve, with ruminant vaccines added from Africa
guidance.quote: We foresee that poultry will continue at the worst at this base, cannot go down, and it can only improve, and we will add on ruminant vaccine.

demand.statement: Animal healthcare revenue grew 34% in Q2 but H1 was 14% below prior year due to lower Q1 sales from government program timing
demand.quote: Animal Healthcare recorded a re venue growth of 34% in Q2, supported primarily by increased tender execution. H1 revenue remained 14% below the corresponding period of the previous year, reflecting lower sales in Q1

demand.statement: Poultry healthcare revenue grew 27% in Q2 and 37% in H1 FY27 driven by institutional business and market penetration
demand.quote: Poultry Healthcare maintained its growth momentum with revenue increasing by 27% during the quarter and 37% for the first -- for the half year

margin.statement: Standalone gross profit margin at 78% and EBITDA margin at 35% in both Q2 and H1 FY27 supported by product mix and cost management
margin.quote: Gross profit margin stood at 78% in both Q2 and H1, supported by a favorable product mix and our focus on operational efficiency. EBITDA margin stood at 35% across both periods, reflecting higher sales and disciplined cost management.

order_book.statement: Nepal PPR eradication program procurement not materialized at envisaged scale; evaluating business adaptation
order_book.quote: In Nepal, the anticipated procurement under international PPR eradication programs has not materialized at the scale originally envisaged. We are evaluating on how best to adapt the business to the environment.

product_mix.statement: Poultry healthcare growth driven by vaccines (including H9N2), feed supplements and disinfectants; institutional business and deeper market penetration key drivers
product_mix.quote: Along with vaccines, our health p roducts portfolio includes feed supplements and disinfectant solutions addressing broader disease prevention and farm health management needs. We continue to develop these offerings supported by scientific engagement with customers

risk.statement: Hester Africa priority is building consistent business and improving financial sustainability through market development and institutional opportunities
risk.quote: For Hester Africa, our priority is to build a more consiste nt business and improve financial sustainability through focused market development and institutional opportunities

other.statement: Signed power purchase agreement for 3-megawatt group captive solar project to improve energy cost efficiency and renewable energy use
other.quote: We also signed a power purchase agreement for a 3-megawatt group captive solar project to improve energy cost efficiency and increase renewable energy use.

other.statement: Exports from India were around 10% of sales in FY26; ratio improved in FY27 due to new export opportunities
other.quote: Yes, export from India in the last financial year was around 10%. And clearly, there is a lot of scope to increase the share of export. And in this financial year, the ratio would have increased because we have embarked on quite a few export opportunities.

guidance.statement: Domestic business targets double-digit growth; H1 delivered 13%+ despite seasonal brand weakness.
guidance.quote: half year 1 has delivered a double-digit growth in, for domestic business at 13%-plus.

guidance.statement: Comfort Click expected to maintain double-digit growth in H2 FY27 after 18% H1 growth.
guidance.quote: We do believe that we will stay on course to get to a double digit for half year 2 as well.

demand.statement: Consumption trends show sustained positive momentum across categories with steady recovery in demand and improvement in rural offline markets.
demand.quote: During the quarter, amid the high inflation, largely driven by commodities, consumption trends continue to reflect sustained positive momentum across categories, supported by a steady recovery in demand and an improvement in rural offline markets.

demand.statement: E-commerce and quick-commerce continue strong momentum, steadily increasing contribution to overall sales.
demand.quote: E-commerce and quick-commerce continued to maintain strong momentum, steadily increasing their contribution to overall sales and further strengthening their role in the evolving consumption landscape.

demand.statement: Rural demand remains robust with growth rates slightly higher than urban across Glucon-D, Nycil, Complan, Sugar Free, Everyuth.
demand.quote: So, rural demand continues to be robust. While we have slightly, significantly lower than larger FMCGs in terms of rural portfolio. But whatever we have, Glucon-D, Nycil, or even a Complan, Sugar Free, Everyuth, we do see that rural is holding rather well. In fact, growth rates are slightly higher than urban.

margin.statement: EBITDA grew 271.7% YoY to INR 855 million in Q2 FY27.
margin.quote: On the EBITDA front, the company delivered growth of 271.7% during the quarter, reaching INR 855 million.

margin.statement: Half-year EBITDA grew 83.2% YoY to INR 3,272 million.
margin.quote: On a half year basis, company registered an EBITDA growth of 83.2%, reaching to INR 3,272 million.

margin.statement: Comfort Click steady-state EBITDA margin expected at 14-15%.
margin.quote: Our EBITDA margins for Comfort Click, we expect between 14% and 15%, and that's a plan or that's the steady state that we have envisaged.

order_book.statement: Comfort Click H1 growth at 18%; management expects double-digit growth to continue in H2.
order_book.quote: But if you really look at half year 1, we are at 18% growth, and that, I think, is in line with what we expect.

order_book.statement: Comfort Click new launches in last 1 year contribute ~2% of growth; last 3-4 years closer to 4% share of growth.
order_book.quote: overall products launched in last 3 to 4 years, the numbers will be closer to 4%, but just 2% on the last products launched in last 1 year will be share of growth.

order_book.statement: Everyuth gaining market share in facial cleansing category (~INR 4,500 cr), now ranked #4 from #7 a few years ago.
order_book.quote: We have now this year become number 4. So, we are actually gaining share and rank in this space.

capex.statement: RiteBite Max Protein Crunchy cookies launched pan-India across omnichannel; premium positioning with 7 super grains and high protein.
capex.quote: So, it's a pan-India launch. We are launching both in, across channels. It's an omnichannel approach that we follow. We are on online channels. We are launching in offline channels.

pricing_cost.statement: Calibrated price increases taken on specific SKUs with direct commodity impact; further increases likely in H2 depending on commodity volatility.
pricing_cost.quote: Over half year 2, yes, we will take calibrated price increases, like I mentioned, depending upon what commodity is going up.

product_mix.statement: Key launches include Sugar Free Monk Fruit Sweetener, RiteBite Max Protein Crunchy cookies, and Comfort Click Vitamin B Complex, Omega-3, D3 and K2 under WeightWorld brand.
product_mix.quote: During the quarter, key launches included Sugar Free entered the Monk Fruit Sweetener category with a No Erythritol formulation. RiteBite Max Protein Crunchy cookies, featuring 10 grams of protein made without palm oil, maida or any added sugar. And of course, continued portfolio expansion in the Comfort Click business through the launch of Vitamin B Complex, Omega-3 Triglycerides and D3 and K2 un

product_mix.statement: Complan growth driven by celebrity endorsement (Vaibhav Sooryavanshi), 50% less sugar relaunch, NutriGro toddler range, distribution and on-ground work.
product_mix.quote: Last quarter, we've also launched 50% lower sugar. I mean, we've relaunched with 50% less sugar. Also relaunched Complan NutriGro, which is a 2 to 6-year toddler initiative.

risk.statement: Key risk is continued inflation impacting consumer confidence and consumption, though current environment looks good.
risk.quote: I'm more worried about inflation, a continued inflation could impact consumer confidence and reduce the consumption, which right now in the environment looks good.

other.statement: Consolidated net sales grew 74.6% YoY to INR 11,227 million in Q2 FY27.
other.quote: On the financial front, for second quarter financial year 2027, the company reported consolidated net sales of INR 11,227 million, reflecting a growth of 74.6% year-on-year.

other.statement: Half-year net sales grew 70.1% YoY to INR 25,526 million.
other.quote: On a half year basis, the company reported net sales of INR 25,526 million, reflecting 70.1% growth year-on-year.

guidance.statement: Maintain FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 24% plus
guidance.quote: Yes, we maintain that guidance of 24% EBITDA margin for the full year.

guidance.statement: US business guided for single-digit growth on constant currency in FY27
guidance.quote: And as I said, we are still guiding for a single digit growth on constant currency terms on the high base of FY26.

guidance.statement: Expect commercial expense for Saroglitazar around $100 million annually
guidance.quote: So, we expect our commercial expense to be around $100 million every year.

guidance.statement: Target 20% patient share for Saroglitazar in PBC indication
guidance.quote: So, we are third to market and our current goal is to achieve a 20% patient share.

demand.statement: India branded formulations grew 19% YoY in Q2 FY27, outpacing IPM
demand.quote: Our India -branded formulation business delivered a strong 19% growth during the quarter, significantly outpacing the I PM.

demand.statement: IPM expected to grow 10-11%, company to outperform by 200-400 bps
demand.quote: we still believe that the market will grow between 10 to 11 % and we will definitely grow at 200 to 400 basis points consistently more than the IPM from the future point of view.

demand.statement: Transdermal patch market demand 50% higher than current supply
demand.quote: The demand in the market is 50% more than what is currently served.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 24%, adjusted for Saroglitazar investment margin higher by 150 bps
margin.quote: Our operating profitability remained robust with an EBITDA margin of 24% despite continued investments towards Saroglitazar launch related activities in the US. Adjusted for this investment, our EBITDA marg in was higher by 150 basis points.

margin.statement: MedTech business currently at ~20% EBITDA margin, scaling over 5 years
margin.quote: So, today, the existing business, which is mostly the Amplitude Surgical business is around 20% EBITDA margins, which is a platform built.

order_book.statement: Filed 4 ANDAs, received 12 approvals, launched 5 products in US generics in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: On the US generics front, w e filed 4 ANDAs, received 12 approvals and launched 5 new products during the quarter.

order_book.statement: US specialty revenue share increased to 16%, up ~550 bps sequentially
order_book.quote: Notably, specialty products accounted for 16% of US revenues during the quarter, up 5 of 20 approximately 550 basis points sequentially, underscoring the pace and success of our strategic

order_book.statement: Expect 15-20 launches (ANDAs and 505(b)(2)) in next 2-3 quarters
order_book.quote: About 15 to 20 in the next two to three quarters.

capex.statement: Depreciation run rate to continue at current level up to September 2027
capex.quote: So, I think overall, we tend to believe that we will be at the current level run rate up to September 2027, because that will also have Mira begron related depreciation on the licensing of that particular deal.

capex.statement: Transdermal patch capacity to double in at least a year
capex.quote: It will take at least a year, but we could double our capacity.

pricing_cost.statement: Other expenses (ex-R&D, ex-Saroglitazar) expected at ₹2,000-2,050 crore per quarter
pricing_cost.quote: And what we are expecting is that, you know, excluding R&D and the Sar o commercialization cost, other expenses would be in the range of ₹2000 to 2050 crores, that kind of a spend that we are expecting on other expenses side.

pricing_cost.statement: R&D spend guided at 8-8.5% of revenue, to continue growing
pricing_cost.quote: And R&D cost will, as a percentage, we have guided that is around the 8-8.5% but we don't see R&D for us coming down and it will continue to grow because we are investing heavily.

product_mix.statement: Branded business share expanded to ~57% of total revenue, up 150 bps QoQ
product_mix.quote: Importantly, share of our branded business has expanded to around 57% of our total revenue in this quarter, which is an increase of 150 basis points versus the last quarter.

product_mix.statement: Chronic and sub-chronic portfolio at 56.9% per AWACS MAT Sep 2026, up 450 bps over 4 years
product_mix.quote: Contribution of chronic and sub -chronic portfolio has increased consistently over the last several years and stood at 56.9% as per AWACS MAT September 2026, an improvement of 450 basis points over the last four years.

risk.statement: Keytruda biosimilar launch dependent on patent litigation outcome
risk.quote: Obviously, it will be patent litigation that will go through. So, I don't think we can give any update on when the launch will be.

risk.statement: MASH Phase III not pursued due to biopsy-led trial feasibility challenges
risk.quote: Yeah, not yet because I think , the current expectation is a biopsy led trial, which is almost impossible to do anymore.

other.statement: International formulations revenue ₹10 billion, up 33% YoY in Q2 FY27
other.quote: Building on this momentum, the business reported revenues of ₹10 billion during the quarter , up 33% year-on-year.

other.statement: North America revenue ₹33.1 billion, up 21% YoY and 7% QoQ in Q2 FY27
other.quote: North America business , comprising of the United States and Canada delivered strong performance during the quarter with revenues of ₹33.1 billion up 21% year-on-year and 7% quarter -on-quarter.

guidance.statement: Consolidated revenue guidance not explicitly given; MDF volume growth guided at 17%-18% for FY27
guidance.quote: Going forward, we are confident of 17%-18% growth, and H2, we are sure we will see the same.

guidance.statement: MDF EBITDA margin guided at double-digit (10%+) in H2 FY27
guidance.quote: But for the time being, the visibility is 10% margins in the second half.

guidance.statement: Laminates revenue growth guided at 20%+ for FY27 with margins improving
guidance.quote: 20% plus is something that I believe we can comfortably achieve for the year, and margins should also look on the up.

guidance.statement: Plywood EBITDA margin guided at 14%-15% for FY27 due to marketing spends
guidance.quote: Now we are saying 14%-15% is what we want to aim for plywood.

demand.statement: MDF industry growth robust; 30%+ capacity addition in last 3 months and next 9 months; excess capacity absorption expected by FY29
demand.quote: I think we have 30% plus capacity addition that is happening in the industry over the course of, say, the last three months and the next nine months. This is going to be the last large-scale addition that we have seen. After that, there is no concrete additional capacity that is fixed. I believe that from FY29 onwards, you will see a substantial recovery in margins.

margin.statement: Particle Board utilization still below 70%; MDF utilization ~85%
margin.quote: Now, I do not think in Particle Board if anywhere close to 80%, 85%. We are still totally below 70% capacity utilization.

capex.statement: Hoshiarpur plywood plant (60,000 CBM) commissioned in Q3 FY27; Guwahati and Kandla brownfield expansions to start July 2027
capex.quote: Our 60,000 CBM per annum greenfield plywood plant at Hoshiarpur had commenced its operation in Q3 FY27. The brownfield expansions at our Guwahati and Kandla plant are progressing as planned, with the enhanced production expected to commence from July 27.

capex.statement: Capex increased due to Hoshiarpur commissioning, Sainik MR range in-housing, Hoshiarpur expansion, and U.P. Phase 1
capex.quote: We are also in the next year planning to bring our entire Sainik MR range in-house. We do not have a choice but to really expand capacity aggressively. We are doing a lot of expansion within our existing plants. We will start working on the U.P. phase I as soon as we have the land. We are also going to expand further in Hoshiarpur in the next year.

product_mix.statement: Laminates shifted from liners to decoratives and compacts, reducing volume but increasing revenue and margin
product_mix.quote: Earlier when we had a new plant coming in, we were selling a lot more of liners. Liners is typically lower realization, low profitability sort of a product. So we have transitioned away from liners and we are now focusing on decoratives and compacts. As such, you will see a volume reduction, but a substantial increase in revenue.

risk.statement: MDF overcapacity situation with new capacities from Action and Elixrr; margins under pressure till excess capacity absorbed by FY29
risk.quote: I was saying we're in a typical overcapacity situation here, where till the excess capacity is absorbed, it's very difficult to margins to go back to the erstwhile 20% range. Currently, we're looking at further capacity addition, which has happened already in the quarter with Action coming up with the new capacity, as well as one capacity addition from Elixrr. I think the next two quarters will be

other.statement: Working capital cycle ~60 days; H1 revenue grew from INR2,500 cr to INR3,300 cr, increasing working capital needs and debt
other.quote: We typically have a 60-day working capital cycle. So H1 to H1, our revenue has gone up from INR2,500 crores last year to INR3,300 crores this year. As such, I believe that this has added to the working capital requirement and led to higher debt.

other.statement: Expecting ~INR900 cr EBITDA in FY27; cash flows robust; majority to go towards debt repayment
other.quote: I think we will be looking at close to a INR900 crores EBITDA. And with no further capex or large capex in mind, other than the plywood capacity in Uttar Pradesh, the chunk of it is going to go towards the repayment.

guidance.statement: Management expects FY27 performance to be better than H1 FY27
guidance.quote: I think the way we are placed as of H1, you can definitely extrapolate the number, but it will be better than this. That is for sure.

guidance.statement: Management will not give FY28 guidance at this time
guidance.quote: I would not like to give any guidance for FY28 as of now, but so far as current financial year is concerned, it will be definitely better than H1, that is for sure.

demand.statement: Strong domestic MDF demand drove 41% YoY revenue growth in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: The growth was driven by domestic MDF business with India revenue increasing by 41% YoY.

demand.statement: Laminate domestic revenue grew 82.1% YoY in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: India laminates revenue increased by 82.1% YoY to Rs. 404 million while export revenue grew by 47.7% to Rs. 480 million.

margin.statement: Laminate business overall margin target 12-14%
margin.quote: The margin as a whole business would be 12% to 14%. And we will make sure that we achieve those numbers what we are committing of 12% to 14% margin for the laminate business as a whole.

margin.statement: Jumbo Laminates EBITDA margin 19.4% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: EBITDA increased to Rs. 42 million from Rs. 23 million in Q1 FY27 with an EBITDA margin of 19.4%.

margin.statement: MDF EBITDA margin 9.9% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: MDF EBITDA increased by 6% YoY to Rs. 194 million, with an EBITDA margin of 9.9%.

order_book.statement: Jumbo Laminates has signed orders for Q3 and Q4 FY27
order_book.quote: Yes. So we have already signed a few of the upcoming businesses for Q3 and Q4 as well. So we see a good amount of jumbo business coming into the action.

capex.statement: FY27 capex limited to Rs 15-20 crore for normal operational needs from internal accruals
capex.quote: Amount can be in the range of Rs. 15 crores to Rs. 20 crores in max which will be from internal accruals only.

capex.statement: Brownfield Jumbo Laminates expansion would take ~8 months for main machinery lead time
capex.quote: So, if we see it is a brownfield, supposing, then the lead time from the machinery, which is the most important part, and it takes generally 8 months for the main machine to get ready.

pricing_cost.statement: MDF domestic realizations fell 7% QoQ due to chemical price volatility and 5-10% competition pressure
pricing_cost.quote: So, the current raw material scenario is also very skeptical like the chemical prices have been very volatile and there has also been price pressure, and there was competition of 5% to 10%.

pricing_cost.statement: Laminate price hike taken after October 10, 2026, to reflect in Q3 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: the price hike in laminate has just happened in the month of October, maybe I would say after 10th of October, because of which the price hike has been taken in Q3.

product_mix.statement: Value-added MDF products contributed 44% of volumes and 55% of revenues in H1 FY27
product_mix.quote: Value-added products contributed 44% of MDF volumes and 55% of MDF revenues.

product_mix.statement: Target 50% MDF volumes and 60% MDF revenues from value-added products in FY27
product_mix.quote: We are making progress towards our target of achieving 50% of MDF volumes and 60% of MDF revenues from value-added products during FY27.

risk.statement: Chemical raw material prices volatile due to ongoing war in the West
risk.quote: there are also some raw material price hikes in the terms of chemical because of the ongoing war in the West.

risk.statement: Freight costs for Jumbo Laminates exports surged from USD 800-900 to USD 8,000 per container
risk.quote: The freight charges which were supposed to be at USD 800 or USD 900 are at USD 8,000. So, that is the main reason for this kind of variabl e charges

other.statement: Jumbo Laminates capacity utilization reached 41% in Q2 FY27
other.quote: Capacity utilization in the jumbo laminate business reached to 41% during the quarter.

other.statement: Management targets 80-85% Jumbo Laminates utilization by March 2027
other.quote: We are striving for it. So, I would say, March, we will be at level of utilizing somewhere around 80%, 85%.

guidance.statement: Targets 22-23% restaurant-level EBITDA margin post-Ind AS and 20-22% revenue growth from new store expansion
guidance.quote: See, the target, what we look at is from an EBITDA perspective, we should be having -- post Ind AS, I'm talking about, we should be between 22% to 23% of EBITDA at restaurant level.

guidance.statement: Plans to reach 200 outlets by FY30 with focus on Oriental, Italian cafe and QSR brands
guidance.quote: So we as a company have taken our strategy focused brand expansions, which I may reiterate, which will be Oriental and in Oriental, we have our mother brand Mainland China, Asia Kitchen thereafter, which is our mall format.

demand.statement: Same-store sales growth 8.1% in Q2 FY27, 11.32% in Q1 FY27, 9.8% in H1 FY27; optimistic on Q3 seasonality
demand.quote: What we have witnessed during this particular quarter is the same-store sales growth which had been 8.1% in the quarter 2, which was 11.32% in quarter 1 and is 9.8% in H1 of FY27.

margin.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin 8.03% in Q2 FY27 vs 6.81% YoY; pre-Ind AS EBITDA 7.90% vs 6.52% YoY; restaurant-level EBITDA ~22% for Asia Kitchen
margin.quote: Operational EBITDA grew by 39.44% to INR 10.242 crores against INR 7.47 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, with the EBITDA margin improving to 8.03% from 6.81%.

capex.statement: Capex per restaurant INR 4-5 crores; annual capex ~INR 50 crores; 4-year plan ~INR 200-250 crores
capex.quote: See, your point is well taken. Sir, what has -- let's say, when we talk in terms of a capex plan, which have been just detailed by Mr. Avik for the next 3 years, what we are looking at is for a restaurant, let's say, we spend between INR 4.5 crores to or INR 4 crores, INR 5 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: No major price hikes taken; managing input cost inflation via vendor renegotiation and scale buying power
pricing_cost.quote: So we haven't really taken a very big jump in price h ike. What we have managed to do is because of economies of scale having such a large operations, our vendors have been very supportive

product_mix.statement: Delivery mix 32% in Q2 FY27 vs 27.4% in Q2 FY26; expects 30-35% long-term; dine-in 68%
product_mix.quote: This Q2 FY27 had 32% delivery and 68% dine-in, which was 27.4% on delivery and 72.6% Q2 FY26 of last year.

other.statement: 75% of delivery customers are new; 25% loyal per aggregator data
other.quote: See, we don't get the delivery customer data point, but what we gather from aggregators is that 25% of our -- these are loyal customers and 75% of the guests who get into delivery are the newcomers.

other.statement: Liquor revenue 8-9% of total revenue
other.quote: We operate at around 8% to 9% of our total revenues as liquor.

guidance.statement: Long-term EBITDA margins for Chennai Park expected to stabilize at levels of established parks like Hyderabad, Bangalore and Kochi after 2-3 years
guidance.quote: Long-term margin, it will become like our established parks like Hyderabad, Bangalore and Kochi. So its margins will continue to expand, but this is the first year, so it's very erratic. It might move up and down in different, different quarters. After 2 to 3 years, it will stabilize.

guidance.statement: Company looking at 2-3 new locations for expansion, hopes to conclude deals before end of current financial year
guidance.quote: Yes, we are looking at 2 to 3 new locations, but no final call has been taken. We hope to conclude some of these deals before the end of this financial year, and we'll keep you updated.

guidance.statement: Chennai Park expected to take 2-3 years to achieve optimal utilization and sustainable profitability
guidance.quote: It'll take 2 years, 2 to 3 years.

demand.statement: Existing parks Bengaluru, Kochi, Hyderabad, Bhubaneswar grew revenue 8% YoY in Q2 with footfalls up 6%, and 13% revenue growth with 7% footfall growth in H1
demand.quote: Together, our parks Bengaluru, Kochi, Hyderabad, Bhubaneswar grew revenue by 8% year -on-year in the quarter, with footfalls up 6%. For the half year, they grew revenue by 13% with footfalls up by 7%.

demand.statement: Resorts business delivered best ever Q2 with 57% YoY growth, hospitality becoming increasingly meaningful contributor
demand.quote: Our resorts business delivered their best ever Q2, with the resorts growing 57% year -on-year. Hospitality is becoming increasingly meaningful contributor to our business.

demand.statement: Bengaluru and Kochi delivered best ever Q2 performance, Hyderabad delivered best ever H1
demand.quote: Second, our existing parks, Bengaluru and Kochi, delivered their best ever Q2, and Hyderabad delivered best ever H1.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 24% from 18% YoY, H1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 40%
margin.quote: The EBITDA margin expanded to 24% from 18%. We also moved from a loss in Q2 last year to profit in this quarter. For the first half, the income grew 41% to INR378 crores and EBITDA grew 47% to INR150 crores at a margin of 40%.

margin.statement: Chennai Park contributed INR 10.37 crores (73%) of EBITDA increase in Q2, existing parks contributed INR 1.83 crores (13%), resorts contributed INR 2.06 crores (14%)
margin.quote: The INR14.26 crores increase in EBITDA was led by Chennai. And Chennai Park contributed about INR10.37 crores, accounting for about 73% of the EBITDA increase. Our existing parks contributed about INR1.83 crores, representing 13%. Our resort business contributed INR2.06 crores, accounting for the remaining 14 percentage.

capex.statement: Typical capital for a large park in a city like Bombay might be close to INR 200 crores for land, last Chennai land purchase was roughly INR 100 crores
capex.quote: So land parcel, the last time we bought was roughly INR100 crores for Chennai. For a city like Bombay, we might have to spend maybe close to INR 200 crores.

capex.statement: Company plans at least 1 big project in next 1-2 years and maybe 1 Tier 2 city, possibly 2 large cities
capex.quote: We are looking at least 1 big project in the next 1 or 2 years, and maybe 1 Tier 2 city. Maybe 2 large cities also is possible, but we will keep you updated.

capex.statement: Substantial investments made over last 2 years in flagship global rides for capacity addition at Bangalore park
capex.quote: One is capex investments, which you would have seen over the last 2 years, we've done some substantial investments, bringing some flagship global rides.

pricing_cost.statement: Non-ticket revenue grown at early double digits CAGR over 4-5 years, now at 30%+ of ARPU, company continues to build on retail and F&B product assortments
pricing_cost.quote: I think we've been able to substantially grow our non -ticket revenue, and just not quarter -on-quarter, but I think across the 4 to 5-year CAGR, we've been able to grow at early double digits. So we've been able to kind of come to the global trends of almost having 30%-plus of non-ticket part of the entire ARPU.

pricing_cost.statement: Average ticket price declined 3% YoY to INR 983 in Q2, offset by 11% increase in non-ticket revenue per guest to INR 510, ARPU up 1% to INR 1,491
pricing_cost.quote: The average ticket price declined by 3% Y-o-Y to INR983. This was offset by an 11% increase in non-ticket revenue per guest to INR510, supported by our in-park spending initiatives. Consequently, average revenue per unit increased by 1% Y -o-Y to INR 1,491

product_mix.statement: Company focusing on price-led, cohort-led interventions and bringing larger groups in lean seasons to improve weekday footfall and reduce seasonality
product_mix.quote: So I think we are focusing on price -led, cohort-led interventions. And I think we've seen some good results in this lean season of quarter 2. And during these lean seasons, we also work on bringing larger groups that otherwise cannot afford our parks in the holiday season. And I think these are 2 initiatives that we continue to build on to increase our footfall in the lean seasons.

product_mix.statement: Flexi tickets already implemented on online booking portal allowing customers to change dates based on weather or emergencies
product_mix.quote: We have flexi tickets which anyways allow customers to change based on weather or any other emergency conditions that they have. So that's already implemented on our online booking portal.

risk.statement: Chennai Park first monsoon season (mid-October to end-November) will impact footfall, full year impact to be assessed
risk.quote: So in Chennai, this is actually in sense our first ever monsoon, as Chennai monsoons happen between mid-October to end-November. We are also kind of understanding the overall consumer trends and patterns. But yes, the monsoons will have an impact on the footfall as we've seen, but we will only be able to get a better sense once we finish the whole year.

risk.statement: Land prices fluctuating with uncertainty, may go up or down, making capital planning speculative
risk.quote: Also land prices keep fluctuating, and this year, as there are a lot of -- there is a lot of uncertainty. Land prices may go down, it may go up. We don't know what is going to happen.

other.statement: Current capacity utilization across parks at 30-40% occupancy for whole year, considered normal for amusement parks
other.quote: So if you look at a whole year perspective, I think we are -- we'll be at a 30% or 40% occupancy, but that is normal for these kind of parks.

other.statement: Roughly 40-50% land still available across parks for future development, Hyderabad has less available land
other.quote: We have roughly 40% to 50% land is still available. Some parks like Hyderabad, it'll be less.

guidance.statement: Management maintains low double-digit revenue growth guidance for FY27, 20% home textile growth, and 40-45 new EBOs focused on West and South
guidance.value: low double-digit revenue growth; 20% home textile growth; 40-45 new EBOs
guidance.quote: We continue to maintain our guidance for low double-digit revenue growth, 20% home textile growth and 40-45 new EBOs focused on West and South also.

demand.statement: Later festive season shifted consumer demand and winter sell-through from Q2 to Q3; macro inflation reducing discretionary spending but economy growing at 7%
demand.quote: This year, the later festive season shifted a meaningful part of consumer demand and winter sell-through towards Q3.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expected to be within plus/minus 100 basis points of FY26 level depending on Q3 performance
margin.quote: So, as far as margins are concerned, we are into third quarter and this quarter is very important for us. So, we see plus-minus 100 basis point margin as compared to last financial year, depending on how this quarter goes.

margin.statement: Rebates and discounts increased to 12% of revenue in H1 (vs 9% YoY) due to early end-of-season sales and old inventory liquidation; full-year expected 3-4%
margin.quote: Compare it with the revenue in proportion to revenue. In proportion to revenue, it is 12%. As against last year, it was 9%. So, we have to see every percentage in relation to revenue only.

order_book.statement: Gross sales increased across cotton (Rs 390 cr), home textiles (Rs 91.6 cr), kids wear (Rs 34.5 cr), footwear (Rs 9.3 cr); woolen declined to Rs 94 cr
order_book.value: cotton Rs 390 cr; home textiles Rs 91.6 cr; kids wear Rs 34.5 cr; footwear Rs 9.3 cr; woolen Rs 94 cr
order_book.quote: Cotton sales increased from Rs. 326 crores in H1 to Rs. 390 crores in H1 FY '27. Home textiles sales increased from Rs. 83 crores to Rs. 91.6 crores. Kids wear sales increased from Rs. 30 crores to Rs. 34.5 crores. Footwear increased from Rs. 4.9 crores to Rs. 9.3 crores. Woolen gross sales declined from approximately Rs. 106 crores to Rs. 94 crores.

capex.statement: 35 MW solar plant in Madhya Pradesh with PPAs signed; land identified; COD 31 Mar 2027; expected ROI 17-18%
capex.quote: So, for the solar bid, I would like to mention that the PPAs for all these three sites have already been signed. It is a 35-megawatt plant that we are putting in Madhya Pradesh. The land has been identified, land aggregation is in place and all the three sites are supposed to go live on 31st March 2027 and we are on track to achieve that.

pricing_cost.statement: Price hike of 8-9% taken in winter wear to offset raw material cost increases
pricing_cost.quote: We have taken a price rise of around 8% to 9% in this winter and I think that will suffice whatever raw material cost increased we have in the winter wear category.

product_mix.statement: Cotton largest category at 63% of gross product sales in H1 FY27; home textiles, kids wear, footwear growing; woolen declining
product_mix.quote: Cotton has been our largest reported product category since FY '22 and contributed approximately 63% of gross product sales in H1 FY '27.

product_mix.statement: Non-Monte Carlo brands (Rock.it, Cloak & Decker, Monte Carlo Home) contribute ~8% of revenue but growing faster than parent brand; Home growing ~20% CAGR
product_mix.quote: Then if you talk about Cloak & Decker which is an economy segment, again it cannot be clubbed into Monte Carlo because Monte Carlo is a premium brand. So, both these brands if you see in last 2-3 years, they have been grown handsomely and they will have substantial revenue going forward.

risk.statement: Geopolitical tensions and macro inflation impacting material costs and discretionary spending; later festive season shifted demand to Q3
risk.quote: But unfortunately, this year, we got interruption by the material cost rise because of geopolitical tensions and all. So, that has hurt us in this quarter.

other.statement: Pure wool raw material prices increased ~20% YoY, cotton cost of goods increased only 3%
other.quote: Also, if you look at our quarter 3 products, which supplies woolen products, the raw material price for pure wool has grown by almost 20% over the last year. This year also, we expect the same increase in the raw material price.

other.statement: EBO count 506 (vs 497), shop-in-shop 632 (vs 578), MBO 1,413 (vs 1,615), National Chain Stores 846 (vs 891) as of Sep 26
other.quote: As on September 26, we reported 506 EBOs compared with 497 EBOs a year earlier. Our shop-in-shop network increased to 632 from 578. MBO declined to 1,413 from 1,615 while National Chain Stores declined to 846 from 891.

guidance.statement: Target 120 corporate clients by end of FY27; currently at 54 sourced in H1
guidance.quote: See we have already sourced 54 and I think we should be able to source 120 clients by the year-end.

guidance.statement: MSME loan book target minimum INR150 crores-plus by March 2027 from current INR131 crores
guidance.quote: So as of today, it's INR131 crores MSME loan book, and minimum what we are targeting is INR150 crores-plus by end of the year.

guidance.statement: Expect quarter-on-quarter EWA disbursement growth of 15-20% in H2 FY27
guidance.quote: We are expecting quarter-on-quarter to grow by at least 15% to 20% on a Q-on-Q basis.

guidance.statement: Eligible for NSE listing after March 2027 audited balance sheet; net worth must exceed INR75 crores for three consecutive years
guidance.quote: We'll be eligible for listing on NSE after March '27 balance sheet. So once the March '27 balance sheet is audited, we will be audited before the 30th of May, then we have to submit to NSE, and we are eligible for listing over there.

demand.statement: Second half typically stronger due to festive season EWA demand and March quarter activity
demand.quote: The second half is typically stronger for our business, supported by a festive season EWA demand and activity towards the March quarter.

demand.statement: Gold loan demand down 30-35% due to falling gold prices and reduced balance transfer cases
demand.quote: With the decrease in prices, you know, the demand for balance transfer has also decreased. But to counter that, we are tying up with two new banks.

margin.statement: Current margin levels sustainable as technology handles growth without increasing employee strength or overheads
margin.quote: We are using so much technology that the current expenses take care of the growth in business, so that is why our margins are improving.

margin.statement: EBITDA grew 54% YoY due to operating leverage from technology-driven model with minimal manual intervention
margin.quote: Sir, it's all operating leverage. The entire system is technology-driven. There is minimum manual intervention in the entire system.

order_book.statement: Onboarded 24 new corporate partners in Q2 FY27 across manufacturing, hospitality, education, apparel, technology and financial services
order_book.quote: During Q2 FY27, we continue to expand our partnerships network across the Earned Wage Access segment. We have onboarded 24 new corporate partners across manufacturing, hospitality, education, apparel, technology and financial services.

order_book.statement: Total corporate partners now 270; employee base 40,000-42,000 with 5,500 monthly transacting (12-13% engagement)
order_book.quote: So as now we have 270 corporates. Slowly and steadily, we are onboarding all these corporates migrating all these corporates to the Emerald Ekam platform.

order_book.statement: MSME loan book AUM at INR131 crores as of Q2 FY27, up from INR125 crores in June 2026
order_book.quote: See as on date our current AUM is INR131 crores.

capex.statement: Technology and AI adoption across departments eliminates need for additional headcount to support growth
capex.quote: Talin is very good in adoption of technology, and we have put artificial intelligence in a number of our departments. So the need for more employees was not required.

pricing_cost.statement: MSME loans average ticket INR40 lakhs at ~18% yield; EWA max limit INR1 lakh at 30-36% IRR
pricing_cost.quote: So MSME loans average ticket is about INR40 lakhs, and yield is around 18%. For EWA, about INR1 lakh is the maximum limit. There is no downward limit. Minimum is INR100, and maximum is up to INR1 lakh for the EWA program, and IRR over there is around 30% to 36%.

product_mix.statement: Launched Emerald Ekam integrated financial wellness platform combining salary access, loans, investments, insurance and employee benefits
product_mix.quote: I'm very glad to announce the launch of Emerald Ekam. It's an integrated financial wellness platform that brings salary access, loans, investments, insurance and the employee benefits together under one digital roof.

product_mix.statement: Revenue mix in Q2 FY27: 49% interest income, 39.2% distribution, 11.8% EWA business
product_mix.quote: This quarter of the total INR100 what we have earned, 49% is from the interest income and 39.2% is from the distribution business and 11.8% from the EWA business.

fund_raise.statement: NSE listing planned after March 2027 audited balance sheet; requires net worth >INR75 crores for 3 consecutive years
fund_raise.quote: NSE listing requirement is for 3 consecutive years, our net worth should be more than INR75 crores. And for the last 2 years in the '25 year, sorry -- so the net was more than INR75 crores.

risk.statement: Gold loan volumes may recover in next 2 quarters if gold prices stabilize; new bank partnerships to offset decline
risk.quote: I think gold loan business should -- if the gold prices stabilize, I think we should pick up in the next 2 quarters.

risk.statement: Management emphasizes steady, collection-focused growth over aggressive disbursement; cites 30 years experience and Aditya Puri/Tushar Chopra philosophy
risk.quote: Now ramping up the NBFC business much easy, if we have a today top line of INR10 crores we can make INR20 crores in six months. But then it's not a disbursement business, it's a collection business.

other.statement: EWA retention rate 90%; users transact until they leave organization; challenge is getting first transaction
other.quote: Our retention rate in EWA is 90%. So once a user/customer transacts once, they will keep transacting until they leave the organization.

other.statement: Gold loan business under stress due to RBI tightening gold loan distribution policy and bank appraisal/sourcing practices
other.quote: During this quarter, the gold loan business has been under a little stress. That's basically DSA business because of certain regulatory requirements, which has influenced bank appraisals and the sourcing practices.

guidance.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin of 21%-22% going forward
guidance.quote: Yes, around 21%-22% is a sustainable EBITDA margin even going forward.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 10%-12% for next year assuming no realization change
guidance.quote: Overall, assume that if there is no change in the realization from now onward, for the next year at least, the guidance will be the revenue will increase at least around 10%-12%.

guidance.statement: Expects 9%-10% tonnage growth in H2 FY27 and medium term
guidance.quote: The similar growth we are expecting even in the second half of the year.

demand.statement: October tonnage growth ~20% YoY driven by festival demand and own fleet advantage
demand.quote: Our tonnage growth in the month of October is around 20% plus compared to year-on-year.

demand.statement: Volume growth across all industries; FMCG and textile stronger during festival season
demand.quote: No, across all industry, because it is a widespread operations what we are having. Considering these festival seasons and all, now FMCG and textile, there is a good growth compared to the industrial and other segments.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 23.3% from 19.7% YoY
margin.quote: Correspondingly, the EBITDA margin expanded to 23.3% from 19.7% in the corresponding quarter last year, an improvement of 367 basis points.

margin.statement: Expects EBITDA margin to sustain at 23%+ in near term, 21%-22% long term
margin.quote: But as of now, considering these volumes and the current cost structure, whatever it is there, the 23% plus margin is sustainable.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex INR158 cr (INR76 cr Q1, INR82 cr Q2) for vehicles and land/buildings
capex.quote: Our capital expenditure for the first half stood at around INR158 crores, comprising around INR76 crores in quarter one and INR82 crores in quarter two.

pricing_cost.statement: Freight rate hikes of ~5% in April and ~4% in May drove 9% realization improvement
pricing_cost.quote: We did an increase at the beginning of the year from April 1st around 5% and in mid of May, we increased around 4%. There is a 9% increase in the freight rates.

pricing_cost.statement: Fuel cost per litre rose from ~INR85 to INR97, pressuring operating costs
pricing_cost.quote: The cost per litre increased significantly from approximately INR 85- INR 97, putting pressure on our operating cost structure.

product_mix.statement: Realization improvement driven by freight rate hikes, not route mix; intra-state and inter-state margins similar
product_mix.quote: Going forward, because of addition of new branches and new routes, that is not a significant contribution to the realization. The realization is directly related to the freight rates.

risk.statement: If fuel price drops >5%, will cut freight rates ~2.5% but maintain margins via selective route pricing and bulk procurement savings
risk.quote: If tomorrow, assume that the scenario changes, definitely that option will be always open with us. Whatever savings we will do out of the bulk purchase, that is again will benefit to improve in the margins and no need to pass on that benefit to the customers.

other.statement: Trade receivable cycle healthy at ~10-11 days due to paid/to-pay LTL model
other.quote: Consequently, our trade receivable cycle remains very healthy at approximately hardly around 10 - 11 days.

other.statement: H1 FY27 operating cash flow before WC changes INR415 cr; net operating cash flow INR363 cr
other.quote: The cash generated from operations before working capital changes is around INR415 crores, compared with around INR314 crores in the last first half year. Net cash generated from operating activities increased to INR363 crores from INR334 crores.

guidance.statement: Management does not target specific margins; focus is on volume growth and affordable pricing
guidance.quote: Just to clarify, we don't target any specific margins. The margins you see, which are best-in-class despite an ARPOB that is significantly lower than peers, are a reflection of the huge amount of effort we've put in over the past 10 years in digitization, process improvement, supply chain and addressing every single driver of unnecessary cost in the company.

guidance.statement: Will not give up on insurance nor pursue at any cost; adapting strategy, keeping spend low; clinics proven valuable and will continue
guidance.quote: Prithvi, neither we will give up on insurance nor we will pursue this at any cost. There were a set of strategies we had in mind when we first started out, and some did not work as well as expected. We are adapting and pivoting, and we're keeping the amount of money spent as low as possibly we can.

guidance.statement: UK business evaluated over 5-7 year horizon; insurance not measured on standalone ROCE; target is zero cash burn in insurance
guidance.quote: For the U.K. business, I think a 5 to 7-year time horizon is a good way of looking at the business because we have just entered and there is a journey that we have to achieve on that business. As far as the insurance business is concerned, we are not running a stand-alone health insurance company. It's part of the continuum of care.

guidance.statement: UK revenue recovery of 3-4 million additional per quarter would start showing cost benefits; annualized effects over several quarters
guidance.quote: So even if you go 1 or 2 quarters back, which is just 3 million, 4 million additional revenue for the quarter, we will start seeing these benefits flow in. But more significantly, once -- with time because these are changes we've made very recently. So the effect of them will flow in over a few quarters.

demand.statement: IP volumes up 4% YoY, OP footfall up 12.5% YoY; ARPOB rose from INR17.5M to INR19.5M annualised YoY
demand.quote: So on IP volumes, we've seen 4% increase year-on-year. OP footfall, we've seen around 12.5% growth. ARPOB, as you said, has increased from INR17.5 million to INR19.5 million (annualised) year-on-year, as we focus more on high-end procedures and greater use of robotics.

demand.statement: IP footfalls grew 6% QoQ and ~4% YoY; Eastern cluster transition issue settling; expect stronger footfall growth in Q3 and Q4
demand.quote: Our IP footfalls have actually grown 6% quarter-on-quarter and almost 4% year-on-year. So we have been seeing IP growth on a continued basis between quarter.

demand.statement: Cayman hospital growth driven by integrated care strategy and cost reduction; best growth days behind due to island size; focus on securing patient base
demand.quote: We've always maintained the best days of growth for Cayman are behind it. Our size is a limiting factor and an anchor on our growth in that small island.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 India hospital EBITDA margin exceeded 26%, among industry best, despite ARPOB well below peers
margin.quote: And on the margin side, yes, it has gone up to more than 26%, which is now among the best in the industry, even though our ARPOB remains well below peers.

margin.statement: Doctors and nursing costs fell 1.9% QoQ due to operating leverage on largely fixed clinical cost base
margin.quote: Along with better realizations, we've also had the benefit of operating leverage on the costs where our doctors and nursing costs have come down by 1.9% QoQ, which has added to the margin.

margin.statement: Q2 margin uplift seasonal; Q3 typically muted; do not guide margins; follow industry trend for forecasting
margin.quote: We do not guide on margins, but as you know, quarters are seasonal in health care. Q2 is a higher margin quarter. Q3 is slightly muted. So you should go with the trend you've seen in health care rather than extrapolate the current quarter.

capex.statement: Adding ~635 beds in FY28; quarterly addition guidance given 1 quarter in advance as facilities commission
capex.quote: As and when our facilities are ready to be commissioned, we will share that guidance 1 quarter in advance.

pricing_cost.statement: Oncology drugs under price cap are only part of 15% oncology revenue; caps effective Nov 9; company supports transparent affordable pricing
pricing_cost.quote: Oncology is about 15% of India hospital revenue, and the drugs that have come under the cap are only a part of it. I think the caps will go live from 9th of November, and we'll have a better idea at that point in time.

product_mix.statement: AI used in radiology (proven), voice bots, data interpretation for patient lists and OT scheduling; no decision-making errors; focused on low-hanging efficiency fruit
product_mix.quote: AI in radiology predates LLMs. This is a technology that's fairly proven and is not prone towards making mistakes. AI-based radiology interpretation is now the gold standard the world over. We've been using it with great success. The rest of our applications use voice bots or just simple data interpretations from the information that we have to generate, say, for example, a set of patients with ou

risk.statement: Cybersecurity a huge concern; cannot revert to pen-and-paper; must spend more on better systems; recent vulnerability patched quickly
risk.quote: The wrong response to AI-powered attacks on critical infrastructure is to say, okay, let's go back to pen and paper. We cannot go back to those days. We've seen so much efficiency gain. Our patients move through the system much faster. Our nurses are less hassled at work. There's so much information flowing in our systems that going back to pen and paper is impossible for us. We just need to spend

other.statement: Insurance loss INR14 crore, clinic loss INR8 crore in Q2 FY27; clinic business merging into hospital reporting
other.quote: Health insurance is around INR14 crores and clinics around INR8 crores. Last quarter, insurance was INR19 crores, which has now come down to INR14 crores, and clinics from INR14 crores to INR8 crores.

other.statement: International patients 6-7% of hospital revenue, mainly from Bangladesh; growth organic, not targeted; subject to macro fluctuations
other.quote: International patients contribute around 6% to 7% of hospital revenue, but it is not something we specifically target. And when it comes to the volume, it is subject to a lot of these macro issues, which can fluctuate quarter-on-quarter.

guidance.statement: Revenue target of Rs 1,000 crores by FY28
guidance.quote: Our ambition is to achieve Rs. 1,000 crores in annual revenue by FY '28.

demand.statement: Overall demand very good across most industries, positive outlook for future
demand.quote: Overall demand is very good in the market. As we already said, we are supplying to many of the industries. So, I think one or two industries is down, but otherwise many industries are doing really good and the demand is very good.

margin.statement: Management targets sustainable double-digit EBITDA margins, aims for improvement
margin.quote: I think double digit EBITDA is a good in this kind of market scenario. And we are trying to get over those things.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 12.41%, H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 14.34%
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 1,188.55 lakhs up by Rs. 101.97% year-on-year with a margin of 12.41%.

capex.statement: Fully automated Khalapur facility for 1,000-liter IBC containers expected operational by Q3 FY27
capex.quote: Our fully automated Khalapur facility for 1,000-liter IBC container is expected to be operational by Q3 FY 2027.

pricing_cost.statement: No hedging of polymer prices, 90-95% sourced domestically
pricing_cost.quote: In India, polymers have not been hedged officially. So, definitely, we are also not doing the same thing. And we are buying 90% or 95% from India.

product_mix.statement: Focusing on higher margin products, niche items share increased to 16%+ from 13-15%
product_mix.quote: We were at around 13%, 14%, 15%. And now it is around 16% plus. So, I think, we consider this is a good and you will see a good progress, as like you can see 30% Y-o-Y.

product_mix.statement: Industrial packaging 81.88%, hospital furniture parts 16.27%, infrastructure furniture 1.86% of Q1 FY27 revenue
product_mix.quote: Industrial packaging revenue stood at approximately 81.88%, hospital furniture parts revenue approximately 16.27%, infrastructure furniture and other recorded revenue of approximately 1.86% of total revenue for Q1 FY '26-27.

risk.statement: No significant impact from West Asia geopolitical tensions on exports or projects
risk.quote: Not as such. For the export market, not as such.

other.statement: Current capacity can support revenue of approximately Rs 425 crores without additional capex
other.quote: So, approximately Rs. 425 crores you can reach easily.

other.statement: Exports currently ~1.5% of revenue, major markets USA, Canada, Europe, expecting growth after approvals
other.quote: So, the export yet not grown up good, but yes, in 6 months, around 1.5% of the total growth.

guidance.statement: EdTech revenues likely flat for ~1 year then grow; margins stable to slightly up with higher online mix
guidance.quote: The revenues are likely to be around the current number for maybe another one year or so, after which I see them increasing.

guidance.statement: DEXIT H2 revenue expected to expand over previous year due to contract accruals
guidance.quote: A significant chunk of that will accrue in H2, and that should result in a revenue expansion in DEXIT in H2 over the previous year.

guidance.statement: CL Media (platform monetization) expected to see solid H2 with significant revenue growth
guidance.quote: I think this vertica l will see a pretty solid H2, and a significant revenue growth in this segment is expected, accompanied by a reasonably positive EBITDA margin

demand.statement: Test prep market facing headwinds across segments; EdTech revenue declined 13% in H1 FY27
demand.quote: The test prep business continues to face headwinds, and this is a factor evident across almost all test prep segments, affecting most of the test prep players.

margin.statement: EdTech EBITDA margin expanded ~400 bps to ~22% in H1 FY27
margin.quote: Our EdTech margin expanded by about 400 basis points, from 17.5% to close to 22%.

margin.statement: DEXIT EBITDA margin expanded ~171 bps in H1 FY27
margin.quote: The EBITDA margin has shown an expansion of about 171 basis points in H1 as compared to H1 of last year.

margin.statement: MarTech EBITDA grew ~26.7% with margin expansion ~100% in H1 FY27
margin.quote: In the MarTech business, the revenue, as I have already shared, has expanded by about 14%, EBITDA by about 26.7%, a margin expansion of about 100%.

order_book.statement: DEXIT renewed and extended contracts with IIBF and DGFMS for 2-3 years
order_book.quote: The contracts with IIBF and DGFMS have got renewed and extended for a further period of two to three years.

order_book.statement: DEXIT multi-year contract wins total ₹172 crore over 2-3 years, with ₹40 crore expected in current fiscal year
order_book.quote: The total multi-year contract wins, as we speak, aggregate to about ₹ 172 crores, which will get delivered over the next two to three years.

capex.statement: DEXIT increasing capacity to be eligible for NEET and other large government exams
capex.quote: we are l ooking at increasing our capacity so that we are eligible for the NEET exam or any other exam whenever it comes up

pricing_cost.statement: Overhead costs reduced by ₹12.5 crore in H1 FY27 vs H1 FY26; full-year savings estimated at ₹20-22 crore
pricing_cost.quote: The critical element to note is the decline in the overhead cost by about ₹ 12.5 crores in the first six months as compared to the same cost in H1 of last year.

product_mix.statement: EdTech revenue mix shifted toward franchise network partners, aiding higher EBITDA margin and ARPU
product_mix.quote: Our revenue mix coming from various channels — which is basically our franchise partners and what is coming from our digital and company-owned centers — has moved more towards network, and this has aided a greater achievement of a higher EBITDA margin.

risk.statement: NEET CBT opportunity split among multiple vendors; DEXIT share uncertain; Nilekani panel report awaited Jan 2027
risk.quote: It is safe to assume that it will not be given to one player; it will be split between multiple parties, as has been the case for government exams in the past.

other.statement: MarTech international revenue now 40%, India 60%; new wins with Infosys, Salesforce, Dell; pilots with 3-5 corporates for DEXIT internal exams
other.quote: International revenues now account for about 40% and the India revenues account for about 60%.

other.statement: Received term sheet for ₹100 crore listed NCDs to refinance acquisition lenders; completion expected in 4-6 weeks
other.quote: We have also received a term sheet from a lender for ₹ 100 crores of debt raise in the form of listed NCDs. This will largely be used to refinance a couple of existing long-term acquisition lenders.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance maintained at 30-35% YoY, internal target beyond 30%
guidance.quote: As I mentioned, our current guidance is to deliver year-on-year growth in the range of 30% to 35%. Based on the run rate we are seeing this year, there could potentially be an upside to this guidance, and internally, we are targeting growth beyond 30%.

guidance.statement: FY28 EBITDA margin expected around 7% with potential to reach 7.5-8%
guidance.quote: Based on our experience across various projects and the cost models currently in place with the Group, we expect the overall cost impact to remain in the range of approximately 7%.

demand.statement: Strong execution visibility from order book, projects max 36-month timeline
demand.quote: So maximum project time line for any of the projects which is included in this order book is not going beyond 36 months. So we can consider that this is to be done in 2.5 at most is 3 years.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 6.30% vs 6.12% in H1 FY26
margin.quote: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 6.30% compared to 6.12% in H1 FY26.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 6.21% vs 7.10% in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: EBITDA margin is at 6.21%, which was 7.10% similar earlier quarter.

margin.statement: Adani projects operate on cost-plus model with material cost pass-through, limiting margin risk
margin.quote: Our order book is almost 75% is Adani and 25% is non-Adani. If you understand that we are working with Adani Group as cost-plus percentage only. So all the material cost difference has to be reimbursed by the group.

order_book.statement: Order book at INR12,872 crores as of Sep 2026, up 30% YoY
order_book.quote: As of 30th September 2026, outstanding order book stood at INR12,872 crores, 30% year-on-year growth, providing a healthy multiyear revenue visibility.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 order inflow of INR1,305 crores including INR675 crores in Q2
order_book.quote: During H1FY27, we secured order inflow of approximately INR1,305 crores, including INR675 crores during the second quarter.

order_book.statement: Full year order inflow guidance maintained at INR5,000 crores plus
order_book.quote: Yes. I am still expecting at the end of the year, overall, , we will be in the range of INR5,000 crores plus.

capex.statement: Q2 FY27 capex of INR62 crores, H1 FY27 capex of INR91 crores
capex.quote: During Q2FY27, company has incurred capex of INR62 crores. And in half year ended 30th September, capex stands at INR91 crores.

capex.statement: Annual capex guidance at 3-4% of revenue to support 25-35% growth
capex.quote: See that will be again, as I always said that it should be in the range of 3% to 4% of our revenue. Because if you are expanding at 25% to 30% each year you require minimum 3%, 4% of capex.

capex.statement: FY27 total capex expected around INR190-200 crores (INR90 crores H1 + INR100 crores H2)
capex.quote: For half year, we have incurred around INR90 crores. So further around INR100 crores we might be incurring.

risk.statement: Geographical concentration: ~70% projects in Gujarat, ~25% in Maharashtra
risk.quote: Around 70% of the projects are within Gujarat only, around 25% is within Maharashtra. And we have small projects in many states, but those are not significant.

other.statement: Small precast capex of INR5-10 crores planned for molds/machines, sheds already ready for doubling
other.quote: Today, we are not in that plan, but small capex is always being because small things which is related to project we require for machines or some molds. So that will not be substantial, it will be in the range of INR5 crores to INR10 crores.

other.statement: Order book split: 72% group (Adani) projects, 28% external
other.quote: Of the total order book within group projects account for approximately 72% (INR9,229) crores, while external projects contribute the remaining 28%.

guidance.statement: FY27 order inflow target of INR4,500 crores
guidance.quote: So FY '27, the original guidance was INR4,500 crores. I believe that as I speak to you today, we have done ~ INR2,500 crores or whereabouts.

guidance.statement: FY27 cash PAT margin guidance 10.5% to 11.25%
guidance.quote: And we have given cash PAT levels of between 10.5% to 11.25% thereabouts, and we continue to maintain that level.

guidance.statement: FY28 revenue guidance of INR4,000 crores
guidance.quote: Yes. At the moment, our guidance remains unchanged. FY '28 at INR4,000 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance 15.5% to 16.5%
guidance.quote: So we have given a guidance in the quarter 1 itse lf of 15.5% to 16.5% at EBITDA level

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 15.5%
margin.quote: EBITDA margin for Q2 FY '27 stood at 15.5%.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 15.6%
margin.quote: EBITDA margin for H1 FY '27 came in at 15.6%.

margin.statement: Commodity price pressure mitigated by escalation clauses
margin.quote: While elevated commodity prices continue to exert some pressure on the margins, the impact was substantially mitigated through contractual escalation clauses embedded in our projects for key raw material.

order_book.statement: Order book at INR13,013 crores as of September 30, 2026
order_book.quote: As mentioned earlier, order book stood at INR13,013 crores as on September 30, 2026, with a balanced mix of 54% coming from public sector and 46% from the private sector projects.

order_book.statement: New orders worth INR2,487 crores secured in FY27 so far
order_book.quote: During FY '27, thus far, we have secured new orders worth INR2,487 crores, reinforcing our market position and creating a solid foundation for sustained growth.

order_book.statement: Active bid negotiations for INR3,270 crores
order_book.quote: So we have active bid negotiations going on for INR3,270 crores. The bid pipeline is very strong and we see no reason wh y we will not surpass our annual target provided to you

capex.statement: Full year FY27 formwork procurement budget INR135-140 crores
capex.quote: Since the order pipeline is very strong, I do believe that the entire budgeted procurement of INR135 crores to INR140 crores will be required and completed in the current financial year.

capex.statement: FY27 capex ~INR80 crores funded via term loans
capex.quote: We have invested about INR80 crores in capex, majority of which has come through term loans.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 formwork purchase INR64.2 crores, plant & machinery INR10.57 crores
capex.quote: The total formwork purchase is INR64.2 crores and the plant and machinery purchase is INR10.57 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Steel prices increased from INR47,000 to INR62,000 per metric ton
pricing_cost.value: INR47,000 to INR62,000 per metric ton
pricing_cost.quote: See, at the moment, the steel prices, which were INR47,000 three months ago, today are hovering around INR62,000 per metric ton.

pricing_cost.statement: Aluminum formwork cost increased 40% from INR10,500 to INR14,500 per sqm
pricing_cost.quote: Aluminum formwork has gone from INR10,500 per square meter to INR14,500 representing a 40% increase.
