risk.statement: NGT disruption risk in NCR: 15-20 days assumed, but could be 45 days
risk.quote: If the disruption is 15 days or so, no issues at all. If it is 20 days, we will still cope up from the other projects. However, if it is 45 days, I cannot give a number to that.

risk.statement: Commodity price volatility risk; margin improvement dependent on escalation catch-up
risk.quote: If the commodity prices stabilize and the escalation clauses in the government tender match those increases then yes, you will see improvement from quarter 4. But if the prices of main commodities are so volatile that between quarter 1 and 2, you see a gap of 35%, then it's very difficult to give a prediction.

other.statement: Monthly run rate crossed INR260 crores, targeting INR300 crores by Q4 FY27
other.quote: We have already crossed in the previous month more than INR260 crores. So we are well positioned to cross INR300 crores run rate by quarter 4.

other.statement: NGT disruption factored at INR45-50 crores revenue loss for Q3 FY27
other.quote: However, we have definitely factored about INR45 crores to INR50 crores of revenue loss.

demand.statement: Hospital growth broad-based; joint replacement flagship, faster growth in nephrology, urology, oncology, general surgery, critical care; specialty mix more balanced
demand.quote: Growth was faster in other specialties, particularly nephrology and urology, oncology, general surgery and critical care. As a result, our speciality mix is becoming more balanced, which is in line with our strategy of building a multispecialty network and reducing dependence on any single speciality.

capex.statement: Majority 80-90% of fresh capital to be invested in hospital business for facility upgrades, technology, and bed additions; MedTech to be self-sustaining with no significant new capital
capex.quote: So whether it is upgrading our facilities, whether it is upgrading the technology, whether it is adding number of beds, all the -- majority, I would say, 80%, 90% of the new capital is going to be invested in the hospitals business.

guidance.statement: Targets RoE of 16% and RoCE of 24% by 2031

guidance.quote: An initiative is expected to generate an incremental EBITDA of close to INR400 crores by FY31.

pricing_cost.quote: We will translate it into orders in the American market at much higher margins, unlike other peers who white-label the insulators. We intend to go directly with our brand inside the US.

product_mix.statement: PCS (power converter) booked at 10-12% margin; battery pass-through; domestic BESS not viable due to regulatory contingent liabilities; focus on export from India
product_mix.quote: We booked the PCS at about 10% to 12%. The battery was a pass-through. But I will have to really push it through the factory to be able to tell you. It's a new product, new factory. Give us some time. About a quarter, I think we will have the published numbers this quarter.

product_mix.statement: Making capacitor and GIS bushings; working with global vendors; will be in both composite and porcelain; not limited to transformer bushings
product_mix.quote: I would rest it at that point. But I can already say that we are making capacitor bushings now, GIS bushings. GIS, we're already started delivering. Capacitors, we're working with a few vendors, global vendors, to be able to deliver. So, bushing does not mean only transformer bushing. Bushing is a very wide category.

fund_raise.statement: QIP targeted around Nov 15-30 after preferential issue listing; EGM done, awaiting regulatory approvals
fund_raise.quote: So, we are waiting so we are waiting for the pref to complete. The pref have to get listed. The EGM was done. The pref listing is expected sometime this week before we open the QIP, but being a holiday season, I think if all the regulatory approvals come in time and everything is in order, I think around November 15th to 30th is what we are targeting.

risk.statement: Global supply chain for specialized electrical equipment remains constrained; geopolitical developments, changing trade conditions, logistics disruptions, extended procurement lead times pressure manufacturers and project schedules
risk.quote: The global supply chain for specialized electrical equipment remains constrained. Geopolitical developments, changing trade conditions, logistics disruptions and extended procurement lead times are placing additional pressure on manufacturers and project schedules.

risk.statement: Cable business requires 4 months cash flow for manufacturing (100-200 tons aluminum, components); working capital negative impact before margin improvement
risk.quote: And the cable business is going to take us about 4 months of cash flow in manufacturing timelines, where we end the vendor credit periods. Obviously, it will improve the margins, but initially you will see a working capital negative impact before it improves.

other.statement: INR300 crores of QIP proceeds earmarked for working capital due to elongated cycle from reverse integration into HVDC CTC cable manufacturing (4 months extra working capital per project) and large order pipeline
other.quote: We are also earmarking about INR300 crores for working capital requirements. We have large order pipeline coming in with our new facilities getting qualified in the next couple of months. We would see a huge input requirement from customers, and we've also reverse integrated in the cable manufacturing business.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue INR285.45 crores, PAT INR63.33 crores (80.10% YoY growth)
other.quote: For the quarter, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR285.45 crores, while profit after tax reached INR63.33 crore, representing a year-on-year growth of 80.10%.

guidance.statement: Expect Q3 FY27 to remain challenging; industry analysts expect agri input earnings to bottom out between October and December 2026 with recovery from Q1 FY28
guidance.quote: We, therefore, expect Q3 FY '27 to remain a challenging quarter. Industry analysts currently expect Agri input earnings to bottom between -- bottom out between October and December 2026 with a recovery from first quarter of FY '28 as weather conditions normalize.

guidance.statement: Priorities for rest of FY27: deepen farmer engagements, expand differentiated portfolio across specialties and biologicals, pursue selective international opportunities, maintain discipline in procurement, inventory, manufacturing
guidance.quote: Our priorities for rest of FY '27 are to deepen farmer enga gements, expand our differentiated product portfolio across specialty products and biologicals, pursu e selective international opportunities and maintain discipline in procurement, inventor y and manufacturing

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 was challenging due to below-normal monsoon, drought in parts of India, and weak pest pressure reducing herbicide, insecticide, and fungicide offtake
demand.quote: The second quarter of FY '27 was challenging for the domestic agrochemical industry, primarily due to below normal and uneven Southwest monsoons.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 12% from 10% YoY; gross margin improved to 29% from 26% YoY
margin.quote: The EBITDA and EBITDA margin stood at INR50.1 crores and 12% in H1 FY '27 compared with INR41.9 crores and 10% in H1 FY '26.

capex.statement: Board proposed reallocating INR8.34Cr unutilized IPO proceeds from in-house DF plant to specialty machinery and dedicated facility for climate stress management and PGR products at Barwasni (9,000 sq ft); expect facility operational by Q4 F
capex.quote: As set out in the notice of our AGM, the Board has proposed reallocati on of INR8.34 crores of unutilized IPO proceeds originally earmarked for an in-house DF plant towards specialty machinery and a dedicated production facility for climate stress manag ement and plant growth regulators product at our Barwasni facility in Sonipat on an area of 9,000 square

pricing_cost.statement: Generic agrochemical prices rose 15-20% Mar-May due to Middle East conflict, rupee depreciation, freight, packaging, solvent costs; since June prices corrected to pre-conflict levels; elevated channel inventory and weak demand constrained p
pricing_cost.quote: In the preceding months, the Middle East conflict and related supply chain disruption pushed generic agrochemical prices up by roughly 15% to 20% between March and May, alongside rupee depreciation and higher freight, packaging and solvent costs. Since June, prices of several generic products have corrected to pre-co nflict levels, while elevated channel inventory and weak demand constrained the i

product_mix.statement: H1 FY27 channel mix: B2C 59%, B2B 35%, exports 6%; Crop Protection 85%, Plant Nutrients 5%, Biologicals 6%
product_mix.quote: Our H1 FY '27 channel mix comprised B2C at 59%, B2B at 35% and exports at 6% of the revenue. During H1 FY '27, Crop Protection contributed 85% of revenue, while Plant Nutrients and biological contributed 5% and 6%, respectively, with the balance from other products.

product_mix.statement: 3 new specialty products commercialized in H1 FY27; one launched in September quarter received positive response; 3 products (Shaan, Polgar, another) sold ~INR11-12Cr in H1
product_mix.quote: Our 3 products has given us good sales in this first half and this one particular product Shaan has already sold in the last six months of around INR4.5 crores and P olgar is around INR4.25 crores. Sanjay Aggarwal: Means almost another Company also, we have sold the products. So almost INR11 crores, INR12 crores we have done maybe means we are quite hopeful for H2 also for these 3

other.statement: Negative operating cash flow in H1 FY27 due to increased debtors and inventory; expect positive operating cash flow in H2 FY27
other.quote: We are expecting in the second half, we will be in the positive position.

other.statement: Working with ICAR for 3 years on stress management products; collaborating with Pusa Institute for product development
other.quote: Also in the long term, we have been in the agreement with ICAR for three years where we are developing some stress management products for long term, and we are working closely with the Pusa Institute for the development of a few products in the times to come in this category.

guidance.statement: Revenue guidance for FY27 reiterated at INR3,200-3,500 crores, representing 60% growth over FY26
guidance.quote: We had a guidance to revenue of approximately INR3,200 crores to INR3,500 crores for the full financial year FY27. This would represent growth of 60% compared with FY26

demand.statement: Healthy demand from retail partners driving 25.4% volume growth in Q2 and 41% in H1 FY27
demand.quote: Our volume has also increased by 25.4% in the quarter and 41.0%in the first half, reflecting healthy demand from all our retail partners and our ability to scale up execution

margin.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin guidance of 5-7% given evolving product mix and growth phase
margin.quote: Broadly speaking, we should be in the range of 5 to 7% EBITDA looking at the current dynamics, current market situation

capex.statement: Marol facility operational, Jaipur facility interior work ongoing targeting Jan-Feb commissioning
capex.quote: Jaipur facility. The furniture means the interior work and, things are going on. Very soon we should be starting once it's finished, maybe Jan or Feb or something

product_mix.statement: Expanding product portfolio across designer, Turkish jewelry, plain gold, CZ and advanced gold categories
product_mix.quote: We have been expanding our offering across categories including designer and Turkish jewelry while deeply deepening engagement with existing customers and onboarding new retail clients

fund_raise.statement: Rights issue of INR99.83 crores fully utilized for working capital requirements
fund_raise.quote: During the quarter, we also successfully raised approximately INR99.83 crores through a rights issue. The proceeds are being deployed towards meeting the Company's working capital requirement

risk.statement: Gold price volatility not seen as structural risk due to natural hedging and inventory discipline
risk.quote: Our risk management policy is centered around natural hedging and inventory discipline. That's number one. Having said that, gold has historically demonstrated resilience across economic cycles

other.statement: Gold metal loans (GML) at 15-20% of stock profile, comfortable increasing to 30% for hedging
other.quote: As of now it's still, at 15%-20% of the stock profile, but we are comfortable going up to 30% looking at the current market dynamics and all

other.statement: Deepening engagement with existing retail partners and onboarding new retail clients across South, West, North and East India
other.quote: We are expanding in new geographies, initially we were present only in South India, then we reached out to West Market. Now we have increased our presence in North India and also in East India

order_book.statement: Massive order volume from corporates with pipeline of 80 showrooms in 2 years; all major corporates associated
order_book.quote: Today we have a massive volume of orders. Corporates are expanding rapidly in India. I cannot name some corporates, but they have pipeline programs for 80 showrooms within two years.

capex.statement: Setting up wholly-owned subsidiary with initial investment of INR 2-5 crores for new jewellery categories
capex.quote: we have thought that first we open a subsidiary with a very minimal fund, like INR2 crores, INR4 crores, INRS crores at most, since it is a new venture

pricing_cost.statement: Profitability improves with rising gold prices due to percentage-based charging model; volumes remain intact
pricing_cost.quote: If gold prices increase, our profitability actually improves. The reason is that we charge on a percentage basis. If I charge 6% on a product worth INR1,00,000, I earn INR6,000. If that same product becomes worth INR1,50,000, manufacturing it earns me INR9,000.

risk.statement: Gold price volatility makes consumers cautious; recycling model (old gold exchange) limits 100% outright sales
risk.quote: If the price of gold were to reach, say, $5,000 US dollars per ounce, which translates to roughly INR1,70,000 to INR1,80,000, customers looking to purchase 100 grams of gold might choose to bring in 60 grams of their existing gold and pay for only the remaining 40 grams.

other.statement: Board approved wholly-owned subsidiary for diversified jewellery manufacturing, design, trading, distribution across B2B/B2C
other.quote: Regarding the timeline, we just received board approval for this yesterday. Now, the company will be incorporated, its portals will be developed, designs will be created, and all new brand names will be registered.

other.statement: Manufacturing capacity increased from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; bridal segment started with 20 karigars, scaled to 40
other.quote: We have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

guidance.statement: Maintains FY27 revenue guidance of INR1900 crores with 10-10.5% EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: On guidance, we are maintaining our FY27 outlook of INR1900 crores of revenue with a 10 % to 10.5% EBITDA margin.

guidance.statement: Targets 25-30% revenue CAGR for next couple of years
guidance.quote: And going forward also, like, we are doing this here, we are growing at 25% to 30% CAGR, and going forward also, that will be our endeavor to grow at 25% to 30%.

margin.statement: Gross margin fell 2.3% in H1 due to steel cost rising faster than pass-through on existing orders
margin.quote: First is, the steel and other input cost rose faster than we could pass them through on orders already being executed. So, our gross margin fell by almost 2.3%.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin recovered to 10.1% from 9.4% in Q1; expects H2 margins to improve further
margin.quote: Our Q2 margin already recovered to 10.1% from 9.4% in quarter one, and H2 will see more of our orders priced at curre nt input price, as well as the inventory built up has given us a lot of confidence that we will be able to improve upon our gross margin in this quarter and the quarter next to this

capex.statement: No new capex needed in FY27-28; focus on utilizing new plants at Ghiloth and Gujarat
capex.quote: For '27, '28, actually we won't need any capex, new capex. The idea on 20 of '27, '28 would be to do the utilization of the new plants that we have set up.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices rose 17-18% in Q2 but margins still improved due to price escalations on existing orders
pricing_cost.quote: Although at the same time in this quarter itself, the raw material prices have gone up by as much as 17% to 18%, but still the margins of the company improved.

pricing_cost.statement: New orders priced at current input cost; pushing for escalation clauses but not yet standard practice
pricing_cost.quote: Every new order is now priced on current input cost, and we have long-term sourcing arrangements in place. We're also pushing for price escalation clauses with our large customers. Yes, some of the customers have agreed, but it hasn't become a standard practice yet.

product_mix.statement: Data center subsidiary under discussion for DFMA products with one large customer; timeline uncertain
product_mix.quote: This data center company which we floated in the last quarter, is related to one of the opportunities that has come our way. So, it is still under discussions. It is one big large customer to whom we are talking to, like make some DFM products for them, DFMA products for them.

product_mix.statement: Received first data center structural steel order in Q3; existing capacity handles heavy structures up to 2m web width; no additional capex needed
product_mix.quote: we are getting our fi rst order of structural steel supplying to the data center in this quarter and it is a heavy structure but in effect, the best part is whatever investment we have done in the past, a lot of investment, accommodates both heavy struct ure as well as the PEB building

risk.statement: Steel prices at peak (HR ~INR70,000/ton); no further near-term increase expected; margins recovered in Q2 despite 17-18% input cost rise
risk.quote: The steel prices now, HR price is almost INR70,000 a ton, and they are at their peak level. So, I do not foresee any more increase in steel prices to happen in the near future.

other.statement: Commissioned 13,000 tons steel processing capacity and sandwich panel line at Ghiloth Unit 5
other.quote: On 30th of October, about 3, 4 last week only, we have added 13,000 tons of steel capacity, processing capacity at our Ghiloth Greenfield project that is Unit 5, and we also commissioned our sandwich panel line in Ghiloth, Rajasthan.

other.statement: Peak revenue potential at current capacity is INR2,800-3,000 crores
other.quote: With this plant that we have just commissioned at Ghiloth for the sandwich panels, plus the one which is coming up in Gujarat, with that, the total capacity of the company would be to do a revenue of close to INR2,800 crores to INR3,000 crores.

guidance.statement: Targets 25% average revenue growth and 20% profit growth for FY27 over FY26; EBITDA growth not quantified
guidance.quote: We hope that this year we will see an average growth of 25% from the last year. We will also see a 20% increase in profit from the last year.

guidance.statement: Aims for fabrication business to contribute 5-7% of revenue and 10% of EBITDA by FY28
guidance.quote: By FY28, we aim to derive 5% to 7% of revenue and 10% of EBITDA from the fabrication business.

guidance.statement: Targets fabrication revenue contribution up to 10% of total revenue from PEB and railway segments
guidance.quote: Our goal is to scale the fabrication revenue contribution up to 10% of total revenue from PEB and railway segments.

demand.statement: Steel demand in Bihar very strong due to massive infrastructure growth; prices rising ₹2,500/ton monthly with no near-term correction expected
demand.quote: Demand, especially in Bihar, remains very strong due to massive infrastructure growth. We don't see any price drops expected i n the near future; in fact, prices are being increased by ₹ 2,500 per ton monthly by manufacturers, and demand remains strong supported by recent government funding

margin.statement: Fabrication EBITDA margin expected at 9-11% (Neeraj) and 10-12% (Chairman); distribution blended margin healthy with flat products better than long
margin.quote: We believe EBITDA margins in the fabrication business range between 9% to 11%, which will play a critical role in enhancing overall company profitability going forward.

order_book.statement: Fabrication order book stands at ₹76.5 crore as of September 30, split ₹50.8 crore PEB/railway and ₹25.7 crore Bihar Railway RDSO-approved orders
order_book.quote: As of September 30, our fabrication order book stands at a healthy ₹76.5 crore, which includes ₹50.8 crore from PEB and railway orders, and ₹25.7 crore from the Bihar Railway RDSO-approved unit orders.

capex.statement: Welding electrode plant in Purnea built, commercial production starts November; fabrication capex ~₹5 crore for machines when utilization reaches 60-70%; land parcels (43 acres Purnea, 15 acres Kolkata) available for future expansion
capex.quote: Around 5 crore, because we already have land parcel available. So if there is a requirement, it will be for the machines.

pricing_cost.statement: 66% revenue via dealer retail where Tata Steel fixes prices; project sales priced competitively; HR/CR/GP sheets follow Tata Steel structured pricing with premiums over other brands
pricing_cost.quote: Around 66% of our revenue comes through direct dealer retail sales where Tata Steel fixes the prices, and we supply accordingly while maintaining our warehouse margins. For project sales, we price competitively based on demand and project scale.

product_mix.statement: Expanding into value-added: tailor-made re-bars, PEB fabrication, railway structures, welding electrodes (own brand), nails (own brand), profiling GC sheets, brackets for Tata Steel
product_mix.quote: We are setting up a welding electrode plant in Purne a. Th e plant is built, and commercial production will start this November. We will manufacture and sell under our own brand using our existing network

other.statement: CRISIL rating upgraded to A- from BBB-; focus on reducing inventory days, cash conversion cycle, and interest costs
other.quote: I would like to tell you that the BBB minus that we got from CRISIL has been upgraded to A minus this year.

other.statement: Interim dividend ₹1.5/share declared for current year; paid ₹1.5/share last year; aims to reward shareholders consistently as profits grow
other.quote: We also distributed an interim dividend of ₹1.5 per share last year, and our board has announced another interim dividend of ₹1.5 per share. We aim to reward our shareholders consistently as profits grow.

guidance.statement: Medium-term revenue aspiration of INR 1,000 crores with exports contributing 25-30%
guidance.quote: Our medium-term aspiration is to scale our overall revenue to INR1,000 crores with exports contributing approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.statement: FY27 volume growth guidance maintained at 8-10% with pickup expected in H2
guidance.quote: Yes, I think my guidance would be we still remain in line with the volume growth that we had given the guidance on earlier, which is about 8% to 10% and I think you will see that pick up in H2 this year because of the capacity increase.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance maintained at high teens 15-19%
guidance.quote: I think on the growth side, I had earlier given my guidance on high teens, so anywhere between 15% to 19%. So we are in line.

guidance.statement: Export growth guidance: short-term 30-35%, long-term sustainable 20-25%
guidance.quote: My guidance has always been sustainable over the long-term period is more on exports more like 20%, 25%. When I say long term is more like 5 years. But I think short-term growth, we had given a guidance of about 30% to 35%.

demand.statement: Domestic volume ~35 lakh, export volume ~4 lakh in H1 FY27; no demand issues currently; winter seasonality not flagged as concern
demand.quote: So domestic volume is approx 35 lakh and export volume is about 4 lakh.

margin.statement: SMK margins 70-80% higher than Studds margins; new accessories margins in line with respective brand margins
margin.quote: So I would say SMK margins are about close to 70% higher than Studds margins, depending on what kind of times. But if I was to talk about percentage, that will be typically the ballpark we are anywhere between 70% to 80% depending on product to product.

margin.statement: First-year revenue target for jackets INR 15-20 crores; Bluetooth capacity >2 lakh units/year; accessories margins in line with respective brand helmet margins
margin.quote: Starting off, I think the revenue potential from accessories because I said 40,000 jackets. So that's close to about anywhere between INR 15 crores to INR 20 crores.

order_book.statement: Export revenue grew from INR 53.2 crores in FY24 to INR 127.6 crores; H1 FY27 export revenue INR 79.4 crores, up nearly 50% YoY
order_book.quote: In H1 FY27, we recorded export revenue of INR79.4 crores. That's growth of nearly 50% over H1 FY26, reflecting the growing scale of international operations.

capex.statement: FY27 total capex INR 84.7 crores including INR 58.22 crores for new plant
capex.quote: So, our capex spend for FY27 is going to be INR 58.22 crores for the new plant and including the regular capex, the total capex is going to be INR 84.7 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Implemented 9% calibrated price increase (6.5-7% in Q1, balance in Q2); further price hike decision in Q4 depending on raw material prices
pricing_cost.quote: So, the price increase that we've taken is 9%, which was slightly calibrated because about 7% -- 6.5% to 7% price increase we got during the Q1 and the balance we got in the Q2 because there were some older orders, which were committed at the older prices, export especially.

product_mix.statement: SMK premium brand contribution increased from 13% in Q2 FY26 to 20% in Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: We are encouraged by the progress so far with SMK's contribution to overall sales increasing from approximately 13% in Q2 FY26 to 20% in Q2 FY27.

product_mix.statement: Entered riding jackets under SMK brand via in-house manufacturing; target 10,000 units by Mar 27 and 40,000 units next fiscal; launching Bluetooth rider communication system Nov 2026
product_mix.quote: We commenced production in September 2026. We are progressively scaling up this capability with plan of producing 10,000 units by March '27 and 40,000 units by next fiscal year.

risk.statement: Biggest execution risk in foreign markets is ramp-up speed due to high fixed costs; subsidiaries may show losses initially until scale achieved
risk.quote: I think the biggest risk on execution on the foreign markets is the speed at which we actually ramp up operations, and we're able to scale up sales because in these foreign markets, the fixed costs are very high.

other.statement: Styrene-based raw material prices remain elevated in Q3; Q2 slightly better than Q1 but no softening yet; previous cycle lasted 2 years, this one expected slightly smaller
other.quote: In Q3, we were expecting styrenics to soften, but they haven't softened yet. They're still elevated. So as I said, we will wait for this quarter before we take a call for price increase.

other.statement: Key growth geographies: Latin America (volume-driven, less price-sensitive), Europe and US (premium, higher margins)
other.quote: I would place the opportunity in 2 baskets. One is the Latin American market, where it's more of a quantity-driven, it's not as price-sensitive as India, and it's a quantitative driven market because it's a larger motorcycle market. Second, I would see Europe and U.S. as a more of a premium market where you have good margins and higher revenues.

guidance.statement: Management expects EBITDA per kg to reach Rs.60-65 in FY2028
guidance.quote: Hopefully, we expect that maybe around 60 to 65.

demand.statement: Order scenario on renewable side very bullish; transformer deliveries improving; EV and data centre demand growing
demand.quote: Overall, the order scenario what we see on the renewable side is very, very bullish and in fact, just a few days back there was in Bharat Mandapam in Delhi, our Honorable Prime Minister, he also attended and there is a good progress taking place there and in the coming time we will see that renewable projects are going to be very fast and considering this scenario of Middle East problems, now the

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA per kg Rs.59 in H1 FY2027 vs Rs.44 in H1 FY2026, up ~34%
margin.quote: So, FY2027 in Q2, if you see in a half-year basis, we are at EBITDA per kg of Rs.59. So, comparative to for the last half-year FY2026 it was around Rs.44 per kg, so it has grown up by roughly 34%, basically.

capex.statement: IPO funds for ALCU capex being used as planned; unspent amount in fixed deposits; capex largely complete by end of Q3
capex.quote: The IPO funds set aside for the ALCU capex are being used as planned. The amount not yet spent is kept in fixed deposits. We expect the capex to be largely complete by the end of the third quarter in line with the planned completion Shailesh ji spoke about it.

product_mix.statement: New ALCU products EV wire, round ripple, aluminium paper-covered, PV ribbon, copper busbars and foils now on regular orders
product_mix.quote: The new products we launched at ALCU in February are moving well. EV, round ripple and aluminum paper-covered are now being supplied to customers on regular orders. ALCU now has production lines installed for aluminium enameled wires and strips, paper-covered aluminium strips, PV ribbon for solar modules, and copper busbars and foils.

other.statement: First exports from ALCU shipped to Israel and Nepal; target exports to make up a quarter of revenue once expansion complete
other.quote: I am also pleased to tell you that we have started exports from ALCU. The first shipments have gone to Israel and Nepal. This is an early step towards our aim of exports making up a quarter of our revenue once the expansion is complete.

other.statement: ALCU installed capacity currently 10,000-11,000 metric tons; full 18,000 tons expected by mid-December
other.quote: We have not been able to install the entire capacity, so, we are progressing and currently, we believe around 10,000 to 11,000 metric tons have been already installed and by January or somewhere close to that we will be able to do the remaining one.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue target INR750 crore; H1 FY27 at INR376 crore, ahead of 45:55 split plan
guidance.quote: H1 FY27 revenue was at INR376 crores, around half of our FY27 revenue target of INR750 crore. We have always guided to a 45:55 split between the two halves, with the fourth quarter historically our strongest. So we are ahead of plan.

guidance.statement: Gross margin target above 45% for coming quarters
guidance.quote: These controls remain in place and so we see to keep a gross margin above 45% in the next all coming quarters.

guidance.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guided ~17%; H1 FY27 at 17.6% already ahead
guidance.quote: For the first half, EBITDA stood at INR66 crores with margin of 17.6%, already ahead of approximately 17% we guided for the year.

guidance.statement: FY28 guidance to be given in next earnings call (Jan-Feb)
guidance.quote: For FY28, for sure I'll put it on my next earnings call.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin 47.5% vs 40.9% in Q1; raw material cost fell 3% despite 9% revenue growth
margin.quote: Gross margin rose from 40.9% in Q1 to 47.5% in Q2. Raw material cost actually fell by about 3% even as revenue grew by 9%.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 21.1% vs 13.7% in Q1; EBITDA grew 67% sequentially to INR41 crore
margin.quote: EBITDA grew 67% sequentially to INR41 crores, with EBITDA margin at 21.1% against 13.7% in Q1.

order_book.statement: Two OTC supply contracts renewed in Australia: EBOS Group AUD202M (7.5 years) and Wesfarmers AUD30M (3 years); total contracted OTC supply AUD232M (~INR1,506 crore)
order_book.quote: Together, these two renewals take our contracted Australia OTC supply business over this period of time to AUD 232 million or approximately INR1,506 crores.

capex.statement: Adelaide facility: AUD46M of AUD53M invested; commissioning expected January 2027; TGA license inspection Q2 2027; commercial supply thereafter
capex.quote: To date we have invested AUD46 million of the AUD53 million planned for Adelaide. The program has been supported by the AUD20 million grant from the Australian Federal Government under the Modern Manufacturing Initiative. And we expect the facility to be commissioned in January of 2027, slightly behind where we previously advised, and this delay has been caused by logistics disruptions due to the

capex.statement: Unit III Bhongir expansion almost complete; new block starts December 2026; capacity rises from 85.5M to 155M units/month (+81%); output ramps Q4 FY27
capex.quote: The expansion at Unit III, Bhongir, is almost completed. The new block will start commencing from December 2026. Production capacity will rise from 85.5 million to 155 million units a month, an increase of 81% after completing this new block.

capex.statement: Saicriti Pharma injectable facility on track for July 2027 completion; total project cost INR215 crore; company investing INR83.83 crore for 60% stake
capex.quote: The total project cost is estimated at INR215 crores. Our contribution of INR83.83 crores is unchanged from the originally earmarked figure.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material cost fell ~3% QoQ despite 9% revenue growth due to tighter inventory management, FIFO controls, new ERP system
pricing_cost.quote: Raw material cost actually fell by about 3% even as revenue grew by 9%. This was driven by tighter inventory management. Inventory was on the higher side last quarter. During Q2, we worked through a major higher-cost inventory, introduced strict first-in-first-out controls and implemented a new ERP system which has brought inventory levels down materially.

product_mix.statement: Q2 revenue mix: CDMO 73%, branded generics 27%; exports 73% of revenue (Australia 76%, Philippines 16%, South Africa 4%, others 3%)

order_book.quote: The foundational work at Clean Coats is now in place, and it has built a strong order pipeline for the rest of the year and beyond.

capex.statement: Nellore greenfield boards plant on track for commercial production in Q4 FY27; Hyderabad project groundbreaking by December
capex.quote: On the capacity front, our greenfield boards plant at Nellore is on track to begin commercial production in the fourth quarter of this financial year. We also expect to break ground on our second new project in Hyderabad by December.

capex.statement: Both Nellore and Hyderabad projects on track per plan; monitoring execution and capital deployment
capex.quote: As mentioned by Akshat, both the Nellore and Hyderabad, both projects are on track as per our plan. We are closely monitoring project execution and capital deployment to ensure timely completion within the planned investment outlay.

pricing_cost.statement: Roofs benefited from pent-up price correction and steel roofing price surge driving volume shift
pricing_cost.quote: One, there was almost a pent-up requirement for price correction in the market over the last 2, 3 years because if you look closely at our numbers or any of our industry peers, the cost increase was much more than what we could pass on to the market.

pricing_cost.statement: Pipes revenue growth: 4% volume, 15% pricing and mix; inventory gains marginal
pricing_cost.quote: Overall, the revenue growth was about 20%, of which about 4% was the volume growth, and the rest was from a pricing and mix perspective, so 15% was pricing and mix related.

product_mix.statement: Roofs value-added share 35% higher YoY; Pipes fittings now 47% of portfolio; Walls retail presence broad-based
product_mix.quote: We are also selling a richer mix with the share of value-added products 35% higher than last year.

risk.statement: Geopolitical uncertainties, supply disruptions driving raw material, energy, freight, currency inflation; high inflation and tight liquidity may weigh on near-term demand; El Nino risk to rural demand
risk.quote: Geopolitical uncertainties and global supply disruptions continue to drive inflation in key raw materials, energy, freight, and currency. High inflation and tight liquidity are likely to weigh in on near-term demand, and the El Nino effect poses a risk to farm output and, therefore, rural demand.

other.statement: Walls segment capacity utilization around 85% across Boards, Blocks, Panels
other.quote: And capacity utilizations are depending on which product segment are in the vicinity of about 85%.

other.statement: Rooftop solar commissioned at Golan and Chennai; approved at 2 more units; green power to exceed 20-25% of energy mix in 2 years
other.quote: During the quarter, we commissioned rooftop solar at our Golan and Chennai units and have also approved solar capacity at 2 more manufacturing units. We expect green power to exceed 20% to 25% of our energy mix within the next 2 years, reducing both our energy cost and our carbon footprint.

guidance.statement: Chemaf debt restructuring targeted to close within 3-4 months (by end FY27)
guidance.quote: So we are looking to close it within the next 3 to 4 months. So before the end of this financial year, it will be done.

guidance.statement: Chemaf long-term net debt expected around $500 million (from current ~$800 million) including plant completion capex
guidance.quote: So net debt in the longer run in the asset will be somewhere around $500 million from the current levels of around $800 million. And this includes the capex incurred for the plants because we are also spending money to complete the plants.

guidance.statement: Beneficiation (BHQ) volumes expected to start FY29
guidance.quote: FY29. Volumes of iron ore remains at 26 million tons throughout the period. Relevant or usable iron ore will remain at 26 million. The benefits should start in '29.

guidance.statement: FY27 copper production target revised to 5,850 tons (from earlier 8,000 tons) due to Surya Mines challenges
guidance.quote: So I think 5,850 is the target that we are looking for the full year. So in fact, earlier when we had disclosed in the last quarter, the target was higher at 8,000 tons. But given the challenges that we are having in Surya, a large part of the effort is going towards completing the Chemaf plant.

margin.statement: Value-added products contribute 61% of stand-alone revenue and 67% of EBIT in Q2 vs 43% and 49% a year ago
margin.quote: Value-added products now contribute 61% of stand-alone revenue and 67% of EBIT in quarter 2 versus 43% and 49% a year ago. This is a structural re-rating of the earnings base, not a cyclical spike.

margin.statement: Thriveni H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 19.18%, up 436 bps YoY; Q2 weaker due to monsoon and higher HSD/explosives costs
margin.quote: EBITDA for H1 came at INR 884 crores, up 85% year-on-year with margins at 19.18%, an expansion of 436 basis points over the last year.

margin.statement: Thriveni pursuing pass-through of higher input costs (HSD, explosives) to clients; negotiations underway
margin.quote: We are actively pursuing pass-through of these higher input costs to our clients, and those negotiations are currently underway.

order_book.statement: Iron ore resource 26 million tons per year available till 2051; monthly run rate upward of 2 million tons
order_book.quote: With 26 million tons of iron ore available for -- till 2051, we think we are quite well placed in terms of balancing.

order_book.statement: Thriveni expects 12-14 million tons iron ore and 1.5-1.8 million tons manganese from Tata Steel JV mines from next year
order_book.quote: And we are expecting that at equipment contracting would help 12 million to 14 million tons of iron ore and around 1.5 million to 1.8 million tons of manganese from next year onwards.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 stand-alone capex INR 6,052 crores on downstream steel and beneficiation projects
capex.quote: The company incurred capex of INR6,052 crores in H1 FY2 7, as we continue to build out our downstream steel and beneficiation projects

capex.statement: $300 million NCD enabling resolution passed for potential capex funding
capex.quote: That's an enabling resolution what we have taken. So we just wanted to keep ourselves ready if such an opportunity arises. And we already have this resolution in place, and we can go ahead with it. And everything obviously will be used more and more for capex or that's what the intention is.

pricing_cost.statement: Iron ore realization ~INR 6,700/ton (INR 670/ton in transcript appears to be a typo for INR 6,700); pricing based on quality, stocks, order book; considered sustainable
pricing_cost.quote: Our price of INR6,700 reflects the quality. It's one of the best iron ores available, except maybe one company. And it reflects that pricing. It's a market which is quite open, and I wouldn't say -- I mean, it's a good market. So we are having a pricing system of our own.

pricing_cost.statement: Pellet realization INR 11,348/ton (Q2) and INR 11,520/ton (H1); EBITDA INR 4,604/ton (Q2) and INR 4,988/ton (H1)
pricing_cost.quote: Realization stood at INR 11,348 per ton in quarter Q2 and INR 11,520 for H1 with EBITDA of INR 4,604 and INR 4,988 per ton, respectively.

risk.statement: Thriveni Q2 margins hit by heavy monsoon in Odisha/Jharkhand and higher HSD/explosives costs; pass-through negotiations underway
risk.quote: Due to rains, all the iron ore production as well as coal productions are badly hampered. And this year, particularly in Odisha and Jharkhand, both the places, there were heavy rains. And in terms of coal also, due to these geopolitical issues for the pricing of HSD and explosives, we had to suffer a little bit.

other.statement: Slurry pipeline 1 running at full capacity; extending to longer, larger network to eliminate truck movement of fines
other.quote: The first pipeline is already running at full capacity and has actually lowered our freight cost for iron ore. And we are now extending this to a much longer and larger pipeline network, which will carry our beneficiated materials over long distances, eliminating the movement of fine iron ore by truck almost entirely.

other.statement: 1.2 mtpa integrated steel plant (wire rod) progressing; blast furnace and coke oven Q4 FY27, steel plant and wire rod mill Q1 FY28
other.quote: 1.2-million-ton integrated steel plant producing wire rod is progressing well and moving steadily towards commissioning.

guidance.statement: Revenue target of INR2,000 crore by FY28 remains on track.
guidance.quote: Yes. I think we are on track for that, yes.

demand.statement: India demand optimistic in API and specialty chemicals; US demand high; Europe slightly subdued.
demand.quote: So the demand scenario in India is quite optimistic. We have very high demand in, as I explained in my speech, in the API sector and the specialty chemical sector. So overall demand is quite good. Europe, the demand in Europe is slightly subdued, but it is not really subdued, but the demand from U.S. is quite high.

margin.statement: India glass-lined equipment business at high single-digit EBITDA margin in H1 FY27; expects 16-18% at INR300 crore revenue.
margin.quote: We believe that even at current levels of operation, current levels of expenditure, even with a INR300-odd crores revenue, we could still be between 16% and 18% kind of EBITDA levels going forward.

margin.statement: THALETEC Germany H1 FY27 revenue INR192 crore with EBITDA margin a little over 11.5%.
margin.quote: So the revenue for the first half from THALETEC Germany is about INR192 crores. And the EBITDA margin was roughly about a little over 11.5%.

margin.statement: Omeras (HLE Surface Technologies) achieved EBITDA breakeven in H1 FY27; targets double-digit EBITDA margins at EUR25-30 million revenue.
margin.quote: We think that once we cross the EUR20 million revenue per annum, the company should get back to serious profitability and maybe between EUR25 million and EUR30 million, we could even be as high as double-digit EBITDA margins.

order_book.statement: Consolidated order book crossed INR1,000 crore for the first time, reaching INR1,087.3 crore as of September 30, 2026, up 51% YoY and 64% QoQ.
order_book.quote: As of September 30, 2026, the consolidated order book stood at INR1,087.3 crores, registering a growth of 51% year -on-year and 64% quarter -on-quarter compared to INR662 crores as of June 30, 2026.

order_book.statement: Order book accretion of INR425 crore in Q2 FY27; total new orders including execution of INR350 crore reached INR775 crore.
order_book.quote: Add to that about INR350 crores of order execution, which means the total order book or total of new orders during this period is close to about INR775 crores.

capex.statement: New heavy engineering plant near Anand (Adas) for equipment >100-150 tons, up to 4.5-5m diameter and 15-20m length, targeting energy, oil & gas, petrochemicals, renewables.
capex.quote: Yes. So as you rightly said, we are putting up a new plant at the site, which is called Adas close to Anand. This will be largely focused on heavy equipment. So these will be equipment's which are in excess of 100, 150 tons large diameters and length, so maybe up to 4.5 to 5 meters in diameter, 15, 20 meters in length.

pricing_cost.statement: Competitive intensity in India glass-lined and filtration & drying easing as demand picks up; booking orders at improving margins month after month.
pricing_cost.quote: With the market demand picking up, I think obviously, that competitive intensity has gone down. We are able to not only book orders, we are able to book orders at improving margins month after month.

product_mix.statement: THALETEC products now ~22% of India glass-lined product business, up from earlier quarters.
product_mix.quote: We are now seeing this transition gaining momentum with THALETEC products contributing approximately 22% of our overall glass lined product businesses in India during the current quarter.

risk.statement: Customer delivery acceptances delayed by 1-2 months due to geopolitical disturbances, impacting dispatches and revenue recognition.
risk.quote: delivery acceptance by customers gets postponed simply because of Let's say, things like geopolitical disturbances and stuff like that due to which their own project execution or their own project implementation gets delayed by a month or even a couple of months here and there

other.statement: India glass-lined equipment revenue expected INR260-280 crore in FY27 based on current order book visibility.
other.quote: We expect the revenue this year to be anywhere between INR260 crores and INR280 crores.

other.statement: Omeras H1 FY27 turnover slightly above EUR8.5 million, EBITDA breakeven achieved.
other.quote: during this entire half year, Omeras has achieved a turnover in a little excess of about EUR8.5 million and has touched EBITDA breakeven during the first half.

guidance.statement: Guided 15-20% growth for corporate advisory and capital markets over next 3-5 years
guidance.quote: We've guided that corporate advisory and capital markets will see anywhere between a 15%-20% growth over the next couple of years, three to five years.

guidance.statement: Guided private markets loan book growth around 20% and investment side around 15%
guidance.quote: We've guided private markets will see a similar number, around 20% increase on the loan book and around 15% increase on the investment side.

guidance.statement: Guided wealth management AUM growth 20-25% subject to mark-to-market
guidance.quote: Wealth management, we've maintained 20% -25% growth in AUM, subject to mark-to-market.

guidance.statement: Guided asset management growth 15-20%
guidance.quote: Asset management, again, we expect to have 15%-20% growth.

demand.statement: Primary markets revival from June with strong FPI and domestic participation
demand.quote: On the primary side, there has been a lot of interest, not only from mutual funds and domestic family offices, but we have also seen FPI participation in the primary markets.

demand.statement: October deal activity decent, expecting November-December to be decent
demand.quote: Month of October has been decent and we hope that November, December also will be pretty decent.

margin.statement: Corporate advisory and capital markets annualized ROE ~36% for Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Annualized ROE for the segment stood at approximately 36%.

margin.statement: ARC returns modeled at 16-18% on SR investments
margin.quote: Usually, the returns on that are modeled at around 16%-18%.

margin.statement: Real estate pricing needs 200-300 bps above corporate, pricing is a challenge
margin.quote: Real estate needs to be at least at a 200-300 basis points pricing above corporate.

order_book.statement: INR130,000 crores of transactions filed with regulator for execution over next 12 months
order_book.quote: We still have INR130,000 crores worth of transactions, which are already filed with the regulator for execution over the next 12 months, and many more to be filed this quarter and next quarter.

order_book.statement: Closed INR83,000 crores transactions in Q2 FY27, ranked #1 in IPOs and QIPs
order_book.quote: Pleased to report that we were ranked #1 across IPOs and QIPs and closed transactions of INR83,000 crores in Q2.

capex.statement: Adding infrastructure and technology spend continuously in broking business
capex.quote: We are adding infrastructure and spending on technology on a continuous basis in the broking business, and that growth will continue.

product_mix.statement: Recurring revenues ~50% of total; adding brokerage ~12-15% makes 62-65% recurring bucket
product_mix.quote: Basically approximately 50% of our revenues are from recurring sources out of the total revenue. If we add both of them, it is roughly 62%-65%, which you can club under the recurring bucket.

risk.statement: Equity/alternative portfolio mark-to-market volatility (e.g., Gokaldas Exports impacted by US tariffs)
risk.quote: We necessarily have to suffer mark-to-market every quarter for it. For example, we merged one of our ARC assets into Gokaldas Exports, and we take a quarterly mark-to-market on that, and it is a fantastic company, and it has suffered because of the tariff which has been placed by the U.S. government.

risk.statement: Capital markets revenue lost INR40-50 crores in Q2 due to deal size reductions (INR10,000 crores reduction)
risk.quote: To give you the actual number, in the last quarter itself, we had a INR10,000 crores reduction in deal size, which actually got launched compared to where they were filed with th e regulator. That is approximately 40 - 50 basis points of fee loss for us, INR40 crores-INR50 crores

other.statement: Wealth recurring AUM grew 17% YoY to ~INR40,000 crores including loans
other.quote: Overall recurring AUM, including loans, stood at approximately INR 40,000 crores, which is an increase of 17% year-on-year.

other.statement: Affordable housing AUM grew 30% YoY to ~INR4,000 crores, disbursements up 48% YoY
other.quote: Our affordable housing finance business reported a 30% year -on-year growth in AUM and a 48% year-on-year growth in disbursements. The AUM in the business now stands at almost INR4,000 crores.

guidance.statement: Maintains FY27 guidance of 15% revenue growth with EBITDA margin 18-20%, currently at upper end of margin range
guidance.quote: We are maintaining our FY27 guidance of 15% revenue growth with an EBITDA margin of the guidance given, 18% to 20%. We still remain at the upper side of our margin guidance.

demand.statement: Seeing strong US order momentum post-election; customers visiting factory; big deals on the edge; UK surfaces soft but new head appointed
demand.quote: We also like to give news that there has been a big win by Democrat s in United States. So we see now a strong momentum of orders coming from United States. We're already seeing some immediate trips by our customers to our factory as early in next week

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 19.4% vs 20.3% YoY due to higher raw material and freight costs; expects improvement as costs cool; 5% price hike from last month
margin.quote: EBITDA grew to INR54.1 crores, up by 9.3%. Margin for quarter 2 FY27 was 19.4% compared to Q2 FY26 20.3% and Q1 FY27 21.2%. This margin decrease is on account of higher raw material cost and sea freight.

order_book.statement: Received first orders from Hafele Australia/New Zealand (25-30K sinks/year) and Canada; first Amazon US order received; strong US inquiry pipeline post-election
order_book.quote: So, we have signed a good deal, I would say a great deal, with Hafele, New Zealand and Australia, and we have got our first orders in this quarter, and, which would be dispatched by next month. And, this coming quarters, I think the deal was about anywhere around 25,000 to 30,000 sinks a year.

capex.statement: Investing in 250K quartz and 150K steel sink capacity by end FY27; doubling faucet and appliance capacity to 100K each by end FY27
capex.quote: In addition, 250,000 units of annual capacity of quartz sinks and 150,000 in steel sinks due by the end of FY27 comes at the right time. In line with Make in India, we are also doubling our faucet and kitchen appliances capacities to 100,000 units. Each is to reduce our dependence on imports. This too is on track for end of FY27.

capex.statement: Faucet/appliance capacity doubling is asset-light with 5-6x asset turnover; targeting 80-85% utilisation in FY28
capex.quote: Yeah, so this, is very asset -light model because it's more assembling tha n manufacturing. So, the turnover will be 5x to 6x of the capex what we are doing. And on utilization, it will gradually increase. Utilization we are targeting for next year 80 to 85 percentage

pricing_cost.statement: Implemented 5% price increase last month; exports on FOB basis limit freight impact; further raw material cost increases will be passed on
pricing_cost.quote: Yes, I think we already have increased 5% price, but if something goes wrong, further than this, if some in flation -- if some inventory cost comes in terms of freight or in terms of best part is all our exports to the major customers are all FOB basis

product_mix.statement: Quartz sinks 54% of revenue, 217K units (+10%); stainless steel 47K units (+8%); faucets +8%, appliances +12%, surfaces +23% revenue growth
product_mix.quote: The quartz sink volumes grew about 10% to 217K units, and the quartz sinks contributed about 54% of our revenue. Stainless steel volume also grew by 8% to 47K units. Together, our sinks contribute 65% of our revenue. Our faucet volume grew by 8%, kitchen appliances 12%, and surfaces 23% on our revenue this quarter.

other.statement: Granite sink plant at 92% utilisation, stainless steel at 91% in Q2 FY27; new capacities on track for end FY27
other.quote: Our granite sink plant is running at a 92% utilization, stainless steel plant running at a 91% capacity utilization in quarter 2 FY27, which is close to optimum level.

other.statement: UK subsidiary Carysil Products highest ever H1 revenue GBP6.2M; surfaces business softer at GBP5.8M vs GBP7M; US United Granite revenue $5.6M (+10% H1)
other.quote: In the UK, Carysil Products Limited recorded its highest ever half revenue of GBP6.2 million. guidance.statement: FY27 revenue expected to grow 20%-25% YoY on volume and pricing improvement
guidance.quote: Overall, we expect to end FY2027 with a 20%-25% improvement in top line over the previous year, owing to the improvement in volumes as well as pricing.

guidance.statement: FY28 EBITDA margin expected at 25%-26%
guidance.quote: We are expecting a 25%-26% EBITDA margin next financial year also.

demand.statement: ATBS demand impacted by customer destocking in H1; volume recovery expected in H2 with Q3 uptick
demand.quote: Demand for ATBS did not pick up as anticipated at the beginning of FY, owing to destocking by customers, which impacted our ability to meet the half-year target. We expect volume recovery in H2.

demand.statement: Butyl Phenol stable in H1, better performance expected in H2 on improving demand
demand.quote: The Butyl Phenol segment delivered stable performance, and we anticipate better performance in H2, supported by improving demand conditions.

demand.statement: IB strong in H1, performance expected to continue in H2
demand.quote: IB reported strong performance during H1, and we expect the performance to continue in H2.

order_book.statement: VOPL revenue expected INR75-100 crore in FY27, not crossing INR100 crore due to internal re-engineering delays
order_book.quote: 2026/2027, it will be in the range of around INR75 crores-INR100 crores, not more than that. It will not cross INR100 crores in this financial year.

capex.quote: we have announced a capex plan of INR500 crores to develop and commercialize new specialty chemicals with applications in fragrances, personal care, water treatment solutions, oil fields, and others, with scope for further expansion into adjacent product segments based on market growth and opportunities. capex.quote: Usually, the asset turnover one can expect is 1:1 or maybe slightly higher, maybe 1.2, 1.5, since they are related to our chemistries. But ROI on this expense, it can be in the range of 15%-20%.

pricing_cost.quote: Even though the increase in raw material prices has largely been passed on to our customers, the logistics and energy costs could not be passed through entirely.

product_mix.statement: H1 FY27 sales mix: ATBS 27%-28%, IBB 12%-15%, Butyl Phenols 16%-20%, Antioxidants 15%-17%

risk.statement: Second INR500 crore capex may not happen; will wait six months for land acquisition and pilot trials before confirming

other.quote: Depends. There are three major product segments. I think in two of them, we will be fairly large. In the other one, there are other players also.

guidance.statement: Raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to low double digits from previous high single digits to low double digits
guidance.quote: We now expect revenue growth in the low double digits for the full year. Last quarter, our guidance was high single digits to low double digits.

guidance.quote: On profitability, we continue to expect stable margins within the target band of 14.75% to 15.75%, while we invest in the capabilities that drive the next phase of growth.

demand.statement: Q2 delivered strongest sequential growth in three years, broad-based across verticals and segments
demand.quote: Q2 delivered what we said it would: our strongest sequential growth in three years, broad-based across verticals and segments.

margin.statement: Q2 EBIT margin remained flat; EPS increased 14.6% sequentially to INR 29.4
margin.quote: Q2 EBIT margin remained flat. EPS increased 14.6% sequentially to INR 29.4.

product_mix.quote: Tria -led opportunities are a growing part of our pipeline, and they are different in kind: larger and multi -year deals , combining optimization and transformation with ongoing operations, sponsored by business leaders, and increasingly starting with a proof of value on the client's own

other.statement: Non-institutional growth 21% vs institutional growth 5% in Q2 FY27
other.quote: the non-institutional growth in Q2 has been 21%, whereas institutional growth has been 5%

guidance.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue target ~INR5,000 cr with EBITDA ~INR600 cr (margin >12%) including Furlenco
guidance.quote: As these pieces come together, we expect the combined group to close this year at a revenue of around INR5,000 crores with an EBITDA of roughly INR600 crores, a margin a little above 12%.

guidance.statement: FY27 Sheela Foam standalone revenue INR4,300-4,400 cr; Furlenco revenue INR500-600 cr
guidance.quote: We currently -- in the current year are anticipated to do somewhere around INR4,300 crores to INR4,400 crores in Sheela Foam consolidated as it stands today. Furlenco this year is anticipated to do around INR500 crores to INR600 crores.

demand.statement: Festive season shift from Q2 to Q3; demand soft but pipeline building from Great Sleepwell Festival
demand.quote: Additionally, the festive season, which was in late September last year, moved into October this time, resulting in a shift of demand from Q2 to Q3.

demand.statement: Market pickup seen in October and marriage season looks better
demand.quote: But the -- coming to the market has definitely picked up overall. I mean what we saw in September, the October definitely and going forward, the marriage season, they definitely look better.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 9-10% currently; could reach 12% if raw material prices normalize (ex-Furlenco)
margin.quote: Currently, it's not double digit. It is consolidated level, 9% to 10%. And if the situation comes to a situation similar to pre-February, I think somewhere around 12% would be a reasonable level of profitability that we should see, and this is without Furlenco.

margin.statement: Medium-term target 13-15% EBITDA margin if environment normalizes; difficult if raw material inflation persists
margin.quote: Next year margins, as you mentioned, we had said, yes, we will do between 13% to 15%. Had it been a very normal situation, definitely, we would have done that. We were on track to that. Now it depends how much the current situation prevails.

order_book.statement: Furlenco subscriber base 200,000+, asset utilization >90%, revenue INR229 cr H1 FY27 (+34% YoY), EBITDA INR89 cr (+69% YoY)
order_book.quote: The recent trend is the same in the first half for Furlenco. The revenue has grown about 34% -- and to 34% to INR229 crores, and EBITDA was also up by about 69% to a level of INR89 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Polyol up 65%, TDI up 33% since mid-February; crude up ~50%
pricing_cost.quote: On a ballpark, the crude is up by about 50%, and our 2 key raw materials have moved even more. Since mid-February, polyol, our main chemical or main raw material is up by 65% and TDI by 33%.

pricing_cost.statement: Price increases of 35-40% in foam and ~25% in mattress since Middle East crisis
pricing_cost.quote: So since the advent of the Middle East, we have taken around 35% to 40% price increase in foam and around 25-odd percent in mattress.

product_mix.statement: Launching sub-INR10,000 mattress with new support layer technology to recapture volume without margin dilution
product_mix.quote: So we have recently adopted a technology wherein we'll be making a support layer, which will go into the product, which we plan to position around less than INR10,000 with a margin similar to what we have in the mid-segment.

risk.statement: Raw material inflation persistence and Middle East logistics disruption key risks to margin recovery and volume growth
risk.quote: If it remains like this, if you see more disruptions in the Middle East and further increases in raw material prices, I think that strategy will continue to remain to protect profitability or the margins, which may have some impact on the volumes.

other.statement: TDI capacity ~15-20% wiped out by war and European closures; polyol less affected; logistics main constraint
other.quote: So some of it is capacity issue, but a lot more is also a logistic issue. So if we take total, let's say, TDI, I would say almost about 15% to 20% has been wiped out, one, because of the war and second, because of closing down industries in Europe.

other.statement: U2O touchpoints >10,000, grew 41%; D2C/e-commerce growing healthily via brand.com
other.quote: The U2O busi ness, which is the unorganized to organized business, which takes us from the unorganized to the organized market and has now reached more than 10,000 touch points or dealers and has grown by about 41%.

guidance.statement: Expect 12-15% net square feet addition and gross opening of about 150 stores in FY27
guidance.quote: We'll continue to add about 12% to 15% net square feet addition in this fiscal year.

guidance.statement: Confident of delivering guided growth and EBITDA objectives for FY27; targeting mid double-digit growth in H2 with 30-40 bps EBITDA margin expansion
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering our guided growth and EBITDA objectives.

demand.statement: Demand environment remains stable and positive; festive sales tracking well with near high double-digit LTL
demand.quote: The demand environment for us remains stable and positive.

margin.statement: Gross margin expanded 136 bps YoY driven by lower discounting, better channel mix, and product premiumization
margin.quote: Gross margin has increased by 136 bps Y-o-Y, aided by strong LTL with lower discounting and better channel mix.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 67 bps YoY to 15.5% growth in absolute terms
margin.quote: EBITDA, excluding other income, was INR 216 crores versus INR 187 crores. That is a 67-bps improvement and 15.5% growth over last year in absolute terms.

margin.statement: Expect 30-40 bps EBITDA margin expansion in H2 FY27
margin.quote: We are confident of sustaining mid double-digit growth in the balance of the year, with 30 to 40 bps of EBITDA margin expansion.

order_book.statement: Wholesale primary sales grew high double-digit; channels well stocked for festive season
order_book.quote: Wholesale: Primary sales grew at a high, double digit in Q2. The channels are now well stocked to cater to the upcoming festive season.

capex.statement: Spent ~INR 100 crores in H1 FY27 on new shirt factory in MP, corporate office, and store expansion
capex.quote: In H1, almost 100 crores of capex was spent on the following: A new shirt manufacturing factory in MP

capex.statement: New shirt factory in MP to produce 3L units/month at steady state, meeting 25-30% of shirt requirements with 3-3.5 year payback
capex.quote: At a steady state, the factory will produce 3L units month & will meet 25 -30% of total shirt requirements. We expect a payback of 3-3.5 yrs on this investment.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost increases of ~5% expected to be mitigated through 1.5-2% MRP increases
pricing_cost.quote: As we speak, I think our cost increase will be about 5% and we are confident of mitigating that through MRP increases.

product_mix.statement: Footwear and innerwear adjacencies contributing 25% of business
product_mix.quote: At the same time, we are doubling down on adjacencies like footwear and innerwear, which are already contributing to 25% of our business.

product_mix.statement: Direct channels now 53% of sales, up 380 bps YoY; targeting 65% D2C share
product_mix.quote: Direct channels now account for 53% of sales, up nearly 380 bps year-on-year.

risk.statement: Watchful of inflation, geopolitical developments, El Niño effect, and repo rate changes; will mitigate via smart pricing and cost control
risk.quote: On the macro, we continue to remain watchful of external factors like inflation, geopolitical developments, a potential El Niño effect and repo rate changes.

other.statement: GWC days stable at 157 days; NWC days flat at 65 days despite inventory days increase offset by receivable days decline
other.quote: This keeps GWC days stable at 157 days, the same as the previous quarter closing. NWC days are flat at 65 days.

other.statement: Estimate INR 150-175 crores free cash flow release in H2 FY27; will be used to pare down debt
other.quote: In H2 FY27, we estimate cash release of 150-175 crores of free cash flow.

guidance.statement: Expect to commission remaining 140 beds at Max Smart after Diwali puja
guidance.quote: We expect to commission the remaining 140 beds after Diwali puja.

guidance.statement: Zirakpur Mohali 400-bed greenfield EBITDA loss estimated around INR 30 crore, lower than Gurgaon
guidance.quote: Lower, much lower. Around INR 30 crore. We will work out the numbers and provide more precise figures later, but roughly around that.

guidance.statement: Ex-oncology revenue growth 25% YoY should accelerate further as chemotherapy drug discontinuation impact anniversaries in Q3
guidance.quote: Yes, that should be the case because you are coming off a lower base.

demand.statement: Occupancy steady at 77% despite 14% YoY increase in operational bed capacity
demand.quote: Average occupancy for the Network was 77%, similar to last year, despite a 14% increase in operational bed capacity.

demand.statement: Occupied bed days up 13% YoY and 7% QoQ
demand.quote: Occupied bed day s (OBDs) were up by 13% year -on-year and 7% quarter -on-quarter.

margin.statement: Operating EBITDA margin 26.8% in Q2 FY27, similar to Q2 FY26 despite 14% bed capacity increase
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA margin was 26.8%, similar to Q2 FY26, despite 14% increase in operational bed capacity, and reflected an improvement of around 200 basis points over the trailing quarter.

margin.statement: EBITDA per bed grew 4% YoY to INR 77 lakhs per annum in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: While EBITDA per bed grew by 4% year-on-year to INR 77 lakhs per annum.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin 25.9%, similar to H1 FY26 despite 20% bed capacity growth
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA margin was 25.9%, similar to H1 FY26. This is despite total bed capacity increasing by 20% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: International patient revenue INR 307 crore, up 33% YoY, now 10% of hospital healthcare revenue
order_book.quote: International patient revenue was INR 307 crore, registering significant growth of 33% year -on-year and now accounts for 10% of healthcare revenue from hospitals.

capex.statement: Board approved INR 415 crore for 209 brownfield beds at Max Noida, Max Vaishali, BLK-Max and MLCP tower at BLK
capex.quote: the Board has approved an investment of INR 415 crore towards addition of 209 brownfield beds at Max Noida, Max Vaishali and BLK-Max, along with a multi-level car park (MLCP) tower at BLK at the cost of approximately INR 85 crore.

pricing_cost.statement: IP ARPP grew 8% YoY to INR 2.31 lakhs, partly driven by decline in institutional bed share to 29% from 34%
pricing_cost.quote: Average revenue per patient (IP ARPP) for the quarter stood at INR 2.31 lakhs, growing by 8% year -on-year. This growth was partly driven by a decline in institutional bed share to 29%, from 34% last year.

pricing_cost.statement: Excluding oncology, gross revenue grew 25% and ARPP grew 11% YoY
pricing_cost.quote: Excluding oncology, gross revenue grew by 25% and ARPP grew by 11% year-on-year.

product_mix.statement: Oncology inpatient revenue share dropped to 21% from 26% YoY due to discontinuation of high-value chemotherapy drugs for institutional patients after CGHS rate revisions
product_mix.quote: Due to the discontinuation of se lect high -value chemotherapy drugs for institutional patients, as a result of CGHS rate revisions last year, the share of oncology for in-patient revenues dropped to 21%, from 26% in Q2 FY26.

risk.statement: Matter of trade margin cap on non-scheduled drugs is sub judice; sector median net profit ~9% in capital-intensive industry
risk.quote: the Government or the hospital sector. I think the hospital sector pretty much stands by the fact that the median net profit of the entire sector, if I was to look at last quarter's numbers, is about 9%, if I am not mistaken, in a capital -intensive sector

other.statement: 202 brownfield beds added in Q2 FY27 at Max Smart, Max Lucknow, Max Noida and Max Dwarka
other.quote: During the quarter, 202 brownfield beds were added to the operational capacity, mainly at Max Smart, Max Lucknow, Max Noida and Max Dwarka.

other.statement: Phase commissioning of 500 beds at Sector-56 Gurgaon expected by end of FY27
other.quote: 500 beds at Sector -56, Gurgaon: We expect to start phase commissioning of this facility by the end of this financial year.

guidance.statement: Aspiration to achieve US $1 billion annual revenue by FY28 after ITC Infotech combination
guidance.quote: Upon completion, the combined enterprise is expected to be better positioned to pursue larger transformation opportunities, deepen customer relationships and compete more effectively across global markets with an aspiration to achieve US $1 billion in annual revenue by FY28.

demand.statement: Enterprise tech spending selective; clients prioritize measurable outcomes in AI, modernization, data, cybersecurity
demand.quote: Enterprise technology spending remains selective with clients prioritizing investments that deliver clear and measurable business outcomes, especially in the near to medium term.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 operating margin improved to 18.5% from 17.5% in Q1
margin.quote: Operating margins have improved by 100 basis points sequentially to about 18.5% compared with 17.5% in Q1.

order_book.statement: Secured multimillion dollar BOTAT engagement with global digital asset management company
order_book.quote: During the quarter, we secured a multimillion dollar BOTAT, which is Build, Operate, Transform, Agentify and Transfer engagement with a global digital asset management company.

capex.statement: Investing in AI platforms Rel(AI)Build, ELLIPSE, SecAIGenie, EduWeave, Insurance in a Box
capex.quote: Our AI service delivery platform, Rel(AI)Build, is designed to e nable human engineers and AI agents to work together across the entire software development life cycle

pricing_cost.statement: AI productivity enabling aggressive fixed-bid pricing and margin improvement
pricing_cost.quote: Enterprise AI Platform we talked about helps us to gain higher AI productivity than using agents with foundation models. This allowed us to make more aggressive bids than competition on fixed-bid deals.

product_mix.statement: IP-led revenues improved to 10.5% from 9.3% in Q1
product_mix.quote: IP -led revenues improved to 10.5% from 9.3% in the last quarter.

risk.statement: Merger subject to necessary approvals including NCLT, shareholders, creditors
risk.quote: The merger, of course, remains subject to necessary approvals, which are being pursued in earnest by both companies.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue INR 645 crores, up 12.5% YoY in rupee terms
other.quote: Revenue stood at INR645 crores, growing 12.5% year-on-year in rupee terms.

other.statement: Active customers increased to 311; $1B+ corporations up to 95 from 92; repeat business 95.1%
other.quote: We ended Q2 with 311 active customers and now serve 95 billion -dollar corporations, up from 92 in Q1. Repeat business increased to 95.1%.

guidance.statement: Plan to add 40-50 restaurants annually across portfolio, largely funded from internal accruals
guidance.quote: Beyond this year, our medium-term plan is to add 40 to 50 restaurants annually across our portfolio, largely funded from internal accruals and with the same discipline on site selection and underlying standards that will continue to guide us so far.

guidance.statement: Target to cross 300 restaurants by end of FY27
guidance.quote: We remain on track to cross 300 restaurants by end of FY27, and we plan to add 40 to 50 restaurants annually every year.

guidance.statement: Internal target to reach around 500 restaurants by FY30
guidance.quote: Frankly, internally, our internal target is to move to a base of around 500 restaurants by FY '30.

guidance.statement: Long-term SSSG target of 5-7% for established restaurant business
guidance.quote: My view is that, in an established restaurant business, not just in India but globally, if we continue to deliver 5% to 7% SSSG on a long -term basis, it's a great

demand.statement: Consolidated dine-in transaction volumes grew ~56% YoY, delivery grew 47% YoY
demand.quote: Consolidated dine-in transaction volumes grew around 56% year-on-year, and our delivery business grew 47% year-on-year.

demand.statement: ~90% of dine-in volumes from captive channels (app, website, call center, walk-ins)
demand.quote: Across our total dine-in business, approximately 90% is being driven through our captive channels, that is our app website, our reservation center and walk-in to our restaurants.

demand.statement: Pre-reservation rate increased from ~70% to >80% YoY
demand.quote: Within our dine-in business, more than 80% of our customers are now pre-reserving their visits compared to around 70% a year ago.

margin.statement: Mature portfolio pre-Ind AS ROM 14.7% in Q2, 15.5% in H1
margin.quote: Our matured portfolio pre-Ind AS restaurant operating margin was 14.7% for Q2 and 15.5% for first half, reflecting the underlying strength of our unit economics.

margin.statement: New store cohort pre-Ind AS ROM improved to 7.4% in Q2 from 6.1% in Q1
margin.quote: Our new restaurant portfolio reported pre-Ind AS restaurant operating margin of 7.4% in Q2, which is the highest level we have reported in several quarters. This is an improvement from 6.1% we reported in Q1 FY27.

margin.statement: Gap between mature and consolidated ROM narrowed to 1.3% from ~1.8%
margin.quote: The way I see it is earlier, the gap between matured and consolidated margin on account of new stores used to be around 1.7% - 1.8%. And for the last 2 quarters, this gap has been shrinking. This quarter, if you look at it, the gap between matured margin and consolidated margin is only 1.3%.

capex.statement: Funding expansion primarily from internal accruals with prudent leverage
capex.quote: We continue to fund our expansion primarily from internal accruals, and we operate on prudent leverage limits relative to our underlying business.

pricing_cost.statement: No price hikes taken in last 4 quarters; average realization down 7-8% YoY
pricing_cost.quote: we have not taken any price hike in the business over the last 4 quarters. And just specifically between Q2FY27 and Q2FY26, the average realization would be lower by around 7% - 8% in my

pricing_cost.statement: Plan selective price actions in specific markets/dayparts as volumes stabilize
pricing_cost.quote: As this volume number stabilizes, we'll also have an ability to take selective price acti ons in specific markets or specific dayparts where the volumes are well established, which will help us to also drive higher revenues from these

product_mix.statement: Big Buffet attracting new customer cohort and converting to regular buffet
product_mix.quote: And in some of the places where we've done mix Big Buffet, we've also seen that people are coming to us and experiencing the brand for lunch sessions with Big Buffet concepts and in a lot of cases, also converting into regular buffet and dinner concepts.

risk.statement: Navratri impact ~1-1.5% on consolidated SSSG due to ~30% drop in North India for 9 days
risk.quote: North India generally is impacted a lot. North India, you will see almost 30% drop for those 9 days. 9 days is approximately 10% of a quarter, dropping by 30% is almost 3% of the entire business. And North India business in our total business, North India including UP and, in some cases, Bihar would be around 40%. There's a good 1% to 1.5% impact that we get on our SSSG because of this.

other.statement: Opened 9 new restaurants in Q2 FY27, 19 under construction for Q3-Q4 FY27
