other.quote: We closed the quarter with 274 restaurants in our network with 9 restaurant additions during Q2. We currently have 19 restaurants under construction, which will open through Q3 and Q4 of this financial year.

other.statement: New store design rightsized to 3,000 sq ft driving better throughput and lower fixed costs
other.quote: We have changed our designs. We have rightsized the areas now at a 3,000 square feet area. I think it is driving better throughput per square feet. It has also reduced operating cost on a per store basis on rental, utilities and some fixed operating overheads.

guidance.statement: Calibrated price increases of 3-4% planned effective mid-November post festive season.
guidance.quote: As we look at the pricing in November, we are looking at a price increase range of between 3% to 4% to be rolled out post Diwali.

guidance.statement: Management expects H2 growth to accelerate over H1 and aims for flat full-year adjusted EBITDA margins despite commodity headwinds.
guidance.quote: As we look at to H2, Q3 and Q4, our conviction is that given what we see as tailwinds in our categories, given that we have seen strong sell-out momentum both in Q2 and more recently early in the festive period, we believe that we will see and we will deliver a step-up in growth and an acceleration in growth over H1 in H2.

demand.statement: Revenue grew 15% YoY in Q2 and 15.1% in H1, broad-based across channels and categories with high teens growth in Water Purifiers.
demand.quote: In line with our strategy to accelerate growth, I'm pleased to share that revenue grew 15% in Q2 FY '27. For the first half, revenue growth now stands at 15.1%.

demand.statement: Water Purifier business delivered high teens growth and gained market share driven by volumes and higher ASPs.
demand.quote: Within that, our Water Purifier business continued its strong momentum, delivering high teens growth and gaining market share.

demand.statement: Emerging categories (robotic vacuum cleaners, water softeners, air purifiers) grew significantly faster than company average.
demand.quote: Our emerging categories, comprising robotic vacuum cleaners, water softeners and air purifiers, grew significantly faster than company average.

margin.statement: Q2 adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 43 bps YoY to 13.6%, a lifetime high, driven by operating leverage.
margin.quote: Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter grew by 18.8% year-on-year to INR120.7 crores with adjusted margins expanding 43 basis points year-on-year to reach 13.6%.

margin.statement: Gross margin declined 138 bps YoY to 55.1% due to commodity inflation.
margin.quote: Gross margins were impacted by commodity inflation and declined by 138 basis points year-on-year to 55.1%.

margin.statement: Q3 margins to face transitionary impact from delayed price hikes; recovery expected in Q4 with full-year margins targeted flat.
margin.quote: Hence, there will be a transitionary impact on margins as far as quarter 3 is concerned, but we expect our margins to come back in quarter 4. On a full year basis, we continue to aim for holding on to margins on a full year basis as flat.

capex.statement: Stepped up advertising and sales promotion investments in Q2 and H1, focused on in-store visibility, new launches and consumer campaigns.
capex.quote: We also stepped up our advertising and sales promotion investments during the quarter, particularly behind in-store visibility, new product launches and consumer campaigns.

capex.statement: A&SP spends grew ahead of revenue in H1 with higher proportion towards sales promotions and in-store promoters.
capex.quote: Overall, between A&SP in the first half of the year, our spends have grown ahead of our revenue. And like I said, the bias has been more towards SP expenses because we've chosen to increase our deployment of in-store promoters and our point-of-sale visibility.

pricing_cost.statement: Price hikes taken in April: Water purifiers 5-6%, AMC 3-10%; no further hikes until planned mid-November increase.
pricing_cost.quote: The price hikes that we have taken was in April. After that, we've not taken any price hikes since then. I think just to give you a broad sense, water was in the range of around 5% to 6%. That was the range in which price increase was taken.

pricing_cost.statement: Commodity inflation intensified, creating pressure on gross margins; no pricing actions taken during festive period to prioritize growth.
pricing_cost.quote: At the same time, commodity inflation has intensified in recent months and is beginning to create pressure on gross margins. We deliberately refrained from taking pricing a ctions during the festive period, choosing instead to prioritize growth, customer acquisition and category expansion

product_mix.statement: Launched 6 new SKUs under Aeroguard brand in air purifiers, materially strengthening portfolio.
product_mix.quote: We launched 6 new SKUs under the Aeroguard brand, materially strengthening our portfolio and positioning us well for the opportunity in the second half.

product_mix.statement: Launched industry-first 4-year product range with unconditional warranty on parts and filters to reduce lifetime ownership cost.
product_mix.quote: In Water Purifiers, we launched the industry-first 4-year product range designed to reduce lifetime cost and to make purifier ownership convenient for consumers.

risk.statement: Commodity environment remains challenging with inflation persisting and worsening across key input categories.
risk.quote: The commodity environment continues to remain challenging with inflation persisting across several key input categories and in some cases, are, in fact, worsening.

risk.statement: Grey market for 2-year filters currently absent due to recency and longer life breaking parallel market's high-frequency renewal model.
risk.quote: The unit price that they sell at is low, but the frequency of contact is high and the frequency of change is high. This 2-year filter life, given the longer life, breaks that relationship and breaks the equation fundamentally.

other.statement: Net cash surplus of INR 304 crores at quarter end; H1 cash from operations negative historically, full year cash flow generated in H2.
other.quote: We ended the quarter with a net cash surplus of INR 304 crores. Cash balance in H1 was impacted due to working capital deployment.

other.statement: Company is net cash positive with INR 304 crores surplus; no borrowings mentioned.
other.quote: We ended the quarter with a net cash surplus of INR 304 crores.

guidance.statement: Revised FY27 revenue guidance to INR 800 crore and PAT to INR 125 crore due to TLS incident impact
guidance.quote: At the start of the year , we guided a revenue of about INR 825 crores and PAT of about INR 137 crores, about 25% PAT growth. We now expect our revenue to be about INR 800 crore and PAT of around INR 125 crore.

guidance.statement: TLS incident expected to reduce FY27 total income by INR 20-23 crore and PAT by INR 10-12 crore, largely in H2
guidance.quote: We expect the incident to reduce our FY27 total income by about INR 20 crores to INR 23 crores and our PAT by about INR 10 crores to INR 12 crores, largely in the second half.

guidance.statement: Incident impact expected to last only next two quarters, then business as usual
guidance.quote: In our opinion, the impact of the incident may only last for next two quarters, after which it will be business as usual.

demand.statement: Enterprise solutions on own five-product platform grew 36% YoY, now two-thirds of revenue; international markets also two-thirds of revenue
demand.quote: The growth is coming from enterprise solutions built on our own five product platform that grew 36% and now makes up two -thirds of our revenue. International markets also contribute two -thirds of our revenue.

demand.statement: Post-quantum migration, machine/AI agent identity, and data privacy are now board-level topics driving demand
demand.quote: Customers now face fixed deadlines on post -quantum migration, on identity for machines and AI agents, and on data privacy. These are now board level topics, especially in banking and regulated industries.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin target maintained at around 25% consolidated level going forward
margin.quote: EBITDA margins are around the 25%. That we will try and maintain because, obviously, our focus is more on the solutions business, which is anyway slightly high gross margins.

order_book.statement: Won national PKI for Nigeria's certifying authority regulator; first Kazakhstan win with defense entity; pipeline growing in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan
order_book.quote: In Africa, we won the national PK I for Nigeria's certifying authority regulator; our entry into that market. In CAS, we secured our first win in Kazakhstan with a defense entity and our pipeline in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan is growing.

order_book.statement: UAE trust services pipeline building while awaiting license
order_book.quote: And in the UAE, our trust services pipeline keeps building as we await our license.

order_book.statement: Won DPDP deal for an NBFC in Q1; momentum continuing in Q2 with B2C banks, NBFCs, private sector; expect more traction next year as DPDP enforced
order_book.quote: We already won a deal in the last quarter itself for DPDP. This is for a NBFC. There is quite a bit of momentum in the current quarter. We should be winning many more deals for the data privacy.

product_mix.statement: CertiNext platform independent of TLS; can connect any SSL vendor; sold standalone in many cases; TLS not bundled requirement
product_mix.quote: CertiNext is a neutral product. With CertiNext, we can connect any SSL given by any vendor. So, in lot of cases, it is sold standalone. It is not sold along with the TLS.

risk.statement: TLS incident: weak keys in 8 intermediate certificates from April 2025 ceremony; revoked next day; none issued to end customers; root keys unaffected; browser programs distrusted related root; KPMG appointed for independent review
risk.quote: On October 17 th, an independent researcher reported weak keys in eight intermediate certificates within one of our public TLS hierarchies created during a key -generation ceremony in April 2025. We revoked all eight the very next day. None of them had been used to issue any certificate to end customers and our root keys were not affected.

risk.statement: AI used to analyze and improve security across technology; other business segments not affected as they don't store data like TLS
risk.quote: But from a technology perspective, whatever possible, we are tracking to analyze with the help of the AI and see what are the further securities to put in place. That work is parallelly going on.

other.statement: Receivables grown in line with business, days stable; creditors declined despite revenue increase, weighing on H1 operating cash flow
other.quote: As our scale has increased, so have our working capital needs. Receivables have grown in line with the business; however, in terms of the number of days, it remains around the same level. Though the revenue has increased, we have paid the creditors without delay resulting in decline in creditors in spite of the increase in revenue. And this has weighed on the operating cash flow in the first half.

other.statement: Only directly affected customer is US University Federation; they continue with CertiNext and asked for TLS subcontract model; no existing contract terminations
other.quote: In the US, the only customer, University Federation, who will be directly affected was using our CertiN ext product and TLS certificate. They have decided to continue to work with us and asked us to provide the TLS certificate to any other TLS vendor on a subcontract model.

guidance.statement: Management reiterates long-term CAGR target of 30%+ but declines to give specific FY28 revenue guidance
guidance.quote: We would want to give it a pass for the moment. I think the only guidance that we want to talk as of now is a consistent CAGR of 30 plus.

demand.statement: Strong order book for H2 FY27 with expected optimal capacity utilization across segments
demand.quote: The order book looks very encouraging and we should be able to achieve the numbers that we have been talking all along.

demand.statement: Commercial refrigeration (deep freezers) seeing strong order book and 70-80% capacity utilization expected in H2
demand.quote: In the coming 6 months, we have a very strong order book and we see almost full capacity utilization or at least 70%, 80% or optimal capacity utilization of the existing capacity in commercial refrigeration.

margin.statement: EBITDA margins expected to remain range-bound at 9-10%; PAT improvement targeted towards 3% net margin
margin.quote: EBITDA, we have been consistently saying that will remain range-bound between 9% and 10%. I think, yes, of course, the bottom line, which is PAT, is something that we are very keen on trying to improve.

margin.statement: Compressor margins currently lower than other segments due to import competition; expected to improve with backward integration from Q4 FY27
margin.quote: compressor for the moment is not giving higher margins because of the simple fact that we are competing with the imported prices. So obviously the margins are lower than what we have in the other

capex.statement: No new capex planned beyond current commitments; all required capex for peak revenue already invested or tied up
capex.quote: No further CapEx, so whatever CapEx has been planned, I think that's there ongoing, and that is what we require as far as our numbers are concerned.

capex.statement: Compressor capacity expansion of 60 lakh units (INR 120-130 crore) targeted for completion by end of FY27
capex.quote: The highest CapEx that was required was for compressors, about INR 120 crores, INR 130 crores, and I think a large portion of that has already been invested.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost pass-through to brands for room ACs expected to be visible in Q3 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: It's an ongoing process, I think, but the effects of that will start to be visible in Q3.

pricing_cost.statement: Pass-through ongoing across all products; other products relatively stable in last 6 months
pricing_cost.quote: Pass-through is happening in all products across. Actually, the price is now for the other products been a little more stable in the last 6 months.

product_mix.statement: AC segment revenue share in Q2 FY27 estimated at 30-40% of overall revenue
product_mix.quote: I think AC in general has been lesser. I think it is between 30% and 40% of the overall.

product_mix.statement: Compressor backward integration at 10-25% value add currently; targeting 60% within a year
product_mix.quote: Compressors, we are sitting at, depending on the model, between 10% and 25% of value add today, we would want to take it to up to 60% in the next maybe a year or so.

fund_raise.statement: Future equity raises possible if debt reaches saturation while maintaining 30-35% growth; no timeline given
fund_raise.quote: As long as we keep looking at a 30%, 35% growth, I think additional capital, external capital will be required. And as I said earlier, that the endeavour has always been to keep the debt equity to below 1 or close to 1.

risk.statement: Star Eltech Chennai facility on hold due to lessor issues; no new similar arrangements expected this year
risk.quote: Star Eltech is currently on hold. It has not progressed from where it was. This is something which is not in our control. This is more to do with the lessors over there.

risk.statement: Supply chain improving but not yet at pre-disruption levels; normalizing gradually
risk.quote: Supply chain is better than Q4 last year with all the disruptions. But yes, not as smooth as before, but it is getting there. So things are normalizing a little bit.

other.statement: AC IDU capacity to reach 14-15 lakh units (1.5-1.6 million) after expansion
other.quote: So we should have a 14, 15 lakh kind of a capacity on the IDU side. 15 lakh, 1.5 million, 1.6 million, kind of a number, peak capacity.

other.statement: Anchor AC client contributes 40-50% of AC revenue; 3 new clients added (Tier 1 & Tier 2); targeting 1-2 more
other.quote: The anchor client will continue to be about 40% to 50% of the overall number that we will do. Rest of it, we have 3 that we have been able to add, and we hope that we'll be going forward, probably 1 or 2 more get added.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 presales guidance of INR 5,000 crores; 41% achieved in H1 FY27
guidance.quote: I'm happy to mention that we've already achieved 41% of our full year presales guidance of INR 5,000 crores in the first half of FY '27.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 launch GDV guidance of INR 8,000 crores
guidance.quote: These are the launches which is planned to take us to the number of about INR 8,000 crores that we have targeted for the current year.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 operating cash flow guidance of INR 700-800 crores
guidance.quote: But for sure that we feel that INR 700 crores to INR 800 crores of the OCF we should be able to garner for the whole of this year.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 collections guidance of INR 3,000-3,100 crores at 70-72% efficiency
guidance.quote: And the collection should pick up to about INR 3,000 crores to about INR 3,100 crores in the whole of the year of FY '27.

demand.statement: Strong demand in Luxury and Super Premium segments driving 84% YoY presales growth in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: Presales performance is driven by strong momentum from Luxury and Super Premium category and establishes and strengthens our brand recall as a premium developer.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 14.5% from 7.1% YoY; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 17.8% vs 8.2% YoY
margin.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 14.5% from 7.1% in Q2 FY '26 and PAT grew to INR 101 crores from INR10 crores in Q2 FY '26.

margin.statement: Urbania LA Fam tower achieved 16% EBITDA margin on GDV of INR 1,300+ crores
margin.quote: we have been able to make the EBITDA margins of 16%. And that is what we have picked up into as a one line item, which is in the PAT number.

order_book.statement: Q3 FY27 Urbania tower launch with GDV of INR 886 crores; total launches till date ~INR 3,128 crores
order_book.quote: In Q3 FY '27, we have also launched our tower at Urbania with a GDV of INR 886 crores. With this, till date, we have launched close to GDV INR 3,128 crores of new launches.

order_book.statement: Q2 FY27 presales of INR 1,423 crores (highest ever quarterly); H1 FY27 presales of INR 2,041 crores
order_book.quote: We delivered presales of INR1,423 crores and collections of INR 541 crores in this quarter. This is the highest ever quarterly presales.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 construction spend increased 21% YoY to INR 547 crores; ~12 msf under development across 19 projects
capex.quote: Our construction spends have increased from INR 452 crores in H1 FY '26 to INR 547 crores in H1 FY '27. This is a 21% growth year-on-year on a half yearly basis.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 land and approval investments of INR 425 crores (41% YoY growth); FY27 total expected ~INR 1,000 crores
capex.quote: Our land and approval investments in the projects have increased to INR 425 crores in this half year compared to INR 302 crores in H1 FY '26. This reflects a 41% year-on-year growth.

product_mix.statement: Commercial foray: 25HQ Prabhadevi (200k sq ft Grade A, lease model); Thane 1.1 msf construction starting FY27; 2030 target INR 10,000 crores commercial portfolio
product_mix.quote: And then Thane, which we've been talking about for quite some time has now come of age, and we should be doing about 1.1 million square feet, construction for which should begin in the financial year.

fund_raise.statement: Mt K Kapital second fund of USD 450 million announced with Marubeni Corporation
fund_raise.quote: I'm pleased to mention that the fund management vertical undertaken by Mt K Kapital continues its expansion with the announcement of a second fund of USD 450 million. This is our venture with the Japanese partner, Marubeni Corporation.

risk.statement: Dindoshi and Om Nagar cluster launches deferred to H1 FY28; launch guidance maintained via GTB Nagar, Avinash Towers, Thane, Dombivli launches in Q4 FY27
risk.quote: So we are looking at Dindoshi in H1 of '28. So that's the kind of planning that we are doing to ensure that we go to the market with Dindoshi and also Om Nagar.

other.statement: Completed 4 RERA projects in H1 FY27 (1.39 msf) 9-15 months ahead of RERA timeline
other.quote: We have completed 4 RERA projects in H1 FY '27 with a total construction area of 1.39 million square feet. The projects are completed 9 to 15 months ahead of its RERA time line.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 collections INR 541 crores; H1 FY27 collections INR 1,141 crores; H2 expected to double H1 run-rate
other.quote: Our collections remained at INR 541 crores in Q2 FY '27 and INR1,141 crores in the first half of FY '27.

guidance.statement: FY27 net revenue growth expected in high teens despite higher base in H2 from GST 2.0
guidance.quote: In spite of the current geopolitical situation, we are confident that we will continue to grow in high teens in FY27, despite post GST 2.0 higher base in Q3 and Q4 of FY27.

guidance.statement: Export revenue guidance of INR180 crores for FY27, confident of crossing it
guidance.quote: Last time we had given a guidance of that we will be from INR145 crores, we will touch INR180 crores and we are very confident will be crossing that.

guidance.statement: Export growth expected >25% YoY on average for FY27, faster growth expected next year
guidance.quote: as I said that our exports will grow more than 25% year-on-year on an average. So, that we are achieving in this year. And even next year we have the clarity to grow even much faster, you know.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin adjusted for aluminium prices at 13.5% or slightly higher
guidance.quote: We are maintaining what I suggested, because if you adjust the abrupt aluminium prices, our margins will come to 13.5% or a little more.

demand.statement: Two-wheeler industry expected to grow ~10% in FY28 after strong FY27, customers bullish and expanding capacities
demand.quote: I think it should still grow at 10%. The industry should grow at 10%.

demand.statement: EV revenue grew 98% YoY in Q2 FY27, EV kit value INR1,250-1,300 vs ICE INR950 (1.3-1.4x multiplier)
demand.quote: EV also we are performing. We have grown in EV by 98% YoY in Q2 FY27.

demand.statement: EV penetration expected to reach 20% of two-wheeler market in next 2 years from current 10%
demand.quote: I think EV in the next 2 years, it should enjoy 20% of the total market.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA INR185 crores (30% YoY), margin 11.8% (lower due to alloy price pass-through), absolute EBITDA growth in line with net revenue growth
margin.quote: Achieved EBITDA of INR185 crores with 30% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 11.8%. However, EBITDA margin percentage appears lower due to pass-through alloy prices.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA INR348 crores (31.3% YoY), margin 11.9% (lower due to alloy price pass-through)
margin.quote: We achieved EBITDA of INR348 crores with 31.3% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 11.9%. However, EBITDA percentage lower due to pass-through alloy prices.

margin.statement: HPDC alloy wheel margins same as ALPS segment, close to company EBITDA margins
margin.quote: Our EBITDA margins are very close in each of the segments.

order_book.statement: Indian OEM alloy wheel supply in final testing stages, breakthrough expected next financial year
order_book.quote: As regards the other Indian customers, as I mentioned, as far as being a safety item, it is in the final stages of the testing. And once that breakthrough comes, so that additional supplies will come only in the next financial year.

capex.statement: 19th plant commissioned for friction material expansion, 20th plant (4th Bangalore plant) commissioning 14-15 Jan 2027
capex.quote: we have commissioned our 19th plant for the expansion in the friction material, the brakes. And 20th plant will be commissioning very soon, likely on 14th January or 15th January 2027.

pricing_cost.statement: Other expenses elevated due to 35% minimum wage increase in Haryana and other states impacting contractual labour charges
pricing_cost.quote: The major part of the other expenses is contractual labour charges that was increased due to heavy increase in minimum wages in Haryana and other states.

product_mix.statement: Aftermarket revenue ~11% of total revenue, growing faster than brake segment
product_mix.quote: Our aftermarket is growing as per the growth of the company, and it generally outgrows the brake segment. And it normally, of the overall revenue, it constitutes about 11%.

product_mix.statement: Passenger vehicle revenue grew 79% YoY in Q2, 67% YoY in H1 FY27
product_mix.quote: See, in passenger vehicle, we have grown by 79% in this quarter, you know. And overall, also we have grown in the half year also, we have grown by 67%.

other.statement: Previous plant with INR380 crores investment running at 90% capacity utilization
other.quote: the previous plant, which we had put, with an investment of about approximately INR380 crores, that is now running on full capacity of 90% capacity utilization.

other.statement: Honda contributes ~35% of total revenue, content per vehicle slightly higher than other customers
other.quote: Honda being the leading customer, it still enjoys about, I think, 35% of our total revenues.

guidance.statement: Management declined to provide forward-looking financial targets
guidance.quote: I can, I can give you a number, as I've been, I know I cannot give any future looking statements.

demand.statement: El Nino driving almond, walnut, pistachio prices up significantly; cashew relatively stable but supply needs to increase
demand.quote: We all know that there is an El Nino which is there from a dry fruit perspective excluding the cashew all other dry fruits, which is almonds, walnuts, pistachio, everything has significantly increased. Much more, maybe some of them have doubled up as well. Cashew has not.

margin.statement: EBITDA per kg stable at 7 rupees despite revenue growth; percentage margins decline as raw cashew prices rise
margin.quote: The prices are 150 rupees per kilo of raw Cashew nuts and the value addition margins are 27 rupees. Minus the operating cost, which is 20 rupees, our EBITDA per kg would remain 7 rupees.

capex.statement: Board approved 114 crore expansion including 100 crore for shelling and cardanol plant plus 14 crore staff housing
capex.quote: The total project cost will be around 100 crores, including the land and manufacturing unit, and the staff housing colony will be for 14 crores. This is still a total of 114 crores.

capex.statement: CNSL and solar plants in final stages; commercial production expected mid to end December subject to approvals
capex.quote: Both are in the final stages. We are expecting this to be completed, subject to approvals and all those stuffs. Maybe mid or end of December, I can take conservatively as the start times.

pricing_cost.statement: Kernel realization averaging 735-738 rupees; derived from raw cashew price, shell prices, and packing costs linked to crude oil
pricing_cost.quote: So, we have on an average a kernel realization of around 735 to 738. The realizations depend upon 3 aspects one is the raw cashew nuts , second is the shell prices that we get in the market and then finally how the processing cost and the packing material cost is behaving.

risk.statement: Management acknowledges past timeline misses; now giving 30-month conservative timeline for new expansion
risk.quote: We have learned also from a management perspective that when you give internal timelines, It is something that is something that the larger group takes us as clearly, as you know, non-negotiable, and you can see that, you know, the project that we have now given has been given with a 30 months' timeline.

other.statement: Shelling capacity to expand from 140 to 200 metric tons per day with 60 ton addition on adjacent land
other.quote: This will be increasing to 200 tons per day capacity from 140 existing. So, the additional capacity is of 60 metric ton.

other.statement: Short-term borrowings rose from 111 to 232 crores due to higher raw material prices, longer transit times, and delayed Diwali; finance cost flat at 8.39 crores
other.quote: The borrowing at H2 end of FY26 was 111 crores. The end of H1 FY27 was 232 crores. These are terminal numbers on that date. The impact.is really seen in the finance cost from a finance cost perspective the finance cost was 8.36 crores for the H2 of FY26. The finance cost for H1 of FY27 is 8.39 crores.

guidance.statement: Management does not disclose forward-looking numbers but expects quarter-on-quarter growth trend to continue in Q3 and Q4 FY27
guidance.quote: those are all forward-looking numbers. Okay. So, I'm not able to comment on that. But quarter -on-quarter, if you observe it, we are growing. So, our Q1 was better than Q4. Our Q2 was better than Q1. And hopefully, the same trend will continue in Q3 and Q4.

demand.statement: Infrastructure product business facing delivery delays and weekly price increases for the last year, expected to continue for another year
demand.quote: currently the situation at the infrastructure products is slightly difficult because the delay in the deliveries, pricing going up every week, those are the challenges we saw coming up for the last one year and it will continue to be there for another one year as well.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 263 bps QoQ to 10.20% in Q2 FY27 from 7.57% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 22.45 crores, an increase of 45.6% quarter-on-quarter from Rs. 15.42 crores. And our EBITDA margin has expanded by 263 basis points from 10.20% to 7.57% in Q1 of FY27.

margin.statement: Margins sustainable if revenue mix stays at approximately 60% services and 40% products
margin.quote: So, until and unless this ratio or the mix of business remains the same, meaning approximately 60% of the services and 40% of the products. If the mix remains the same, I think the margins are definitely sustainable.

order_book.statement: Order book stood at Rs 331.61 crore as of September 30, 2026, to be built by March 31, 2027
order_book.quote: As of September 30th, 2026, our order books stood at Rs. 331.61 crores, representing business expected to be built up to March 31, 2027.

order_book.statement: Order book composition: Rs 132 crore product orders and Rs 199 crore services orders as of September 30, 2026
order_book.quote: Out of which 132 crore is product orders and 199 crore is the services order. So, this can be built before 31st of March, 2027.

capex.statement: Plan to invest approximately USD 5 million in cybersecurity expansion, hire around 100 cybersecurity professionals, and target 12% expansion in cybersecurity customer base
capex.quote: We plan to invest approximately USD 5 million in this expansion, hire around 100 cybersecurity professionals, and target a 12% expansion in our cybersecurity customer base.

product_mix.statement: Services revenue grew 24.95% QoQ to Rs 130.99 crore in Q2 FY27, contributing 59.6% of revenue vs 51.92% in Q1
product_mix.quote: Revenue from Services grew by 24.95% sequentially to Rs. 130.99 crore , while revenue from products stood at Rs. 88.78 crores, compared with Rs. 97.09 crores in Q1 of FY27. Services contributed 59.6% of revenue compared with 51.92% in Q1 of FY27, supporting the expansion in our EBITDA margin.

product_mix.statement: Managed services contracts typically 3-year tenure, some 5-year or 7-year; all managed services are recurring revenue
product_mix.quote: most of the managed services order is basically 3-year contract. So, we try and book it for 3 years, most of the contracts. But there are certain contracts which are 5-year or 7-year also.

other.statement: SOC and NOC facility at Turbhe currently at just over double-digit percentage utilization, expected to reach full capacity by Calendar Year 2027
other.quote: currently, it is just over double-digit percentage. More and more, after quarter, you will see the percentage will keep on growing and within a year or so, I think we should be at the full capacity usage over by Calendar Year ‘27.

other.statement: Board approved interim dividend of Rs 2 per share for FY27, representing 20% of face value
other.quote: the Board of Directors has approved an interim dividend of Rs. 2 per share for FY27, which is 20% of the face value, balancing the shareholders' return with investment in strategic growth opportunities.

guidance.statement: FY28 revenue guided at INR7,200-7,300 crore and FY29 at INR7,700-8,000 crore
guidance.quote: For FY 2028, we are looking at a revenue of about INR7,200 crores, INR7,300 crores, and FY 2029, we should be close to about INR7,700 crores, INR8,000 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue expected to exceed INR6,000 crore vs earlier INR5,600-5,700 crore target
guidance.quote: we had targeted this year FY 2027 with a revenue of about INR5,600 crores, INR5,700 crores, but we are on course to do more than INR6,000 crore s for FY 2027

margin.statement: Punjab EBITDA per ton improved from ~INR2,500-3,000 in Q1 to substantially higher in Q2; will rise further as utilization increases
margin.quote: If you see the Punjab facility, the first quarter, because we were operating at only at about 76%, 77%, the EBITDA per ton was about close to INR2,500 per ton, INR3,000 per ton only, which is substantially higher this quarter.

order_book.statement: Technical textiles expanded capacity fully stabilized and placed in domestic and export markets
order_book.quote: We are fully stabilized on the production, and we have placed our material well in the domestic as well as the export market.

order_book.statement: Technical textiles addition to contribute ~INR80-90 crore incremental revenue in FY27 (half-year impact)
order_book.quote: Typically, this would give us an additional top line of about INR150 crore s, INR160 crores. So we should get about INR80 crores, INR90 crores additional for FY 2027

capex.statement: FY27 capex ~INR200 crore; FY28 capex ~INR400 crore with some spillover to FY29
capex.quote: The capex for the current year is close to INR200 odd crores, and for the following year, it would be close to INR400 odd crores.

capex.statement: MP cotton yarn project (INR400 crore) on track; groundwork by early Jan 2027; production by end CY2027; full stabilization by end FY28
capex.quote: We aim to start getting set foot on ground by early January, and we aim to get into production by end of the calendar year and stabilize fully by the end of the financial year.

product_mix.statement: Consolidated revenue mix: polyester 87%, cotton 10%, technical textiles 3%; Standalone: polyester 77%, cotton 18%, technical textiles 6%
product_mix.quote: On a consolidated basis, polyester contributed close to 87% of the revenue, cotton close to 10%, and technical textile close to 3%.

other.statement: Gross debt ~INR1,350 crore by FY27 end; net debt ~INR1,150 crore; FY28 gross debt to reduce by ~INR120 crore
other.quote: Gross debt would be close to INR1,350 crores at the end of the year. Net debt would be close to INR1,150 crores. Next year, the gross debt should reduce by approximately INR120 odd crores.

other.statement: EU FTA will give India advantage vs Bangladesh for yarn, fabric, garment exports
other.quote: With the FTA coming in, yes, we will now be at an advantage in terms of yarn exports also, and more so with the fabric and garment exports.

guidance.statement: Long-term ambition to reach INR 1,000 crores revenue by FY2030 through organic growth and diversification
guidance.quote: As discussed previously, the company has articulated an ambition of reaching INR 1,000 crores in revenue by Financial year 2030. This remains a long -term ambition and depends on the business opportunities, order inflows, execution capabilities, condition of the market and the company's financial health.

demand.statement: Strong demand in CGD driven by PNG mandate; solar target 500GW by 2030; water infrastructure opportunities
demand.quote: Since April and May that in this current business of CGD, already with PNG drive has taken place, and in the geography in India, wherever the piped natural gas is available and if our citizens are not using piped natural gas, there has been a compulsion mandate has already taken place by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas through their PNGRB which is regulatory board.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 19.45% vs 21.38% YoY; PAT margin 12.66% vs 14.68% YoY
margin.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 19.45% as compared with 21.38% in H1 Financial year '26. PAT margin 12.66% compared with 14.68% in H1 Financial year '26.

capex.statement: CBG pilot plant operational at 97-98% capacity; commercial injection into Adani Total Gas pipeline expected before Diwali
capex.quote: We already had a pilot project. We even had flared the compressed biogas for 60 days to see whether this monsoon weather makes any hindrance to run that plant or not. But it has done quite wel l, and calorific value, and 97% to 98% capacity has already been incurred. I hope before Diwali, we are definitely going to make this on the commercial

capex.statement: UAE subsidiary Desco Global participated in ADNOC tender; price bid opening expected in 2-3 months
capex.quote: Desco Infratech subsidiary, Desco Global has already participate d in the tender with ADNOC. So yes, I am waiting for the opportunity to open the price bid, and let's hope for the best that we even get that opportunity to work in Ras Al Khaimah moving forward in the next 2 to 3 months

product_mix.statement: Diversifying from CGD into power distribution, solar EPC, compressed biogas, water treatment, and international EPC
product_mix.quote: we are moving as an infrastructure energy -mixed EPC company such as city gas distribution, power and transmission d istribution, solar EPC solution , then, what we call, the water treatment

risk.statement: Geopolitical uncertainties in Middle East monitored for impact on crude-linked material prices, logistics, procurement costs
risk.quote: We are actually, basically conscious of the geopolitical uncertainties that has taken place already in Middle East and their potential impact on crude-linked material prices, logistics, procurement costs. But at present, we are closely monitoring these developments.

other.statement: Other current assets increased due to PNG drive execution; certifications and billings started, cash conversion expected in 45-60 days
other.quote: Considering the nation's emergency and our participation into the same sector, we have executed state jobs, and certifications, billings, measurements already has started, and I am expecting it to be getting converted into cash in the next 45 to 60 days maximum.

other.statement: Project execution capability now INR 50 crores+ per project; infra projects completed ~INR 340 crores
other.quote: Our infra projects completed approximately INR 340 crores and project size capabilities now stand at INR 50 crores plus.

guidance.statement: Targeting consolidated revenue of INR1,500 crores by FY29 with equal contribution from nuts and ice cream divisions
guidance.quote: Further, we have set ambitious target of achieving consolidated revenue of INR1,500 crores for FY29, and all our efforts in capacity ramp-up, even distribution network expansion, and everything, new product launching in both the segment whatever we are doing is, by keeping this FY29 targets in the sight.

guidance.statement: Targeting ~50% revenue growth and ~50% EBITDA growth in FY27; H1 FY27 revenue grew 50% and EBITDA grew 63%
guidance.quote: As outlined in our investor presentation, we are targeting approximately 50% growth in top line and 50% growth in profitability in current financial year, that is FY27.

demand.statement: Expect nuts growth of 20-25% in next 2-3 quarters; ice cream growth nearly double nuts growth
demand.quote: We expect next two to three quarters, 20% to 25% growth in the Nut segment, whereas in ice cream the growth will be much more than this, almost double the Nut segment.

margin.statement: Nuts EBITDA margin target 15-16%; ice cream EBITDA margin target 15-16% at full capacity utilization in FY29
margin.quote: See, nuts business, EBITDA beyond 18% is very challenging, I tell you. So, our target EBITDA in nuts is 15% to 16%, or our target EBITDA in ice cream is also 15% to 16%. When -- in ice cream, when optimum capacity is utilized in FY'29.

order_book.statement: Added 85 new distributors in Q2 FY27, total 205; distributor retention rate ~95%
order_book.quote: During the quarter, we added 85 new distributors taking overall distributor count to 205. We have also maintained a distributor retention rate of approximately 95%.

order_book.statement: Deep freezer network at 18,752 units end Q2 FY27; target 27,000 by end FY27; products across 35,000+ retail touchpoints in 6 states
order_book.quote: As of end of Quarter 2 FY27, our deep freezer network stood at 18,752 units with the target of reaching to 27,000 deep freezers by the end of this financial year.

pricing_cost.statement: Managed input cost pressures (El Nino, sugar, crude oil) via sound sourcing and inventory buildup; ice cream EBITDA 16% vs 8% target in Q2
pricing_cost.quote: Even in ice cream, in this period we have seen expansion of EBITDA beyond our expectation as Quarter 2 is relatively less top-line growth because of monsoon for ice cream, there an also profitability has been maintained.

product_mix.statement: Nuts portfolio includes flavored cashews, almonds, pistachios, makhana, trail mixes; INR20 MRP affordable range expanding; ice cream adding zero added sugar options
product_mix.quote: We are also expanding our affordable on-the-go offering through INR20 MRP range which include trail mixes, cereal mixes, salted nuts, mixed assorted nuts, roasted almonds, and assorted mixes.

risk.statement: FY29 identified as inflection point for net profit margin expansion as operating leverage kicks in; current depreciation/finance costs high due to deep freezer expansion
risk.quote: Financial year '29 is our inflection point. So, our -- this expansion, growth, everything will continue for next two years, and financial year '29 will be the inflection point.

other.statement: Ice cream installed capacity is 1 lakh liter per day; expect 37% utilization in FY27 and full utilization by Q1 FY29 yielding INR600 cr top line
other.quote: Current financial year, we expect to reach almost 37% of the ice cream capacity of the installed capacity. And as full capacity utilization, we are targeting in Q1 FY29, the full capacity utilization in ice cream can give us INR600 crores top line.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 export shipment to Singapore USD384,000; planning US market entry next year and Japan exploration
other.quote: During this quarter, Quarter 2, we had a very good export shipment to Singapore. The shipment to Singapore during Quarter 2 amounted to USD384,000.

guidance.statement: Revised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 40% YoY and PAT margin expansion to 150 bps over FY26
guidance.quote: On the top line for this financial year, we should grow by 40% over previous financial year. And on the bottom line PAT point of view, it should be growing by 1.5% from previous guidance of 1%.

demand.statement: Demand healthy across India and international markets (US, Europe, Middle East); company ahead of full-year FY27 guidance on revenue and profitability
demand.quote: Demand remains healthy across and our international markets, the United States, Europe and the Middle East, and we are ahead of our full year FY27 guidance on both revenue growth and profitability.

margin.statement: Gross margin expanded 515 bps YoY to 25.1% in Q2 FY27; management says margin sustainable and will grow due to permanent price reset and brand premium
margin.quote: Gross margin improved by 515 basis points year-on-year to 25.1%. Our India business grew 45% year-on-year and our international business grew by around 40%.

margin.statement: Inventory gains contributed 125-150 bps to gross margin expansion; balance from brand pricing power and realization improvement
margin.quote: Of this, it will be fair to assume that somewhere between 125 to 150 basis points is on account of the advanced inventory strategic decisions that have been taken. And the substantial part is on account of our ability to enhance our price, have a better realization, get the proposition well established and well received.

order_book.statement: Q2 volume 225k units, H1 volume 374k units; laptops 78-80% of revenue; volume growth ~25% YoY in Q2
order_book.quote: So in the quarter 2, we have had a total volume of about 2,25,000-odd units. And for the first half, the number is about 3,74,000-odd units.

capex.statement: Doubled India refurbishment space 2-3 quarters ago; expanded UAE from 3-4 to 8 facilities; headcount more than doubled since IPO
capex.quote: In India, we have almost doubled our space almost 2, 3 quarters back. In UAE also, we have enhanced from 3, 4 facilities to almost 8 facilities.

pricing_cost.statement: New laptop prices up ~80% YoY (INR35-40k to INR65-72k); refurbished ASP up 11% in H1; management sees permanent price reset enabling higher refurbished pricing at 30-45% of new
pricing_cost.quote: A year ago, the sweet spot for a laptop in India was around INR35,000 to INR40,000. That same computer today is now between INR65,000 to INR72,000.

risk.statement: Management acknowledges inventory risk if memory prices crash but cites strategic buying at old prices, brand pricing power (30% to 45-50%), and real-time intelligence as mitigants
risk.quote: In a kind of unlikely scenario, I would say, where memory prices come crashing down or the computer prices, which I don't believe for a moment will happen. In that situation, also since we are buying ahead of the curve, we have a significant cushion.

other.statement: Electronics Bazaar brand now top-of-mind in multiple markets; customers ask for brand by name; 5,542 customer touchpoints (up from 5,130); 55 countries supplied (up from 49)
other.quote: As of the end of Q2 FY27, Electronics Bazaar supplies to 55 countries, up from 49 at the end of Q1. Customer touch points stand at 5,542, up from 5,130.

other.statement: Inventory and receivable increases funded substantially through accruals; equity plus debt guidance covers working capital needs
other.quote: Yes, it is substantially accruals driven. So if you look at the inventory and receivables and payables, all of this factored in, this stacks up with our equity plus the debt guidance that we have given.

guidance.statement: SteriPort Line 3 expected to contribute INR60 crore in FY27; earlier guidance of INR110 crore annual revenue to be met with optimal utilization
guidance.quote: So we expect it to contribute about INR60 crores in the current financial year, that is FY '27, in top line. And we expect that our earlier guidance of about INR110 crore annual revenue will be met with the optimal utilization of the line.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue target INR420-430 crore; 2-year aim: 20%+ revenue CAGR and 25%+ EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: With these investments, we have set ourselves a clear 2-year aim, revenue growth of 20%-plus CAGR and EBITDA margins of 25%-plus.

demand.statement: Strong SteriPort demand across onco, critical care, anesthesia, pediatrics; selling all production; hospital ICU/HDU space growing robustly
demand.quote: SteriPort is built on advanced ISBM technology, continues to see strong customer acceptance for its advantages in stability, safety, and reduced patient risk with demand across high-value therapies such as onco care, critical care, anesthesia, and pediatrics.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 21.6% despite polymer price volatility; absorbed cost increases via product/market mix and price hikes (~4-4.5%)
margin.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is also up by about 22%, which is INR18 crore, and EBITDA margin has remained healthy at 21.6% despite all challenges of overhead and new raw material price pressure.

margin.statement: Gross margin pressure from polymer price volatility (70%+ spike); expect normalization in 3-6 months; price hikes of INR0.70-1.80 per bottle (~4-4.5%) implemented
margin.quote: I think the price hike varies from around INR0.70 per bottle to maybe around INR1.80 per bottle, depending upon the product. So average relation increase could be around roughly INR1.

order_book.statement: Out-licensing/CDMO revenue ~INR25-30 crore annually (ophthalmic portfolio); classic contract manufacturing only 2-3% of revenue
order_book.quote: So that's where you will see a flavor of CDMO. But I think contract manufacturing, classic contract manufacturing, we don't do much. We hardly 2%, 3% of our revenue, but we do develop products and license out. So that is roughly -- I think this is INR25 crore to INR30 crore revenue.

order_book.statement: SteriPort Line 3 expected INR60 crore revenue in FY27; SVP line conservative estimate INR16 crore in FY28; inhalation portfolio potential INR35-60 crore but speculative
order_book.quote: So we expect it to contribute about INR60 crores in the current financial year, that is FY '27, in top line.

capex.statement: SVP expansion capacity rising ~52% from INR20.9 crore to INR31 crore; commissioning in Q1 FY28
capex.quote: After SteriPort, our next expansion is in small volume parenterals, where capacity will rise by roughly 52%, from INR20.9 crores to roughly INR31 crores during Q1 FY '28.

capex.statement: Future capex focused on product development, regulatory filings, automation; quantum INR7-20 crore
capex.quote: So product development, dossiers, and regulatory filings and automation at the plant level. These are -- there is -- the quantum may not be as high as SVP also. This could be anything from INR7 crore, INR8 crore to INR20 crore, but these are all part of developing product pipeline.

pricing_cost.statement: Captive 10.8 MW solar plant operational since end of Q1 FY27; expected INR9 crore annual power cost saving
pricing_cost.quote: Captive solar is also expected to deliver about INR9 crore of annual power cost saving, and that will also help in EBITDA as well as bottom line improvement.

product_mix.statement: SVP expansion dedicated to inhalation (6 products, 2 commercialized) and preservative-free ophthalmics; 20 products in pipeline (12 in SVP)
product_mix.quote: So we have 20 products in the pipeline. Out of 20, roughly 12 are in SVP and that's split between inhalation and ophthalmics. So inhalation portfolio of 6 products, 2 are already commercialized, additional 6 products will be developed in due course.

risk.statement: Polymer price volatility (linked to oil) absorbed in Q2; expect normalization in 3-6 months; SVP ramp-up speculative due to tech transfer and regulatory variation timelines (6-9 months)
risk.quote: The polymer price is linked to oil, as we know, and I think there was more than 70% increase, and it remained like that for roughly 1 month or so. Then it came down again, it has gone up again, it's coming down. So plastic prices have been very volatile.

other.statement: SteriPort Line 3 commissioned early September 2026, capacity up ~75% from INR6.6 crore to INR11.6 crore annually; full ramp-up by 20 Nov 2026
other.quote: We commissioned it in the first week of September 2026 at our existing Kheda facility, taking our SteriPort capacity up by about 75%, from INR6.6 crores per year to roughly INR11.6 crores.

other.statement: SVP new line expected 40-50% utilization in first 2 quarters post-commissioning (Q1-Q2 FY28) due to product transfers and regulatory filings
other.quote: So because SVP line is specifically meant for inhalation products only. In initial stage, we hope -- we are hoping around 40% to 50% utilization for first 2 quarters because other products are being developed and they'll be transferred from one line to other line.

guidance.statement: Full-year consolidated revenue growth guidance maintained at ~30% including M&A contribution (<5%)
guidance.quote: In terms of overall guidance, the 30% is inclusive of these M&As which we have planned.

guidance.statement: Online business expected to continue strong growth; core online grew 34% in H1
guidance.quote: Our core business is stronger than ever. Our first half core online business grew at 34%.

guidance.statement: Offline Vidyapeeth expected to turn EBITDA positive this year; overall offline near breakeven
guidance.quote: We are on track. Last year to this year, Vidyapeeth has already turned profitable at a stand-alone entity and overall offline also will inch toward near breakeven is what we are guiding.

guidance.statement: PAT positive target for full year FY27
guidance.quote: As committed at the start of the year, we are holding ourselves accountable to closing the year at PAT positive for the full year.

demand.statement: Government exam enrollments down 24% due to vacancies and forms not released
demand.quote: There is one miss, that is the government exams enrollment, down by 24% because of the vacancies and the forms not coming out.

demand.statement: Categories beyond JEE/NEET contributed 73.8% of H1 enrollments vs 64.8% last year
demand.quote: The base is broadening. Categories beyond JEE NEET contributed 73.8% of H1 enrollments, up from 64.8%.

demand.statement: NEET demand delayed in Q1 appeared in Q2; online NEET collections up 27%, enrollments up >30%
demand.quote: NEET demand that was delayed in Q1, result came out on 16 July, a month late, showed up in Q2. So, in Q2, we saw NEET demand. Online NEET collections up by 27% and enrollment up over 30%.

margin.statement: Q2 Pre-Ind AS EBITDA INR233 cr, up 45% YoY at 18.8% margin (+350 bps)
margin.quote: Our EBITDA was again highest ever in the quarter at INR233 crores in Q2, pretty much in line with the highest revenue quarter that I just talked about. This is up 45% from INR161 crores from Q2 of last year, translating into 18.8% margin against 15.3% that we did in the same year, an expansion of 350 basis points.

margin.statement: Online EBITDA margin 34.4% in Q2; management not reinvesting margins aggressively into marketing
margin.quote: In terms of margin, online margins, we are confident that we will deliver as we guided. There are no aggressive plans to shift those margins into marketing.

margin.statement: Employee cost (ex-ESOP) down 2.3% YoY in Q2; marketing spend as % of revenue improved 1.2% in H1
margin.quote: Our employee costs without ESOP costs were lower by 2.3% as compared to last year quarter, and at H1 level, lower by 2.4%.

order_book.statement: Q2 unique enrollments up 12.9% to 1.5M; unique transacting users 3.44M vs 3.22M
order_book.quote: Q2 unique enrollments are up by 12.9% to 1.5 million and 3.44 million unique transacting users or students, up from 3.22 million.

order_book.statement: Infinity Pro collections up 32%, share of collections rose to 35% from 31%
order_book.quote: ACPU on unique enrollments up 9.2% to INR4,280 Infinity Pro collections up by 32%, with their share of collections rising to 35% from 31%.

order_book.statement: Skills enrollment up 10.3x to 1.69 lakh; CA enrollments up 19%; NEET PG enrollments 9,500 up 35%
order_book.quote: Skills enrollment up 10.3x to 1.69 lakh. CA enrollments up by 19%. NEET PG enrollments at 9,500, up by 35%.

capex.statement: Tech/AI spend H1 INR104 cr vs INR70 cr last year (+1% of revenue)
capex.quote: Our overall tech spends for H1 were INR104 crores as compared to INR70 crores last year, an increase of 1% as compared to the first half of last year as a percentage of revenues.

capex.statement: IPO proceeds INR1,800 cr to be utilized over 2 years; <USD20M allocated for M&A from unidentified bucket
capex.quote: We now have INR1,800 crores of IPO proceeds that we will utilize over the next 2 years.

product_mix.statement: PW Digital University incorporated (notified Oct 29); will offer UG/PG degrees digitally; admission cycle July next year
product_mix.quote: PW Digital University Incorporated, and it is India's first greenfield digital university, which will solve for our forward integration.

risk.statement: NEET full-cycle collections still 7% below last year; enrollments 13% lower; offline NEET enrollments 8% lower for academic year
risk.quote: Full cycle online NEET collections are still 7% below last year, with enrollments 13% lower. Offline NEET enrollments for the academic year are 8% lower, and we expect this gap to be reflected in full year NEET numbers.

other.statement: 106M cumulative app downloads; 4.1M DAU with 98 min engagement
other.quote: Quick catch-up on funnel that we have 106 million cumulative app downloads and 4.1 million daily active users, with the engagement of 98 minutes.

other.statement: Acquired 11% in Sarrthi IAS for INR71 cr; now largest in civil services by enrollments and collections
other.quote: We also acquired 11% in Sarrthi IAS, translating to INR71 crores, with that transaction getting consummated in this quarter.

guidance.statement: FY27 volume growth ~25-26% YoY expected; H2 volumes expected better than H1
guidance.quote: the current year, we are expecting, around 25% increase in the quantities, 25%-26% increase over the last year. If you take that into account, our second half is expected to be better than the first half

guidance.statement: No specific quarterly or next-year EBITDA per ton guidance given; 75k-85k is long-term sustainable range not quarterly guidance
guidance.quote: the 75,000 -85,000 is a long -term sustainable rate, we believe, given the overall mix of the business. It is not intended to be a guidance for any quarter or specific year

guidance.statement: Long-term sustainable EBITDA per ton of ~Rs 85,000 post Phase-3 at optimal utilization; 26% volume growth seen sustainable for FY27
guidance.quote: we believe post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 per ton should be sustainable

demand.statement: Sustained growth across power generation, transmission, renewables, electrification, industrial and digital infrastructure; OEMs expanding capacity
demand.quote: We see sustained growth and investments across power generation, transmission and related equipment driven by grid infrastructure development, renewable energy integration, electrification and growth , electricity requirements from industrial and digital infrastructure

demand.statement: India CTC demand expected ~120k-130k tons by FY30 excluding exports; HVDC and 765kV add incremental demand
demand.quote: by FY '30, we expect the overall CTC, the demand to be approximately around 120,000 tons to 130,000 tons in India

margin.statement: Export profitability 3-5% better than domestic historically; premium expected to sustain
margin.quote: As far as the export business is concerned, we have said earlier that the profitability is 3 %-5% better than the domestic. And that has been the historical trend

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA/ton ~Rs 101,400 driven by elevated CTC mix, higher exports (32% revenue), 76% utilization, weaker rupee, recycling/solar benefits
margin.quote: In Q2 FY '27, we reported EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 1 01,400 per metric ton up from roughly Rs. 93,000 per metric ton in Q1 and Rs. 65,500 per metric ton a year ago

order_book.statement: Export revenue grew 108% YoY and 44% QoQ in Q2; exports now 32% of revenue vs 26% in Q1
order_book.quote: Export revenue in Q2 grew 108% year -over-year and 44% higher than last quarter. As a result, exports represented almost 32% of our revenue in Q2, up from 26% in Q1

order_book.statement: Target to return exports to historical ~40% of revenue over next 1-2 years on expanded capacity
order_book.quote: our objective over the next few years is to return exports to its historical average of around 40% of total revenue

order_book.statement: Received trial order for 2 HVDC transformers overseas; Power Grid approved Supa facility for up to 765kV transformers and reactors
order_book.quote: Last quarter, we received a trial order to supply specialized wires for 2 HVDC transformers overseas, which demonstrates that our HVDC opportunity is not just confined to India alone

capex.statement: Phase-3 capex up to Rs 185 cr over next 18 months funded by internal accruals and long-term debt; majority spend in FY28
capex.quote: The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance this expansion, which also includes he purchase of an additional 10 acres of land in Supa and it will be funded with a combination of internal accruals and long-term debt

capex.statement: Additional 10-acre land purchase in Supa enables ~20,000 MT future capacity beyond 72,200 MT
capex.quote: that would give us approximately say about 20,000 tons of capacity additional if required

pricing_cost.statement: LME copper price and FX are direct pass-through; business is make-to-order
pricing_cost.quote: LME copper price and exchange rate is a direct pass through

pricing_cost.statement: Conversion charge increase not significant driver of EBITDA/ton rise; mix shift to higher-value products (CTC, exports, HVDC) is main driver
pricing_cost.quote: the contributor to the increase in conversion rate s is not that significant in the overall increase in EBITDA per metric ton

product_mix.statement: Phase-3 adds specialized wire capacity for transformers, EV motors, renewables, railways; will skew mix further toward specialized
product_mix.quote: Once that is complete, the mix will skew more so towards specialized wire than it is today

product_mix.statement: PEEK wire for EV still in pilot/trial stage; meaningful volume contribution expected post FY29 after qualification cycles
product_mix.quote: for it to truly translate into a volume business, I think it would be somewhere in FY '29 onwards

risk.statement: US AI data center CAPEX slowdown risk minimal as it's <10% of revenue; core T&D drivers (grid, renewables) remain strong
risk.quote: US anyway, in terms of overall contribution is less than 10%, of the revenues for us

other.statement: Phase-2 expansion 96% complete as of Sep 9, 2026; installed capacity 57,845 MT available for H2 FY27
other.quote: We are very pleased to have completed 96% of both Phase -1 and Phase-2 of our capacity expansion as on September 9th, 2026, roughly 6 months ahead of schedule. Period end capacity stood at 57,845 metric tons and is now available for H2 of FY ' 27

other.statement: Over 120 domestic and global OEM customers; repeat revenue >95%; wallet share focus with existing export customers adding capacity
other.quote: We are a B2B company servicing over 120 leading domestic and global OEM customers and maintain long term relations with these customers with repeat revenue in excess of 95%

guidance.statement: Management says H1 FY27 results are well in line with full-year targets and expects stronger H2 performance.
guidance.quote: We are pretty much well in line with achieving our targets. We would like to in fact, see if we can top it up. However, I may not just give you any number at the moment. We want to back our projections with the visibility we have. And then there is a pretty decent projection for the H2 we have in front of us.

demand.statement: Received out-of-the-box opportunity from energy sector; advanced stage of signing MOU with one customer and finalizing orders with a second customer driven by PLI obligations.
demand.quote: We have received an out-of-the-box opportunity from energy sector. At the moment I may not be in a position to share names, but we are at an advanced stage of signing an MOU with a customer. And furthermore, we are also at a very advanced stage of finalizing orders with a second customer.

margin.statement: Medical-grade monitors carry 30-40% margins; overall margins sustainable due to design control and end-to-end solutions.
margin.quote: Margins, if I were to talk, we have a pretty decent margin of about 30% to 40% in these medical-grade monitors because we have designed these ourselves and we manufacture them locally. So we enjoy a very healthy margin on these products.

margin.statement: Confident margins are sustainable; different segments have different margins but average will be maintained.
margin.quote: Very confident. Reason being, we are not just a trading company where the margins will waver. We design the product. So we have design controls, we are approaching a time where we are able to offer an end-to-end solution.

order_book.statement: Order book visibility of about INR30 crores to be executed in the next 12 months.
order_book.quote: And as far as the order book is concerned, we have a visibility of about INR30 crores to be executed in next 12 months' time frame.

capex.statement: Goa Fast Track project capex of INR9 crores plus INR3 crores working capital.
capex.quote: So the capex planning for the Goa Fast Track, which is happening pretty quickly, is about INR12 crores, where the capex is INR9 crores and about INR3 crores is for the working capital.

product_mix.statement: Focus on specialized displays for defense/aerospace, railways/transportation, medical/healthcare, industrial automation; no intention to enter commercial displays (TV, phone, laptop).
product_mix.quote: So I can say that we do not intend to enter the commercial market as of now. For the foreseeable future, we will never be making a TV or a cell phone display or a laptop or a monitor display because those are commercial displays and we do not have any intention of entering those markets.

other.statement: MSME payment terms target 45 days; using LC discounting for cash flow; export customers moving to LC terms.
other.quote: Since we are an MSME, 45 days is standard. We try to make sure that our payments are received within 45 days at the latest. Wherever there is also an LC from some customers, we get the discounted, so it helps us in the cash flow. But Yes, 45 days is something that we have made sure that the payment cycle should be completed.

other.statement: Total borrowings INR7.08 crores (long-term INR2.7 crores, short-term INR4.38 crores) as of 30 Sep 2026; IPO proceeds deployed for Goa factory; additional fundraise may be needed for owned facility.
other.quote: As of 30th September 2026, total assets stood at approximately INR43.62 crores, shareholders' funds at INR29.08 crores, long-term borrowings were INR2.7 crores, and short-term borrowings at INR4.38 crores, taking total borrowing to approximately INR7.08 crores.

guidance.statement: Targets 88% capacity utilization by FY28 with 25% capacity growth from current levels
guidance.quote: Sir, in the year '28 we plan to achieve this 88% of capacity. We'll be growing by 25% the capacity that we have currently.

guidance.statement: Engineering segment to contribute 22-25% of revenue in current year with higher blended margins
guidance.quote: This year, again, we'll be doing almost 22% to 25% of revenue will be coming from the engineering category.

guidance.statement: Expects stronger H2 FY27 with premium furniture and engineering services growth plus deferred price recovery from September
guidance.quote: The premium furniture revenue will be more stronger in the second half. The engineering services business will also be more stronger in the second half. And also the deferred price fluctuations that happened in September, that also will contribute to a more stronger H2 results that we foresee.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 20.3% vs 11.5% in H2 FY26, full year FY26 margin was 20.7%
margin.quote: EBITDA margin improved from 11.5% in H2 to 20.3% in H1 FY27, broadly in line with the full year '26 margin of 20.7%.

margin.statement: H2 FY26 margin drop to 12% vs 36% in H1 FY26 due to higher home appliance mix (30%) and tooling revenue with lower margins
margin.quote: In H2, our home appliances business actually took almost 30% of the revenue in that half year, impacting the overall EBITDA margins.

capex.statement: Adding injection molding machines takes 45-60 days; generic 350-450 ton machines available in 15 days
capex.quote: And adding a molding machine does not take much time. It takes a time of almost 45 to 60 days at max to add an injection molding machine in plant.

capex.statement: Plans machine additions in FY28-29 as capacity approaches 88% utilization
capex.quote: Above 88%, we would always think of again reinvesting and adding a few machines so that we spare up the capacity for newer projects.

pricing_cost.statement: October billing includes ~INR1.45 Cr recovery from September polymer price increases due to 1-month pass-through lag
pricing_cost.quote: So, my prices have gone up in the month of October, and we have already billed those components at higher pricing in the month of October itself, which is to the tune of, I would say, almost close to INR1.45 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material cost was ~75% of revenue in H1 FY27; 22% polymer price increase from 20% crude rise with 1-month pass-through lag
pricing_cost.quote: During this period, the volatility in the crude oil markets also translated in substantial increase in the polymer pricing, but our customer contracts provide corresponding raw material price adjustments.

product_mix.statement: H1 FY27 revenue mix: 53.4% premium office furniture, 26.9% home appliances, 19.7% engineering solutions
product_mix.quote: The revenue mix for first H1 FY27 comprised 53.4% from premium office furniture, 26.9% from home appliances, and 19.7% from engineering solutions and other applications.

product_mix.statement: New drip irrigation vertical to emerge from engineering co-design project with Toro; adds high-margin, sticky customer relationship
product_mix.quote: There will be one more vertical which will move out from the engineering and it will be created or treated as a separate vertical for our business where we can actually approach another value-added clients.

other.statement: Engineering services EBITDA margins can reach 50-65% on in-house design activities
other.quote: I can say that when we do only the services part of this development activity, the EBITDA margins can go up to almost, I can say, more than 50% or at sometimes close to 60%, 65%.

other.statement: Co-design irrigation project with US MNC Toro approved for production phase; customer investing in molds and assembly machines
other.quote: Now we are in a stage that we have moved forward to the production phase, that is building of the molds and assembly machines for this particular project, where the customer will be investing for their molds and the assembly machines.

guidance.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin target 19-21%, internal target 20%
guidance.quote: Unless, we see further headwinds on the commodity prices, we believe that, 19% to 21%, internal target of 20% of EBITDA is a doable target for us.

order_book.statement: Order book expected at INR 2,000-2,200 crore by March 2027
order_book.quote: Currently we are sitting at around INR2,000 crores. We believe that it will grow a little bit from here, and to best estimate by March end it should be in the same range-bound INR2,000 crores to INR2,200 crores types of order book.

order_book.statement: Order book at INR 2,000 crore as of 30 Sep 2026, up 12% QoQ and 93% YoY; export order book at all-time high ~INR 500 crore
order_book.quote: Our outstanding order book as of 30 September , 2026 stood at INR2,000 crores approximately, compared with INR 1,778 crores at the end of June '26 and INR1,030 crores, INR1,000 crores approximately, at the end of September '25. The order book grew 12% sequentially and 93% Y -o-Y, providing strong visibility for the coming quarters. The export order book was also at an all-time high.

capex.statement: FY27 capex ~INR 75 crore for new machine capacity (conversion, recycling, coating) and maintenance; new assembly shed planned
capex.quote: This year the figure is something like INR75-odd crores, which is to add some capacity of new introduction of machines that we have done, especially on the conversion and recycling machinery side, as well as some maintenance capex as well. And we intend to start building a new shed in times to come, in near future, in time to come to add more assembling capacities.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue INR 594 crore (+42% YoY, +18% QoQ); H1 FY27 revenue INR 1,097 crore (+50% YoY)
other.quote: Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR594 crores, compared with INR418 crores in Q2 of financial year '26, representing Y-on-Y growth of 42%. On a sequential basis, revenue increased by 18% from INR 503 crores in Q1 FY27. For the first half of financial year '27, consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR 1,097 crores, registering growth of 50% over INR 734 crores of last H1.

other.statement: Net working capital cycle 92 days as of 30 Sep 2026 vs 84 days at end FY26; customer advances key to working capital
other.quote: Our net working capital cycle as of 30 September , 2026 stood at approximately 92 days , compared with 84 days at the end of financial year '26. Customer advances continue to be an important element of our business model, supporting order execution and working capital requirements.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of approximately INR950 crores with full-year EBITDA margin broadly similar to FY26
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve our p reviously communicated FY27 revenue guidance of approximately INR950 crores with a full -year EBITDA margin profile broadly similar to FY26

guidance.statement: FY28 expected to see similar year-on-year growth as FY27; specific FY28 guidance to be given in Q4 call
guidance.quote: So, it will be in a similar territory. But right no w, we won't have a number to say. Perhaps in the, you know, the Q4 call, we'll have a guidance number for FY28

demand.statement: Railways market opportunity ~1,000 traction substations in next 5-10 years translating to ~INR20,000 crores
demand.quote: And that's about 1,000 traction substations in the next 5 to 10 years, which translates into roughly INR20,000 crores of market opportunity.

demand.statement: Shunt reactor market ~30,000 MVAR; typical ratings 50-125 MVAR at 245 kV and 420 kV; current execution broadly 245 kV with some 420 kV
demand.quote: So, roughly the market is around 30,000 MVAR. And the typical ratings are like 50 MVAR, 63 MVAR, 80 MVAR, 125 MVAR. Higher ratings be ing in 420 kV and the lower side being in 245 kV

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin was 35%, PAT margin 25.8%; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 32.3%, PAT margin 23.5%
margin.quote: EBITDA m argin was 35%, while PAT margin stood at 25.8%. For the half-year H1 FY27, revenue grew 109% year-on-year to INR345.7 crores. EBITDA margin was 32.3% and PAT margin stood at 23.5

margin.statement: No one-off in H1 margins; quarter-to-quarter and order-to-order variation; guiding prudently at FY26 EBITDA margin level
margin.quote: There is no one-off as such, but having said that, it will be fair to say that there is variation in the, quarter-to-quarter or order-to-order kind of m argins. And so that is the reason why we have maintained the full-year EBITDA margin guidance at basically the same level as

margin.statement: Order book gross margin profile broadly similar to FY26 executed margins
margin.quote: So, order book margin is on a gross margin level. And that gross margin level is quite similar between the FY26 gross margin level and FY27 as wel l. So, that remains at that point, broadly similar to that line

order_book.statement: Order book stood at INR2,711.2 crores as of 30th September 2026, up 34% from end of Q1

margin.statement: EBITDA margin floor at 14%, targeting 18% then 20% over next 1-2 years
margin.quote: we would like to look at this as a floor as I have stated earlier as well, it is something it is a sustainable EBITDA margin improvement. going forward, first step would be to get to 18%, and then to 20% EBITDA margin over the next year

order_book.statement: Order book at Rs 60 crore remaining to execute; Rs 30 crore moved to production over last 3 quarters; existing part ramp-up potential ~Rs 20 crore annually
order_book.quote: the order booking is now at, around 60 crores of remaining order book to be executed. Earlier we had 90 crores, of order book, new product orders, and 30 crores is moved into production over the last 3 quarters.

capex.statement: Capex supported by new term loans, board-approved Rs 45 crore funding plan, and internal accruals
capex.quote: the CAPEX is supported by new term loans, as well as partly by the board -approved Rs.45 crore funding plan and internal accruals.

pricing_cost.statement: Three steel price revisions in Q2 passed on to customers; Vriddhi Council projects targeting material cost reduction
pricing_cost.quote: we have been keeping material costs, under control, even though the steel prices have been shooting up. We had almost 3 price revisions in the last quarter, which have passed on to customers.

fund_raise.statement: Fundraise utilization: Rs 20-30 crore for incremental working capital for revenue growth, remainder for capex and general purposes
fund_raise.quote: utilization of the funding growth is for incremental revenue. That would be around say 20 to 30 crores. And the remaining would be for CAPEX, as well as some general administrative purposes and contingencies.

risk.statement: Press reconditioning and plant relocation caused 18.5% sequential revenue decline in Q2; activities completed by November, production restoration underway
risk.quote: The press reconditioning and driveline plant relocation had cut sequential revenue by 18.5%. However, our margins have absorbed on a largely fixed cost.

other.statement: Exports at 14% of sales (Rs 7.6 crore), broadly in line with 15% a year ago; new export programs replacing legacy business with better margins
other.quote: exports, these are at 14% of sales, that's 7.6 crores, broadly in line with 15% a year ago. But the changes that we hav e new export programs, which have replaced phased -out legacy businesses.

other.statement: OEM revenue Rs 41 crore in Q2 FY27, up 41% YoY; fifth consecutive quarter of OEM revenue growth
other.quote: OEM revenues, which are in blue here on the chart, have increased to 41 crores in Q2 FY27. This is a 41% year-on-year growth and the fifth consecutive quarter of OEM revenue growth.

guidance.statement: No meaningful capex planned for FY27; focus on debt repayment and wait-and-watch on capital allocation
guidance.quote: Yes, there is no meaningful CapEx that is planned for the year. Paying down our debt is something that is of vital importance to the company to improve our balance sheet and continuously improve our balance sheet.

demand.statement: Domestic sugar demand ~28.5 MMT; opening stocks ~3.5 MMT, lowest in over a decade

margin.statement: H1 FY27 operating margin improved 383 bps to 6.9% from 3.1% YoY

order_book.statement: Water business order book ₹1,452 crore as of 30 Sep 2026 (₹404 crore EPC + ₹1,048 crore O&M)
