capex.statement: No meaningful capex planned for FY27; only minor steam efficiency improvements
capex.quote: Yes, there is no meaningful CapEx that is planned for the year. What I can share with you is what we may look at is some steam improvement in efficiency measures, but again, nothing terribly significant.

And the next big crop that is coming is actually many months away, and this will be the Bihar crop followed by the UP crop, which will only come in May of 2027. other.statement: Sugar closing inventory 1.03 lakh MT (vs 1.69 lakh MT YoY) valued at ₹38.6/kg; lower inventory reduced working capital intensity
other.quote: The closing inventory as of the 30th of September 2026 stood at 1.03 lakh metric tonnes compared to 1.69 lakh metric tonnes a year ago, which also, of course, had an impact of reducing our working capital intensity. The sugar in stock as of the 30th of September 2026 is valued at ₹38.6 per kilo.

guidance.statement: Target loan book of INR 2 lakh crore by end of FY27 and INR 3 lakh crore by 2030
guidance.value: INR 2 lakh crore, INR 3 lakh crore
guidance.quote: We are targeting that during this year, this financial year, we will be around INR 2 lakh crores loan book. By 2030, we had given an initial guidance two years back that we will be achieving around INR3 lakh crores loan book.

guidance.statement: Internal disbursement target of INR 65,000 crore for FY27
guidance.quote: Disbursement target, yes, we have kept an internal target of INR 65,000 crores. During H1, we had already achieved more than INR 35,000 crores.

guidance.statement: Target ROA of 2% to 2.2%
guidance.quote: Regarding ROA, we are trying to maintain between 2% - 2.2%, and definitely we will be maintaining that kind of ROA.

guidance.statement: Negative credit costs expected for next one to two years due to provision reversals

margin.quote: If you see, without this EBR of 20,000, presently also our spread is 1.96%, which is just around 2%, and our net interest margin is 2.93.

capex.statement: Monetizing assets; targeting 1 lakh sqm of space creation over next three years to generate income
capex.quote: A lot of assets we are monetizing, and around 1 lakh square meters of the space we will be creating in the next three years of the time, and we are expecting that income will start coming from that.

pricing_cost.statement: Bond yields elevated ~8%; raised INR 2,200 crore in Q1 at ~7-7.25%; waiting for better rates
pricing_cost.quote: Coming to the bonds as you see, the bond rates are quite elevated these days for the last two, two and a half months. It is hovering around 8%. pricing_cost.statement: Bank borrowing cost at ~7.25%
pricing_cost.quote: From banks also, we are able to raise money at around 7.25%.

other.statement: Gross NPA declined to ~0.7%, Net NPA ~0.04%; committed to zero Net NPA shortly
other.quote: Our gross NPA has declined to around 0.7%, and net NPA is just above zero, that is 0.04%, and we are committed to become zero Net NPA company very shortly.

other.statement: Provision coverage ratio ~95% enabling provision reversals
other.quote: Because the provision coverage ratio is around 95%. So definitely there will be the reversals for a year or two.

guidance.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 180 bps YoY to 27.2%, well ahead of guidance of 125-170 bps; expect similar trends for rest of year
guidance.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter 2 stood at 27.2%, an expansion of 180 basis points year-on-year, well ahead of our guidance of 125 to 170 basis points.

guidance.statement: Management expects FY27 revenue growth around 16% and EBITDA margin expansion of 180-200 bps for full year
guidance.quote: So we did say that the first half of the year was about 16% is good revenue growth and about 180 to 200 bps margin growth. So we expect the similar trend to continue for the rest of the year as well.

guidance.statement: H1 FY27 revenue grew 16.2% and EBITDA margin expanded 190 bps to 26.2%; management expects similar growth and margin trajectory for rest of FY27
guidance.quote: For the past 2 years, our growth was around 12% to 13% organically per year. However, over the last 4 to 6 quarters, we have stepped that up to 15% to 16% with revenue growing at 16.2% for H1 FY27, ahead of our stated guidance.

demand.statement: Patient volumes grew 10% and test volumes 11% in Q2 FY27; B2C revenue grew 17%, B2B grew 15%
demand.quote: Patient volumes grew by 10% and test volume around 11% with the balance coming from a richer test mix and better realization.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 190 bps to 26.2% without any price increase
margin.quote: Importantly, we have delivered the step-up in growth while expanding EBITDA margins by 190 basis points to 26.2% EBITDA margin for the first half, and this is without any price increase so far in the year.

margin.statement: Medium-term margin expansion opportunity of 125-150 bps per year from operating leverage, lab platform transition, productivity initiatives, and future price revisions
margin.quote: So net of it, we clearly see an opportunity to improve the margins, maybe 125 to 150 bps in the coming years also.

order_book.statement: B2B partner network crossed 9,000 partners; partner retention improved to very low single-digit churn via MetLink program

pricing_cost.quote: Given our strong volume trends and the structural shift towards trusted organized players, we believe there is room for a calibrated price increase, enabling us to pass on a portion of these cost increases without any meaningful impact on volumes.

product_mix.statement: Specialty and TruHealth each grew ~20% YoY in H1 FY27; Specialty contributes 40% of revenue, TruHealth 17%
product_mix.quote: TruHealth contributed 17% of revenue and grew 20% on a year-on-year basis, while Specialty contributed 40% of revenue and grew 20% on a year-on-year basis.

product_mix.statement: Added 43 specialty and super-specialty tests in H1 FY27; genomics and oncology portfolio accelerating post Core acquisition
product_mix.quote: We added 43 specialty and super specialty tests in the first half of the year, giving us further headroom for growth.

other.statement: Same-store growth of 10% in existing centers; newer centers ramping up; digital engagement and micro-marketing driving patient acquisition

other.quote: Core was at breakeven when we acquired it 1.5 years ago, and today, it is delivering near double-digit margins. Taking into account the acceleration of our genomics business, we estimate that in the past year, our IRR on the Core acquisition is at about 13%.

guidance.statement: FY28 revenue growth target of ~15% subject to order inflows
guidance.quote: Yes, I mean, see, of course, subject to the order inflows and project executions, we can reasonably target a growth of around 15% in the next fiscal.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance raised to ~20% for FY27 from earlier 15%
guidance.quote: Considering the growth which we have witnessed in H1 of this fiscal, we are expecting that the growth would be closer to 20%.

demand.quote: Recent key development was the approval of Green Energy Corridor Phase-III, with a total outlay of approximately INR1.86 lakh crores, including INR1.36 lakh crores towards interstate transmission infrastructure.

margin.statement: Target standalone EBITDA margin 10-11%; 11% if commodity costs stabilize, else ~10%

order_book.statement: Appointed dates for two awaited projects expected by end of December or January
order_book.quote: Yes, the expectation as of now is that they should arrive within this quarter, by the end of December or in January.

capex.statement: Capex guidance INR200-250 crores for FY27 (INR83 crores done in H1); similar range for FY28

And for the next fiscal year, it would be around the same range of INR200 crores.

risk.statement: NTPC battery project: force majeure invoked due to war-driven price spike; revised bid issued; discussions ongoing to complete project
risk.quote: Yes, so see the force majeure clause was activated considering this war situation. The prices, you know, of the battery have skyrocketed. That is why that particular clause got activated. So we are quite positive to complete this project, but there are certain terms which are underway discussion.

other.statement: Working capital days increased to 152 days (from 128 days at FY26 end) due to higher debtor and inventory days
other.quote: The working capital in days at the end of September 2026 is 152 days compared to 128 days at the end of fiscal 2026. The increase is primarily on account of increase in debtor days and inventory days.

product_mix.quote: So Cluster 2 is more or less in the same lines as what we report out for consol as a whole. So it's somewhere around 26% - 27%.

risk.quote: We may see some slowdown or stoppage of construction activity with the pollution -linked norms for construction activity that may impact over the next 1 or 2 months.

other.quote: we have a significant bed addition pipeline that is expected to ad d approximately 3,450 beds over the next few years. This represents almost a doubling of our network capacity to over 7,600 beds.

other.statement: Average revenue per patient (ARPP) increased 3% YoY to INR 2.06 lakhs supported by favorable case mix
other.quote: Average revenue per patient, ARPP, increased by 3% year-on-year to INR 2.06 lakhs, supported by favorable case mix and increasing contribution from high-acuity specialties.

guidance.statement: Reaffirmed EBITDA margin target of 13-15% for FY28

guidance.statement: Expects Egypt plant revenue of INR 25-30 crores in FY27 from Jan-Mar sales
guidance.quote: Egypt FY27 say INR 25 crores to INR 30 crores, we are expecting the revenue from the Egypt plant. That is, considering only Jan, Feb, March, these three months of sales.

guidance.statement: Targets 35% revenue CAGR over next three years
guidance.quote: Otherwise, we are on track only to achieve. So, in the next three years, we have said that we will achieve a CAGR around 35%.

demand.statement: PVC pipe industry saw 18-20% degrowth April-Sept 2026, recovery from mid-September
demand.quote: So, Arnav, as per data that we have received from April to September, there has been a significant degrowth in the PVC industry, PVC pipe industry. So, this is also the records that we have.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin declined to 8.9% in Q2 FY27 from 13.8% in Q2 FY26 due to shipping costs and lower high-margin product share
margin.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 10.8 crores with an EBITDA margin of 8.9%, compared to INR 13.6 crores and 13.8% respectively in Q2 FY26.

capex.quote: Mainly due to Capital Advance given to Project Suppliers by our Egypt Subsidiary.

product_mix.statement: Oleochemicals sales INR 11.4 crores in Q2 FY27, INR 16.7 crores in H1 FY27
product_mix.quote: Sales from this segment generated an amount of INR 11.4 crores in Q2 FY27 and INR 16.7 crore in H1 FY27.

risk.statement: Shipping costs expected to remain elevated for next 3-4 months

other.quote: But in the case of lead-free stabiliser in H1 FY27 versus H1 FY 27, then there is a drop of 3 to 4%.

guidance.statement: FY30 INR 2,000 crore revenue target remains on track based on current run rate and FY27 projections

order_book.statement: Won multi-year mandates: 3-year enterprise deal with a global security depository; $10.8M 4-year Costa Rica training institute deal (~$2.7M annual); INR 39.32 crore power utility CX center of excellence; 3-year VRL Logistics CX mandate; e-c

capex.statement: Capex focused on AI platform development; CWIP ~INR 80 crore; further expenditure expected in coming quarters but within comfortable range; no exact number given
capex.quote: We will continue investing in our AI platform and expect to incur some further expenditure. We can't give an exact number yet, but this is well within our comfortable range.
